The Ritz
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1906 by César Ritz, this Piccadilly institution was designed by architects Mewès and Davis to resemble a French château.
The interiors are defined by their Louis XVI style, featuring extensive gold leaf, marble columns, and intricate garlands.
Its signature Afternoon Tea is served in the glazed Palm Court, while the dining room holds a Michelin star.

Name: The Petersham
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on Richmond Hill, this privately owned Victorian landmark has been stewarded by the Dare family since 1978.
The property combines 19th-century character with a riverside setting, serving as a discreet retreat from the city.
Its interior features a Portland stone staircase—reputedly the UK's tallest unsupported example—and a restaurant where floor-to-ceiling windows frame the famous bend in the Thames.

Name: The Mirage
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Carved into the rocky slopes of Tinos by Kois Associated Architects, this subterranean residence is designed to vanish into the Cycladic landscape.
Its character is defined by radical camouflage, using local dry stone walls to merge with the hillside rather than imposing upon it.
The standout feature is a rimless infinity pool that serves as the roof, reflecting the Aegean sky to create a shimmering optical illusion.

Name: Chateau Marmont
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Modeled after the Loire Valley’s Château d’Amboise, this 1929 West Hollywood landmark was built as apartments before becoming a hotel owned by André Balazs.
The property offers soundproof suites and hillside bungalows that retain a residential layout with full kitchens and discrete private entrances.
A long-standing ritual involves ordering the signature Spaghetti Bolognese on the garden terrace, a central gathering point for industry figures.

Name: Den Mother
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Elisa Angelone in a restored 1930s craftsman bungalow on Abbot Kinney, this Venice Beach spot serves as a holistic neighborhood retreat.
The interiors prioritize natural materials, blending Japanese and Nordic design elements with cedar walls and stone fixtures for a residential feel.
A signature contrast therapy circuit pairs private saunas with cold plunges, concluding with relaxation time in the property's secluded outdoor garden.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: At least 24 hours notice required for cancellations or rescheduling. Cancellations or rescheduled appointments made less than 24 hours in advance will result in a 50% cancellation fee.

Name: Tanya Bonakdar Gallery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1994 by Tanya Bonakdar, this Chelsea contemporary art gallery represents a roster of established artists including Olafur Eliasson and Ernesto Neto.
The gallery focuses on large-scale installations and multimedia works across a wide spectrum of disciplines.
Housed in a former taxi garage renovated by Rogers Partners, the building features expansive exhibition spaces tailored for monumental photography and sculpture.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NA

Name: Museum of Jurassic Technology
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by David Hildebrand Wilson and Diana Drake Wilson, the Museum of Jurassic Technology is a cultural institution in Los Angeles.
The space functions as a modern cabinet of curiosities, presenting a collection of artistic, scientific, and ethnographic exhibits that blur the line between fact and fiction.
Visitors conclude their journey at the Tula Tea Room, a Russian-style study where tea is served from a traditional coal-fired samovar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NA

Name: Hotel Bel-air Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Nestled in the canyons of Los Angeles, Hotel Bel-Air Spa is a wellness retreat operated by the Dorchester Collection with interiors designed by Alexandra Champalimaud.
The facility blends Swiss skincare with holistic therapies within a secluded garden setting.
The 4,000-square-foot space features seven treatment rooms and offers the signature Valmont Vitality of the Stars facial.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NA

Name: Hillcrest Country Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1920, Hillcrest Country Club in Los Angeles features an 18-hole golf course originally designed by Willie Watson and renovated by architect Kyle Phillips.
Established by the local Jewish community, the institution became a central social hub for the entertainment industry.
The clubhouse Grill centers around a large oak "Round Table" that served as the regular lunch spot for comedians like Groucho Marx and Jack Benny.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NA

Name: The Academy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within five Georgian townhouses in London’s Bloomsbury, this YTL Hotels property features interiors by New York-based Champalimaud Design.
The hotel balances modern city style with literary heritage, offering an intimate atmosphere that feels more like a private residence than a standard hotel.
A secluded courtyard garden provides a rare outdoor sanctuary, while the Alchemy Bar serves bespoke cocktails and the signature Mr. Ma’s Afternoon Tea.

Name: Bel-Air Country Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by George Thomas in 1925 and restored by Tom Doak, this course is routed through the canyons of Los Angeles.
The layout navigates steep terrain via a system of tunnels and an elevator built into the hills.
A swinging suspension bridge spans a deep gulch on the tenth hole, connecting the tee to the green.

Halehouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at Stanly Ranch in Napa Valley, this Auberge Resorts wellness hub was created with TLEE Spas + Wellness as a dedicated recovery destination.
The facility functions as a performance center rather than a traditional spa, offering a social, circuit-based approach to restoration that targets sleep and physical recovery.
Its Springhouse circuit anchors the experience with a hyperbaric oxygen chamber, salt therapy room, and an undulating cedar sauna overlooking the vineyards.

Name: Cavallo Point
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set beneath the Golden Gate Bridge, this LEED Gold-certified lodge occupies the restored Colonial Revival buildings of the former Fort Baker.
The property juxtaposes historic officers' quarters with modern hillside suites, creating a retreat dedicated to sustainability and culinary culture.
Guests settle into rocking chairs on the expansive front porches to watch the fog roll over the bay and city skyline.

Name: The Treasury
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in Perth’s 19th-century State Buildings, this contemporary hotel is a celebrated heritage restoration by architect Kerry Hill.
The property balances Victorian grandeur with a minimalist aesthetic, offering light-filled spaces that feel more like a private residence.
Visit the rooftop Wildflower restaurant, where the tasting menu revolves around the six seasons of the indigenous Noongar calendar.

Name: Sotheby's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Hopkins Architects-designed Gate Village in the DIFC, this gallery is overseen by Katia Nounou Boueiz.

Members receive access to training facilities worldwide, scheduled around individual calendars and organized by Aurora, plus end‑to‑end fitness and longevity testing with results integrated into Aurora. Digital firesides led by Nims, group meet‑ups with fellow climbers, practice hikes, full kit outs, and coordinated transport support both preparation and the journey to the mountain. Aurora can also arrange travel and accommodation end to end, along with viewing opportunities for family and friends who want to follow the climb and mark the summit.

Name: Mr. Drip Live Portrait Session
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sit for a live drip-painting session with contemporary artist Mr. Drip in his private Miami studio or on location worldwide. Known for recent live portraits of Carlos Alcaraz, Will Smith, Paul Pogba, Shaquille O’Neal, and Neymar Jr., he works at large format in real time, building a likeness with layered splashes and paint drips.

You watch the full process unfold—from a blank canvas to a finished work—then leave with a one-of-a-kind portrait, signed and personalized by the artist. The session can center on an individual or an animal and is often arranged for parents, friends, or partners, including as a surprise for birthdays or anniversaries.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Goodwood Aerodrome Arrival and Goodwood Motor Circuit Car Rentals
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Arrive by air at Goodwood Aerodrome in West Sussex, set beside the Goodwood Motor Circuit and Goodwood House. The aerodrome accommodates light aircraft, turboprops, and helicopters. For jets, the nearest major airports are London Gatwick (around 40 minutes by road) and Farnborough (about 45 minutes), both with full private aviation facilities.

On the ground, take the wheel of period and performance machinery with rentals that include the Jaguar E‑Type Coupe and Roadster, AC Cobra, Ford Mustang GT350, Mini Cooper S in classic rally specification, Lotus Cortina, and Formula Junior and other single‑seater race cars. Private hires also extend to classic sports cars, Jaguar E‑Type, AC Cobra, Aston Martin DB series, and historic Formula cars, in keeping with Goodwood’s heritage. Additional supercars from leading manufacturers are available on request.

Name: Design your Self-Care Routine with Dr. Jonathan Leary
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Co-create a personalized, sustainable self-care plan with Dr. Jonathan Leary, founder of Remedy Place and a leader in “social wellness.”

Begin with a goals and lifestyle assessment (sleep, stress, travel load, training), then build a weekly protocol that can include breathwork, mobility and posture work, recovery blocks (contrast therapy, red light, lymphatic/compression), chiropractic tune-ups, sauna/ice, and nutrition/hydration habits.

This plan can be completed in person or digitally.

Members receive priority access and preferential pricing.

Name: BXR London Bishopsgate Personal Training and Recovery Suite
Master_Aurora_Insights: Train privately on the 25th floor of BXR London’s Bishopsgate club, surrounded by panoramic city views. Aurora members receive access typically reserved for BXR members, with training inside a facility that pairs elite boxing and performance work with a full-scale Recovery Suite. The suite offers contrast therapy (ice baths plus infrared sauna), Normatec compression therapy, cryotherapy, and infrared therapy. BXR’s Marylebone location is also accessible. Following an initial private visit, Aurora members may enquire about extended membership.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Members are required to provide at least twenty-four (24) hours' notice for the cancellation or rescheduling of appointments for treatments at the BXR Clinic, and at least twenty-four (24) hours' notice for the cancellation or rescheduling of personal training appointments. In the event that a Member fails to attend an appointment without providing the required notice, the Gym reserves the right to charge the full cost of the service for that appointment.

Name: Recover: Global IV and on-location massage
Master_Aurora_Insights: Aurora Wellness Suite brings vetted recovery therapies directly to you, wherever you are, at any time. The offering includes IV drips, vitamin boosts, massage delivered at home, in clinic, or on location, and access to private contrast therapy suites and venues. It supports different rhythms of travel and work: after a late night in London, easing jet lag in Paris, or a Sunday reset before a demanding week. Available globally and designed to move with you, it places therapies and bodywork in the setting you choose.

Name: Breathe: Global Breathwork and Meditation
Master_Aurora_Insights: Aurora connects you to Breathe: Global Breathwork and Meditation, a worldwide network of leading breathwork guides and meditation practitioners. In New York, London, Los Angeles, Dubai, Tokyo, or beyond, Aurora can dispatch a vetted expert to your accommodation or current location, or arrange a meeting in a private wellness space within minutes of any premier urban hotel. Formats include private in-person instruction solo or group as well as seamless on-demand digital sessions. Members use the service to reset after long travel, relieve stress and anxiety, and build sustained focus and resilience ahead of high‑stakes performance. Modalities span Wim Hof–style breathwork, transcendental meditation, and sound-led practices, with sessions personalized to setting and need.
Master_Country: United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Japan

Name: Chef Masa Tokyo Fish Market and Sushi Apprenticeship
Master_Aurora_Insights: An apprenticeship-style program with Chef Masa that moves from Tokyo’s fish markets to his private kitchen. It opens on the market floor, walking stall to stall with Masa to assess the catch and discuss sourcing. Back in his kitchen, the session is a hands-on apprenticeship covering rice mastery, fish sourcing, knife skills, and sushi creation. Instruction stays at the board and counter, focused on handling, cutting, and the sequence from prepared rice to finished sushi. You work beside the chef to turn market selections into precise preparation.

Name: Contrast: Cold plunge, Sauna and Cryo
Master_Aurora_Insights: Aurora connects members to a worldwide network of cold plunges, saunas, contrast therapy suites, and cryo chambers. In New York, London, Los Angeles, Dubai, and other major hubs, a chamber or therapy suite is, on average, within 10–15 minutes of any premier urban hotel. Members use it for physical recovery from injury, stress resets after long travel or demanding schedules, and advanced performance and longevity optimization, on demand, wherever they are.
Master_Country: United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates

Name: Eric Ripert Long Island Oyster Farm Tour and Dinner
Master_Aurora_Insights:
An oyster farm immersion on Long Island with Eric Ripert, chef of the three‑Michelin‑starred Le Bernardin in New York. Grounded in his East Coast ties and focus on sustainable seafood, the day combines fieldwork and dining.

You tour the farm, learn to shuck, and take part in reef seeding. Reef seeding here typically involves placing recycled oyster shells and juvenile oysters (spat) to build living reefs that filter water, provide habitat, and protect shorelines. The day concludes with a coastal dinner hosted by your chef, centered on the farm’s harvest.

Also available in Calicia, Brittany, and the Algarve with chefs Nathan Outlaw and Alex Atala.

Name: TAKU Mayfair Omakase Dinner
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Aurora Edge secures priority reservations at TAKU in Mayfair, an edomae omakase built around a 16-seat counter. Led by co-founder Lucas Leong, the experience is a multi-course progression with live preparation, direct chef interaction, and concise storytelling behind each plate.

Guests have behind-the-counter access, watching chefs season rice, cure fish, and assemble nigiri in sequence. Seasonal Signature or Prestige menus run to 20-plus courses, incorporating truffle, caviar, and aged fish, with rare sakes and wines overseen by sommelier Bowie Tsang. You sit within a serene, counter-forward room shaped by Leong’s design, which places the craft in clear view.

TAKU received a Michelin star within four months of opening in November 2022. The lineage traces to Jin in Paris, the first omakase in the city to earn a Michelin star, which it has held for a decade under founder-chef Takuya (Taku) Watanabe. Watanabe began in Sapporo at 19, trained three years in a traditional kaiseki kitchen, then led Jin to a star in its first year before establishing his London omakase in Mayfair.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All cancellations or changes will be subject to a £50 administration fee. Reservation cancellations or changes made within 72 hours of the booking date may result in the full pre-payment being retained. Due to the nature of the presentation of the Omakase menu, each guest must arrive when doors open and last entry will be within 20 minutes of the booking time. Otherwise we must cancel the reservation and retain the pre-payment.

Name: Cloud Nine Alpine Bistro Snowcat Dinner in Aspen
Master_Aurora_Insights: After dark, you travel by snowcat from Aspen Highlands to Cloud Nine Alpine Bistro, accessible only by snowcat in the evenings. Known for an après-ski atmosphere, it serves an alpine-inspired menu: classic fondue and raclette, with champagne, set against sweeping views of the Maroon Bells.

Name: Aspen Private Snowshoe with Chef Lunch and Champagne
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private, guided snowshoe tour through Aspen’s backcountry. Routes are tailored to your pace and interests—quiet alpine forest for solitude, open stretches for panoramic mountain views, and mileage to suit the group. The trek leads to a secluded mountain setting, where a chef-prepared lunch is paired with champagne in an après-style pause.

Name: Napa Valley Winemaking with Philippe Melka
Master_Aurora_Insights: A two-day winemaking program in Napa Valley led by Philippe Melka, the winemaker behind labels including Melka Estates, Hundred Acre, and Bryant Family. Over two days, you work through core cellar practice: guided blending sessions, barrel tasting, and a final bottling finished with a custom label. The program can also be arranged in Bordeaux, the Douro Valley, and Tuscany with winemakers such as Paul Hobbs and Thomas Duroux.

Name: Massimo Bottura Modena Collaborative Cooking
Master_Aurora_Insights: An experimental kitchen session in Modena with Massimo Bottura, chef of Osteria Francescana. The focus is modern technique and the creative process: you work with Bottura to develop a menu guided by his method and your preferences, then cook the courses alongside him in the kitchen. Optional companion sessions can be arranged with Grant Achatz in Chicago and José Andrés in Washington, D.C., echoing the same experimental forma

Name: Flyfish Club Omakase Counter Dinner and Lounge Cocktails
Master_Aurora_Insights: A members-only evening inside Flyfish club, experiencing its signature omakase counter, followed by drinks in the lounge. The night opens at the chef’s counter for an omakase progression—courses selected and served in sequence directly across the counter, with the pace set by the kitchen. After the final bite, you transition to the lounge for cocktails mixed by the bar team.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Tour Flyfish Club with founder David Rodolitz
Master_Aurora_Insights: A personal tour of the Flyfish Club, the members-only gourmet social club on Manhattan’s Lower East Side blending fine dining, a lounge, bar, and exclusive omakase experience under one roof.  Conducted in person by founder David Rodolitz, the visit runs directly with Rodolitz as he guides you through the spaces and decisions that define his work.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: SHA Wellness Mexico Longevity Retreat
Master_Aurora_Insights: SHA Wellness Mexico in Playa Mujeres, near Cancún, offers a science-based longevity and wellness retreat. It’s roughly a 4.5-hour direct flight away, with November–May bringing dry weather and calm seas. The program combines diagnostics, nutrition, and restorative therapies. On arrival, you complete a consultation and wellness evaluation, then move into hydrotherapy and IV therapy before a sunset sound healing session. Morning programming includes yoga and a metabolic cooking class, with an aesthetic treatment or massage in the afternoon, followed by an anti-inflammatory tasting dinner. Aurora amenities at this property include complimentary treatments in addition to the booked program.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Provided that you give at least 14 days’ notice, you may cancel your booking without any charge apart from a 3% administrative charge on the amount to be refunded. After this period, a charge equivalent to 50% of the services contracted during the booking process will be applied. A deposit of 50% of the total amount of the booked services is required to confirm the booking. In the event that the accommodation booked is in a Royal Suite, the amount required for confirmation will be 100%. In the event of early departure with respect to the initially contracted stay, 100% of the costs corresponding to the booking will be applied in full, with no refund permitted.

Name: Mongolia Horseback Trek with Nomad Guides
Master_Aurora_Insights: A test of time and terrain across the Mongolian steppe, offered June–September. You ride on horseback with nomad guides across open grassland with no roads and no fixed destination. There is no itinerary; pace and direction follow weather, water, and the condition of the horses. Camp where the day ends, keep kit light, cook over a small fire, and move on at first light. Days are measured by wind and fire, by the feel of the saddle and the line of the horizon. At dusk, the horses stand on picket lines beside a low flame, with grass and sky running unbroken to the edge of sight.

Name: Ningaloo Reef Whale Shark Dive and Overnight Stay
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Western Australia’s Ningaloo Reef sets the stage for a private, marine biologist–led whale shark dive scheduled April–July, when these giants aggregate in clear Indian Ocean water. You drift in still water beside the largest fish on Earth as a specialist guide reads the animal’s movements and the reef’s ecology.

The itinerary extends overnight on a floating platform anchored above the coral. After dark, a swim reveals bioluminescent plankton beneath the Milky Way.

Name: Iceland Þríhnúkagígur Volcano Descent and Hot Springs
Master_Aurora_Insights:
June–September in southwest Iceland, just outside Reykjavík. You hike across moss fields toward the crater of Þríhnúkagígur, a dormant volcano with an emptied magma chamber. Clipped into a rappel line, the descent opens onto walls stained by mineral color, a pulse of geothermal heat, and a striking silence inside the ancient chamber. A meal is served underground, set on stable stone within the cavern.

Back at the surface, a helicopter lifts over glacier country, tracking crevasse fields and ash-darkened ice on the way to geothermal waters. The day ends in hot springs under the midnight sun, steam lifting as the horizon holds its light.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you cancel with more than 24 hours notice: Full refund is made; If you cancel with less than 24 hours notice: No refund is made.

Name: Nobu Los Angeles Coastal Fishing and Cooking
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A coastal fishing and cooking immersion led by world‑renowned chefs. Based out of Nobu’s Los Angeles kitchen, the program pairs time on the water with a hands‑on sequence in which you prepare, preserve, and cook the catch alongside Nobu Matsuhisa. The focus stays on coastal methods and practical preservation before the fish hits the pan.

The same format is available with Éric Ripert in Montauk and René Redzepi in Copenhagen, following the fish–prepare–preserve–cook progression shaped by each shoreline. Ripert is the chef of Le Bernardin; Redzepi leads Noma. Final scene: fillets lifted from the board and searing in a stainless‑steel pan.

Name: Venture: Hudson Valley day with Dan Barber
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A family-friendly, one-day countryside immersion in New York’s Hudson Valley with Dan Barber. The co-owner of Blue Hill in NYC and Blue Hill at Stone Barns in Pocantico Hills, Barber is a pioneer of farm-to-table dining and sustainable, regenerative agriculture. Blue Hill at Stone Barns has earned multiple Michelin stars and sustainability awards, and is widely noted for integrating a restaurant with an on-site working farm.

The itinerary moves between field and pasture: guided harvesting, outdoor cooking over an open fire, milking cows, horseback riding, and ice cream making. You see Barber’s nose-to-tail and root-to-stem approach applied at source, using whole plants and animals with minimal waste.

Name: Alice Waters Market-to-Kitchen Cooking Workshop
Master_Aurora_Insights: A market-to-kitchen immersion led by Alice Waters, a pioneer of the farm-to-table movement and chef-founder of Chez Panisse. You start at a market, sourcing ingredients directly with Waters, then move into a workshop focused on composition and menu creation. Cooking follows in two configurations: in New York with chef Michael White, or in Milan, Barcelona, or London with Michelin-starred chef Enrico Bartolini. The sequence moves from ingredient selection to menu design to execution. The morning’s market finds sit on the prep table before the burners light—beside White in New York, or Bartolini in Milan, Barcelona, or London.
Master_Country: United States, Italy, Spain, United Kingdom

Name: White Desert Antarctica Private Jet and Ice Excursions
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A private jet flight from Cape Town to Wolf’s Fang Runway carries you five hours into Antarctica, landing in the interior of Queen Maud Land amid ice waves and mountain peaks. On the ground, White Desert’s polar experts lead guided excursions: short treks or gentle hikes across the ice with the option of trekking bicycles; visits to nearby ice tunnels and pressure ridges; and, depending on season and location, wildlife sightings such as penguins and seals. The day centers on a picnic set directly on the ice, with champagne and chef-prepared food.

After the experience, return to Cape Town the same day or remain in heated “polar pods” (six per camp) with advanced thermal insulation, warm interiors, and newly upgraded ensuite showers and bathrooms. Each pod includes a large glass-front conservatory for panoramic views of ice, lakes, and glaciers. Communal spaces include a dining pod with private chefs, lounge and library areas, a wellness dome/sauna, and a separate shower facility, though the new upgrades bring showers into individual pods. 

From camp, activities extend to ice tunnel exploration; nunatak climbs and glacier hikes; ice climbing and abseiling; rope walks above ice cliffs; guided nature walks, polar talks, and adventurers’ picnics.

Name: Andrew Zimmern African Trekking and Asian Market Cooking
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Andrew Zimmern, the adventurous chef behind Bizarre Foods, leads a trekking-and-cooking immersion that moves from African bushveld to Asian markets. In South Africa, the itinerary centers on hikes near Kruger or in the Drakensberg, followed by fireside cooking with indigenous ingredients such as mopane worms, marula, and game meats. In Botswana’s Okavango Delta, guides take you bush trekking before open-fire preparations of traditional Setswana dishes. In Tanzania, safaris pair with Hadza hunter-gatherer foraging, with time spent cooking with families over fire pits and gathering herbs, mushrooms, and insects.

There is also the option for Zimmern to cook a private dinner at a location of your choosing, or to lead a market hop through Asia’s more extreme and storied flavors: hawkers in northern Thailand, Bangkok’s floating markets, Hanoi’s wet markets, Singapore’s hawker stalls, and beach grilling in Indonesia. Shock-and-awe dishes appear in the mix—silkworm pupae, pig’s blood cake, durian feasts. Hidden-gem stops lean into places not in guidebooks, from a single-wok cook in a Hanoi alley to an elderly grandmother’s backyard kitchen. Along the way he shares stories of his closeness with Anthony Bourdain and how New York’s culinary scene was reimagined.
Master_Country: South Africa, Botswana, Tanzania, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, Indonesia

Name: Fortnum & Mason Tea Etiquette with The Royal Butler
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A private etiquette masterclass with The Royal Butler at Fortnum & Mason in London. Structured as a bespoke family consultation, the session uses afternoon tea to teach the art and etiquette of Britain’s tea ritual. You are welcomed by a Fortnum & Mason tea expert before working through correct sequencing and service — choosing teas, perfect pouring, and how each course is taken.

Service includes delicate finger sandwiches, savoury treats, sweet pastries, and freshly baked cakes, paired with teas from Fortnum’s collection. Hands-on guidance is combined with stories and expert commentary, suitable for all ages.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For all talks, courses and tuition provided by Grant Harrold The Royal Butler or HRH Princess Katarina of Yugoslavia & Serbia are 50% non-refundable from the time of booking. The full cost of any of the talks, courses and tuition booked will be refunded if Grant Harrold The Royal Butler cancels them. Should you (the client) cancel you will only receive back the balance of 50% unless there are extenuating circumstances, or your place is taken by a new client.

Name: Champagne Sabrage Lesson with Sommelier
Master_Aurora_Insights: A sommelier leads a focused introduction to sabrage — the ceremonial opening of Champagne with a saber — before moving into guided practice. You learn the history of the ritual and the safety fundamentals, then execute your own ceremonial strike under supervision. Participants leave with two keepsakes: a signed cork plaque and an engraved saber sheath. The bottle opens on a single motion, glass shearing cleanly at the neck as the saber lifts away.

Name: London Savile Row and Couture Private Shopping with Stylist
Master_Aurora_Insights: A stylist-led immersion in London’s luxury fashion circuit with private fittings at Savile Row tailors and couture houses. You are paired with a personal stylist who plans and escorts a private shopping tour through Mayfair’s fashion landmarks, moving from appointment-only designer ateliers to the tailoring rooms of Savile Row. Appointments include personal fittings with master tailors—at houses such as Anderson & Sheppard—for a custom suit or ensemble. Access extends to couture showrooms and high-fashion boutiques, often opened after hours specifically for the visit. Throughout, the stylist provides expert guidance from London fashion insiders.

Name: The Ritz London Afternoon Tea and Etiquette Primer
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private etiquette primer frames Afternoon Tea at The Ritz London. Scheduled in or just before the sitting, the session covers the ritual’s history, the correct sequence of service, and the table manners expected at the table. You then move into the Palm Court for the full experience with live music. The Ritz’s dress code—jackets and ties—sets a formal tone. On request, a maître d’hôtel adds a walkthrough of the room’s service choreography and a concise silverware tutorial.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations and amendments may be made up to 48 hours before your reservation without charge. If you fail to arrive, cancel, amend, or reduce the number of guests within 48 hours of your reservation, the card details provided at the time of the booking will be charged £95 per person.

Name: Borough Market London Tasting Tour and Cooking Class
Master_Aurora_Insights: A chef-led immersion at London’s Borough Market in Southwark, beside London Bridge. The visit begins with a behind-the-scenes tasting circuit, with introductions to stallholders and stops for oysters, charcuterie, and British cheeses among the produce aisles. The chef then leads a transfer to a private kitchen for a hands-on cooking class and lunch built from your market haul. You move from tasting to technique, prepping and cooking with the ingredients just sourced.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance of the experience for a full refund. For a full refund, you must cancel at least 24 hours before the experience’s start time. If you cancel less than 24 hours before the experience’s start time, the amount you paid will not be refunded. Any changes made less than 24 hours before the experience’s start time will not be accepted. Cut-off times are based on the experience’s local time.

Name: Asprey Bespoke Masterclass
Master_Aurora_Insights: Asprey, the British house known for leather goods and silversmithing, opens its atelier for a bespoke masterclass. Under the eye of a master craftsman, you emboss leather or engrave silver and design a small piece to take away, marked with initials or a crest. The session pairs making with salon tea served in-store, with photography documenting the process and the finished work.

Name: The Pie Room Workshop and Chef’s Table, Rosewood London
Master_Aurora_Insights:
An intimate culinary workshop and chef’s table inside The Pie Room at Holborn Dining Room, Rosewood London, led by Calum Franklin — Britain’s “Pie King.” The session begins at the marble workbench with a hands-on masterclass in traditional hot-water crust pastry, latticing, and intricate decorative pie tops under Franklin’s guidance and the pastry team’s oversight. You move straight into a private Chef’s Table within the same copper-and-oak room, where a multi-course, pie‑inspired tasting menu is paired with small‑batch English wines or artisanal ales.

Guests depart with a handcrafted mini pie, boxed and sealed with The Pie Room crest; a signed recipe booklet by Calum Franklin; and a branded Pie Room pin and apron.

Name: Endo Kazutoshi Omakase and Sushi Workshop
Master_Aurora_Insights: An omakase-style date night led by Chef Endo Kazutoshi, the third-generation sushi master behind the Michelin-starred Endo at The Rotunda. Hosted at Carousel London or arranged in your own home, the evening begins with Endo’s demonstrations in nigiri shaping, rice seasoning, and knife etiquette. Couples then prepare one course under his guidance before Endo presents a bespoke sequence tailored to the table. An optional sake calibration can be added, and the night concludes with a signed menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Due to the nature of the presentation of the Omakase menu and the logistics of transporting guests from the foyer to the restaurant in our private elevator, each guest must arrive at the stated reservation time, otherwise we must cancel the reservation and retain the pre-payment.

Name: KOL London Chef's Table Tortilla Masterclass and Tasting Menu
Master_Aurora_Insights: At KOL in London, the Chef’s Table sits beside its own Oaxacan‑inspired kitchen for a focused tortilla‑making masterclass. You learn nixtamalisation fundamentals, then move into masa pressing and hand‑forming tortillas. The session continues as a tasting menu built around seasonal British–Mexican pairings. Optional additions include a mezcal tutorial in the Mezcaleria and, subject to schedule, a welcome from chef Santiago Lastra.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled at least 48 hours in advance. A cancellation fee of £70 per person applies to late cancellations and no-shows.

Name: Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall Fitness and Pressing Training
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Train at Everton’s Finch Farm training ground or an exclusive private facility with Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall, twice named Leicester City’s Player of the Season before making the move to Everton in 2025.

This session is about matching his engine and intensity. Work alongside him in pressing drills, endurance runs, and high-tempo passing routines designed to push you to the limit.

Ask Kiernan how he maintains elite fitness over a Premier League season - from nutrition to mindset to recovery - and what it takes to cover every blade of grass week after week.

If you want to elevate your stamina and mentality to Premier League standards, few players set the bar higher than Dewsbury-Hall.

Name: Floris Jermyn Street Perfume Blending
Master_Aurora_Insights: A two-hour bespoke fragrance appointment inside Floris’s historic Jermyn Street perfumery. Guided by a master perfumer, you move through the fragrance wheel, sampling key scent families, assessing notes, and selecting the base accords that suit your brief. Using antique measuring glasses, you blend your chosen elements to compose a personal Eau de Parfum. The final formula is decanted into a personalised 100 ml engraved bottle and logged in the Floris archive for future re-orders. The moment ends at the workbench: antique glassware, measured drops, and your engraved bottle being filled.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Specially ordered items, Bespoke vouchers/products, bottle engravings or Customisation vouchers/products may not be exchanged or refunded unless faulty or damaged upon arrival. For Bespoke and Customisations, we are happy to transfer the name on the voucher, but unfortunately, they are non-refundable and may not be exchanged for store goods.

Name: Wrexham A.F.C. Matchday Hospitality at Racecourse Ground
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Watch Ryan Reynolds’ Wrexham A.F.C. play at the Racecourse Ground in Wrexham, North Wales the world’s oldest international football stadium still in use. Aurora secures hospitality with premium seating or private box access during the match. The itinerary includes private transfers to and from Wrexham and bespoke pre‑match dining at a curated local restaurant or pub. After the final whistle, post‑match entertainment is arranged, with the option of a meet and greet with club insiders, subject to availability. 

Aurora is on call 24/7 throughout to adjust transfer times, secure last‑minute dining, or extend the evening in Wrexham.

Name: Chelsea FC Private Box at Stamford Bridge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Private-box hospitality at Stamford Bridge for Chelsea’s home fixtures, with premium-positioned suites offering elevated sightlines over the pitch.

Aurora designs the full matchday: private transfers, bespoke pre-match dining, curated post-game entertainment, and access to meet‑and‑greets with club insiders where available. The team remains on call throughout, adjusting transfers, dining, or entertainment in real time as plans shift.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All sales are final. Once payment is received, bookings are non-refundable and non-exchangeable. Refunds are only applicable if the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. A smart-casual dress code applies; smart trainers, smart jeans, and tailored shorts are permitted, but tracksuits, casual shorts, and away colours are not allowed.

Name: The Standard Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights: At The Standard Spa, Miami Beach, contrast therapy runs as a deliberate circuit on Biscayne Bay. You move between a cedar sauna with bay views, an icy plunge pool, and an aromatherapy steam room to reset circulation and energy. The ritual can extend into the hammam, a Roman waterfall hot tub, a mud lounge, and the infinity pool, creating a complete wellness loop suited to recovery, performance, or pure relaxation.

Name: AIRE Ancient Baths Thermal Circuit and Massages
Master_Aurora_Insights: AIRE Ancient Baths stages Roman and Greek–style wellness rituals inside heritage spaces across New York, Chicago, London, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Sevilla, and Almería. Guests move at their own pace through a sequence of thermal baths—hot and warm pools, cold plunges, and a saltwater float bath—calibrated to relax, balance, and revitalize. Treatments extend beyond the circuit to candle-lit massages, exfoliation rituals, and steam rooms, with signature sessions that include wine or milk baths. Useful after a long flight, as the centerpiece of a wellness-focused weekend, or as a couples’ ritual.

Name: Krasota Dubai Tasting Menu at Cinar Rugs Museum
Master_Aurora_Insights:
An immersive multi-course performance dinner staged inside the Cinar Rugs Museum in Dubai, produced in collaboration with VIP Dubai, Krasota, and Cinar Rugs. The culinary program is guided by Chef Dmitry under the creative direction of Vladimir Mukhin, brand chef of Krasota Dubai’s gastro-theatre concept, where tasting menus are presented as staged dinners. 

Set among Cinar’s museum displays of handwoven silk and wool carpets, the evening places contemporary dining within a textile gallery environment.

Name: Mleiha Zoologist-Led Wildlife Tour and The Guild Dinner
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private wildlife program in Mleiha, in the Sharjah desert, led by a zoologist and focused on the region’s native fauna and habitats. You continue by golf cart for a guided tour across dunes and rock formations, covering distance with minimal impact. Canapés and a fine-dining service by The Guild are staged on site, moving the day from field observation to the table. Helicopter transfers are available for direct access to the desert.

Name: Saks Fifth Avenue Personalzed Shopping Session
Master_Aurora_Insights: A personalized shopping session at Saks Fifth Avenue led by the store’s style experts. The team curates and presents a focused edit drawn from designer ready-to-wear and accessories, aligned to your fit and aesthetic. You move through looks in sequence, refine combinations, and finalize pieces with clear styling direction tailored to your brief, whether building a versatile rotation or dressing for a specific event.

Name: Orpheus and Pelorus Islands Snorkeling Day
Master_Aurora_Insights: A marine day linking Orpheus and Pelorus Islands on Queensland’s Great Barrier Reef. Both sit within the Palm Island Group north of Townsville, a pocket of reef and beaches used for easy day trips and time in the water. Around Orpheus, snorkelling focuses on fringing coral systems and the sheltered giant clam garden, with shallow coral bommies suited to unhurried surface dives. A short hop across the channel brings you to Pelorus, a neighbouring island with sandy entry points and reef flats that work well for relaxed swims and snorkelling directly off the beach. The day stays close to calm, shallow sites geared to hard corals and schooling reef fish rather than deep drift dives. You step out with fins in hand on a quiet Pelorus shoreline while the tender idles just offshore.

Name: Aurora Dining™️ Curated Date Night: Spice & Fire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A three-part date night in Notting Hill built around smoke, spice, and strong cocktails. Guests start with agave-based drinks at Naked & Famous before moving to The Barbary Notting Hill, an open‑kitchen restaurant serving Middle Eastern and North African dishes cooked over flame. The evening ends at Trailer Happiness, a long‑standing tiki bar with a relaxed atmosphere and a menu centered on rum-focused cocktails. 

Aurora members receive priority access and a reserved table at The Barbary, with secured entry at Trailer Happiness.

Name: Royal Air Force Communication and Decision-Making Workshop
Master_Aurora_Insights: An applied masterclass on communication and decision-making drawn from Royal Air Force practice. It examines how RAF pilots maintain clarity under stress, coordinate as a team, and hold composure in time‑critical moments. The session focuses on practical methods: prioritizing information, aligning roles, and making clean calls, showing how disciplined communication supports sound decisions when the margin for error is small. The emphasis stays on habits that travel beyond aviation: concise language, mutual support, and calm execution.

Name: Solent Sailing Masterclass with Sir Ben Ainslie
Master_Aurora_Insights: A hands-on sailing masterclass on the Solent led by Sir Ben Ainslie, Britain’s most successful sailor. The session focuses on the core principles of elite racing: teamwork, precision, and composure on the water. Ainslie’s pedigree: Olympic sailing’s most decorated athlete and an America’s Cup skipper, underpins direct, on‑water coaching that translates high-performance methods into clear, executable actions.

Name: Ferguson, Guardiola, Klopp, or Arteta Leadership Masterclass
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private leadership masterclass with Alex Ferguson, Pep Guardiola, Jürgen Klopp, or Mikel Arteta. The session examines leadership, mindset, and motivation at the highest level of sport and how top managers build winning cultures, manage pressure, and inspire performance. Context comes from their work with Europe’s major clubs: Ferguson at Manchester United; Guardiola across Barcelona, Bayern Munich, and Manchester City; Klopp with Borussia Dortmund and Liverpool; Arteta at Arsenal. The conversation stays practical, focusing on culture-setting, handling scrutiny, and getting consistent performances from teams and individuals.

Name: Aurora Dining™️ Curated Date Night: Art & Colour
Master_Aurora_Insights:
An evening set across Soho, Mayfair, and Covent Garden. Pre‑dinner at SOMA, a minimalist cocktail bar with Indo‑Japanese influences. Dinner at Sketch in Mayfair: Modern European fine dining, with a choice between the Michelin‑starred tasting menu in the Lecture Room & Library or an à la carte service in the Gallery. Post‑dinner moves to Louie’s Alligator Bar, a rooftop bar and lounge in Covent Garden with live jazz and cocktails. 

Aurora members have guaranteed entry at all three venues, with reserved tables at Sketch and at Louie’s.

Name: Aurora Dining™️ Curated Date Night: New York Style
Master_Aurora_Insights: Cocktails in Mayfair to start: either Dukes Bar or The Connaught Bar, both classic London hotel bars. Dinner at The Dover in Mayfair follows, serving American, contemporary plates in a New York brasserie mode. The night ends at Nikita, a private members’ lounge in Mayfair with champagne service and late-night music. Access to Nikita is reserved for Aurora members, with priority booking privileges across the other venues.

Name: Aurora Dining™️ Curated Date Night: Old World Italian
Master_Aurora_Insights:
An Old World Italian date night moving across Soho and Mayfair. Begin with Italian aperitivi at Bar Termini in Soho or Encore in Mayfair; Bar Termini is known for precise negroni variations and a tight, standing-bar energy suited to a first toast. Dinner follows at Carbone in Mayfair, the Italian‑American room defined by tableside service and classic dishes: spicy rigatoni and veal parmesan among the signatures. The evening closes at Claridge’s Fumoir, the hotel’s art deco cocktail bar in Mayfair, where discreet service and a list of vintage spirits set a quieter pace.

Aurora members receive priority booking and private table access at all venues, with guaranteed entry to The Fumoir.

Name: Royal Air Force Pilot Flying Lesson
Master_Aurora_Insights: A guided flying lesson alongside a Royal Air Force pilot. You take to the skies for first-hand experience in aviation control and situational awareness, with the instructor unpacking the mindset used in elite military flight training. Instruction focuses on reading the aircraft and the airspace while making measured control inputs. In flight, the RAF pilot scans the horizon and instruments beside you as you hold the controls.

Name: Belize Jungle Survival and Leadership Training with SAS Instructors
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A week-long field programme in the jungles of Belize led by former UK Special Air Service instructors, conducted on the same terrain and using the methodology employed in UK Special Forces training. The curriculum draws from current British Army and Royal Marines field practice, combining jungle survival, endurance, and tactical leadership.

Participants work through navigation, fieldcraft, shelter construction, and team movement while building resilience under pressure inside a tightly controlled, safety-led environment. You operate in tropical rainforest conditions: heat, humidity, dense canopy, where pace, spacing, and communication are deliberate and measured.

Each day concludes with guided debriefs on mindset, adaptability, and decision-making in extreme conditions, translating field lessons into clear frameworks for teams and individuals.

Name: SAS or Royal Marines Former Members Training Day
Master_Aurora_Insights: A day of training with former members of Britain’s Special Air Service (SAS) or the Royal Marines. Instructors lead physical challenges, tactical exercises, and leadership techniques designed to build mental resilience and teamwork. You work through a sequence of drills that test decision‑making, coordination, and sustained effort.

Name: Aurora Dining™️ Curated Date Night: Smoke & Mirrors
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A three-stop date night moving from Mayfair into Marylebone. It opens with pre-dinner drinks at The Bar at The Twenty Two, a private members’ club in Mayfair with an art deco–inspired interior. Dinner follows at Nina in Marylebone, a contemporary Italian restaurant serving modern regional dishes, with signature cocktails inspired by vintage cigarette brands. The evening concludes at LAVO Bar & Lounge, a hotel lounge and late-night venue in Marylebone featuring a live DJ programme and late-night cocktail service. 

Access to The Twenty Two and priority seating at LAVO are arranged for Aurora members.

Name: Tower of London Private Crown Jewels Before Hours Tour
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private, before-hours visit to the Crown Jewels at the Tower of London. Your host meets you at your hotel and accompanies you to the fortress, where you enter before the site opens to the public. An expert guide leads the Morning Jewel House Tour through the Jewel House vault, focusing on the coronation regalia and the rituals and symbolism attached to it. A Yeoman Warder, one of the Tower’s ceremonial guardians, then leads a guided walk across the grounds, setting the collection in the context of the Tower’s royal, military, and state history.

Name: Aurora Dining™️ Curated Date Night: Parisian Classic
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Aperitifs and light snacks at Quality Wines in Farringdon lead into dinner at Bouchon Racine, Henry Harris’s French bistro, with dishes such as rabbit in mustard, escargots, and crème caramel. The evening finishes at The Winemaker’s Club in Holborn, a candlelit cellar bar set in the vaults beneath Holborn Viaduct. 

Aurora members receive preferred table allocation and reservation privileges at all venues.

Name: Aurora Dining™️ Curated Date Night: Tokyo by Night
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A three-stop date night across Covent Garden with a Tokyo lens. You move between three addresses on foot: pre-dinner begins with sake tastings at Moto, a dedicated sake bar. Dinner follows at Wanitzuki, a contemporary Japanese izakaya offering sushi, robata dishes from the grill, and omakase-style service. The evening ends at Louie’s Alligator Bar, a rooftop bar and lounge, for cocktails and live jazz. 

Aurora members receive reserved seating and private access at Louie’s.

Name: Churchill War Rooms Private After-Hours Tour
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private-night itinerary tracing Churchill’s London. You arrive in a 1940s Humber Pullman limousine, then stop at his royal‑warrant cigar merchant to see rare artefacts and hear shop stories before a toast with his favourite Pol Roger. After hours, descend into the Churchill War Rooms for a private, behind‑the‑glass tour, followed by access to a hidden room set for canapés and champagne. Optional enhancements include talks by members of the Churchill family or historians, and private visits to Blenheim Palace and Chartwell.

Name: Woods’ Silver Fleet Private Thames Yacht Cruise
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private Woods’ Silver Fleet river yacht sets out for an evening on the Thames. White-glove service throughout, with champagne and canapés brought to the deck as the boat moves past London’s illuminated skyline. The soundtrack is either live jazz or a curated playlist, set to the tempo of the river. Suits a sunset departure as the bridges light up, or a post-dinner sail when the embankments are quiet.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Cancellation must be made in writing. Cancellation fees apply based on notice given:
- 180 days or more: 10% of Room/Boat Hire (0% of Event Charges)
- 120-179 days: 25% of Room/Boat Hire, 10% of Event Charges
- 90-119 days: 50% of Room/Boat Hire, 20% of Event Charges
- 60-89 days: 100% of Room/Boat Hire, 30% of Event Charges
- 30-59 days: 100% of Room/Boat Hire, 80% of Event Charges
- 15-29 days: 100% of Room/Boat Hire, 90% of Event Charges
- Less than 14 days: 100% of Room/Boat Hire, 100% of Event Charges

If cancelled after a food tasting, an additional £650 + VAT applies. Fees may be reduced if the vessel is re-hired.

Name: Royal Opera House Backstage Tour with Royal Box Seating
Master_Aurora_Insights: At Covent Garden’s Royal Opera House, home to The Royal Opera and The Royal Ballet, a private, behind-the-scenes tour moves through the theatre’s historic wings before curtain. You then take your seats in the Royal Box for the evening performance. The night concludes in a private salon with champagne and canapés.

Name: London Hyde Park Private Horseback Ride
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private, guided ride in Hyde Park led by the park’s resident equestrian team. The route follows Rotten Row, the centuries-old bridleway once reserved for royalty, running along the park’s southern edge in central London. From the saddle, you take in the Royal Park’s open lawns and tree lines before dismounting for a finish arranged with your hotel: a champagne breakfast or an afternoon picnic in the park, curated by your hotel’s culinary team.

Name: Bvlgari Hotel London or Shoreditch Arts Club Private Screening
Master_Aurora_Insights: An evening private-cinema takeover in London built around a film of your choosing. Screen a cult classic, a new release, or a personal favourite in one of two settings. At Bvlgari Hotel London in Knightsbridge, the 47-seat screening room comes with mid‑film service of champagne and gourmet snacks. At Shoreditch Arts Club in Shoreditch, the experience leans contemporary, with cocktails and creative décor in a members’ club setting. Either venue is yours alone, auditorium, projection, seating, and bar service, for a self-contained premiere with your guest list.

Name: High Jewellery Styling and Portrait Session
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private styling and photography session inside a high‑jewellery atelier, staged in the language of modern editorial campaigns. Under soft, controlled lighting, you try on a curated selection of pieces from a leading house while a professional photographer builds a set of refined portraits. Editorial conventions: precise light and an uncluttered frame keep attention on fit and proportion as looks change. The setting remains quiet and pared-back so the jewellery reads clearly on camera. Soft light on cut stones; the shutter clicks in the atelier.

Name: Savile Row After Dark - Tailoring × Club Cameo
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private, after-hours appointment on Savile Row in Mayfair with a tailor, staged under soft studio light with whisky poured and jazz playing. Measurements and fittings take place in the studio; once the final pins are set, you step straight into Club Cameo, a nearby members’ club, where your new look makes its first appearance.

Name: Aurora Masterclass™: Cocktail Alchemy with Harrison Ginsberg
Master_Aurora_Insights: An intimate masterclass in cocktail making led by Harrison Ginsberg, Beverage Director at Overstory, a New York bar recognized by The World’s 50 Best Bars. The session explores balance, flavor, and craft in detail, giving a clear framework for how drinks are composed and refined.

Name: Aurora Masterclass™: Behind the Bar with Natasha Bermudez
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private bartending masterclass led by Natasha Bermudez, bar director at Red Room and Principe. Structured as a behind-the-bar session, it focuses on sensory pairing and bar artistry: aroma, flavor, balance, and presentation. Bermudez outlines a clear approach to pairing, then walks through the decisions that shape a cocktail, with attention to why elements belong together.

Name: Aurora Masterclass™: Fashion Design Atelier Experience
Master_Aurora_Insights: A masterclass in fashion design focused on draping and craftsmanship, led by a Parsons-trained designer or an atelier professional from The Row or Gabriela Hearst. The session follows the arc of fashion creation from concept to finish, pairing demonstration with hands-on practice. Instruction examines how a design is defined, draped, and realized as a finished piece, with attention to technique and build quality.

Name: Aurora Masterclass™: Yankees Dugout Strategy Session
Master_Aurora_Insights: A behind-the-scenes baseball masterclass led by a New York Yankees coach or retired player. It opens with a dugout-level strategy conversation on how a game is read and managed in real time, then transitions to a batting cage segment directed by the instructor.

Name: Aurora Masterclass™: Acting for Presence — Broadway Masterclass
Master_Aurora_Insights: Aurora Masterclass™: Acting for Presence is a dynamic Broadway Masterclass focused on performance and stage presence, led by a Broadway actor or director. The session explores expression, storytelling, and on‑stage confidence, with attention to how choices read from the audience.

Name: Manhattan Michelin-Starred Kitchen Private Cooking Workshop
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private, hands-on cooking workshop staged inside a Michelin-starred kitchen. Hosted at restaurants such as Atomix (two Michelin stars) or Rezdôra (one Michelin star) in Manhattan, the session puts you at a workstation on the line to prepare one course alongside the chef. You work with the kitchen team on mise en place and technique, then plate at the pass. After the cook, you move to the chef’s table for a seated meal, with the course you helped create served as part of the sequence.

Name: Aurora Masterclass™: Scent Architecture with Joya Studio or D.S. & Durga
Master_Aurora_Insights: A focused, hands-on session led by perfumers from either house. The workshop examines how composition and story inform a fragrance, then moves into guided creation of a personalized fragrance.

Name: CORE Club Private Art & Suite Tour
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private, art- and design-focused walkthrough of CORE Club. The route traces the club’s in-house collection through corridors and shared rooms, then moves into social areas before entering the new member suites to view the interiors at residential scale.

Name: Lincoln Center Behind-the-Scenes Tour
Master_Aurora_Insights: A rare, behind-the-scenes tour of Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts focused on its working rehearsal and performance spaces. Led by internal staff or performing artists, the visit moves through parts of the Upper West Side campus that the public does not typically see. Lincoln Center houses the Metropolitan Opera, the New York Philharmonic at David Geffen Hall, the New York City Ballet at the David H. Koch Theater, and The Juilliard School, placing the tour within the core of New York’s performing arts infrastructure.

Name: MoMA After-Hours Tour + Cocktails at The Modern
Master_Aurora_Insights: An after-hours private tour of New York’s Museum of Modern Art led by a museum curator. You move through collection galleries and current exhibitions without daytime traffic, pausing for close viewing and discussion. The evening continues with cocktails at The Modern, MoMA’s Michelin-starred restaurant overlooking the Abby Aldrich Rockefeller Sculpture Garden.

Name: Private Shopping Experience at Printemps NYC
Master_Aurora_Insights: A tailored, private shopping appointment inside Printemps New York’s flagship at One Wall Street, pairing champagne service with a one-to-one session with a personal stylist. You brief the stylist on priorities: an event look, a wardrobe refresh, or targeted pieces, and curated selections are prepared for try-ons and edits across the store’s fashion and beauty offer.

Name: Private Curator-Led Tour of the Whitney Museum of American Art
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private early-morning or after-hours visit to the Whitney Museum of American Art in New York, arranged for uncrowded access to the current exhibitions. A curator opens with a focused briefing on the show, mentioning its themes, key works, and how to read the installation, then you move through the galleries at your pace.

Name: After-Hours Chef’s Table at Mirazur
Master_Aurora_Insights: Mirazur opens after nightfall on the French Riviera for a private chef’s table across its glass-walled dining room and gardens above the Mediterranean. Chef Mauro Colagreco leads a tasting drawn from the restaurant’s terraced orchards, the sea, and a menu that follows the lunar cycle, with wines paired to each course by the sommelier. The restaurant holds three Michelin stars and was named No. 1 on The World’s 50 Best Restaurants list in 2019.

Name: After-Hours Chef’s Table at L’Arpège
Master_Aurora_Insights: After-hours chef’s table at L’Arpège in Paris. When lunch service ends, Alain Passard’s three-Michelin-star dining room becomes a nocturnal atelier for a single party. Through the evening, you can step into the kitchen to watch dishes come together or speak with Passard at the pass.

Name: After-Hours Chef’s Table at Osteria Francescana
Master_Aurora_Insights: After-hours at Osteria Francescana in Modena, Chef Massimo Bottura closes the restaurant to all but your party. In the art-filled dining room, his brigade serves a one-off menu of modern Italian cuisine that riffs on tradition and memory, paced to your palate. Bottura narrates the story behind each course while the sommelier draws from a deep Emilia-Romagna cellar.

Name: After-Hours Chef’s Table at Le Cinq
Master_Aurora_Insights: An after-hours chef’s table inside Le Cinq at Four Seasons Hotel George V, Paris, led by Chef Christian Le Squer; the restaurant holds three Michelin stars. Once doors close, the salons become a private dining room; crystal chandeliers remain lit and the kitchen stays open to explore. Le Squer directs a haute-cuisine sequence rooted in classic French repertoire with contemporary technique, prepared by the brigade and served in cadence.

Name: After-Hours Chef’s Table at La Pergola
Master_Aurora_Insights: After hours, La Pergola at the Rome Cavalieri opens solely for your party, high above the city with panoramic terraces facing Rome. Led by Chef Heinz Beck, the restaurant holds three Michelin stars; the kitchen serves a seasonally driven menu rooted in Italian tradition and executed with technical precision amid a dining room hung with original art. The sommelier pours vintage Italian wines alongside the sequence of courses.

Name: After-Hours Chef’s Table at Core by Clare Smyth
Master_Aurora_Insights: An after-hours takeover of three Michelin-starred Core by Clare Smyth in Notting Hill. After service, the restaurant closes to the public and resets as a private chef’s table and salon for your party. Clare Smyth and her brigade direct a narrative tasting centered on British provenance and modern technique; each course is presented to you at the table by the kitchen.

Name: After-Hours Chef’s Table at Sketch Lecture Room
Master_Aurora_Insights: After-hours chef’s table inside Sketch’s Lecture Room & Library in Mayfair, London. The restaurant closes to the public and the dining room is reserved solely for your party. Beneath a domed ceiling and art installations, the kitchen serves a multi-course menu grounded in French technique with British touches. A sommelier leads pairings drawn from the restaurant’s extensive cellar.

Name: After-Hours Chef’s Table at Azurmendi
Master_Aurora_Insights: An after-hours chef’s table at Azurmendi, the three-Michelin-starred restaurant from Eneko Atxa on a green hill outside Bilbao. After dusk, the glass-walled greenhouse opens privately, and you begin with a stroll through the garden and kitchen, tasting small bites along the way. The evening then moves to the airy dining room for a tasting menu that follows the Basque landscape through fermented, smoked, and foraged flavors, paired with thoughtfully selected wines.

Name: After-Hours Chef’s Table at Schloss Schauenstein
Master_Aurora_Insights: After-hours chef’s table inside Schloss Schauenstein, the historic castle restaurant in the Swiss Alps led by Chef Andreas Caminada. The property closes its doors and courtyard for a private evening, with a seasonally attuned tasting menu served in the castle’s intimate salons. Wines from nearby valleys are selected by the sommelier to match the sequence.

Name: Private Omakase with The Araki
Master_Aurora_Insights: The Araki brings a private omakase to your setting aboard a moored yacht, in a snow-dusted chalet, or on a city penthouse terrace. A master itamae builds a live counter on site and prepares each nigiri with fish flown from Toyosu Market in Tokyo, explaining the cut and provenance as an assistant pours chilled sake. The entire toolkit travels with the chef: rice, knives, and lacquerware, with the team handling setup and cleanup so the space returns to order. Similar sessions can be arranged with Sushi Tetsu, Zuma, or Nobu, each delivering its own approach to the format.
Fulfillment Steps:
Confirm location, guest count and budget
 Secure chef availability
 Define menu and sourcing
 Collect deposit
 Arrange travel and setup
 Confirm final details
 Deliver experience
 Link Airtable entry for content back to ticket.

Name: Chef’s Counter at Humo
Master_Aurora_Insights: Aurora secures a private evening at the chef’s counter at Humo, a live-fire kitchen that is normally booked solid. Chef Miller Prada directs a tasting built on charcoal, smoke and flame, moving through aged beef, scallops and miso-marinated vegetables. With no other diners, you watch the choreography of the open kitchen, speak with the chefs about technique, and linger over each course as the sommelier pairs wines and spirits to the heat of the grill.

Name: Chef’s Counter at The Araki
Master_Aurora_Insights: The Araki’s austere nine-seat counter is reserved for your group. Sushi master Mitsuhiro Araki, whose bar is typically one of London’s hardest reservations, leads an extended edomae progression of over a dozen courses. From your seats, you have an unobstructed view of his knife work and rice technique. He explains the provenance of each fish, flown in from Tokyo’s Toyosu Market.

Name: Ikoyi London Private Chef's Counter with Jeremy Chan
Master_Aurora_Insights: Ikoyi opens its chef’s counter in central London for a private service led by Chef Jeremy Chan. The restaurant holds two Michelin stars, with a tasting format that channels West African-inspired cooking through British produce. You sit at the counter to watch the kitchen work at arm’s length while an extended menu explores rare peppers, fermented grains, and seasonal ingredients. Between courses, Chan steps in to discuss technique and inspiration.

Name: Chef’s Counter at Table Bruno Verjus
Master_Aurora_Insights: Inside the 16-seat Table Bruno Verjus in Paris’s 12th arrondissement, seats are scarce. Aurora can take over the entire counter for a night as Chef-owner Bruno Verjus cooks and plates in front of you, building a tasting menu around ultra-seasonal produce: wild asparagus, line-caught sole, foraged herbs, while narrating the origins of each ingredient.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The payment made at the time of booking - RESERVATION TICKET - is €200 per guest; it is deducted as a deposit for the number of people present. It is not refundable in case of cancellation or no show.

Name: Chef’s Counter at Counter 71
Master_Aurora_Insights: At Portland’s Counter 71, the experience occupies all ten seats that curve around the open hearth. Chef Spencer Horwath leads a seasonal Pacific Northwest tasting served over several hours, with cooking and plating done within arm’s reach. Courses draw on local farmers, fishermen, and foragers; the extended menu may include dry‑aged fish, wild mushrooms, and meats finished over charcoal, paired with regional wines.

Name: Chef’s Counter at Core by Clare Smyth
Master_Aurora_Insights: Within Core by Clare Smyth’s hushed Notting Hill dining room, a chef’s counter, seldom open to outsiders, becomes yours for the evening through Aurora. Smyth and her brigade serve an extended tasting centered on British terroir: Isle of Mull scallops, Herdwick lamb, heritage carrots, each presented directly across the counter. The format is conversational; you ask about technique and sourcing as the team works in the open kitchen, and between courses you may step behind the counter.

Name: Chef’s Counter at Frantzén
Master_Aurora_Insights: Björn Frantzén’s three-Michelin-starred Stockholm restaurant spans three floors and centers a small kitchen counter with only a few seats. Aurora secures a private reservation of that counter, putting you within arm’s length of the brigade as they plate Nordic ingredients with Japanese precision. The tasting menu extends to include rare dishes and off-menu creations, paired with wines and infusions chosen by the sommelier.

Name: Chef’s Counter at Geranium
Master_Aurora_Insights: Geranium sits atop Copenhagen’s national football stadium, Parken, where chef Rasmus Kofoed directs a tasting menu grounded in Scandinavian nature. Aurora access reserves the entire kitchen counter for one evening, placing a single party within arm’s reach of the brigade. The kitchen prepares an extended menu with additional courses and deeper exploration of signature techniques. Between courses, guests can speak with Kofoed, step into the test kitchen, and walk onto the terrace.

Name: Chef’s Counter at Septime
Master_Aurora_Insights: Aurora arranges a private seating at the open kitchen counter at Septime, Chef Bertrand Grébaut’s Michelin‑starred restaurant in Paris. From this vantage, you watch the team plate an extended tasting of vegetables, seafood, and meats with kaiseki‑like precision filtered through modern French bistronomie.

Name: Chef’s Counter at Alchemist
Master_Aurora_Insights: Inside Alchemist in Copenhagen, chef Rasmus Munk leads a 50-course sensory sequence staged at the kitchen counter. Kitchen counter seats place you directly in front of the plating, where edible art pieces with surprising textures arrive one by one, each explained by the chef. Music, lighting, and projections are tailored to your party, and the team is available for conversation and guided tours of the research laboratory.

The tasting moves across climats and vintages; climats being Burgundy’s named vineyard sites. while the host details the domaine’s meticulous viticulture and the evolution of each bottle. A local chef serves a paired dinner that centers regional produce. Provenance documents and tasting notes are provided.

Name: Icon Vertical at Domaine Leflaive
Master_Aurora_Insights: Inside Domaine Leflaive’s historic cellars in Puligny-Montrachet, a winemaker leads a vertical tasting of grand cru and premier cru white Burgundies. Guests compare mineral-driven young vintages with honeyed bottles that have rested for decades, while the host explains the estate’s biodynamic principles and barrel selections. A chef prepares a menu centered on shellfish and poultry to complement the wines, served at a long communal table set within the fermentation hall.

Name: Icon Vertical at Domaine Dujac
Master_Aurora_Insights: At Domaine Dujac in Morey‑Saint‑Denis, Côte de Nuits, a farmhouse table is set for a decades‑spanning vertical of Clos de la Roche Grand Cru. Led by a member of the Seysses family or a Master of Wine, the bottles are poured in sequence to track how the site and its vintages evolve over time. A locally sourced dinner is served in the barrel room alongside the tasting.

Name: Icon Vertical at Gaja Barbaresco
Master_Aurora_Insights: A vertical tasting inside the Gaja family’s library in Barbaresco, Piedmont, focused on single-vineyard Nebbiolo. Guided by a Master of Wine or a member of the Gaja family, you taste through decades of Costa Russi, Sorì Tildìn, and Barbaresco, comparing how vintage and aging shape the wines. A multi-course dinner prepared by a chef anchors the session with Piedmontese dishes such as tajarin and brasato, calibrated to highlight aroma and structure. Documentation of provenance accompanies the bottles.

Name: Icon Vertical at Vietti
Master_Aurora_Insights: A private vertical tasting inside Vietti’s cellars in Castiglione Falletto, in the heart of Barolo. You join a Master of Wine to open multiple vintages of two single‑vineyard Barolo crus, Rocche di Castiglione and Lazzarito, with each pour framed by discussion of vineyard exposure and winemaking decisions that define the year. Provenance documentation accompanies the bottles. A chef prepares a Piedmontese dinner calibrated to the wines and serves it in the cellar among large botti casks.

Master_Aurora_Insights: A Master of Wine leads a vertical of Tignanello, Solaia, and other Super Tuscan bottlings at the Antinori family’s estate in Tuscany, staged in a modern cellar carved into the hillside. You taste across decades, tracing the evolution of Cabernet Sauvignon and Sangiovese blends, with a Tuscan menu prepared by the estate’s chef served alongside. Between courses, the program moves through the winery’s contemporary architecture and the family’s historic art collection.

You dine at a long table beneath festoon lights and a canopy of stars, with live acoustic music setting the pace. 

Similar residencies can be hosted at estates such as Château d’Yquem, Vega Sicilia, or Ruinart, each reflecting its terroir.

Name: After-Hours Banquet at Palais Liechtenstein
Master_Aurora_Insights: Vienna’s private Palais Liechtenstein opens after hours for a banquet set within the Princely Collections. A curator introduces Baroque highlights before guests sit for dinner beneath frescoed ceilings and gilded mouldings. A chef interprets Austrian and wider European classics, paired with wines drawn from the princely cellars.

The meal is served in an ornate gallery or in a courtyard, with a Spanish chef reinterpreting classic Iberian dishes such as jamón Ibérico, bluefin tuna, and acorn-fed pork, paired with aged Rioja and Sherry.

A DJ programs a soundtrack that moves from sunset to starlight and between courses, the itinerary can incorporate a dive or a coastal tender excursion before returning to the counter for the next pour and plate.
