Name: Jean-Georges
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated at the base of the Trump International Hotel, this two-Michelin-starred destination is the eponymous flagship of chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
The kitchen fuses French technique with Asian flavors, serving light, broth-based dishes in a dining room defined by floor-to-ceiling views of Central Park.
The signature egg caviar presents a study in temperature, layering warm, lightly cooked yolk with chilled cream inside the shell.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled or modified at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a fee. Late cancellations and no-shows are subject to a cancellation fee of typically $50 per person. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Sartiano's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the subterranean space of SoHo’s Mercer Hotel, this modern Italian destination pairs restaurateur Scott Sartiano with James Beard Award-winning chef Alfred Portale.
Studio Sofield’s design layers warm textures and intimate lighting to complement a menu that elevates Neapolitan roots with New York sophistication.
Begin with the signature caviar cannoli and house-made paccheri, served in a room that expertly balances privacy with a spirited social scene.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a fee. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a cancellation fee of $50 per guest.

Name: Little Charli
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Bleecker Street in the West Village, this neighborhood pizzeria is helmed by Chef Salvatore Olivella, whose family has been making pizza in Italy for nearly a century.
The intimate space specializes in Roman-style pies cooked in a wood-burning oven, serving crisp crusts that balance Italian technique with a New York twist.
A defining feature is the signature Godfather pie, a one-meter-long creation topped with prosciutto, truffle, and burrata.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Torien
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This NoHo restaurant is the first international outpost of Tokyo’s Michelin-starred Torishiki, helmed by yakitori master Yoshiteru Ikegawa.
The omakase-only menu relies on imported *binchotan* charcoal to grill a progression of head-to-tail chicken cuts, from thigh to heart.
A standout among the skewers is the *nami* (neck skin), the chef’s personal favorite, served at a sixteen-seat camphor wood counter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Strict 24-hour cancellation policy of $185 per person. Any modifications or cancellations will be subject to fees.

Name: Cipriani Downtown
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located on West Broadway, this high-energy outpost of the Venetian hospitality empire is a magnet for the global fashion crowd. The dining room operates with a club-like buzz, prioritizing a lively social scene and swift service over quiet conversation. Waiters in signature white jackets deliver Harry’s Bar classics, from the original beef carpaccio to the towering vanilla meringue cake.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Frenchette
Master_Aurora_Insights:
James Beard Award–winning chefs Riad Nasr and Lee Hanson anchor this contemporary brasserie in New York’s Tribeca district.
The kitchen updates standard French repertoire with a focus on rustic preparations and natural wines, set against a backdrop of warm wood paneling.
A standout brouillade with Peconic escargot arrives in a dining room defined by its gleaming zinc bar and deep leather banquettes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations within 24 hours incur a $50 per person fee. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Sailor
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef April Bloomfield and restaurateur Gabriel Stulman, this Fort Greene bistro brings polished, technique-driven dining to a corner of Brooklyn.
The intimate, oak-paneled space channels a classic nautical spirit without veering into kitsch, offering a menu that balances exacting technique with neighborhood comfort.
A standout detail is the herb-roasted chicken, served in a candy-colored cocotte with bronzed skin and a depth of flavor that reflects years of refinement.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If plans change, please let us know 24 hours in advance of your reservation time to avoid cancellation fees. The $40 per person charge is only assessed when no one shows up for the reservation or it is canceled less than 24 hours before the appointed time.

Name: Casa Lever
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the landmark Lever House on Park Avenue, this Italian destination is operated by the Sant Ambroeus Hospitality Group.
The retro-futuristic interior, originally designed by Marc Newson, features curved leather banquettes that complement a menu of refined Milanese classics.
Power lunches unfold beneath rotating contemporary art, with signature dishes like the veal Milanese anchoring the experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy. Tables are held for 15 minutes.

Name: Penny
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched above its sibling Claud in the East Village, this seafood counter is the latest project from Chase Sinzer and chef Joshua Pinsky.
The narrow, marble-lined space functions as a modern raw bar, prioritizing pristine sourcing and a bustling, walk-in-only energy over formal service.
From the 31-seat counter, guests can order the signature "Ice Box"—a curated selection of shellfish—alongside warm sesame brioche with cod roe.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance or no-shows are subject to a fee of $50 per person.

Name: Monkey Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Midtown’s Hotel Elysée, this 1936 fixture is currently operated by Hogsalt Hospitality’s Brendan Sodikoff.
The intimate, clubby dining room evokes Old New York with its low light and plush red-leather banquettes.
A wraparound mural by illustrator Ed Sorel anchors the space, depicting sixty Jazz Age figures from Duke Ellington to Dorothy Parker.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A $2.50 per person reservation fee is charged to secure seats for all online reservations (holiday booking fees may vary). Reservations identified as sold or traded will be cancelled without notice.
Manual Price: Booking fee: $2.50/person (non-refundable, online bookings). Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy at 9:00 AM on the day the target date releases (21 days out).
2. If unavailable, set Resy Notify alert.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
4. For VVIP, escalate to Colleen.
5. Walk-in at the bar is a viable backup — advise members to arrive when doors open or mid-afternoon for lunch.

- Platform: Resy. Release: 21 days in advance, new dates at 9:00 AM daily.

Escalation:
- Colleen for VVIP.

Name: Casa Mono
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Gramercy Park, this Michelin-starred tapas spot is an intimate homage to Spain’s Costa Brava, led by Chef Andy Nusser.
The narrow, high-energy space delivers refined small plates and a deep wine list, prioritizing authentic flavor over theatricality.
A signature order is the duck egg with mojama and black truffles, best enjoyed from a seat at the open kitchen's counter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or changes made with less than 24 hours notice are subject to a fee of $50 per guest.

Name: Haymarket Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a John Nash-designed Regency landmark near Trafalgar Square, this Firmdale property showcases the vibrant, pattern-heavy interiors of owner-designer Kit Kemp.
The atmosphere balances English country-house charm with urban sophistication, mixing bold textiles and eclectic furniture within grand classical proportions.
A standout feature is the subterranean swimming pool, which is framed by a pewter bar and a mesmerizing lighting installation that sets a moody, glamorous tone.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or amendments to your Booking must be made by 12 noon (GMT) 24 hours ahead of arrival to avoid a one night accommodation charge. Cancellations or amendments are not permitted on any ADVANCED PURCHASE Bookings as a full, non-refundable deposit is taken at the time of booking. When making your Booking you must give details of a current, valid credit or debit card.

Name: Nobu Downtown
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the landmarked 195 Broadway building in the Financial District, this flagship location unites Chef Nobu Matsuhisa and architect David Rockwell.
The dual-level venue features a street-level bar and lounge that leads to an immersive, subterranean dining room defined by Japanese craft.
A monumental ash wood sculpture, carved to resemble a swirling sumi-e ink brushstroke, floats dramatically above the central bar area.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to secure all reservations. Cancellations or no-shows within 24 hours may be charged $50.00 per person.

Name: Ito
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in the shadow of One World Trade in Tribeca, this 16-seat omakase counter is the domain of chefs Masashi Ito and Kevin Kim.
The experience eschews the solemnity of traditional sushi temples for a high-energy atmosphere fueled by premium sake and deep, potent knife work.
A meal here culminates in the signature wagyu and uni pairing, a finish that exemplifies the kitchen’s sourcing prowess.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or reservation changes made less than 48 hours before reservation time are non-refundable. Rescheduling, or reducing party size unfortunately, counts as a cancellation if it is within 48 hours of your seating time. We cannot guarantee the full menu to guests who are more than 15 minutes late.

Name: Drai's Supper Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York’s Meatpacking District, this venue marks a return to roots for nightlife impresario Victor Drai and his son Dustin.
Designed by Leo A Daly, the space channels the golden age of supper clubs with deep red velvet interiors and French-American cuisine accompanied by live jazz.
A standout finale is the Baba Rum, Victor’s personal favorite, served with seasonal strawberries and housemade vanilla ice cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Zimmi's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In the West Village, this intimate French bistro is the creation of chef Maxime Pradié and hospitality veteran Jenni Guizio.
The kitchen focuses on the homestyle cooking of the South of France, favoring rustic family recipes over standard brasserie staples.
A standout is the pissaladière, a savory Niçoise tart of caramelized onions and anchovies, best enjoyed with a selection from the extensive list of half-bottles.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 24-hour cancellation policy applies. Reservations cancelled within 24 hours of the reservation time are subject to a $25 per person cancellation fee.

Name: Zuma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Rainer Becker in London, this contemporary izakaya has established a global presence with its modern interpretation of informal Japanese dining.
Interiors by Noriyoshi Muramatsu of Studio Glitt utilise raw granite, wood, and stone to create a textured, elemental backdrop for the shared-plates menu.
The open robata grill serves as the focal point, producing signatures such as the miso-marinated black cod wrapped in hoba leaf.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations require valid card details. There is no charge to the card unless you cancel your reservation with 24 hours' notice or less, or the party fails to attend their booking, where a charge of 50 per person will be incurred.

Name: Olmo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened by alumni of Cosme and Pujol, Olmo is a Mexican cantina located in Brooklyn’s Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood.
The kitchen focuses on regional Mexican fare and small plates, paired with Mexico City-style cocktails and a selection of mezcal.
Within the white and light wood dining room, a dedicated ofrenda serves as a permanent altar where guests are invited to leave photographs of their loved ones.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you wish to change the reservation date or the number of diners, your request will be honored as long as it is made with a minimum of advance notice. In the event that you have been asked for a guarantee card at the time of booking, you must reconfirm or cancel the reservation via the provided links; the reservation is only guaranteed upon reconfirmation.

Name: L'Artusi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Named for the father of modern Italian cuisine, this West Village staple is helmed by executive chef Joe Vigorito.
The bi-level space combines high energy with polished service, featuring a crudo bar, cheese counter, and walk-in wine cellar.
Order the deceptively simple spaghetti, a signature dish constructed from garlic, chilies, and a rich parmesan stock.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy. There is a 15-minute grace period for arrivals.

Name: 4 Charles Prime Rib
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a historic West Village brownstone, this intimate supper club is the work of Chicago restaurateur Brendan Sodikoff.
The wood-paneled dining room evokes a bygone era with plush leather banquettes, vintage oil paintings, and crystal chandeliers.
Beyond the slow-roasted, salt-crusted beef, the kitchen serves a version of the double-patty cheeseburger from Sodikoff’s Chicago diner, Au Cheval.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A $5 per person reservation fee will be added to all online reservations to secure your seats. If either Hogsalt or Resy identifies that a reservation has been sold or traded on Appointment Trader or by any other means, it will be cancelled without notice.
Manual Price: Deposit: $50/person (applied to bill, non-transferable). Refund typically 24+ hours in advance. Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.

3. Submit request at exactly 21 days out; include multiple time windows.
4. Follow up once after 48 hours if no reply.
5. Escalate via April — strongest relationship.
6. Escalate via Colleen for VVIP or urgent requests.
7. Always provide strong backup options when going back to the member.

Name: Masa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in New York's Columbus Circle, this minimalist destination is led by chef Masayoshi Takayama.
The omakase-only menu reflects the Japanese concept of *shibui*, prioritizing ingredient purity and simplicity over ornamentation.
Service centers on a solid hinoki wood counter, sanded daily to a soft finish, where the chef presents seasonal courses like toro with caviar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled at least 48 hours in advance. Cancellations made within 48 hours of the reservation time, or no-shows, will forfeit the full prepaid deposit (typically the full cost of the menu, e.g., $750–$950 per person).

Name: Emilio's Ballato
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Nolita, this long-standing Italian venue is run by the Vitolo family, who acquired the original 1956 business in the early nineties.
The intimate dining room features pressed-tin ceilings, tile floors, and walls dense with framed photographs of the restaurant’s many celebrity patrons.
Chef Anthony Vitolo prepares Southern Italian staples, highlighted by a signature bone-in veal parmigiana and a rotation of unlisted daily specials.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND
Manual Price: N/A (no reservation to cancel). Walk-in only.

1. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that they understand the venue is walk-in only with no reservation possible and a typical wait of 30 minutes to 2+ hours.
2. Advise the member to arrive at or before 5:00 PM door open with the entire party present.
3. No insider escalation route. Walk-in is the only path.
4. Offer Lilia bar walk-in, I Sodi, or Via Carota walk-in as Italian alternatives.

Name: Minetta Tavern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Restaurateur Keith McNally oversees this Greenwich Village landmark, which originally served literary giants like Ernest Hemingway and E.E. Cummings.
The space blends the clubby warmth of an old-school New York tavern with the culinary precision of a Parisian steakhouse.
Red leather banquettes and restored caricatures line the walls, setting the stage for the kitchen’s signature dry-aged Black Label Burger.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You will receive a courtesy reminder text 2 days prior to your reservation. If you need to make any changes or cancel your reservation please call us at (212) 475-3850. A credit card is required to secure the reservation, and a fee may be charged for no-shows or late cancellations.

Name: Le Rock
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chefs Lee Hanson and Riad Nasr, the duo behind Frenchette, have opened this French brasserie in a historic Rockefeller Center space.
The dining room celebrates its Art Deco architecture with soaring ceilings and terrazzo floors, providing a polished backdrop for traditional cuisine.
A standout detail is the signature leeks vinaigrette, which is plated with a distinct touch of tableside service.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Noda
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York’s Flatiron District, this Michelin-starred omakase destination was founded by Justin Hauser and David Hess, with interiors by Ken Fulk.
Breaking from traditional minimalist aesthetics, the intimate room features a moody atmosphere defined by saturated colors and theatrical lighting.
The experience centers on a signature semicircular counter, ensuring every guest has a front-row view of Chef Shigeyuki Tsunoda’s technique.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Odre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York’s East Village, Odre is a modern Korean restaurant from Hand Hospitality and Chef Changki Kang, an alumnus of Seoul’s Michelin-starred Onjium.
The kitchen serves an accessible prix-fixe menu that balances artistic presentation with the comforting flavors of homestyle Korean cooking.
A cast-iron *gamasot* cauldron anchors the dining room, simmering the daily soup that accompanies the meal’s concluding *bansang*.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Acme
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Manhattan's NoHo neighborhood, ACME is a restaurant and nightlife venue opened by Jon Neidich and Indochine operators Jean-Marc Houmard and Huy Chi Le.
While the ground floor serves as a French-Italian bistro, the destination is defined by its subterranean lounge that operates as a late-night club.
The downstairs space features a dance floor illuminated by a disco ball and framed by exposed brick walls.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window. Lunch reservations are subject to a $10 late cancellation fee.

Name: Cervo's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the Lower East Side, this lively seafood spot is led by partners Nialls Fallon, Leah Campbell, and chef Aaron Crowder.
The kitchen channels the coastal energy of Spain and Portugal, serving sustainable catches and natural wines in a room that mimics a bustling European bar.
While the lamb burger with white anchovies is a standout, the menu centers on plates like crispy shrimp heads and Manila clams.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made less than 48 hours before the reservation time are subject to a fee of $55 per person.

Name: Il Mulino
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Brothers Fernando and Gino Masci founded this Greenwich Village stalwart, dedicating the kitchen to the rich cuisine of Italy’s Abruzzo region.
The dining room is defined by a high-octane service style, where tuxedoed captains maneuver through the tight, dimly lit space with practiced urgency.
Dinner starts with a generous ritual of complimentary antipasti, including fried zucchini, spiced mussels, and Parmesan chipped directly from the wheel.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please call 212-673-3783 at least 24 hours in advance to confirm and cancel. Any cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance or no shows will incur a $400 fee.

Name: Chateau Royale
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chateau Royale is a New York French restaurant in Greenwich Village, set in a restored late 1800s double wide carriage house.
Features two distinct dining spaces, a wood paneled bar on the first floor with 175 wine bottles and an airy upstairs dining room with 250 bottles.
Serves dishes inspired by Michelin starred L'Ambroisie including sable with caviar beurre blanc, lobster thermidor, and tableside martini carts with custom vermouth blends.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask for at least 12 hours’ notice for any cancellations. Cancellations made with less than 12 hours’ notice will incur a fee of $50 per person.

Name: Nobu Fifty Seven
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on West 57th Street, this Midtown outpost of Chef Nobu Matsuhisa’s group features interiors by architect David Rockwell.
The bi-level space evokes the fluidity of an Asian river with sweeping curves and walls lined with sliced bamboo.
Beneath a floating abalone-shell chandelier, the dining room serves Peruvian-Japanese classics including the signature Black Cod Miso.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to secure reservations for parties of five or more. Cancellations are accepted until the day prior to your reservation. Same-day cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of $25 per person.

Name: Jungsik
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Jungsik Yim’s Tribeca restaurant is the first Korean restaurant in the United States to earn three Michelin stars.
The kitchen pioneers "New Korean" cuisine by applying Western techniques to traditional ingredients like kimchi and fermented condiments.
A signature dish is the braised octopus, which is slow-cooked in dashima broth and seared for a crisp texture.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a prepaid deposit of $50 per person. Cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation are subject to a cancellation fee of $150 per person.
Manual Price: Prepaid via Tock: ~$335 per person + tax/fees (e.g. ~$734.46 for 2 guests). Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Monitor Tock for openings and set Tock waitlist alerts. Check regularly — apply the same monitoring cadence used for Atomix, Sushi Sho, Per Se.
2. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised, that they agree to the cancellation policy, and that they understand the prepaid model and deposit (~$335 per person + tax/fees).
3. Have member's payment details ready before booking.
4. Escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel for VVIP requests.
5. Bar seating is a viable backup for solo or small parties.

Key notes:
- Cuisine: New Korean Tasting Menu. Michelin: 2 Stars.
- Platform: Tock (prepaid).
- Format: Tasting menu (~2.5–3 hours).
- Bar seating available.

- Colleen (placeholder) — flag for CK to add insider contact.

Name: Daniel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on Manhattan’s Upper East Side, Chef Daniel Boulud’s flagship restaurant presents contemporary French cuisine within a neo-classical interior.
The dining room, reimagined by Tihany Design, pairs rigorous classical technique with polished, white-tablecloth hospitality.
Beneath soaring coffered ceilings and custom porcelain chandeliers, the signature Scallop Black Tie features diver scallops and black truffle encased in a golden pastry crust.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance. A credit card is required to secure the reservation, and a fee applies for late cancellations or no-shows.
Manual Price: Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour. Venue deposit / cancellation not publicly listed.

1. Check Resy at the 60-day release for the target date. Set calendar reminder.
2. If unavailable, set Resy Notify alert for the preferred time.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised, that they agree to the cancellation policy, and that they understand the dress code.
4. Escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel for VVIP. Flag to CK that Boulud-group access via April (La Tête d'Or contact) needs verifying.
5. Bar / lounge walk-in is a viable backup.
6. Offer La Tête d'Or as a Boulud-group alternative.

- Walk-ins: Available in bar / lounge.

Name: Roberta's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Carlo Mirarchi and Brandon Hoy in a converted Bushwick warehouse, this pizzeria anchored the neighborhood's culinary identity.
The unpolished, bunker-like interior features communal seating and a garden that feels like a perpetual backyard party.
The wood-fired Bee Sting, topped with tomato, soppressata, and a drizzle of chili-infused honey, is the kitchen's enduring signature.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Comal
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within Chileno Bay Resort in Los Cabos, this open-air venue is the work of designer Gulla Jonsdottir and Executive Chef Yvan Mucharraz.
The kitchen reimagines regional Mexican traditions with a modern approach, served in a multi-tiered space that dissolves the boundary between dining room and sea.
While a central raw bar highlights the daily catch, the braised short rib with cacao broth offers a rich counterpoint to the panoramic views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For standard reservations (parties of 1–7), Comal has a strict reservation-hold policy with a short grace period; guests are advised to arrive on time. No specific cancellation fee is listed for standard bookings. For parties of eight or more, inquiries must be made via email, and specific booking conditions may apply.

Name: Sushi by Scratch New York
Master_Aurora_Insights: Sushi by Scratch is an intimate 10-seat omakase counter in Manhattan’s Flatiron District, known for its playful, highly personalized take on traditional sushi dining. Led by Michelin-recognized chefs Phillip Frankland Lee and Margarita Kallas-Lee, the experience blends meticulously sourced fish with unexpected touches — from house-fermented soy sauce to sweet corn pudding and sourdough breadcrumbs — all served in a lively, speakeasy-style setting that feels more dinner party than formal sushi bar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We charge a full menu price per person for all cancellations received less than 48 hours prior to your reservation time. A credit card hold is required.

Name: Little Maven
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Flatiron District, this modern American neighborhood restaurant is the latest venture from the VCR Group, led by acclaimed chef Josh Capon.
The space balances a lively, inviting atmosphere with a serious culinary approach, featuring meticulous ingredient sourcing and a robust beverage program.
Arrive early to secure the signature burger—only ten are made daily, featuring house-ground prime NY strip, truffle, raclette, and bordelaise.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Atera
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within a Tribeca residential building, this two-Michelin-starred destination is helmed by Danish chef Ronny Emborg.
The intimate space features a thirteen-seat counter surrounding the open kitchen, where the team orchestrates a precise, seasonal tasting menu.
A standout "Temperance Pairing" offers complex, house-made juices and infusions as a thoughtful alternative to the traditional wine progression.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Prepaid reservation of $325 per person. Cancellations or changes are accepted up until 48 hours before the reservation. Late cancellations or no-shows are non-refundable.

Name: Adda
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Relocated to the East Village, this canteen is the work of Roni Mazumdar and chef Chintan Pandya, the team behind Unapologetic Foods.
The kitchen serves rustic, uncompromised dishes, maintaining spice levels that honor their origins rather than catering to Western palates.
A signature offering is the "Butter Chicken Experience," a tableside service where the dish is smoked and finished with infused butters.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No-shows or cancellations made within 48 hours of the reservation will be subject to a $25 per person cancellation fee. Tables of 5–6 require a $50 per person non-refundable deposit upon booking.
Manual Price: Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour. Venue deposit / cancellation not publicly listed.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy for availability. If not yet released, set a calendar reminder for the release window (~14 days out).
2. If fully booked, set Resy Notify alert for 1 hour before and after the preferred time.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
4. Escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel for VVIP or last-minute requests.
5. Offer Semma or Dhamaka as Unapologetic Foods backups proactively.

Key notes:
- Cuisine: Indian. Group: Unapologetic Foods (sister to Semma, Dhamaka, Masalawala & Sons).
- Platform: Resy. Release: ~14 days in advance.
- Dinner only.

Escalation:
- Colleen (placeholder) — April confirmed she cannot help day-of; no warm contact at Nedah. Flag for CK to add insider contact.

Name: Farra
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Tribeca, this wine bar is the sibling of the two-Michelin-starred Atera, located just a few doors away.
The narrow venue operates as a full-service restaurant, serving a full à la carte menu alongside a deep, globally sourced bottle list.
Guests in the 24-seat dining room enjoy access to Atera's celebrated wine cellar and signature dishes like crispy rice with scallops.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Jua
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In the Flatiron District, chef Hoyoung Kim—an alumnus of the two-Michelin-starred Jungsik—leads this sleek, wood-fired Korean restaurant.
The kitchen specializes in a modern tasting menu where nearly every course touches the open flame, imparting a distinct smoky depth to refined plates.
Dinner opens with the signature "Caviar Kim"—a crisp seaweed shell filled with truffle rice and caviar—and ends with a polished take on the traditional twisted donut.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you need to change or cancel your reservation, please do so at least 12 hours ahead of your reservation time to avoid a fee of $75 per guest. If you are 15 minutes late for your reservation your table may be given away to a waiting guest.

Name: Kochi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Kochi is Chef Sungchul Shim's one Michelin starred Korean restaurant located in Hell's Kitchen, opened in late 2019, focusing on skewer inspired cuisine.
Features an 8-course tasting menu with optional supplements including abalone course, A5 Wagyu upgrade, caviar, uni, and white truffle additions available.
Recognized as a One Star High quality cooking restaurant in the 2025 Michelin Guide USA official guide and website listings.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A fee of $25 per person will be charged for no-shows or cancellations within 12 hours of the reservation time. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Jean-Georges at Topping Rose House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a Greek Revival estate in Bridgehampton, this restaurant from chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten pairs historic architecture with modern design.
The kitchen utilizes a genuine farm-to-table model, harvesting produce from the property’s own one-acre farm to drive the seasonal menu.
Signatures like the egg toast with caviar are served in a light-filled dining room or on the wraparound porch overlooking the grounds.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you are running late, please give us a call at (631) 808-2001 (Tables can only be held for 15 minutes past time of reservation). Cancellation fees may apply.

Name: Gitano
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located on Pier 17, this waterfront destination from Grupo Gitano founder James Gardner brings a polished slice of Tulum to the Seaport. The sprawling venue channels a bohemian aesthetic with lush greenery, rustic wood accents, and sweeping views of the Brooklyn Bridge. Diners gather amidst the tropical flora for modern Mexican plates and the house-favorite Jungle Fever mezcal cocktail.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A $25 USD per person penalty will be deducted from the original payment. Cancellations made within 7 days of the reservation are considered NON-Refundable.

Name: Laser Wolf
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by James Beard award-winning chef Michael Solomonov, this lively Israeli shipudiya pays homage to the skewer houses of Jerusalem.
The menu highlights charcoal-grilled meats and vegetables, cooked over live coals and served in a bustling, communal atmosphere.
Every meal opens with a signature spread of salatim—ten seasonal vegetable dips and pickles—accompanied by unlimited rounds of warm, fresh pita.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation time are subject to a cancellation fee of $50 per person (Brooklyn). No-shows are subject to the same fee. Credit card information is required at the time of booking.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
2. Check Resy at 10:00 AM on the day the target date releases (21 days out).
3. If unavailable, set Resy Notify alert.
4. Call (718) 215-7150 for specific requests or cancellation inquiries.
5. For VVIP, escalate to Colleen.

Name: Jean's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Lafayette Street, this NoHo venue from restaurateur Max Chodorow combines a contemporary American bistro with a cocktail lounge.
The main dining room serves a farm-to-table menu in an environment that transitions from a relaxed dinner service to a spirited social scene.
A standout detail is the signature "Big Cookie," a shareable confection that rivals the draw of the subterranean club level.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Jean's (NYC) requires cancellations to be made at least 24 hours in advance. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a fee of $50 per guest. There is a 15-minute grace period for arrival.

Name: Tutto Il Giorno
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Gabby Karan de Felice and Gianpaolo de Felice, this Southern Italian restaurant brings Neapolitan traditions to the Hamptons.
The setting combines an airy, garden-inspired layout with a polished interior that draws a steady stream of fashion-industry regulars.
A meal here is best anchored by the signature spaghetti with scarpariello sauce, featuring Corbara cherry tomatoes and pecorino.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 12 hours of the reservation time are subject to a fee of $10 per person for lunch and $25 per person for dinner. Large parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy. Reservations are held for 15 minutes.

Name: Francie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a limestone-clad former bank in Williamsburg, this Michelin-starred brasserie is led by chef Chris Cipollone and partner John Winterman.
The space balances the ease of a neighborhood brasserie with the technical precision of modern European cooking.
A standout order is the dry-aged crown of Rohan duck, presented whole for two with seasonal accompaniments.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a cancellation fee. Late cancellations and no-shows are subject to a fee (typically $50 per person). A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Tucci
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York’s NoHo district, this refined Italian restaurant is the latest venture from Max Tucci, a third-generation partner of the legendary Delmonico’s steakhouse.
The space evokes a timeless, clubby warmth, balancing the comfort of a classic trattoria with the sophistication of a downtown hotspot.
Guests can expect generous portions of signatures like the chicken parmigiana, served in a dining room defined by soft lighting and old-school hospitality.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To confirm, cancel, or change your existing reservation, please refer to your email or text confirmation.

Name: Mari
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Hell's Kitchen, this Michelin-starred destination is the latest concept from Chef Sungchul Shim, the talent behind the acclaimed Kochi.
The intimate counter-dining space reimagines the casual handroll genre as a refined tasting menu, blending Korean flavors with high-precision technique.
A signature progression of handrolls features ingredients like cured mackerel and mushrooms, culminating in a traditional tray of banchan.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are subject to a fee of $50 per person. Guests who arrive more than 15 minutes late cannot be guaranteed the full menu.

Name: East Hampton Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located in the heart of the village, this reliable year-round fixture is a polished outpost of the Hillstone Restaurant Group. The interior features dark mahogany paneling and leather banquettes, creating a dimly lit, clubby environment suited for intimate dinners. A meal here invariably begins with the house-made rosemary biscuits, followed by classics like the Danish barbecue ribs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations that are not canceled by 1:00pm on the day of the booking will incur a non-refundable $25.00 charge per guest. No-show reservations will result in the same charge.

Name: The Musket Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by owner Jennifer Vitagliano and executive chef Mary Attea, this Michelin-starred Nolita restaurant features interiors by Alexander Waterworth.
The rustic-chic dining room features a walnut timber bar and lime-washed brick, setting the tone for a globally inspired, seasonal menu.
A signature glass wall opens onto a lush private garden, offering a rare al fresco sanctuary that anchors the dining experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please cancel at least 48 hours in advance. Canceling less than 48 hours before the reservation will incur the full charge.

Name: Rezdôra
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York’s Flatiron district, this Michelin-starred osteria is led by chef Stefano Secchi, an alumnus of Massimo Bottura’s Osteria Francescana.
The menu is dedicated to the culinary traditions of Emilia-Romagna, centering on handmade pastas that balance rustic authenticity with exacting technique.
A signature offering is "Grandma Walking Through Forest in Emilia," a green cappelletti dish that pays homage to the chef’s Modenese heritage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch reservations are subject to a $10 per person fee if cancelled within 12 hours of the reservation time or for no-shows. Dinner reservations are subject to a $25 per person fee if cancelled within 12 hours of the reservation time or for no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Eleven Madison Park
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a monumental Art Deco banking hall in the Flatiron District, this three-Michelin-starred restaurant is led by chef Daniel Humm.
Following a four-year plant-based tenure, the kitchen has reintroduced meat to offer parallel tasting menus that balance botanical precision with classic proteins.
The experience is defined by elaborate tableside service, most notably the return of the signature honey-lavender glazed duck.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All sales are final and non-refundable. We do not offer cancellation or rescheduling options at this time. Reservations require full prepayment.
Manual Price: Prepaid tasting menu charged at booking. Non-refundable. Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour (additional to non-refundable EMP charge).
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Set calendar reminder for the 1st of the month when the following month's dates release on Resy. Have member's payment details ready.
2. If sold out, monitor Resy daily for cancellation releases (rare but possible).
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and explicitly confirm in writing that they understand the prepaid reservation is non-refundable, no rescheduling, no exceptions.
4. Escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel for VVIP main-dining requests. Flag to CK that EMP main needs an insider contact added.
5. Offer Clemente Bar as a backup — separate booking flow, more accessible, April has referenced as a route.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: Plant-based Tasting Menu. Michelin: 3 Stars.
- Platform: Resy. Release: 1st of the month for the following month.
- Format: Prepaid tasting menu in main dining room. Clemente Bar (the EMP bar concept) is more accessible — April has referenced it as a route.
- Sales policy (verbatim): "This prepaid reservation is non-refundable. You will not receive a refund if you change or cancel." Members must be told this before booking.

Escalation:
- Colleen (placeholder) — flag for CK to add insider contact for main dining. Clemente Bar route via April is exploratory.

Name: Aquavit
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Midtown Manhattan, this two-Michelin-starred destination is helmed by executive chef Emma Bengtsson, the first female Swedish chef to win two stars.
The kitchen delivers a refined expression of modern Nordic cuisine, elevating humble seasonal ingredients through precise technique and minimalist presentation.
A standout finale is the signature Arctic Bird’s Nest, a visually intricate dessert composed of goat cheese parfait, sea buckthorn, and a honey tuile.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a prepaid deposit of $50 per person for dinner in the Dining Room and $25 per person for lunch or Bar Room seating. Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance are fully refundable; cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows forfeit the deposit.

Name: Shukette
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Acclaimed chef Ayesha Nurdjaja leads this Chelsea kitchen, serving rustic Middle Eastern fare in a bustling, tile-lined space.
The menu centers on a "rip-and-dip" experience, with diners gathering at the counter to share charcoal-grilled small plates.
Essential to the meal is the house-made Frena bread, a fluffy vessel designed for scooping up the signature Not Your Average Hummus.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of $25 per person is charged for cancellations made within 12 hours of the reservation time or for no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation window.

Name: ZZ's Clam Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Major Food Group founders Mario Carbone and Jeff Zalaznick operate this intimate Greenwich Village destination, a Michelin-starred raw bar known for its exclusivity and precision.
The tiny, speakeasy-style space offers a focused, decadent experience where pristine crudo and craft cocktails are served in a dimly lit setting.
A hand-painted bar anchors the room, setting the stage for the house signature: fresh uni served on warm, buttery pretzel toast.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: I Sodi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In the West Village, this celebrated Tuscan destination is the work of self-taught chef and James Beard Award winner Rita Sodi.
The kitchen honors the simplicity of Florentine cooking with a menu of unadorned, farm-fresh classics served in a setting of refined restraint.
The signature meat lasagna is constructed from layers of paper-thin house-made pasta, best enjoyed alongside one of the bar’s many Negroni variations.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the reservation time are subject to a fee of $50 per guest. This fee also applies to no-shows. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.
Manual Price: Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour. Venue deposit / cancellation not publicly listed.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy at the 2-week release for the target date.
2. If unavailable, set Resy Notify alert for the preferred time.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
4. Escalate to April with full request template. April will engage Remy (somm contact).
5. For VVIP, escalate to Colleen in parallel only if April cannot secure.
6. Walk-in during off-peak is a viable fallback.
7. Offer Via Carota (same operators) or Lilia as backups.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: Tuscan Italian. Michelin: 1 Star.
- Platform: Resy. Release: 2 weeks out (April-confirmed).
- Walk-ins available, especially during off-peak hours.

Insider:
- April — confirmed contact via Remy (somm). Communication often via Resy review for thank-yous as no direct line is shared.
- Escalation backup: Colleen (VVIP only, if April cannot secure).

Name: Jeju Noodle Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In the West Village, this restaurant from chef Douglas Kim is the first U.S. noodle shop to earn a Michelin star.
The kitchen reimagines humble Korean ramyun through a fine-dining lens, pairing complex broths with premium ingredients in a lively, open setting.
A seat at the U-shaped counter offers a close-up view of signatures like the wagyu brisket ramyun and the caviar-topped toro ssam bap.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Jeju Noodle Bar charges a cancellation fee of $50 per person for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: Avra Madison
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Owned by The Avra Group and Tao Group, this Greek estiatorio occupies a prominent location just steps from Central Park.
The Rockwell Group-designed interior evokes an open-air courtyard, featuring white oak, Dolomiti marble, and trees stretching toward soaring skylights.
A signature market-style ice display allows guests to select fresh whole fish, which is charcoal-grilled and finished with lemon and olive oil.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations are available 30 days in advance. A credit card is required to secure the reservation. A cancellation fee applies for no-shows or late cancellations.

Name: Chez Fifi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a refurbished Upper East Side townhouse, this bistro is led by Joshua and David Foulquier, the team behind Michelin-starred Sushi Noz.
Designed by Sweden’s Joyn Studio, the two-story space evokes a Parisian home with a menu bridging French and Basque traditions.
Chef Zack Zeidman’s offerings include a signature roast chicken and "Fifi" potatoes, best paired with a deconstructed blue cheese martini.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window.

Name: The Corner Store
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a prominent intersection in SoHo, this American bistro is the latest opening from Catch Hospitality Group and chef Michael Vignola.
The wood-paneled dining room evokes a mid-century martini bar, serving elevated interpretations of nostalgic comfort fare.
Signature orders include the wagyu French dip and spiced apple hand pies, best paired with a savory tomato martini.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancel 24+ hours in advance; $25/person fee for no-shows or late cancellations.
Manual Price: Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check SevenRooms and DoorDash for any available slots.
2. If unavailable, set SevenRooms waitlist notification.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
4. Email Arti with guest names, bio, occasion, and time range.
5. Follow up once after 24 hours.
6. Escalate to Nedah — direct CHG contacts.
7. For VVIP: Colleen → Eugene (senior contact, VVIP only).
8. Bar walk-in (13 seats) is a viable fallback — and a good way to get added to the guest list for future bookings.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: American / Seafood. Group: Catch Hospitality Group.
- Platform: SevenRooms / DoorDash (internal guest list system — limited public availability).
- Release: 2 weeks in advance.
- Guest list strategy: get in once (via bar walk-in or DoorDash), then ask server to add to system for future bookings.
- Bar: 13 seats, walk-in only (not reservable).

Venue contact:
- Arti (Manager) — direct email outreach.

Insider:
- Nedah — direct CHG contacts.

Senior escalation:
- Eugene via Colleen, VVIP only.

Name: Crazy Pizza
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Formula 1 mogul Flavio Briatore, this high-energy concept brings a jet-set edge to locations from London to New York.
The atmosphere is less traditional pizzeria and more theatrical party, defined by sleek interiors, DJ sets, and a see-and-be-seen crowd.
A signature ritual sees chefs performing acrobatic dough-spinning routines tableside before serving ultra-thin, yeast-free pies designed to be surprisingly light.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To guarantee your reservation, we ask you to enter a credit card as a guarantee. If the cancellation is made less than 8 hours before the scheduled time, a charge of 10€.

Name: Yoshino
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Master Chef Tadashi "Edowan" Yoshida, this Michelin-starred destination on the Bowery brings the precision of his former Nagoya institution to New York.
The omakase experience is defined by Yoshida’s distinct "Edowan" style, which harmonizes traditional aging techniques with an extensive champagne program.
Service unfolds at a ten-seat counter made from hinoki wood, where the chef presents signature courses like his celebrated pressed sushi.

Name: ABC Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within New York’s ABC Carpet & Home, this farm-to-table pioneer is the work of chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
The kitchen champions a sustainable ethos, serving seasonal American fare in a bright space defined by reclaimed wood and white porcelain.
A meal here is best concluded with the signature salted caramel ice cream sundae, topped with candied peanuts and caramel popcorn.

Name: Cosme
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Flatiron District, this modern Mexican dining room is led by Enrique Olvera, the chef behind Mexico City’s Pujol.
The kitchen applies contemporary techniques to traditional flavors, favoring a minimalist aesthetic that allows high-quality ingredients to lead.
A meal here culminates with the signature duck carnitas, a shared cast-iron dish best followed by the cracked corn husk meringue.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are subject to a fee of $50 per guest. Guests who are more than 15 minutes late may be charged $30 per person.

Name: Cafe Boulud
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Daniel Boulud, this Michelin-starred French destination resides within the Maison Barnes complex on Manhattan's Upper East Side.
The culinary program is defined by four distinct muses—La Tradition, La Saison, Le Potager, and Le Voyage—covering everything from French classics to global flavors.
A standout is the signature paupiette of sea bass, wrapped in crisp potato scales and served in a rich Barolo sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For Cafe Boulud Palm Beach, no shows or last minute cancellations will be charged the full menu price. For Cafe Boulud Toronto, all cancellations must be received at least four hours prior to expected check-in time, or the full cost will be charged.

Name: Untable
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located in Carroll Gardens, this intimate Thai destination is the solo debut of chef Rachanon “Un” Kampiman, an alumnus of the Michelin-recognized Somtum Der. The kitchen defies expectations with an "unconventional" menu that reimagines regional staples through a sharp, modern lens rather than adhering to strict tradition. A standout example is the signature "What the Hell" fried rice, a fiery crab-laden dish served with a warning level of chili heat.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Il Buco al Mare
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by owner Donna Lennard, this Amagansett venue brings the rustic ethos of Il Buco to a seafood-forward space on Main Street.
The culinary program revolves around a wood-burning oven, turning out blistered ancient grain focaccias and market-driven plates of roasted local fish.
A signature ritual involves pairing the house-baked bread with selections from a curated list of tinned seafood imported from Italy and the Iberian Peninsula.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window.

Name: The Crow's Nest
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the banks of Lake Montauk, this seasonal hideaway is the vision of hotelier Sean MacPherson.
The atmosphere is defined by a relaxed, rustic-chic aesthetic, with weathered wood structures and interiors dressed in global textiles.
A sloping lawn leads guests to the water for sunset drinks, followed by dinner featuring the signature fresh lemon pasta.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Bilboquet
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Philippe Delgrange, this waterfront outpost of the Manhattan original brings a spirited French bistro experience to the Sag Harbor marina.
The atmosphere balances the social buzz of a private club with the breezy charm of a seaside retreat, defined by rattan furniture and crisp linens.
Patrons arrive by boat or land for the signature Cajun chicken, a spicy classic served with beurre blanc and views of the harbor’s yachts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation and No-Show Policies, will be charged $50 per person if reservation is not canceled 72 hours prior to the reservation date.
Manual Price: Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour. Venue deposit / cancellation not publicly listed.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy for availability.
2. If unavailable, set Resy Notify alert for the preferred time.
3. Call the venue if Resy availability is limited — phone is often more productive at door-curated venues.
4. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
5. Escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel for VVIP.
6. Offer Fleming by Le Bilboquet as a same-group alternative.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: French Bistro. Group: Le Bilboquet group (sister venues in Sag Harbor; Fleming by Le Bilboquet in NYC).
- Platform: Resy + phone.
- Reputation: Established UES mainstay; door-curated for regulars.

Escalation:
- Colleen (placeholder) — flag for CK to add insider contact if not obvious from Slack channels, Nedah's list, or WhatsApp threads. Door-curated UES — insider relationship matters.

Name: Le Coucou
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within SoHo’s 11 Howard hotel, this Michelin-starred French restaurant is a celebrated collaboration between restaurateur Stephen Starr and chef Daniel Rose.
The Roman and Williams–designed space pairs raw brick and soaring ceilings with classic white-tablecloth service, offering a grounded yet grand stage for traditional gastronomy.
A standout on the menu is the quenelle de brochet, a delicate pike dumpling served in a rich lobster sauce that exemplifies the kitchen’s commitment to old-world recipes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee will not be charged if you cancel before 24 hours of your reservation. If you cancel after that, you agree to be charged a fee of $50 per guest on the reservation.

Name: Crown Shy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the Art Deco lobby of 70 Pine in the Financial District, this Michelin-starred destination was established by the late chef James Kent and restaurateur Jeff Katz.
The soaring, industrial-chic dining room presents a contemporary American menu that balances European technique with the diverse flavors of New York.
Regulars know to order the signature grilled citrus-marinated chicken, a shareable standout accompanied by house-made hot sauce and pickles.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are subject to a fee of $50 per person.

Name: Mary Lou's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Alex Melillo, Joe Cervasio, and Topher Grubb, this retro-glamorous supper club has expanded from a converted West Palm Beach bait shop to the W South Beach.
The atmosphere channels the hedonistic spirit of 1970s Palm Beach, blending vintage sophistication with a high-energy nightlife experience defined by maximalist design.
Signature touches include animal-print interiors, velvet-lined walls, and a late-night menu featuring elevated comfort food like A5 Wagyu burgers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Mavericks Montauk
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated off Half Moon Bay, this formidable break was pioneered by Jeff Clark, who rode its massive winter swells alone for over a decade.
The cold, treacherous waters draw elite surfers to challenge heavy, thunderous waves that can exceed sixty feet.
A unique underwater rock ramp focuses energy into a violent peak, a spectacle best observed from the safety of Pillar Point Bluff.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations may be cancelled on Resy to avoid the no-show fee. This can be done up until 2PM the day of the reservation. After that a $50 per person cancellation fee will be applied to the reservation. We hold tables for up to 15 minutes after your reservation. Beyond that we can no longer hold the table and the reservation would be considered a no-show.

Name: Frevo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Concealed behind a Greenwich Village art gallery, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the creation of chef Franco Sampogna and restaurateur Bernardo Silva.
The intimate space features a 16-seat counter facing an open kitchen, presenting a contemporary French tasting menu grounded in precision.
Guests enter through a secret doorway disguised as a large-scale painting, moving from the street-front exhibition into the secluded dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All sales are final. Deposits and pre-sold items are non-refundable. However, you can always transfer your reservation to another person. If your guest count drops below the reservation's original number, the deposit for the missing guests will be lost. Parties arriving more than 15 minutes late will forfeit portions of the tasting menu. Reservations require a $100 deposit per person.

Name: Llama Inn
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Erik Ramirez and Juan Correa lead this modern Peruvian restaurant, channeling Andean flavors through a contemporary New York lens.
The kitchen defines its "New Brooklyn Peruvian" style by updating traditional recipes with seasonal ingredients and precise technique.
A dedicated menu section for anticuchos features grilled skewers like beef heart and pork belly, served with spicy rocoto salsa.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner reservations require 12 hours' notice for cancellation to avoid a fee of $25 per person. Lunch reservations require 12 hours' notice to avoid a fee of $10 per person. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy. No-shows are subject to the full per-person fee.

Name: Elaia Estiatorio
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located in Bridgehampton, this transportive Greek estiatorio is the passion project of event designer Sofia Crokos and wine merchant Chris Boudouris. The kitchen delivers authentic, homestyle cooking in a whitewashed setting that feels distinctly like a slice of the Cyclades. Expect a menu anchored by charcoal-grilled whole fish and lamb chops, complemented by an exceptional list of indigenous Greek wines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to hold the table. There is a $25 per person fee for cancellations made within 12 hours of the reservation time or for no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation window.

Name: Torrisi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Puck Building, this Michelin-starred restaurant from Major Food Group and chef Rich Torrisi references New York’s Italian-American history.
The interior features a standing bar and two dining rooms, where the kitchen applies exacting standards to classic local dishes.
An open hearth anchors the space, turning out the signature Duck alla Mulberry alongside hand-rolled pastas and daily market specials.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: $50 per person cancellation fee for cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation time or for no-shows.
Manual Price: Booking fee: $5/person (non-refundable). Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy + set Notify alert.
2. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
3. Email regulars@majorfood.com with member bio and flexible time windows.
4. Follow up once after 24 hours if no reply.
5. Escalate to Colleen only if VVIP or <48 hours.
6. Present 1–2 alternatives proactively.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: Italian-American. Group: Major Food Group.
- Platform: Resy. Release: Dinner 30 days in advance at 10:00 AM EST. Lunch Tue-Sat at 11:00 AM.

Contacts:
- Primary contact: regulars@majorfood.com (Major Food Group regulars line).
- Escalation: Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel (VVIP or <48 hours only).

Name: Bar Miller
Master_Aurora_Insights:
An intimate eight-seat omakase counter in the East Village from the team behind Rosella.
This Michelin-starred destination reimagines the sushi experience by prioritizing sustainable, locally sourced North American seafood over traditional Japanese imports.
The warm, compact interior is defined by burl wood paneling and custom ceramics, creating a refined backdrop for the fifteen-course tasting menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: It takes a great deal of planning to prepare for your visit, therefore any cancellations or adjustments to a reservation less than 72 hours in advance, are non-refundable. Rescheduling to avoid the cancellation fee will not be accommodated. Private parties of 6 or more require one week's notice for cancellation with refund.

Name: Le Veau d'Or
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Riad Nasr and Lee Hanson, the team behind Frenchette, have meticulously restored New York's oldest French bistro on the Upper East Side.
The space retains its storied character with original details, balancing a sense of history with a lively, unpretentious mood.
A prix fixe menu features classics like sizzling frog legs in garlic butter and a signature martini served with a salty vermouth sidecar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our intimate dining room means we are unable to adjust party sizes once a reservation is confirmed. Decreases in party size will be subject to a fee of $50/seat. Finally, as a courtesy to other guests, we kindly ask that you book reservation times when you can join us. If you have no intention of joining us at an available reservation time, please allow others the opportunity to book the reservation.
Manual Price: Prix-fixe: Dinner ~$135 / Lunch ~$85 (Tue-Fri). Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy at 9:00 AM ET on the 14-day release for the target date.
2. If unavailable, set Resy Notify alert for the preferred time.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
4. Escalate to April with full request template.
5. For VVIP, escalate to Colleen in parallel only if April cannot secure.
6. Offer Frenchette (TriBeCa) as a same-operator alternative — Nedah also has access via the top MD who oversees Frenchette and Wild Cherry.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: French Bistro. Michelin: 1 Star. Operators: Riad Nasr and Lee Hanson (also Frenchette).
- Platform: Resy. Release: ~14 days in advance at 9:00 AM ET.
- Capacity: 15 tables; intimate.
- Format: Prix-fixe only.

Insider:
- April — confirmed she can secure here.
- Escalation backup: Colleen (VVIP only, if April cannot secure).

Name: Bar Pitti
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Greenwich Village, this bustling Tuscan trattoria is owned by Giovanni Tognozzi, who has run the sidewalk staple since 1992.
The no-frills destination is defined by its fast-paced energy, cash-only policy, and a daily rotation of specials presented on portable chalkboards.
A standout order is the Pappardelle alla Fiesolana, featuring flat pasta ribbons tossed with smoked bacon, cream, and tomatoes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: San Sabino
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated next to Don Angie in the West Village, this seafood-centric spot is the latest from chefs Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli.
The kitchen trades heavy red sauce for coastal Italian-American invention, serving clever plates in a room defined by butter-yellow tones and mid-century lighting.
A signature order is the shrimp parm, featuring three massive, head-on prawns rising dramatically from a pool of marinara.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please cancel at least 24 hours in advance. Cancellations within 24 hours incur a $50 per person fee.

Name: Peter Luger Steak House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by German immigrants in 1887, this James Beard America’s Classic in Williamsburg is one of New York’s oldest steakhouses.
The space retains a beer-hall aesthetic with oak wainscoting, brass chandeliers, and a brigade of white-aproned waiters.
The defining dish is the dry-aged porterhouse, served sizzling in clarified butter and often preceded by a slice of thick-cut bacon.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: “No show” reservations made online will be subject to a $40 per person fee if and only if the booking is not cancelled within 24 hours of the reservation date and time. Reservations are held for up to 15 minutes.

Name: Cafe Carmellini
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Fifth Avenue Hotel, this fine-dining destination is the signature project of James Beard Award-winning chef Andrew Carmellini.
The kitchen bridges Italian and French traditions with a distinct New York sensibility, serving polished plates in a maximalist, Martin Brudnizki-designed space.
A double-height dining room featuring full-sized trees sets the stage for signature dishes like the intricate Duck-Duck-Duck Tortellini.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation fee of $50 per person if not canceled 48 hours in advance. Credit card hold required.

Name: Oiji Mi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Flatiron District, this Michelin-starred destination from chef Brian Kim offers a refined evolution of modern Korean cuisine.
The five-course tasting menu reimagines traditional flavors with contemporary precision, served within a sophisticated space designed by AvroKO.
A highlight of the experience is the signature Oiji Bowl, featuring seaweed rice topped with Hokkaido sea urchin, spot prawn, and pickled cucumber.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations that are canceled less than 72 hours prior to the reserved time will be charged a cancellation fee of $50.00 per guest.
Manual Price: 5-course Prix-Fixe in main dining room: $150 per person. A la carte in Lounge & Bar. Venue CXL fee: $50/guest for <24h cancellations. Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy and OpenTable for availability.
2. If unavailable, set platform notify alert for the preferred time.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised, that they agree to the cancellation policy (including venue's $50/guest fee for cancellations <24 hours), and that they understand the 2-hour seating and 5-course prix-fixe in main dining.
4. Escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel for VVIP.
5. Bar / Lounge walk-in is a viable fallback for solo or small parties (a la carte option).

Name: Sag Harbor Tavern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the historic American Legion Hall on Bay Street, this waterfront spot comes from Billy Durney, the chef-owner behind Brooklyn’s Red Hook Tavern.
The atmosphere channels a classic American pub with a polished edge, offering a straightforward menu that prioritizes execution over experimentation.
Diners flock here for the signature dry-aged cheeseburger, served simply with American cheese and onion, alongside a thick slab of bacon and ridge-cut fries.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Crane Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in West Chelsea, this polished venue from Tao Group Hospitality is helmed by Michelin-starred chef Melissa Rodriguez.
The expansive interior functions as a modern supper club, pairing elevated steaks and pastas with a backdrop of Art Deco design.
A massive central bar anchors the room, flanked by sweeping banquettes that offer a prime vantage point for the evening's energy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For cancellations or changes to your reservation, we ask for a 48-hour notice before your reservation. Reservations may require a credit card for cancellation policies.

Name: BondST [NoHo]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a multi-story NoHo townhouse, this enduring Japanese destination from restaurateur Jonathan Morr has remained a downtown fixture since 1998.
The interior balances a warm, minimalist aesthetic with a lively social scene, offering a polished modern menu that transcends fleeting trends.
For a verifiable classic, order the Big Eye Tuna Tarts, a signature pairing of creamy spicy tuna and crispy rice that defined the genre.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Modern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within New York’s Museum of Modern Art, this two-Michelin-starred destination is a Danny Meyer project with streamlined interiors by architects Bentel & Bentel.
The dining room offers a quiet respite from the galleries, serving Chef Thomas Allan’s precise contemporary cuisine in a light-filled, minimalist setting.
A wall of floor-to-ceiling glass frames the Abby Aldrich Rockefeller Sculpture Garden, allowing the outdoor art to serve as the room’s primary focal point.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please cancel at least 48 hours in advance.

Name: Blanca
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in Paris's 11th arrondissement, this intimate Argentine-Basque bistro is a family affair led by chef Fernando de Tomaso and his sister Violetta.
The space balances the precision of French bistronomy with the rustic warmth of a Buenos Aires fonda, offering a soulful, unpretentious exploration of South American heritage.
Order the signature Angus flank steak with chimichurri or the hand-folded empanadas, best enjoyed at the counter with a glass of Malbec.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card number required for parties of 4 or more. Cancellation policy: 35$ per person that cancels within 24 hours of reservation.

Name: Estela
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a bustling downtown alcove, this Michelin-starred bistro is the celebrated flagship of Uruguayan chef Ignacio Mattos.
The kitchen delivers inventive, European-leaning small plates that prioritize sharp acidity and texture over heavy presentation.
A standout signature is the ricotta dumplings, served beneath a shield of paper-thin white button mushrooms and pecorino Sardo.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are subject to a fee of $25 per person. This fee also applies to no-shows.

Name: The Nines
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the top nine floors of the historic Meier & Frank building, this Luxury Collection hotel sits at the center of downtown Portland.
The design centers on a sun-drenched seven-story atrium, blending a vast contemporary art collection with LEED Silver sustainability credentials.
Visit the rooftop restaurant Departure for modern Asian plates and a wrap-around terrace that offers one of the city’s best skyline views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We have a 24hr cancellation policy for all deposits. Your deposit is to secure your booking and will be deducted from your final bill. Tables are released if you have not arrived within 20 minutes of your reservation. We allocate a time of 2.5hrs to your reservation.

Name: Misi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in South Williamsburg, this modern Italian destination is the second Brooklyn venture from acclaimed chef Missy Robbins.
The kitchen dedicates itself to a singular, disciplined format, serving only vegetable antipasti and handmade pasta dishes.
A glass-enclosed production room stands at the entrance, allowing guests to witness the methodical shaping of fresh noodles throughout the day.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations can be cancelled without penalty up to 24 hours in advance. Late cancellations (within 24 hours) or no-shows are subject to a fee of $50.00 per guest. A credit card hold is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Carbone
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Major Food Group’s Mario Carbone, Rich Torrisi, and Jeff Zalaznick, this Italian-American restaurant pays homage to the mid-century dining rooms of New York.
The atmosphere is defined by tuxedoed captains providing tableside service in a space that references the era of the classic red-sauce joint.
Signature plates like the spicy rigatoni vodka arrive on custom ceramics, underscoring a commitment to precise, retro-inspired culinary rituals.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To secure a reservation, a deposit of $25 per person is required for lunch, and $50 per person is required for dinner. Cancellations must be made by 12:00 PM on the day of the reservation to avoid forfeiting the deposit.
Manual Price: Lunch deposit $25/person; Dinner deposit $50/person (plus tax). Applied to final bill. Non-transferable.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy for availability. If not yet released, set a calendar reminder for the 30-day release at 10 AM EST.
2. If fully booked, set Resy Notify alert for 1 hour before and after the preferred time.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
4. Email regulars@majorfood.com with member bio, occasion, flexible time window, party size, and dietary restrictions.
5. If no response within 24 hours, follow up once on the same email thread.
6. If still unsuccessful or for VVIP: escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel with original request and member details.
7. Gather and offer Tier 1 alternatives in parallel (L'Artusi, Monkey Bar).

- Cuisine: Italian. Group: Major Food Group.
- Platform: Resy. Release: 30 days in advance at 10:00 AM EST.
- Dress code: Dress for the occasion. No shorts, open-toed shoes, tank tops, athletic wear, or baseball caps. May be refused entry.
- No high chairs; strollers not accommodated due to space constraints.
- Do not contact venue directly for cold outreach — always go through regulars@majorfood.com first.
