Name: The Palomar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Award-winning restaurateurs Layo and Zoë Paskin bring the vibrant flavors of modern Jerusalem to this energetic Soho destination.
The narrow, mosaic-lined room centers on a raucous open kitchen where the boundary between chef and diner dissolves.
Claim a stool at the counter to watch the action and order the signature kubaneh bread and polenta Jerusalem style.

Name: St. JOHN
Master_Aurora_Insights: Housed in a whitewashed former smokehouse near Smithfield, this restaurant is the culinary home of chef Fergus Henderson. The kitchen pioneered the nose-to-tail movement, serving a daily-changing menu of British classics and offal with rigorous, unadorned simplicity. Most meals begin with the signature roast bone marrow and parsley salad, a dish that has defined the venue since opening.

Name: 5 Hertford Street
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a discreet Shepherd Market townhouse, this private club is the creation of Robin Birley with interiors by fashion designer Rifat Ozbek.
The aesthetic blends English aristocracy with bohemian flair, featuring jewel-box dining rooms, open fireplaces, and an eclectic array of patterned textiles.
A ground-floor cigar shop leads into a heated courtyard, while the basement houses Loulou’s, a dimly lit nightclub distinguished by its signature stuffed giraffe.

Name: Annabel's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a Grade I-listed Georgian townhouse on Mayfair’s Berkeley Square, this private members’ club was reimagined by owner Richard Caring and designer Martin Brudnizki.
The maximalist interiors unfold across four floors, offering distinctively themed spaces that range from a frescoed garden room to a jungle-inspired nightclub.
A signature detail is the ladies’ powder room, defined by pink onyx basins, gold swan taps, and a ceiling of silk cherry blossoms.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: COMO Shambhala Urban Escape
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Christina Ong, this holistic wellness sanctuary is located within COMO’s metropolitan properties in cities including Singapore, Bangkok, and London.
The concept integrates modern science with ancient Asian therapies to support proactive health in a refined, minimalist setting.
A defining ritual is the signature COMO Shambhala Massage, which uses long, soothing strokes and custom-blended essential oils to restore balance.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before the workshop, private session, or consultation, and at least 12 hours before group equipment classes. Cancellations received after the stipulated time will result in deduction from package or forfeiture of pre-payment. For late cancellations or no-shows, the payment is non-refundable and will be forfeited.

Name: The Rex Rooms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former 151 site on Chelsea’s King’s Road, this nightlife venue is the work of fashion designer Marc Jacques Burton and operator Piers Adam.
The space references Gaudí and Dalí through structural twisted timbers and webbed ceilings, establishing a distinct, organic aesthetic within the basement setting.
A separate enclave known as the King’s 1942 Room functions as a dedicated tequila lounge, serving rare vintages in a wood-panelled, curvilinear environment.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 20% deposit is required to confirm the booking. The deposit is non-refundable (specifically noted for bookings within 48 hours). In case of an emergency cancellation, the venue is happy to discuss options or apply the deposit as credit for a future visit.

Name: Singburi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Sirichai Kularbwong, this Michelin-recognized Thai restaurant recently relocated from its original Leytonstone home to a larger space in Shoreditch.
The family-run establishment focuses on authentic, regional cooking served in a lively, informal dining room.
Signature dishes include the wild ginger chicken thigh and dill pork sausage, which are often enjoyed at the restaurant's counter seating.

Name: The Tamil Prince
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a neighborhood pub in Islington, this lively venue is led by chef Prince Durairaj, formerly of Roti King, and Glen Leeson.
The kitchen reimagines the British boozer with a South Indian menu, pairing robust, spice-forward sharing plates with craft beers and cocktails.
A standout order is the channa bhatura, a balloon-sized fried bread served with chickpea masala that dominates the compact tables.

Name: Six Senses London
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the restored Grade II-listed Whiteleys department store in Bayswater, this UK debut features architecture by Foster + Partners and interiors by AvroKO.
The project adapts the group's remote wellness philosophy for a metropolitan context, integrating hotel rooms, residences, and a members' club.
Facilities include a comprehensive longevity clinic and a thermal suite housing a twenty-meter indoor swimming pool and London’s first magnesium pool.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation and prepayment policies vary by property, rate type, and season. Flexible rates generally permit cancellation without penalty up to a specified deadline (ranging from 24 hours to 30 days prior to arrival). Cancellations made after the deadline and no-shows are subject to a fee of up to 100% of the total booking value. Non-refundable rates require full prepayment at the time of booking and are non-refundable. A credit card guarantee or deposit is required for all reservations.

Name: Four Seasons Spa Park Lane
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by architect Eric Parry, the Four Seasons Spa Park Lane occupies a rooftop setting in Mayfair.
The facility features nine glass-walled treatment rooms that provide unobstructed views of Hyde Park and the surrounding cityscape.
The layout includes a double-sized Sky Suite with 180-degree skyline views, alongside two skylit vitality pools and windowed saunas.

Name: Celeste
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a historic 1888 structure designed by Louis Sullivan, this River North venue offers a vertical journey through Chicago nightlife.
The space evolves across four distinct levels, moving from a 1920s-inspired supper club to a lush, ivy-covered rooftop garden.
Its restored masonry facade, a remnant of the building's origins as a glass factory, frames this distinct setting for American cuisine and craft cocktails.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We have a 48 hour cancellation policy for our events with the exception of our wine dinners, which have a four day cancellation policy, our WSET courses which have a two week cancellation policy and all wine trips, which have a two month cancellation policy. If cancelled within these timeframes your deposit is fully refundable.

Name: The Arts Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Charles Dickens in 1863, this Mayfair club was reimagined in 2011 by restaurateur Arjun Waney and designer David d'Almada.
The space bridges its literary history with modern design, hosting a permanent art collection and temporary exhibitions by international artists.
A highlight is the Japanese restaurant Kyubi, where the dining room features a sculptural chandelier composed of iron strokes representing calligraphy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Online bookings can be modified or cancelled up to 24 hours before the reserved time. Cancellations within 24 hours of the reservation date may be subject to a cancellation fee.

Name: Sabor
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Nieves Barragán Mohacho and José Etura, this Michelin-starred destination brings distinct Spanish regional cuisines to London’s Mayfair.
The split-level venue divides its focus between a lively Andalusian tapas counter on the ground floor and a communal Castilian asador upstairs.
A traditional wood-fired oven anchors the experience, producing the signature Segovian suckling pig with crisp, golden skin.

Name: Rita's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founders Gabriel Pryce and Missy Flynn have anchored their cult-status modern American bistro on Soho’s Lexington Street.
The kitchen elevates comforting Americana using seasonal British produce, offering a menu that balances nostalgia with contemporary flair.
Start with the signature Gilda martini, a briny essential often enjoyed alongside the tear-and-share garlic bread.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our cancellation policy is up to £30 per guest in the case of late cancellation (24 Hours) or no- show.

Name: White's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1693 by Francesco Bianco and counting King Charles III among its members, London’s oldest private club occupies a Grade I-listed townhouse on St James’s Street.
The institution remains strictly aristocratic, preserving a hermetic atmosphere where business discussion is forbidden and privacy is absolute.
Its legendary betting book records centuries of eccentric wagers, such as which raindrop would reach the bottom of the bow window first.

Name: Tape London
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mayfair’s Hanover Square, Tape London is a hybrid nightclub and recording studio founded by creative director Jacobi Anstruther-Gough-Calthorpe.
This music-first destination merges a late-night performance space with professional production facilities, regularly hosting global artists for sessions and shows.
A dedicated lounge offers a direct view into the recording suite, which features a high-specification PMC QB1 XBD monitoring system.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For standard table bookings, no deposit is required, and the minimum spend is payable directly at the venue on the night. For high-demand events (such as New Year's Eve or major artist performances), a non-refundable deposit is required to secure the booking.

Name: Umu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a discreet spot on a Mayfair cul-de-sac, this Michelin-starred restaurant presents authentic Kyoto-style kaiseki under the guidance of executive chef Ryo Kamatsu.
The windowless, wood-paneled interior fosters a hermetic atmosphere, allowing the focus to remain entirely on a seasonal menu rooted in the philosophy of "born of nature."
A handle-less sliding door marks the entrance, opening to reveal a dining room celebrated for its pioneering use of line-caught Cornish seafood.

Name: The Araki
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by sushi master Mitsuhiro Araki in Mayfair, this intimate nine-seat restaurant is now directed by his long-time protégé Marty Lau.
The kitchen applies traditional Edomae techniques to locally sourced European seafood, challenging the convention of importing fish directly from Tokyo.
Diners sit at a 200-year-old cypress counter to witness the preparation of courses such as Cornish squid and Irish tuna.

Name: Sushi Kanesaka
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Shinji Kanesaka in Tokyo’s Ginza district, this Michelin-starred sanctuary is a bastion of traditional Edomae sushi.
The minimalist space centers on a hinoki counter, where the omakase highlights rice seasoned with red vinegar and served at body temperature.
A signature ritual involves the chef lingering for "0.5 seconds of elegance" when placing each piece, ensuring a moment of perfect visual balance.

Name: The Cow
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Tom Conran in Notting Hill, this venue combines a traditional Irish saloon with a separate upstairs dining room.
The ground floor is defined by a bustling atmosphere for Guinness and seafood, while the upper level offers a quieter environment for Northern European dishes.
A signature pint of prawns and fresh rock oysters, served on ice, stand as the enduring order in this art-filled local favorite.

Name: The Beaumont Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Thierry Despont-refined interiors of Mayfair’s Beaumont hotel, this spa occupies a quiet corner of a converted 1926 garage.
Clad in stark white marble and mosaics, the facility is defined by its geometric precision and an unhurried, intimate atmosphere.
The centrepiece is a heated marble table for traditional hammam rituals, a warming focal point amidst the cool, clean lines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require 24 hours' notice to cancel or rearrange treatments and 48 hours' notice to cancel or rearrange Spa Experiences. Cancellations made with less than the required notice or failure to arrive for an appointment will incur the full charge.

Name: The London Reign
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The London Reign is a performance-led showclub in Mayfair, founded by Asher Grant with interiors by Brace Studio.
The venue merges a nightclub atmosphere with live theatre, featuring aerialists and fire artists on two dedicated stages.
An illuminated tank of live jellyfish serves as a central design feature, complementing the nightly spectacle of confetti and pyrotechnics.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Cuckoo Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Mayfair, this bi-level nightlife destination features interiors redesigned by Biba founder Barbara Hulanicki.
The space is divided into a ground-floor bar and a subterranean club, defined by a moody aesthetic of dark purples and plush velvet.
A key highlight is The Garden, a downstairs room featuring sculptural lighting and blooming floral details that frame the late-night dance floor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Box
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Simon Hammerstein, grandson of lyricist Oscar Hammerstein II, this theatre of varieties operates in both New York and London.
The venue channels a decadent, crumbling opera house aesthetic, serving as a stage for provocative burlesque and avant-garde cabaret.
Intricate antique woodwork and deep velvet banquettes surround the central stage, where the signature late-night performances defy conventional theatrical boundaries.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Ritz Restaurant
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within The Ritz London in Mayfair, this Two Michelin-starred dining room is led by Executive Chef John Williams MBE.
The kitchen executes classical French cuisine using British produce, served in a Louis XVI interior of marble columns and gilded chandeliers.
Service retains the theatre of the guéridon, with signature plates like the Langoustine à la Nage finished tableside overlooking Green Park.

Name: Scott's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1851 as an oyster warehouse, this Mount Street institution is a historic Mayfair seafood restaurant owned by Caprice Holdings.
The Martin Brudnizki–designed interiors feature a club-like dining room and a street-side terrace that draws a high-profile London crowd.
A central, marble-topped oyster and champagne bar anchors the space, serving signature platters of shellfish and grilled Dover sole.

Name: Sushi Atelier
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Fitzrovia, this modern sushi bar comes from the experienced team behind the respected Chisou restaurants.
The kitchen balances traditional technique with playful innovation, delivering one of London’s most accessible yet high-quality omakase experiences.
A standout signature is the butterfish carpaccio, decadently topped with seared foie gras and crisp vegetable chips.

Name: Maddox Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by nightlife entrepreneur Fred Moss in the heart of Mayfair, this private members' club has operated as a central fixture of London’s late-night scene since 2007.
The venue functions as a dual-purpose destination, housing a mezzanine Italian restaurant that overlooks a minimalist, subterranean nightclub.
A signature glass-enclosed DJ booth commands the main floor, while a rare open-air courtyard offers a quiet retreat from the sound system.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made 48 hours in advance for full refund of deposit. Late cancellations may be subject to charges.

Name: The Cadogan Arms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the King’s Road, this restored Chelsea institution is a project from JKS Restaurants and Dominic Jacobs, with a menu overseen by culinary director James Knappett.
The kitchen refines traditional British pub culture through a focus on provenance, delivering polished classics rather than deconstructed interpretations.
A definitive order is the boneless crispy lamb ribs with anchovy and sorrel yoghurt, a signature starter that exemplifies the kitchen's elevated approach.

Name: Connaught Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by the David Collins Studio, this Mayfair venue within The Connaught Hotel has been recognized by the 50 Best list as the world's top bar.
The shimmering, Cubist-inspired Art Deco interior sets the stage for a cocktail program that balances historical recipes with contemporary innovation.
A defining feature is the signature Martini Trolley, which arrives tableside for a personalized preparation ritual involving distinct bitters and spirits.

Name: Dear Darling
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Jermyn Street, this Mayfair venue from the Cream Group and Fitzpatrick Design operates as a split-level bar and nightclub.
The interior contrasts a Victorian-style "Living Room" lounge on the ground floor with a late-night club space in the basement.
The experience is centered around the fictional hostess Lady Darling, featuring theatrical burlesque performances and a setting hidden beneath the pavement.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Wolseley
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a 1921 car showroom designed by William Curtis Green, this Piccadilly landmark operates as a grand European café in the Viennese tradition.
The high-ceilinged interior is defined by black-and-white geometric marble floors, soaring pillars, and a bustling, disciplined atmosphere.
While afternoon tea is celebrated, the definitive ritual is breakfast, featuring the signature Eggs Benedict served beneath the theatrical vaulted arches.

Name: Sketch Lecture Room & Library
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a Mayfair townhouse, this three-Michelin-starred venue is the flagship of restaurateur Mourad Mazouz and master chef Pierre Gagnaire.
The kitchen delivers complex, multi-course tasting menus that apply rigorous French technique to artistic, seasonal presentations.
Interior designer Gahban O’Keeffe defined the theatrical space with rich sunset tones, velvet armchairs, and a central gilded silver chandelier.

Name: Mark's Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a classic Mayfair townhouse, this private retreat was founded by Mark Birley and recently refreshed by Parisian designer Tino Zervudachi.
It operates as a bastion of old-world refinement, where silver service and a strict dress code preserve the atmosphere of an English country home.
The dining room is anchored by the Mark’s Club Trolley, a signature ritual where daily roasts are carved tableside for members.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Tabu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in The St. Regis Downtown Dubai, Tabu is the work of Infini Concepts and executive chef Roberto Segura.
The venue is defined by its theatrical approach to dining, where avant-garde cuisine is paired with immersive entertainment.
Signature rituals include immersive 'Noh' theatre and sumo appearances that unfold amidst the dining room’s dramatic, dimly lit architecture.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No-Show policy and Same-day cancellation policy of $10 per person.

Name: The Scotch of St. James
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden in a Mason's Yard cul-de-sac, this historic nightclub served as the primary meeting ground for London’s 1960s rock elite.
The split-level space combines a speakeasy atmosphere with late-night revelry, defined by velvet banquettes, mirrored panels, and low lighting.
A handcrafted copper bar and the original gilded staircase remain from the era when Jimi Hendrix played his first UK gig here.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bath & Racquets Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden away on Brook's Mews in Mayfair, this private men's health and squash club was originally conceived by Mark Birley.
The interiors evoke a traditional country house with wood panelling, antique rugs, and Bateman cartoons, creating a quiet retreat where phones are banned.
A signature ritual sees all kit laundered and laid out for members on-site, ensuring there is never a need to carry a gym bag.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Sollip
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London’s Bermondsey, Sollip is a Michelin-starred restaurant led by husband-and-wife team Woongchul Park and Bomee Ki.
The kitchen applies classical French techniques to Korean ingredients, serving tasting menus in a dining room of understated pastel hues.
A signature detail is the daikon tarte tatin, which reimagines the traditional dessert as a savory course with caramelized radish.

Name: Third Space
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring the Wood Wharf district, this 32,000-square-foot club was designed by RHE as a sanctuary for high-performance training.
The industrial-luxe interior balances a serious "training playground" aesthetic—featuring a freestanding athletic rig—with the calming finish of a boutique hotel.
Natural light defines the experience, particularly in the 20-metre swimming pool hall where floor-to-ceiling glazing frames views of the water and public gardens.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Member appointments for medical centre, personal training and spa that have been booked require 24 hours’ notice when cancelling. If a Member fails to attend an appointment without providing such notice, the Club reserves the right to charge the full cost of the appointment.

Name: Sense, A Rosewood Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This proprietary wellness sanctuary resides within Rosewood Hotels & Resorts properties worldwide, reflecting the group's commitment to immersive, location-specific luxury.
The spa’s identity is anchored in a "Sense of Place" philosophy, where every treatment and design element draws directly from the local culture and indigenous healing traditions.
Signature "Lost Remedies" rituals distinguish the menu, reviving ancient regional therapies by utilizing native botanicals to forge a tangible connection to the destination.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you wish to reschedule or cancel your booking, please be advised that 24 hours are required in order for us to accommodate your request, or two hours if the appointment is made on the same day. No-show or last-minute cancellations will incur a 100% charge.

Name: Automobile Club de France
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the Place de la Concorde, the world's oldest automobile club occupies the Hôtel du Plessis-Bellière, a historic mansion with a facade by royal architect Ange-Jacques Gabriel.
Beyond its role in motorsport history, the private institution offers members a vast social sanctuary featuring a swimming pool, movie theater, gym, and various dining rooms.
A standout feature is the club’s library, which preserves a remarkable collection of over 50,000 automotive references and rare volumes.

Name: La Clairière
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the UNESCO-listed Northern Vosges Biosphere Reserve, this Alsatian retreat is a pioneer in eco-centric wellness.
The holistic programming combines Traditional Chinese Medicine and Ayurveda with a certified organic restaurant that sources local, seasonal ingredients.
A 1,000-square-metre spa opens directly onto the woodland, inviting guests to practice *Shinrin-yoku* forest bathing or relax in the heated outdoor hydrotherapy pool.

Name: The Peninsula Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Belgravia, this Peter Marino-designed facility occupies a subterranean level of The Peninsula London, featuring an exclusive salon by Errol Douglas.
The wellness menu combines Ayurvedic rituals from Subtle Energies with results-driven facials by Margy’s Monte Carlo.
A 25-metre indoor swimming pool anchors the space, surrounded by mosaic landscapes and overhead panels that simulate the changing natural light.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 100% cancellation charge will be incurred for any spa treatment cancelled within 24 hours prior to the appointment.

Name: Silencio
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located deep underground in Paris, this private cultural club and cinema was conceived and designed by filmmaker David Lynch.
The interior evokes the surreal atmosphere of *Mulholland Drive* through walls lined with gold leaf, custom furniture, and a moody layout.
A standout feature is the smoking room, which is designed to resemble a forest.

Name: E by Equinox
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within a converted historic bank on St James’s Street, this private fitness club features interiors by Joyce Wang and architecture by Woods Bagot.
The space contrasts original rare marble cladding with modern design to create a discreet, science-led environment for advanced training and recovery.
Facilities include a private Pilates studio, a regeneration room for cryotherapy and compression, and a spa equipped with eucalyptus steam rooms.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel or reschedule your Session up to twenty-four (24) hours before the Session is due to start. You will be charged for the full cost of the Session if you cancel or reschedule with less than twenty-four (24) hours’ prior notice or if you fail to show up to your Session.

Name: Bar Les Ambassadeurs
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Hôtel de Crillon on the Place de la Concorde, this historic salon was reimagined by interior architect Chahan Minassian.
The room commands attention with its 18th-century grandeur, defined by soaring marble walls, gilded chandeliers, and a heritage-listed ceiling fresco of a cloudy sky.
Bar Director Arnaud Volte leads the "A Sense of Memories" menu, pairing evocative illustrations with complex libations like the Coing de Paradis.

Name: The Spa at Equinox
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying three floors in a historic former bank building at 12 St James's Street, this ultra-exclusive wellness destination was designed by architects Woods Bagot and interior designer Joyce Wang with a focus on high-performance luxury.
The interiors are defined by a rich, industrial-modern material palette of black perforated metal, stained oak timber, marble, fluted glass, and large copper accents that frame the doorways. The space is anchored by a striking mezzanine with a double-curved, backlit bulkhead and a grand staircase.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel or reschedule your Treatment up to twenty-four (24) hours before the Treatment is due to start. You will be charged for the full cost of the Treatment if you cancel or reschedule with less than twenty-four (24) hours’ prior notice or if you fail to show up to your Treatment.

Name: Raspoutine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris’s Golden Triangle, this former Russian cabaret is operated by Alexander Ghislain and Logan Maggio.
The venue preserves a baroque aesthetic with heavy red velvet drapery and alcoves that contrast with the contemporary deep-house soundtrack.
Interiors designed by the artist Erté feature intricate stained glass and gold embroidery, setting the stage for a signature caviar and vodka service.

Name: The Lanesborough Club & Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Oetker Collection and designed by 1508 London, this subterranean wellness space sits within the historic Lanesborough hotel in Knightsbridge.
The facility operates as a hybrid private members’ club and spa, merging high-performance fitness with advanced aesthetic treatments.
Interiors inspired by ceremonial Roman baths feature rhythmic colonnades of Cream Vanian marble, setting the stage for signature rituals by partners like Tata Harper.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Treatments may be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours prior to your booked treatment time; thereafter the full rate is charged. Spa day bookings may be cancelled free of charge up to 72 hours in advance; thereafter the full rate is charged. Fitness classes may be cancelled up to three hours before the beginning of a class, thereafter a £40 cancellation fee is charged.

Name: The Spa at Brown's Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Mayfair’s historic Brown's Hotel, this intimate spa is an outpost of the Rocco Forte wellness portfolio.
The quiet, subterranean retreat merges Sicilian design influences with multi-sensory therapies grounded in Mediterranean botanicals.
A standout offering is the Hot Milk and Honey Foot Facial, alongside treatments using Irene Forte skincare ingredients grown at the Verdura Resort in Sicily.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 100% charge will be incurred for spa treatments not cancelled within 24 hours of the scheduled treatment time. Guests arriving late for spa treatments will receive a shortened treatment time and will be charged the full price of the scheduled treatment.

Name: Castel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on a sunny plateau above Merano, this family-run five-star retreat is a sanctuary of South Tyrolean hospitality led by the Dobitsch family.
The property balances extensive wellness facilities with a serious commitment to gastronomy, offering a refined yet relaxed alpine atmosphere.
Its crown jewel is the two-Michelin-starred Castel finedining, where chef Gerhard Wieser orchestrates innovative regional cuisine against a backdrop of sweeping vineyard views.

Name: Deflower
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the 8th arrondissement, this hybrid nightlife venue is a concept from the Paris Society group.
The space blurs the lines between an intimate cocktail bar and a high-energy club, offering a sophisticated alternative to traditional discotheques.
Its 1970s-inspired interior, designed by Vincent Rautureau, evokes a vintage recording studio with details like standing microphones.

Name: Cercle de l'Union Interalliée
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the 18th-century Hôtel Perrinet de Jars, this private club was founded in 1917 to foster diplomatic ties among Allied nations.
The atmosphere defines traditional *art de vivre*, blending gilded reception rooms with a modern athletic wing and a 25-meter swimming pool.
Its defining feature is the expansive landscaped garden, a rare sanctuary adjoining the British Embassy that offers Paris’s most discreet outdoor dining.

Name: Bar Hemingway
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked inside the Ritz Paris, this compact salon is a historic literary enclave lined with the namesake author’s memorabilia and typewriters.
The wood-paneled space resembles a private study, featuring tufted leather banquettes and a hushed atmosphere suited for conversation.
White-jacketed bartenders mix the signature Serendipity, a refreshing cocktail combining Calvados, apple juice, fresh mint, and Champagne.

Name: Les Jardins de Bagatelle
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the Bois de Boulogne, this open-air venue is the Parisian outpost of the global Bagatelle hospitality group.
The seasonal restaurant combines a festive club energy with a Mediterranean menu, offering a refined yet lively dining experience.
Tables are arranged amidst a historic landscape originally built in just 64 days to settle a bet between the Comte d'Artois and Marie Antoinette.

Name: Bonnie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop the SO/ Paris hotel, this restaurant, bar, and club is a retro-futuristic destination from the hospitality group Paris Society.
Designed by Jordane Arrivetz, the interior channels a psychedelic 1960s aesthetic with warm hues, plush textures, and a distinct Space Age verve.
An immersive mirrored ceiling by Studio Other Spaces transforms the room into a kaleidoscope, reflecting 360-degree views of the Seine and Eiffel Tower.

Name: Boum Boum
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Avenue de Friedland, this Paris Society venue designed by architect Charles Tassin reimagines the nightclub as a participatory arena.
The "neo-club" concept merges the energy of a live concert with the polished aesthetic of a 1970s-inspired lounge.
Giant screens display lyrics for crowd-wide sing-alongs, a signature ritual amplified by clouds of confetti and showers of sparks.

Name: Cloud Twelve
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a converted mews in Notting Hill, this wellness and lifestyle club is the creation of herbalist and naturopath Jenya Di Pierro.
The venue merges a family-friendly members' club with a holistic sanctuary, balancing social spaces for parents with serious clinical wellness programs.
Signature features include a dedicated herbal pharmacy, a plant-based brasserie, and an interactive forest-themed play zone for children.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require 48hrs notice for cancellations to avoid being charged. Cancellations made within the 48hrs will be charged at full price.

Name: Rebase Recovery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Marylebone, this social wellness club was founded by Alex Rebeiz and former British fencer Waldo Ramsay, with interiors by Atelier Wren.
The venue frames recovery as a communal act, spanning Finnish saunas and ice baths to hyperbaric oxygen therapy.
A standout feature is the "Dune-like" Members' Suite, where a partnership with 4ocean ensures every ice bath helps remove ocean plastic.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask for a minimum of 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule an appointment. Cancellations within this time frame may be subject to a cancellation fee.

Name: Third Space
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring Canada Square, this 100,000-square-foot outpost is Europe’s largest health club, occupying three floors of the financial district.
The vast layout moves beyond standard fitness, incorporating a medical centre, a combat zone, and a dedicated functional training space designed by Studio RHE.
Distinctive elements include a 13-metre climbing wall and a 23-metre ozone-treated swimming pool flooded with natural light.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancelled within 24 hours incurs 50% of the treatment price. Cancelled on the same day or no show incurs a 100% fee of the treatment price.

Name: St. James's Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a private 100-acre peninsula on Antigua’s southeastern coast, this resort is anchored by its dual frontage on Mamora Bay and the Caribbean Sea.
The property functions as a self-contained village, offering a mix of hillside villas and suites that cater to a relaxed, club-style community.
A standout feature is the open-air Piccolo Mondo restaurant, which is perched on the hillside to provide commanding views of the bay.

Name: Mia Mao
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a cavernous industrial hall in Paris’s La Villette, this electronic music destination was launched by co-founder Arnaud Perrine.
The venue is defined by its brutalist cathedral-like scale, featuring seven-meter ceilings and raw concrete interiors designed for total immersion.
A strict no-photography policy enforces a "disconnect to connect" ritual, where phone lenses are stickered to ensure focus remains on the custom lighting scenography.

Name: Les Planches
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by architect Charles Adda in 1923, this timber promenade runs along the seafront of Deauville and was made famous by director Claude Lelouch.
The walkway is crafted from exotic azobé wood and flanked by Art Deco bathing cabins displaying the names of American film stars.
Originally conceived to protect hemlines from the sand, the boardwalk anchors a mosaic-lined bathing complex and serves as the town's social center.

Name: Jangal
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Avenue de l'Opéra, this nightlife destination occupies the space formerly held by the legendary ParisParis club.
The interior is defined by a "jungle chic" aesthetic, creating a lush, vegetal alcove that offers a sharp contrast to the city outside.
A series of Maharaja portraits lines the walls, overseeing the late-night ritual of cocktails and music amidst the abundant greenery.

Name: La Fête
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Birmingham’s historic Morris Avenue, this Michelin Bib Gourmand bistro is the creation of James Beard-nominated chef Kristen Hall.
The intimate dining room channels a timeless French ethos with tiled flooring, quaint tables, and cabinets lined with wine bottles.
A partnership with sister bakery Bandit Pâtisserie ensures standout pastries, while the roasted half chicken with potato gratin remains a perennial crowd-pleaser.

Name: Mish Mish
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located in Philadelphia's East Passyunk neighborhood, this Mediterranean restaurant is the debut project from former food editor Alex Tewfik. The kitchen delivers a vegetable-forward menu of shareable small plates within a chic, spare interior that feels both polished and neighborly. True to its name, which means "apricot" in Arabic and Hebrew, the meal ideally concludes with a Champagne-poached stone fruit dessert when in season.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Due to the small size of our restaurant, reservations cancelled within 24 hours of your reservation time will incur a $30 per person cancellation fee. Please note: There are no exceptions to this policy. If you absolutely must cancel your reservation last-minute, please call the restaurant Thurs-Mon anytime after 3 p.m. to reschedule and we’ll waive the fee as a one-time courtesy. (Cancelling your rescheduled reservation at any time will re-trigger the fee.)

Name: Chuan Body + Soul
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Langham Hospitality Group, this wellness enclave grounds its practice in the principles of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
The menu is curated around the Five Elements—wood, fire, earth, metal, and water—tailoring therapies to address specific energy imbalances.
A standout treatment, the Chuan Harmony Massage, combines full-body acupressure with element-specific oils to stimulate meridian flow.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All cancellations and amendments should be done at least 24 hours prior to your booking. For late cancellations or amendments, we will levy 100% of the full treatment fee. In case of a no-show, we will levy the full treatment fee. All packages and products are non-refundable.

Name: Taboo Beach Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by Grupo RosaNegra with award-winning architecture by Jorge Borja, this Mediterranean beach club anchors prime waterfronts in Tulum and Cabo.
The open-air venue combines rustic wood design with a spirited social atmosphere, shifting from a daytime lounge to a high-energy dinner club.
A signature theatrical flair marks the service, with live saxophone performances and sparkler-lit champagne presentations accompanying the Mediterranean seafood menu.

Name: Lucali
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a former candy store in Brooklyn’s Carroll Gardens, this rustic pizzeria is the passion project of neighborhood native Mark Iacono.
The no-reservations, BYOB destination operates with old-school simplicity, serving a limited menu of brick-oven pies and calzones in a dimly lit, intimate setting.
Diners watch from wooden tables as dough is rolled out with empty wine bottles before being topped with fresh basil and blistered to a crisp finish.

Name: Le Pavillon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Midtown’s One Vanderbilt, this restaurant pairs Chef Daniel Boulud’s expertise with the modernist vision of Brazilian architect Isay Weinfeld.
The atmosphere evokes a suspended garden, where a seafood-centric, vegetable-forward menu is served amidst lush plantings that soften the skyscraper’s geometry.
A defining feature is the indoor grove of Black Olive trees, which creates intimate canopies beneath the soaring ceilings.

Name: Maple & Ash
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Two-Michelin-starred Chef Danny Grant leads this modern steakhouse, named for the woods that fuel its central hearth.
The space trades traditional quiet for a high-energy atmosphere, pairing fire-roasted cuts with a dark, clubby aesthetic.
For a spontaneous experience, the "I Don't Give a F*ck" tasting menu surrenders control to the kitchen for a surprise parade of dishes.

Name: Tambourine Room by Tristan Brandt
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Carillon Miami Wellness Resort, this intimate venue is led by German chef Tristan Brandt and chef de cuisine Timo Steubing.
The Michelin-starred kitchen presents a technical French tasting menu with Asian inflections, set within a hushed, Art Deco–inspired dining room.
While the name honors the resort's 1958 cocktail lounge, the experience is thoroughly modern, anchored by dishes like the signature beef tartare with kimchi.

Name: Niño Gordo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ranked among Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants, this Palermo Soho parrilla by chefs Germán Sitz and Pedro Peña reimagines the Argentine steakhouse through an Asian lens.
The interior is saturated in red light from hundreds of paper lanterns, creating a cinematic backdrop for a menu that fuses Eastern flavors with local beef.
A definitive order is the katsu sando, a panko-breaded steak sandwich served on toasted milk bread in the neon-lit dining room.

Name: Gekkō
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami’s Brickell district, this Japanese steakhouse is a collaboration between restaurateur David Grutman and recording artist Bad Bunny.
The Rockwell Group-designed interior sets a nocturnal tone with jewel-toned velvet banquettes, dark wood accents, and dramatic lighting that bridges dining and nightlife.
Menu highlights include the signature A5 Wagyu beef served on a hot stone and elaborate raw preparations like the "Lava and Ice" Kumamoto oysters.

Name: Estiatorio Milos
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Costas Spiliadis, this Greek seafood specialist is defined by its strict sourcing of fresh, wild-caught ingredients.
The dining room features an open fish market where guests select their catch to be grilled or baked with minimal intervention.
A meal typically begins with the Milos Special, a tower of paper-thin fried zucchini and eggplant layered with tzatziki and kefalograviera cheese.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a fee of $50 per person. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Balthazar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened by restaurateur Keith McNally in 1997, this SoHo venue operates as a faithful interpretation of a traditional Parisian brasserie.
The expansive room features red leather banquettes, tarnished brass rails, and oversized antique mirrors that amplify the space's constant, energetic chatter.
A three-tiered seafood plateau is the centerpiece of a menu that also highlights steak frites and bread baked in the adjacent shop.

Name: Los Félix
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Coconut Grove, this Michelin-starred outpost by chef Sebastián Vargas honors Mesoamerican heritage through a rigorous culinary lens.
The kitchen centers on an in-house molino processing heirloom corn for tortillas, served alongside natural wines in a space that doubles as an analogue listening bar.
A curated vinyl soundtrack accompanies the menu, which highlights ingredients like milpa-farmed maize and signature pork cheek carnitas.

Name: Doya
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized with a Michelin Bib Gourmand, this modern Aegean destination in Miami’s Wynwood district is led by chef Erhan Kostepen.
The kitchen focuses on a communal meze culture, where cold and hot plates are prepared over wood and coal fires to impart a distinct smokiness.
Dining centers around a lush, expansive garden terrace, a verdant backdrop for the signature Doya Eggplant, which is mixed tableside.

Name: Joe's Stone Crab
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1913 by Joe Weiss, this Miami Beach institution began as a lunch counter before the city was even incorporated.
The seasonal, high-volume venue is defined by its white-tablecloth service, tuxedoed waiters, and a bustling energy that commands long wait times.
While the chilled stone crab claws with mustard sauce are the namesake draw, the menu also features celebrated fried chicken and classic Key lime pie.

Name: Las' Lap
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Lower East Side, this rum bar and restaurant is backed by actor Michael B. Jordan and co-founder Scott Robert Williams.
Named after the final hour of Trinidad Carnival, the intimate space blends West Indian hospitality with a sophisticated, lively atmosphere.
A curated selection of premium rums and signature cocktails are served against a backdrop of warm lighting and tropical accents.

Name: Papi Steak
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Miami’s South of Fifth, this spirited steakhouse is a collaboration between hospitality entrepreneur David Grutman and David “Papi” Einhorn.
The compact, clubby dining room evokes Golden Era Hollywood with red velvet banquettes and floral wall coverings, merging classic service with a high-energy atmosphere.
Its signature ritual is the “Beef Case,” a Wagyu tomahawk steak presented to the table in a rhinestone-encrusted briefcase inspired by Pulp Fiction.

Name: Michael's Genuine Food & Drink
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Miami Design District, this neighborhood bistro is the flagship of James Beard Award-winning chef Michael Schwartz.
The kitchen defines itself through unpretentious, seasonal cooking with a menu built around fresh ingredients and simple wood-fired preparation.
Secure a table in the breezy courtyard to enjoy the house-made stracciatella or a wood-roasted whole fish fresh from the oven.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours. Dinner: $25 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation window.

Name: Yasu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Miami Design District, this intimate eight-seat counter is the personal expression of Michelin-recognized chef Yasu Tanaka, backed by Spicy Hospitality Group.
The venue blends rigorous Japanese craftsmanship with Nordic minimalism, presenting a fourteen-course progression that prioritizes seasonality and restraint over theatricality.
A six-hundred-year-old hinoki wood counter, carved from temple-grade timber and polished daily with rice bran, anchors the serene space.

Name: Elcielo Bogota
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Zona G neighborhood, Elcielo Bogota is a contemporary Colombian restaurant founded by Michelin-starred chef Juan Manuel Barrientos.
The tasting menu presents a multisensory exploration of regional gastronomy, utilizing local biodiversity and modern culinary techniques.
The meal incorporates a signature chocotherapy ritual where guests wash their hands in melted Colombian chocolate.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We do not accept late show to reservations, after 15 minutes the reservation will be considered a no show and no show fee/Cancellation will be applied. Cancellations within 24 hours incur a $100 per person charge. All reservations are non-refundable but can be rescheduled for unforeseen changes.

Name: Komodo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by David Grutman's Groot Hospitality, Komodo is a Southeast Asian restaurant with a flagship location in Miami's Brickell neighborhood and outposts in Dallas and Las Vegas.
The menu focuses on modern interpretations of regional Asian cuisine, incorporating global ingredients into traditional recipes.
Signature dishes include the Peking Duck, Angry Maine Lobster, and Salmon Tacos.

Name: Prime 112
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the historic Browns Hotel in Miami Beach’s South of Fifth neighborhood, this boutique steakhouse is the flagship of restaurateur Myles Chefetz.
The bustling dining room breaks from convention, trading traditional dark leathers for a high-energy social atmosphere that consistently attracts a high-profile clientele.
While the dry-aged beef is the main draw, the menu is best known for indulgent accessories like the signature Truffled Lobster Mac and Cheese.

Name: Felix Trattoria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Venice, Felix is the domain of Chef Evan Funke, a rigorous scholar dedicated to Italy’s handmade pasta traditions.
The menu explores specific regional dialects rather than general Italian fare, prioritizing texture and time-honored technique over modern interpretation.
A glass-walled, temperature-controlled *laboratorio* anchors the dining room, putting the meticulous craft of hand-rolling dough on full display.

Name: Chi Spacca
Master_Aurora_Insights:
James Beard Award-winner Nancy Silverton leads this Los Angeles destination, which transformed from a butchery school into a full-service Italian steakhouse.
The kitchen functions as a modern salumeria, preparing house-cured charcuterie and large-format steaks over an open wood fire.
A meal here is incomplete without the Focaccia di Recco, a blistered, paper-thin flatbread filled with melted stracchino cheese.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner reservations are subject to a cancellation fee of $25 per person if cancelled within 12 hours of the reservation time or in the event of a no-show. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Kato
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the industrial ROW DTLA complex, this Michelin-starred restaurant is led by chef Jon Yao, who translates Taiwanese-American heritage into a progressive tasting menu.
The kitchen balances technical precision with nostalgia, serving complex courses in a polished, minimalist dining room.
Bar director Austin Hennelly’s acclaimed non-alcoholic flight complements the meal, which often concludes with a refined tapioca and brown sugar pudding.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The full price of the menu will be charged per guest if a reservation is canceled with less than one week’s notice. Guests may transfer ownership of a reservation to a guest of their choosing should they not be able to attend their dinner. Tables will be held for a 15 minute grace period before the cancellation fee is applied.

Name: Calabra
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop the Santa Monica Proper Hotel, this indoor-outdoor destination features interiors by Kelly Wearstler and a menu from executive chef Kaleo Adams.
The venue pairs earthy, organic textures with an open-air layout that captures the Westside’s relaxed pace.
Secure a spot at the central circular bar to enjoy panoramic ocean views alongside fresh mezze and seasonal cocktails.

Name: Laurel Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the top floor of the Culver Steps, this American restaurant is the latest project from Dean McKillen, the operator behind Laurel Hardware and Ysabel.
Walnut paneling, dim lighting, and black leather booths evoke the character of a classic, polished neighborhood grill.
The menu features standards like clam chowder with bacon, best enjoyed before retreating to the fire pits on the outdoor terrace.

Name: Funke
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Evan Funke’s eponymous restaurant occupies a sprawling 1930s Art Deco building in the heart of Beverly Hills.
The kitchen presents a rigorous tribute to Italian culinary history, with a menu deeply rooted in regional specificity and traditional technique.
A glass-walled pasta laboratory serves as the main dining room's focal point, showcasing the daily ritual of rolling and shaping pasta by hand.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservation changes and cancellations can be managed on Resy or by contacting info@funkela.com. We kindly ask that any changes be made at least 24 hours in advance. No-show reservations will be subject to a fee of $50 per guest for the dining room. We will hold the table for 15 minutes after the scheduled reservation time. After 15 minutes, the table will be released.

Name: Hermon's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a restored Art Deco church hall in northeast Los Angeles, Hermon's has been recognized by Wallpaper* for its cinematic atmosphere.
The all-booth dining room serves as a community commissary, offering a menu heavy on comfort, cream, and red meat.
Diners should order the signature "tiny tini" martinis before tucking into the ribeye or the lasagna vongole.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation fee of $40.

Name: n/naka
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in an unassuming building in Los Angeles’s Palms neighborhood, n/naka is the Michelin-starred modern kaiseki restaurant led by chef Niki Nakayama.
The tasting menu applies a distinct California sensibility to the traditional Japanese kaiseki format, emphasizing hyper-seasonal local ingredients and artistic presentation.
A signature highlight of the thirteen-course meal is the handmade spaghettini with abalone, pickled cod roe, and truffles.

Name: Morihiro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Echo Park, this Michelin-starred destination is the current stage for chef Morihiro Onodera’s decades-long Los Angeles sushi career.
The omakase blends traditional sushi counter dining with the progression of cha-kaiseki, prioritizing ingredient integrity through a sequence of composed dishes and nigiri.
Underscoring this control, Onodera mills his own rice in-house and serves every course on handmade ceramics he crafted himself.

Name: La Dolce Vita
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originally opened in 1966 with backing from Frank Sinatra, this Beverly Hills restaurant has been revived by hospitality duo Marc Rose and Med Abrous.
The windowless dining room is defined by burl wood paneling, deep red leather booths, and a signature cheetah-print carpet.
Servers prepare the Caesar salad tableside before serving red-sauce standards like the spaghetti and meatballs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 12 hours of the reservation time and no-shows are subject to a fee of $25 per person for dinner ($10 per person for lunch). Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation window.

Name: Osteria Mozza
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Michelin-starred Los Angeles restaurant serves as the flagship for chef Nancy Silverton and restaurateur Joe Bastianich.
The dining room is anchored by a white-marble Mozzarella Bar, offering fresh cheeses with seasonal accompaniments and cured meats.
A signature finish is the rosemary olive oil cake, served with olive oil gelato and rosemary brittle.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations within 24 hours of your booking or no-shows will be charged a fee of $20 per person. For parties of 8 or more, a preselected family-style menu is required.

Name: Vespertine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a twisting steel tower in Culver City’s Hayden Tract, this two-Michelin-starred project is the work of chef Jordan Kahn and architect Eric Owen Moss.
The concept blurs the lines between food and architecture, operating more like a sci-fi narrative than a traditional restaurant.
Dinner unfolds as a ritual across multiple floors, transitioning from the garden or rooftop into the twenty-two-seat dining room.

Name: Meteora
Master_Aurora_Insights: Meteora, Chef Jordan Kahn's 1-Michelin-Star New California restaurant, sits at 6703 Melrose Avenue, Hollywood, Los Angeles, featuring a rainforest-inspired, biophilic interior designed by Roth Architecture. Recognized in the 2024 and 2025 Michelin Guide California with 1 Star; featured in the World's 50 Best Discovery list as a standout modern experimental destination.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations less than one day in advance of reservation date will result in a fee of $25 per person.

Name: Citrin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Santa Monica, this one-Michelin-starred restaurant from Chef Josiah Citrin serves as the à la carte sibling to his landmark Mélisse.
The kitchen applies precise French technique to local ingredients, creating a menu that balances sophistication with a welcoming, unpretentious energy.
Order the signature Lobster Bolognese, which pairs Maine lobster and handmade capellini with a rich brown butter truffle froth.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows.

Name: Dunsmoor
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Los Angeles’ Glassell Park neighborhood, this American heritage restaurant is the solo project of chef Brian Dunsmoor, formerly of Hatchet Hall.
The kitchen revives pre-industrial cooking methods, utilizing a massive open hearth to produce hearty, Southern-inspired dishes rooted in early American history.
A standout experience involves the signature sour milk cornbread—an homage to Edna Lewis—served warm with cheddar and cultured butter within view of the fire.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of $25 per person applies to all same-day cancellations. Reservations are recommended and can be modified or canceled via OpenTable.

Name: Gwen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Michelin-starred chef Curtis Stone and his brother Luke, this Los Angeles venue pairs a European-style butcher shop with a fire-focused restaurant.
The kitchen utilizes open-flame cooking to prepare whole animals and cuts sourced directly from the onsite retail counter.
Signature offerings include house-made charcuterie and dry-aged steaks, cooked over a central wood-burning fire pit.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We enforce a 24-hour cancellation policy. Reservations must be cancelled 24-hours in advance in order to avoid a $50 per person cancellation fee.

Name: BOA Steakhouse
Master_Aurora_Insights: Owned by Innovative Dining Group and led by Chef Brendan Collins, this modern steakhouse anchors the Sunset Strip in West Hollywood. The space trades traditional leather booths for a sleek, indoor-outdoor layout that attracts a steady stream of entertainment industry regulars. While the 40-day dry-aged steaks are the main draw, the meal is defined by the signature Caesar salad prepared tableside as a theatrical ritual.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Horses
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the historic Coach & Horses space on Sunset Boulevard, this acclaimed venue is recognized by *The New York Times* for prioritizing culinary substance.
The kitchen serves Californian riffs on European bistro classics in a room defined by bright yellow banquettes and original equine artwork.
A signature Cornish game hen with warm dandelion panzanella anchors the menu, standing out alongside a widely celebrated cheeseburger and smoked salmon lavash.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation time are subject to a fee. The restaurant does not have a phone; all inquiries and modifications must be sent via email to hello@horsesla.com.

Name: Dante
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Dante NYC is a registered New York City landmark cafe and cocktail bar in Greenwich Village at 79-81 Macdougal Street, operating since 1915. Indoor and outdoor seating, reservations suggested through Resy, walk-ins welcomed, open from 12pm weekdays and 10am weekends, serving until 11pm or midnight. Italian menu features homemade pastas, sourdough flatbreads, burrata, panini, roast chicken; full page dedicated to negronis plus aperitivo cocktails and spritzes.Perched on the ninth floor of The Maybourne Beverly Hills, this rooftop outpost of the New York bar is led by owners Linden Pride and Nathalie Hudson.
The open-air space blends Mediterranean and Californian influences, serving wood-fired pizzas and market-driven plates in a poolside setting.

Name: Mélisse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Josiah Citrin leads this two-Michelin-starred Santa Monica venue, operating as a private enclave within his larger restaurant complex.
The fourteen-seat dining room presents a single tasting menu of French-Californian cuisine in a space where the open kitchen acts as the stage.
Service includes choreographed rituals like tableside saucing and intricate caviar presentations, ensuring every meal feels like a dedicated performance.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To reserve, we place a credit card hold that will be finalized at the restaurant. Just as with attending a sporting event, concert or the theater, all sales are final. We cannot cancel your reservation or reschedule it for another night. If you cannot come, we recommend that you transfer your reservation to someone else. No shows will be subject to a $399 plus tax and service charge per person.

Name: Camphor
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in the Arts District of Los Angeles, this Michelin-starred bistro is helmed by chefs Max Boonthanakit and Lijo George.
The menu presents a sharp, modern take on French cuisine, distinguished by the unexpected integration of Southeast Asian spices.
Beyond the discreet alleyway entrance, the experience is defined by precise plates such as the baby shrimp snack and bite-sized scallop ravioli.

Name: Lele Dinner Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a cavernous West Adams event space, this ticketed supper club is the latest project from chef Daniele Uditi.
The experience functions less like a standard restaurant and more like a spirited Neapolitan wedding reception, serving Southern Italian feasts to an intimate group of diners.
Guests gather at communal tables for a set menu that highlights wood-fired focaccia and crudo, accompanied by free-flowing wine.

Name: Cipriani
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1931 with Giuseppe Cipriani’s opening of Harry’s Bar in Venice, this global restaurant group remains under the stewardship of the founding family.
Each location maintains a consistent aesthetic of polished wood and white linens, pairing a menu of traditional Italian dishes with formal service.
The original Venetian outpost is credited with inventing two culinary staples: the peach-based Bellini cocktail and beef carpaccio.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations or no-shows. A 15-minute grace period applies for reservations.

Name: Holbox
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within Mexico’s Yum Balam Nature Reserve, this car-free barrier island remains a protected sanctuary separated from the mainland by a shallow lagoon.
The village is characterized by unpaved sand streets, large-scale public murals, and low-rise structures that prioritize local materials over vertical development.
At night, the shores of Punta Cocos display natural bioluminescence, while summer brings migrating whale sharks to the surrounding waters.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tasting Menu reservations are prepaid ($130 per guest + tax and 18% service charge). If you can't make it on time, you will pick up the course we are currently running. Regular dining is walk-in only.

Name: Antico Nuovo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Chad Colby, this Los Angeles restaurant channels an Italian countryside taverna within a dimly lit, speakeasy-style dining room.
The kitchen centers on a hand-cranked rotisserie and wood-burning hearth, turning out rustic, hearty pastas and fire-roasted meats.
Dinner concludes with a signature ritual: freshly spun ice cream, churned to order and served with honeycomb or seasonal fruit.

Name: Camélia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Mandarin Oriental Paris, this light-filled bistro features interiors by the design agency Jouin Manku.
Chef Nina Haradji directs a kitchen focused on market-driven French cuisine with an emphasis on local sourcing.
A landscaped interior garden provides an open-air setting for the weekly Sunday brunch or a mid-week lunch.

Name: Somni
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden in West Hollywood, this three-Michelin-star revival by Chef Aitor Zabala frames fine dining as a dream-like visit to a private home.
The tasting menu unfolds at a fourteen-seat counter, blending Catalan and Basque roots with technical precision in twenty-plus artful bites.
Guests enter past an illuminated yellow giraffe before enjoying courses like a crispy Parmesan feather and dashi with fish-shaped caviar.

Name: Gjelina Los Angeles
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Venice’s Abbot Kinney Boulevard, this New American mainstay was established by Fran Camaj and shaped by the rustic, vegetable-forward cooking of chef Travis Lett.
The kitchen serves locally sourced, Mediterranean-inspired small plates in a high-energy room characterized by exposed brick, raw wood, and communal seating.
A wood-burning oven anchors the menu, turning out blistered pizzas and vegetable-centric plates like the signature wood-roasted sunchokes.

Name: Baroo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Named the *Los Angeles Times* Restaurant of the Year in 2024, this Arts District destination is the acclaimed project of chef Kwang Uh and Mina Park.
The kitchen centers its menu on fermentation, serving a multi-course progression that highlights preserved and aged ingredients.
Its name refers to the formal wooden bowls used by Buddhist monks, signaling the kitchen's meditative approach to cooking.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A $125/guest cancellation fee applies in the event of cancellation within 72 hours of the reservation time, reduction in party size, or a no-show. A credit card must be on file to complete the reservation.

Name: Nozawa Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within a Beverly Hills Sugarfish, this Michelin-starred omakase counter is the high-end flagship of sushi master Kazunori Nozawa.
The experience is strictly traditional, serving a fast-paced set menu of nigiri and sashimi defined by the kitchen's signature warm, loose rice.
A standout moment is the signature blue crab handroll, served as the finale to a course count that frequently exceeds twenty items.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Pre-Paid Reservations. A 50% rebooking fee will be charged — for parties less than 6 people within 48 hours of your reservation — for parties of 7 or more within 7 days of your reservation. The same reservation can be transferred to friends or family using your TOCK reservation account with no additional charge.

Name: Bestia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a converted Arts District warehouse, this high-energy Italian destination is the work of husband-and-wife team Ori Menashe and Genevieve Gergis.
The kitchen pursues a rigorous multi-regional approach, producing house-made charcuterie, sourdough pizza, and hand-cut pasta within an industrial space of exposed brick and steel.
A definitive order is the roasted bone marrow, served with spinach gnocchetti and crispy breadcrumbs to cut through the richness.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Lunch: $10 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows.
Dinner: $25 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows.
Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Craig's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by former Dan Tana’s maître d’ Craig Susser, this West Hollywood destination serves American comfort food in a clubby setting on Melrose Avenue.
The dining room balances the feel of an old-school joint with a polished industry canteen, defined by dim lighting and deep blue leather banquettes.
A loyal crowd gathers for the signature Honey Truffle Chicken, a fried dish served with truffle honey and corn pancakes.

Occupying a historic building on Massachusetts Street in Lawrence, this downtown Italian bistro is the work of owner Matt Hyde and executive chef Michael Beard.
The kitchen pairs rustic Tuscan techniques with ingredients from Kansas farms, creating a menu defined by handmade pastas and house-cured charcuterie.
A seat at the lively bar offers a view of the action, best enjoyed with the signature handmade pastas or a classic cocktail.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask for guests to please let us know as soon as possible if you need to cancel. If you are running late for your reservation, please give us a call. We will hold your table for 10 minutes after your reservation time.

Name: Nobu (Malibu)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched above the surf on Carbon Beach, this oceanfront venue is the work of Chef Nobu Matsuhisa and design firm Studio PCH.
The structure creates a seamless transition between the Pacific and the dining room, utilizing warm teak and floor-to-ceiling glass to frame the horizon.
Guests gather on the terrace for signature plates of Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Jalapeño, served against the backdrop of crashing waves.

Name: Damian
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a repurposed Arts District warehouse, this contemporary Mexican restaurant is the work of acclaimed chef Enrique Olvera and his Casamata group.
The industrial interior of polished concrete and exposed brick is softened by lush greenery, framing a menu that grounds Mexican traditions in Californian produce.
A standout uni tostada, featuring fresh sea urchin and a Caesar salad atop a blue-corn base, captures the kitchen’s precise, modern layering.

Name: Alchemie Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Samatha Dave on Santa Monica’s Main Street, this wellness boutique serves as an urban sanctuary dedicated to holistic self-care.
The eco-conscious menu features organic skincare and therapeutic treatments designed to calm the nervous system and restore natural radiance.
For a signature experience, the Holistic Facial combines gua sha sculpting and marma point therapy with a grounding Koshi chime closing ritual.

Name: Seline
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Dave Beran leads this intimate fine-dining destination in Santa Monica designed by Chicago-based Rugo Raff Architects.
The space functions like a modern art gallery where an open kitchen flows seamlessly into the thirty-eight-seat dining room without barriers.
A narrative-driven tasting menu features unexpected pairings like squab heart with strawberry served on custom dark plateware.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You are required to prepay a deposit of $200 per guest when confirming your reservation. We are more than happy to cancel and issue a full refund for your reservation with at least 7 days notice prior to your reservation. All deposits are non-refundable for reservations cancelled, modified, or rescheduled with fewer than 7 days notice. Deposits for reservations rescheduled or modified with fewer than 7 days notice will be forfeited and not transferable to another date. You are more than welcome to transfer your reservation to another guest to dine in your place. If you are running more than 15 minutes late, we may need to omit courses.

Name: RVR
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Abbot Kinney in Venice, this modern izakaya marks the return of chef Travis Lett, the name behind Gjelina and Gjusta.
The menu blends local produce with Japanese tavern cooking, offering charcoal-grilled skewers and vegetable-forward plates alongside curated sake.
Vinyl records play on a high-fidelity sound system in the dimly lit room, which centers on a counter of charred-wood stools.
Master_Menu_URL: There's no menu available on their official website.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Parties of two are allotted 90 minutes; parties of four or more are allotted two hours. We hold reservations for 15 minutes past the scheduled time, after which uncommunicated arrivals may be released. The cancellation fee is $25 per person. To avoid this charge, all you need to do is cancel by noon the day of the reservation.

Name: Polo Lounge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within The Beverly Hills Hotel, this indoor-outdoor venue has operated as a primary meeting point for the entertainment industry since 1941.
The dining room features deep green banquettes and a garden patio, serving American cuisine with an Italian edge to a steady stream of high-profile guests.
Order the signature McCarthy Salad—a chopped Cobb variation named for a polo-playing regular—to enjoy alongside live piano accompaniment in the courtyard.

Name: Hyde Sunset
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a prominent corner of the Sunset Strip, this venue serves as the flagship for Sam Nazarian’s sbe nightlife group.
The space functions as a hybrid concept, pairing a seasonal California dinner menu with a high-energy lounge atmosphere.
A nightly ritual sees the dining room transform into a club environment, complete with bottle service and sets from resident DJs.

Name: Saffy's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
From the husband-and-wife team behind Bestia and Bavel, this East Hollywood restaurant explores the casual, skewer-centric traditions of the Middle East.
The interior blends Art Deco architecture with 1970s Moroccan design, featuring stained glass, plush banquettes, and a long curved bar.
The menu centers on wood-fired shawarma and the signature Hummus Ful, a creamy blend topped with slow-cooked fava beans and lemon.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Jeffrey Deitch Gallery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by former MOCA director Jeffrey Deitch, this contemporary art gallery occupies a large former warehouse on Orange Drive in Hollywood.
The space mounts large-scale group exhibitions that frequently focus on pop, street, and underground art movements.
Architect Frank Gehry designed the interior, preserving the building's original wooden bow-truss ceiling to accommodate oversized installations and sculptures.

Name: Heimat
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a refurbished 1930s industrial plant in West Hollywood, this members-only destination from RSG Group merges fitness with social hospitality.
The five-story structure functions as a communal "living room," integrating performance-focused training zones with coworking spaces and a rooftop pool.
Interiors by Martin Brudnizki feature jewel-toned design elements, while the on-site restaurant, Mother Tongue, offers global wellness cuisine by chef Michael Mina.

Name: Élephante
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched above Santa Monica, this rooftop destination from restaurateur Nick Mathers channels the spirit of Pantelleria and the Southern Mediterranean.
The open-air space blends coastal Italian design with custom furniture, travertine stone, and direct ocean views.
While wood-fired pizzas and cocktails are popular, the signature whipped eggplant dip served with fresh-baked puccia bread is the standout dish.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We charge a cancellation fee of $25 per person for cancellations within 24 hours and no-shows.

Name: Avalon Hollywood
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Built in 1927 as the Hollywood Playhouse, this Spanish Baroque landmark opposite the Capitol Records Building was designed by architects Gogerty and Weyl.
The venue has transitioned from a legitimate theater and broadcast studio for *The Hollywood Palace* into a hub for touring electronic acts.
Its stage remains famous as the site of The Beatles’ first West Coast performance in 1964.

Name: The Peninsula Spa Beverly Hills
Master_Neighborhood: Golden Triangle / Beverly Hills Business District

Name: Next Health (LA)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by surgeon Dr. Darshan Shah, this health optimization center operates outposts in Los Angeles, New York, and the Four Seasons Maui.
The concept modernizes the medical clinic experience, using extensive biomarker data to tailor personalized longevity programs in a setting that rivals a luxury spa.
Guests often start in the communal IV Lounge, though the menu extends to advanced treatments like whole-body cryotherapy and therapeutic plasma exchange.

Name: The Spa at Terranea
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on the Palos Verdes Peninsula, The Spa at Terranea is a 50,000-square-foot oceanfront wellness facility recognized by the Forbes Travel Guide.
Following a recent multimillion-dollar renovation, the space integrates its coastal environment into a program of restorative therapies and hydrotherapy circuits.
Guests alternate between cold plunges, saunas, and a 25-meter heated pool before experiencing signature treatments like nutrient-rich seaweed wraps.

Name: Pizzeria Sei
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef William Joo, a veteran of Providence and Ronan, steers this compact Pico-Robertson spot specializing in Tokyo-style Neapolitan pizza.
The kitchen treats dough with Japanese precision, yielding a blistered, airy cornicione that offers a distinctively chewier texture than the Italian standard.
Diners at the timber counter can opt for the "Pizza Omakase," a tasting menu of slices served immediately from the oven to ensure peak texture.

Name: Dior Spa (Antibes)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc in Antibes, the Dior Spa is a wellness space designed by the architecture studio Labvert.
The 400-square-meter spa is situated among Aleppo pines, utilizing sandy tones that reference the rocky coastal landscape.
Treatment areas include an onyx affusion suite equipped with a rain shower and an outdoor patio centered around a fountain of hand-painted Portuguese tiles.

Name: Zouk
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the West Hollywood footprint of the former Greystone Manor, this nightlife destination is a partnership between Singapore’s Zouk Group and sbe founder Sam Nazarian.
The venue injects Las Vegas-style energy into the district, offering high-tech production and a roster of headlining electronic music talent.
Distinctive touches include a shifting LED ceiling installation and a signature snack of crispy chicken nuggets topped with imperial caviar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Advance deposits are non-refundable unless cancellation is received by venue at least 96 hours prior 10:00 A.M. Pacific Time on booking date. Cancellations received less than 96 hours prior to 10:00 A.M. PT on book date will result in forfeiture of advance deposit. Processing and credit card fees are non-refundable under all circumstances.

Name: The Spa at Beverly Wilshire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Four Seasons, this perennial Forbes Five-Star spa serves as a quiet sanctuary tucked inside the historic Beverly Wilshire.
The newly refreshed space features Art Deco-inspired interiors and a menu prioritizing advanced wellness technology, including the zero-gravity OvationULT red-light therapy bed.
A standout feature is the Mediterranean-style pool, modeled after the private pool at Sophia Loren’s Italian villa.

Name: Surya Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Santa Monica Proper Hotel, this Ayurvedic spa is led by wellness practitioner Martha Soffer.
The destination focuses on traditional Indian healing arts, offering deep restorative therapies in a space designed by Kelly Wearstler.
Signature Panchakarma series often feature Shirodhara, a ritual involving warm herbal oil poured gently in a continuous stream over the forehead.

Name: Dogpound
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Kirk Myers, this elite fitness destination spans industrial-chic studios in New York and Los Angeles, with a seasonal residency at W South Beach.
The atmosphere blends a moody, nightclub-inspired aesthetic with rigorous, customized training regimens designed for a high-performance clientele.
Interiors by GDSNY feature signature black walls, concrete finishes, and a central boxing ring, creating a dramatic backdrop for the gym’s punishing conditioning sessions.

Name: Tower Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying Bugsy Siegel’s former apartment in the Art Deco Sunset Tower Hotel, this walnut-lined venue was reimagined by hotelier Jeff Klein.
The room operates as a discreet sanctuary for industry insiders, managed with exacting care by maître d’ Dimitri Dimitrov.
Live jazz accompanies the dinner service near the fireplace, where the menu centers on classics like the signature roasted chicken.
