Name: Hōseki
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Bulgari Resort Dubai, Hōseki is an intimate dining destination helmed by sixth-generation sushi master Masahiro Sugiyama.
The minimalist space functions as a culinary "jewel box," offering a bespoke Omakase menu dictated entirely by the day's freshest imports from Japan.
Guests arrive through a traditional Tokonoma entryway to find a singular Hinoki wood counter framing views of the glittering city skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Hōseki maintains a strict 10 minute grace period for all reservations. Reservations are required.

Name: KRASOTA
Master_Aurora_Insights:
KRASOTA Dubai is an immersive gastro-theatre by the White Rabbit Family, led by restaurateur Boris Zarkov and chef Vladimir Mukhin.
The concept synchronizes haute cuisine with high-tech visual art, surrounding diners in a twenty-seat rotunda with 3D projections that change with every course.
In the "Imaginary Art" show, dishes like tuna with rhubarb milk are paired with digital interpretations of masters such as Chagall and Malevich.

Name: FZN
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Atlantis, The Palm, this intimate dining room is the Dubai outpost of celebrated Swedish chef Björn Frantzén.
The tasting menu presents a seamless fusion of Nordic gastronomy, Japanese precision, and classic French technique.
A standout course is the signature råraka—a crispy potato cylinder with roe—served in a setting defined by pale wood and minimalist design.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 72 hours of the reservation will be charged the prepayment fee of 50%.

Name: Bull & Bear
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Waldorf Astoria Orlando, this steakhouse is helmed by Chef de Cuisine Juan Suarez as a modern outpost of the Manhattan original.
The club-like dining room overlooks the resort’s golf course and emphasizes tableside preparation, blending traditional service with re-imagined classics.
Signature orders include the Fried Chicken and the Pasta Explosion, served alongside the Chateaubriand carved tableside.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you’ve made a reservation and wish to cancel, you may cancel at no penalty up to 24 hours prior excluding holidays or special events. If you cancel after your 24-hour window, you will be subject to a cancellation fee of $25 per person. We have a 15 minute grace period.

Name: CLAP
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a rooftop in DIFC, this contemporary Japanese restaurant is the Dubai outpost from the Beirut-born Addmind group.
The venue features a dining room, lounge, and bar, serving a menu that merges traditional techniques with modern flavors.
A chandelier composed of 2,100 toys hangs at the entrance, a playful design detail that contrasts with the skyline views.

Name: Mimi Kakushi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Four Seasons Resort Dubai, this Japanese dining room is designed by Pirajean Lees and led by chefs Vladimir Kim and Gilles Bosquet.
The interior channels 1920s Osaka with intricate wood joinery and beaded curtains that reference the "Moga" modern girl movement.
Menu highlights include wagyu foie gras gyozas and marinated black cod, served from an open kitchen accompanied by a curated jazz soundtrack.

Name: Cape Morris
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Cape Morris is a secluded private island sanctuary in Dubai’s World Islands, managed by the team behind the Burj Al Arab.
The destination serves as a dedicated day retreat, defined by its pristine isolation and high-touch service on the sands of the Arabian Gulf.
Visitors arrive by a 64-foot yacht for a day of stone therapy rituals and dining curated by Michelin-starred chef Saverio Sbaragli.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: This offer is non-refundable and non-cancellable.

Name: Langosteria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Enrico Buonocore in Milan, this seafood specialist has evolved from a compact bistro into a respected brand with outposts in Paris and St. Moritz.
The dining room eschews white-tablecloth formality for a moody, club-like atmosphere where the kitchen focuses strictly on sourcing the highest quality raw fish and shellfish.
Order the signature King Crab alla Catalana, served in a labyrinth of intimate, dimly lit rooms lined with floor-to-ceiling wine bottles.

Name: Soul Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Brought to Dubai’s Business Bay by Beirut-based collective Factory People, this venue marries a restaurant and bar with an alternative arts space.
The menu weaves together Levantine and Latin American flavours—dubbed "Lela cuisine"—reflecting the Arab diaspora in South America within a design-led setting.
A standout dish is the white fish tabbouleh, which reimagines a regional classic with a fresh, textural twist typical of the kitchen's cross-cultural approach.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The deposit paid when making the reservation will be deducted from the bill. We ask that any cancellation to your reservation be made no less than 24 hours prior. For no shows or late cancellations, you will be subject to a fee of 25,- euro per person. Soulkitchen reserves the right to cancel the reservation without any form of refund if the group is not complete within 30 minutes after the reserved time.

Name: Kulm Pizzeria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, this GaultMillau-rated venue offers a relaxed counterpoint to the property’s formal dining halls.
The bustling space operates as an upscale trattoria, serving a straightforward menu of authentic Italian classics and rustic staples.
A wood-fired oven anchors the kitchen, turning out signature crispy pizzas that are best enjoyed on the sun terrace overlooking the lake.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The amount of the fee will be communicated at the time of reservation and will be charged if the guest fails to show up for the booked reservation without notifying the hotel at least 24 hours prior to the reservation time. The no-show fee will be charged to the credit card provided by the guest at the time of booking.

Name: Perrotin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by French gallerist Emmanuel Perrotin, this contemporary art space resides within the Dubai International Financial Centre’s Gate Village.
The outpost connects the Middle East to a global network, showcasing established artists alongside emerging voices in a dedicated primary market setting.
Located in Building 5 near the district's auction houses, the gallery has hosted significant presentations by figures such as Daniel Arsham and Jean-Marie Appriou.

Name: Kulm Country Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a historic pavilion renovated by Lord Norman Foster, this St. Moritz destination is helmed by Michelin-starred chef Mauro Colagreco.
The relaxed dining room and sun terrace offer a "Mountain Terroir" menu that blends local alpine ingredients with the chef’s Argentine roots.
A standout feature is the open-fire Asado, where meats are grilled over flames and served alongside views of the Olympic ice rink.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The hotel will hold the reserved table for up to 15 minutes after the confirmed reservation time. A no-show fee applies if the guest fails to show up without notifying the hotel at least 24 hours prior to the reservation time. The fee amount is communicated at the time of reservation and charged to the credit card provided at booking. For early seating (e.g., 19:00), tables must be returned by 20:45.

Name: Secret Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden behind F.R.N.D.S. in Downtown Dubai, this Moscow-born speakeasy is an exclusive nightlife destination operated by the Bulldozer Group.
The intimate, hip-hop-focused space is defined by six-meter walls adorned with intricate, hand-painted Japanese murals and raw concrete finishes.
A concealed entrance serves as the venue's signature feature, allowing VIP guests to drive their supercars directly into the center of the club.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: ALL DEPOSITS made via the Secret Parties website are strictly non-refundable. For cancellations please email us at bookings@secret-parties.com with full details of your cancellation so that we can handle it accordingly.

Name: Provocateur
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Berlin’s Charlottenburg district, this Design Hotels member was conceived by interior designer Saar Zafrir to evoke the glamour of 1920s Paris.
The property distinguishes itself with a burlesque-inspired aesthetic, featuring rooms draped in crushed velvet, dark hues, and intricate stucco details.
A standout feature in every room is the "Provocateur Mode" switch, which instantly dims the lights and sets a mood consistent with the hotel's nocturnal spirit.

Name: Smoked Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden inside the Leña steakhouse in Madrid, this "fire omakase" enclave is the two-Michelin-starred creation of chef Dani García.
The fourteen-seat counter focuses entirely on the transformative power of embers, with chefs preparing every course over charcoal grills in full view of guests.
The tasting menu features dishes like Motril shrimp with brown butter and smoked pepper, highlighting the kitchen's mastery of temperature and smoke.

Name: Twiggy by La Cantine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the Park Hyatt Dubai Lagoon, this Riviera-inspired beach club is the work of the team behind La Cantine du Faubourg.
Evoking the Côte d'Azur, the sun-drenched space uses soft neutrals and natural materials to create a relaxed, sophisticated atmosphere.
A 100-meter infinity lagoon lined with white sand anchors the venue, serving Mediterranean plates like sea bass carpaccio and truffle burrata pizza.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Chasellas
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Positioned at the gateway to the Corviglia ski slopes, this rustic-chic mountain outpost is an extension of Suvretta House, helmed by chef Robert Jagisch.
The atmosphere shifts from a casual daytime stop for hikers and skiers into an intimate, candlelit destination for refined gourmet dining after dark.
Guests gather on the sun-drenched terrace for midday classics before retreating inside for evening specialties like Wienerschnitzel and herb-crusted rack of lamb.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You will be asked to cancel reservations you cannot attend at least 12 hours in advance. Reservations that are not attended but also not cancelled may cause blocking of your mobile phone number in the online reservation system or the respective restaurant can demand cancellation or no-show fees according to its general terms and conditions.

Name: Da Vittorio
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Carlton Hotel, this Michelin-starred outpost is directed by the Cerea family, who bring their Lombardy-based culinary heritage to the Engadin valley.
The dining room serves a refined iteration of Italian comfort food, prioritizing market-fresh ingredients and precise execution over avant-garde experimentation.
Service culminates with the tableside preparation of Paccheri alla Vittorio, a signature pasta dish tossed in a velvety tomato and cheese sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Trump International Golf Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within DAMAC Hills, this championship venue is the work of Gil Hanse, the architect behind the 2016 Olympic Games course in Rio.
The links-style layout features rolling Bermuda fairways that navigate a native desert landscape, contrasting manicured turf with arid surroundings.
A massive, cavernous barranca forms the strategic backbone of the routing, creating significant elevation changes and a distinct visual anchor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Teible
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located within the Jameel Arts Centre on the Jaddaf Waterfront, this seasonal dining concept and artisan bakery is led by Executive Chef Carlos Frunze. The Michelin Green Star-awarded kitchen adheres to a strict farm-to-table philosophy, sourcing nearly all ingredients from the UAE to create menus that change with the seasons. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of the creek, setting a calm backdrop for experimental dishes like the signature Beef Garum Tartare.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Maine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Montreal restaurateur Joey Ghazal, this New England–inspired brasserie has evolved into a global destination with stylish outposts in Dubai, London, and Ibiza.
The interiors deftly balance the rustic warmth of an East Coast oyster shack with the clubby, velvet-trimmed polish of a European grand café.
A brimming raw bar anchors the experience, serving freshly shucked oysters and signature lobster rolls alongside a program of live jazz and cabaret.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A minimum spend of £100 per guest will be required to be paid in advance for all reservations in the Brasserie from 6pm during Fridays and Saturdays.

Name: The Nice Guy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in West Hollywood, this reservations-only restaurant and lounge is a flagship project from John Terzian’s The h.wood Group.
The dimly lit, wood-paneled interior evokes a vintage mafia social club, blurring the line between a dinner spot and a nightlife destination.
A strict no-photos policy preserves the room's privacy, while the kitchen serves late-night lobster pizza and cocktails in flasks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: SEVEN Wellness Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originating in Dubai, this social wellness club merges high-performance fitness with a refined lifestyle offering, creating a sanctuary for physical and mental resilience.
The approach treats mental conditioning as equal to physical strength, pairing advanced athletic equipment with restorative treatments in a calm, open-plan layout.
A signature element of the flagship space is the indoor starlit pool, offering a dramatic yet tranquil setting for post-training recovery.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made through the SEVEN+ app within the required timeframes: Classes: minimum 12 hours before start time; Wellness services: minimum 24 hours before. Late cancellations or repeated no-shows may result in booking restrictions. Credits are non-refundable and non-transferable.

Name: Café Belmont
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Via Maistra, this intimate day bar by Silvano Vitalini operates as a discreet gathering spot in the center of St. Moritz.
The space combines a polished, cozy aesthetic with a focused offering of quality coffee, light bites, and an impressive selection of vintages.
Patrons particularly value the extensive champagne and wine list, which transforms the petite venue into a spirited hub for refined socialization.

Name: King's Social House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within St. Moritz’s Badrutt’s Palace Hotel, this dining and nightlife venue is a collaboration with Michelin-starred chef Jason Atherton.
The space reimagines Switzerland’s oldest nightclub as a modern urban bistro that evolves into a spirited late-night destination.
Interiors feature large-scale murals by Swiss street artists Bane + Pest, creating a striking contrast to the classic alpine setting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of a no-show (i.e., the guest does not arrive for the booked reservation without prior notification to the hotel 24 hours before the reservation time), a fee of CHF 50 per person will be charged to the guest’s credit card provided at the time of reservation. The hotel will hold the reserved table for up to 15 minutes after the confirmed reservation time.

Name: The Surf Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Surfside, this 1930s landmark was originally designed by Russell Pancoast and recently expanded by Pritzker Prize-winning architect Richard Meier.
The property pairs a historic Mediterranean Revival clubhouse with three floating glass towers, balancing old-Florida glamour with modern minimalism.
The Surf Club Restaurant by Thomas Keller serves Continental cuisine amidst Art Deco chandeliers, terrazzo floors, and hand-painted murals.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard reservations must be cancelled at least 72 hours prior to arrival to avoid a penalty. Cancellation and prepayment policies vary according to accommodation type; advance purchase and festive season bookings may be non-refundable. A credit card is required to guarantee the reservation.

Name: SIRO Recovery Lab
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Kerzner International within Dubai’s One Za’abeel development, this performance-focused facility marks the global debut of the SIRO wellness concept.
The venue prioritizes biohacking and physical restoration over traditional spa leisure, anchoring its identity in a high-tech, data-driven Recovery Lab.
Signature protocols range from cryotherapy and infrared sessions to assisted stretching, all developed with input from elite sporting partners like AC Milan.

Name: Kulm Country Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Architect Lord Norman Foster restored this historic ice pavilion in St. Moritz, preserving its legacy as the host of two Winter Olympics.
The structure combines local woodcraft with a striking cantilevered canopy, connecting the warm, pine-clad interiors to the alpine landscape.
Dining centers on the ground-floor restaurant, where chef Mauro Colagreco serves charcoal-grilled specialties overlooking the skating rink.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The hotel will hold the reserved table for up to 15 minutes after the confirmed reservation time. A no-show fee will be charged if the guest fails to show up for the booked reservation without notifying the hotel at least 24 hours prior to the reservation time. The amount of the fee will be communicated at the time of reservation and will be charged to the credit card provided by the guest at the time of booking.

Name: Alphütte Clavadatsch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Hotel Schweizerhof St. Moritz, this converted cow shed sits high on the Suvretta slopes with commanding views of the Engadine lakes.
The destination combines a traditional timber-clad interior with a spacious terrace that serves as a prime vantage point for skiers.
The kitchen utilizes a wood-fired oven for crisp focaccia and pizza, though the signature Kaiserschmarrn remains the essential order.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Dal Mulin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Centrally located in St. Moritz, this intimate bistro is operated by hosts Kathrin and Danijel Krasnic with chef Pietro Spotti.
The rustic, wood-paneled space offers a refined setting for Alpine market cuisine that emphasizes Italian traditions and high-quality produce.
A standout feature is the two book-sized wine lists, offering over 700 labels to pair with the signature veal-shank ravioli.

Name: STAY by Yannick Alléno
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the One&Only The Palm, this two-Michelin-starred restaurant presents the modern French cuisine of chef Yannick Alléno.
The high-ceilinged dining room features timber walls and black crystal chandeliers, providing a sharp backdrop for the kitchen's technical precision.
A signature Pastry Library serves as a dedicated station where chefs finish intricate desserts to order, adding a theatrical element to the meal.

Name: Prime68
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the 68th floor of the JW Marriott Marquis Dubai, this steakhouse offers a commanding vantage point over the emirate’s skyline.
The menu is a study in premium sourcing, featuring carefully aged USDA Prime and Wagyu cuts prepared with traditional American technique.
Beyond the steaks, the signature lump crab cakes are a notable highlight, served amidst panoramic vistas that stretch toward the Arabian Gulf.

Name: Row on 45
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a penthouse at Dubai’s Grosvenor House, Row on 45 is a two-Michelin-starred concept by British chef Jason Atherton.
Designed to resemble a luxury apartment, the intimate venue accommodates just 22 guests for a 17-course tasting menu that unfolds across three distinct spaces.
The theatrical journey moves from a champagne lounge to the main dining room and concludes in the library, featuring dishes such as Bafun uni with Marmite.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To finalise your booking, we would require for a nominal deposit of AED 500 per person. Additionally, please kindly note that we operate a 48-hour cancellation policy. Should you need to amend or cancel your reservation, we respectfully ask that you notify us at least 48 hours prior to your booking time. In the event that this notice period is not respected, the deposit paid will be non-refundable and retained as a cancellation fee.

Name: Tasca by José Avillez
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop the Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, this Michelin-starred venue marks the first international opening from celebrated Portuguese chef José Avillez.
The kitchen reimagines the traditional *tasca* (tavern) with sophisticated, contemporary plates served against a backdrop of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline.
A standout order is the "Bitoque" LX-DXB, a wagyu tenderloin that elevates a humble national staple with truffle and a golden fried egg.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card required to guarantee reservation. Cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation time or no-shows are subject to a fee.

Name: Zuma Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring the DIFC, this contemporary Japanese izakaya is the work of chef Rainer Becker and architect Noriyoshi Muramatsu.
The split-level venue balances high-volume energy with exacting standards, serving sophisticated plates in a setting defined by walls of rusted steel.
A sculptural bamboo installation anchors the dining room, while the open robata grill serves as the focal point for the kitchen's precision cooking.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required to secure your reservation. There is no charge to the card unless you cancel your reservation with 24 hours’ notice or less, or the party fails to attend their booking, where a cancellation fee per person will be incurred.

Name: Beefbar Grace Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Riccardo Giraudi’s dining concept occupies a space within the renovated Grace La Margna St Moritz hotel in the Swiss Alps.
The kitchen reimagines street food through a premium lens, offering high-quality cuts and sharing plates in a setting that merges historic charm with contemporary design.
Signature Angus beef tacos and Wagyu kebabs arrive on custom porcelain plates featuring colorful emojis, created in collaboration with French manufacturer Bernardaud.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Romantik Hotel Krone
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In the Black Forest town of Geisingen, owner Christoph von Bothmer and architect Markus Uhrig have transformed the region's oldest inn into the design-led 1280 Krone.
The property juxtaposes its medieval timber-framed heritage with a minimalist concrete extension, creating a dialogue between centuries of history and modern purism.
Guests can retreat to the atmospheric underground bar, which highlights the building’s ancient foundation walls.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation fees apply from the point of reservation. In the event of a cancellation up to 30 days prior to the arrival date, 30% of the room rate will be charged, up to 14 days prior to the arrival date, 50% will be charged, up to 7 days prior to the arrival date, 70% will be charged, and during the last week and on early departure, 100% of the entire day or package price will be charged. In the event that the room can be rented out until 30 days prior to the arrival date, no cancellation fee will be charged. The terms and conditions of the Austrian Hotel Industry apply (ÖHVB).

Name: Grill Chadafö
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the 17th-century Chesa Veglia farmhouse, this distinguished restaurant is an acclaimed culinary outpost of St. Moritz’s Badrutt’s Palace.
The interior blends rustic history with refined service, offering a menu of classic French cuisine centered on premium cuts prepared over an open grill.
Diners enjoy signature specialties like whole roasted Bresse chicken or Châteaubriand cooked over charcoal, a ritual set to the sounds of a resident pianist.

Name: Verde Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring the sandy shores of Pampelonne, this festive beach club serves as the flagship destination for the Yeeels Group.
The open-air setting channels a bohemian Mykonos-meets-Tulum aesthetic, blending laid-back lounging with high-energy socializing.
Guests enjoy Mediterranean sharing plates by Chef Julien Lee Thibault amidst driftwood decor before the atmosphere shifts to a vibrant sunset party.

Name: L'Olivo at Al Mahara
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Andrea Migliaccio of the two-Michelin-starred Capri original, this Italian seafood restaurant resides within the Burj Al Arab.
The dining room centers on a floor-to-ceiling coral reef aquarium, providing a marine setting for the kitchen's Italian coastal cuisine.
Signature plates include the blue lobster and a king crab with green apple and mussels sauce, served alongside views of tropical marine life.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A deposit of AED 250 per person is required at the time of booking. Cancellations or amendments must be made at least 48 hours in advance to avoid forfeiting the deposit.

Name: Reif Japanese Kushiyaki Al Wasl
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Reif Othman, this Dubai outpost in Dar Wasl Mall presents a spirited, unconventional take on Japanese kushiyaki.
The space eschews skyscraper glitz for a grounded, street-food inspired atmosphere where the menu balances edgy creativity with Bib Gourmand precision.
Beyond the signature skewers, look for standout plates like raw salmon with crispy black rice or the celebrated Wagyu steamed bun.

Name: Kuhstall
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sister to the legendary Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, this converted alpine cowshed on the Sils Maria slopes offers a masterclass in rustic hospitality.
The wood-paneled interior serves as a cosy refuge for creative, seasonal cuisine that transcends typical ski-hut fare.
A signature evening ritual involves arriving by private snowcat or lantern-lit hike to indulge in a curated set menu and select regional wines.

Name: Carigiet Fondue Stübli
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the historic Chesa Veglia farmhouse in St. Moritz, this intimate dining room is operated by Badrutt’s Palace Hotel.
The seasonal venue focuses strictly on traditional Swiss fondue, serving guests in a compact space that mimics a private parlor.
Walls feature original sketches by Graubünden artist Alois Carigiet, whose work adds a whimsical visual narrative to the classic alpine meal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: 7 Tales
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 44th floor of Grosvenor House in Dubai Marina, this Japanese-inspired speakeasy is a concept from chef Jason Atherton.
The space channels the nocturnal energy of 1960s Tokyo, blending izakaya-style informality with an urban, graffiti-laced aesthetic.
A signature ritual invites guests to roll a custom die with their Negroni, offering the chance to win a complimentary cocktail.

Name: SĀN Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Palm West Beach, this beach club and restaurant is the work of South African designer Tristan du Plessis.
The design channels the spirit of the San people through a "raw luxe" aesthetic of curvilinear forms, tactile textures, and neutral tones.
Distinctive details include a swim-up bar, private cabanas designed as open-air living rooms, and a sculptural beach installation by artist Jake Singer.

Name: TakaHisa
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located within the Banyan Tree Dubai on Bluewaters Island, this Japanese dining destination is led by chefs Takashi Namekata and Hisao Ueda. The offering centers on a dual-focus omakase experience that pairs premium sushi with top-tier wagyu in a refined, counter-style setting. Seafood is flown in directly from Tokyo’s Toyosu Market, while the A5 Kobe beef holds a rare marbling score of 12.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 50% fee applies to no-shows or cancellations made within 48 hours of the appointment. Advance online booking is required.

Name: Dracula's Ghost Riders Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1974 by photographer Gunter Sachs, this private members’ club is hidden within a chalet on the grounds of the Kulm Hotel in St. Moritz.
The intimate venue serves as a nocturnal hideaway for the jet set, operating under the playful motto of administering "extra-mortal affairs."
Beyond its winter season, the wood-paneled space transforms each summer into the atmospheric main stage of the St. Moritz Festival da Jazz.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Socialista
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created by Maggio and Giuseppe Cipriani, this private lounge concept maintains exclusive outposts in global hubs including New York, London, and Dubai.
The atmosphere channels the romance of pre-revolutionary Havana, blending colonial European architecture with eclectic twentieth-century modernism.
Interiors defined by velvet banquettes and rattan accents provide an intimate backdrop for evenings of Cuban rhythms and signature mojitos.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ula
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the shoreline of Dukes The Palm, this Mediterranean-led retreat is operated by Solutions Leisure Group and features award-winning design by Broadway Interiors.
The open-air venue channels a grounded, organic aesthetic, offering a calm, earthy respite from the city’s frantic energy.
A signature "Ula Experience" sharing menu anchors the culinary offering, best enjoyed during the venue’s golden hour.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our Ristorante requires a credit card to reserve. Cancellations will result in a per person charge of $50. Cancellation policy will also apply to cancellations due to COVID 19 and all health or travel related circumstances.

Name: La Scarpetta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in St. Moritz, this spirited trattoria is the passion project of three friends who envisioned a culinary "living room" in the Engadin.
The design eschews alpine kitsch for a stripped-back aesthetic of bare wooden tables, rustic floorboards, and an artful mix of chandeliers and wall clocks.
Recognized with a Michelin Bib Gourmand, the kitchen delivers unpretentious handmade pasta and curated wines that offer a grounded counterpoint to the town’s glitz.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ushuaïa
Master_Aurora_Insights: Situated on the waterfront at Dubai Harbour, this open-air venue is a partnership between Ibiza’s The Night League and local operators Studio A by Addmind. The destination translates the brand’s signature festival atmosphere into a standalone nightlife experience defined by high-fidelity audio and immersive production. A towering monolith structure and precision-engineered LED walls frame the stage, offering a dramatic visual anchor against the setting sun and city skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For tickets, refunds are only available if 360 Cancellation Insurance is purchased and cancellation is requested at least 24 hours prior to the event start time; otherwise, tickets are non-refundable. For VIP tables, bookings may be moved or refunded up to 24 hours before the event, except for Opening, Closing, and special events which require 72 hours' notice. Refunds for tickets due to event cancellation must be requested within 48 hours.

Name: Chesa Veglia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Built in 1658, this Engadine farmhouse is a St. Moritz dining staple operated by the neighboring Badrutt’s Palace Hotel.
The interior is a maze of original wood paneling and low ceilings that hosts three separate dining concepts.
The casual Pizzeria Heuboden serves the venue's signature Pizza Dama Bianca, topped with Taleggio, Parmesan, and black truffles.

Name: Da Adriano
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on New York’s Upper East Side, this intimate Italian trattoria is the personal project of Chef Adriano Kercuku.
The compact, minimalist dining room focuses purely on authentic execution, serving handmade pastas and regional classics without pretension.
Regulars favor the signature lasagna and freshly baked focaccia, which exemplify the kitchen’s commitment to traditional, comforting flavors.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Neora
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski, Neora introduces modern Greek dining to the Engadin valley’s alpine landscape.
The kitchen presents a menu of shareable plates that reinterpret Hellenic traditions through a contemporary lens.
Dining centers around the open-fire souvla, where slow-roasted meats are served alongside hand-shaped pita and cold-pressed olive oil.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Coupole Matsuhisa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Badrutt’s Palace Hotel in St. Moritz, this venue is the alpine outpost of chef Nobuyuki Matsuhisa.
The dining room occupies the hotel’s former indoor tennis hall, distinguished by a soaring glass dome that anchors the space.
The menu features signature Japanese-Peruvian plates like black cod miso, served beneath the structure’s expansive glazed roof.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of a no-show at any restaurant operated by Badrutt’s Palace Hotel (i.e., the guest does not arrive for the booked reservation without prior notification to the hotel 24 hours before the reservation time), a fee of CHF 50.- (“no-show fee”) per person will be charged. The no-show fee will be charged to the guest’s credit card provided at the time of reservation. The hotel will hold the reserved table for up to 15 minutes after the confirmed reservation time. After that, the hotel is no longer bound by the reservation and may, at its discretion, allocate the table to other guests and forgo providing services to the tardy guest.

Name: Dorta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in one of Zuoz’s oldest farmhouses, this family-run restaurant is a bastion of enduring Engadin tradition.
The atmospheric dining room features low wooden beams and fur-draped benches, creating a cosy backdrop for a menu rooted in hearty, local recipes.
A standout among the regional specialties is the signature Zuozer Heusuppe, a creamy hay soup that offers a distinct taste of the surrounding alpine meadows.

Name: Le Relais
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Le Restaurant Le Relais serves as the principal dining venue within the historic Badrutt's Palace Hotel in St. Moritz.
The space is defined by its preserved Belle Époque interior and a steadfast commitment to traditional French service standards.
A meal here centers on Guéridon rituals, with staff preparing steak tartare and crêpes Suzette tableside overlooking Lake St. Moritz.

Name: Le Mouton Noir
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by KV Hotels at 2,200 metres atop Verbier’s Ruinettes lift, this split-level lodge houses both a self-service canteen and a gastronomic restaurant.
The atmosphere transitions from leisurely lunches featuring Italian-inflected cuisine to a spirited après-ski scene anchored by resident DJs.
An expansive south-facing terrace serves as the focal point, offering panoramic views of the Grand Combin alongside signature dishes like black truffle risotto.

Name: Chez Dany
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the secluded hamlet of Clambin, this authentic chalet is a long-standing favourite among Verbier’s regulars.
The kitchen balances traditional Swiss recipes with contemporary touches, featuring seasonal ingredients and meats prepared in a large outdoor smoker.
Dinner guests typically arrive by snow taxi, ending the night with a moonlit ski or sledge run back to the village.

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Dr. Becky Burgess, this integrative clinic operates two outposts in the Vail Valley, blending clinical expertise with a holistic wellness philosophy.
The practice distinguishes itself by merging traditional Chinese medicine with modern bioenergetics, offering treatments ranging from fertility support to advanced aesthetic therapies.
Guests can expect restorative rituals like ionic detoxes or infrared sauna sessions, set amidst interiors defined by a kiva-style fireplace and concrete accents.

Name: Paradiso
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Managed by Badrutt’s Palace, this high-altitude brasserie sits above St. Moritz with open views of the Engadin lakes.
The venue functions as both a restaurant and daytime club, where urban beats soundtrack the transition from lunch to dancing.
Members access the Gucci Paradiso lounge, while the main terrace serves lobster rolls and Gillardeau oysters against a backdrop of alpine peaks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to the reservation time to avoid a no-show fee of CHF 50 per person. Reservations are held for 15 minutes after the confirmed time.

Name: La Cordée
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Based within Verbier’s Hotel La Cordée des Alpes, this dining room is one of only two establishments in the village to hold the exacting "Fait Maison" label.
The space centers on an open kitchen where the brigade applies French culinary techniques to seasonal Valais ingredients, offering diners a transparent view of the process.
A striking four-meter wine fridge anchors the room, displaying a serious collection that champions the region’s viticulture alongside international labels.

Name: La Diala
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the wellness wing of St. Moritz’s Badrutt’s Palace, this light-filled venue offers a restorative counterpoint to the hotel’s formal dining rooms.
The kitchen focuses on wholesome Mediterranean cuisine, serving health-conscious plates in a space defined by classic Engadine interiors and relaxed energy.
Named after the Romansh word for "mountain fairy," the restaurant features a sun-drenched terrace with commanding views of the Swiss Alps.

Name: Pizzeria Heuboden
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the seventeenth-century Chesa Veglia farmhouse in St. Moritz, this rustic outpost is an informal dining concept from the legendary Badrutt’s Palace.
Occupying the building’s original hayloft, the space offers a warm, wood-paneled setting for wood-fired Italian classics.
The brick oven produces the signature Dama Bianca, a truffle-topped pizza that remains a standout ritual for visiting skiers.

Name: The Hythe
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated at the base of Vail Mountain in Lionshead Village, this Well & Being spa resides within The Hythe, a Luxury Collection Resort.
The facility adopts an apothecary-style approach to wellness, prioritizing recovery with treatments that utilize indigenous botanicals and alpine ingredients.
A standout feature is the Himalayan Salt Therapy Lounge, a quiet sanctuary lined with glowing salt bricks designed to aid respiration and relaxation.

Name: Patrizier Stuben
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the historic Chesa Veglia farmhouse in St. Moritz, this rustic dining venue is operated by Badrutt’s Palace Hotel.
The interior defines alpine coziness with its original 17th-century pine paneling, low ceilings, and a menu dedicated to traditional Swiss comfort food.
A standout experience involves savouring local specialties like air-dried Bündner Fleisch or Pizzoccheri in one of the town’s oldest surviving buildings.

Name: W Verbier
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at the base of the Médran lift, this dining venue is overseen by culinary director Sergi Arola, blending modern Swiss cuisine with Spanish influences.
The interior juxtaposes rustic local wood and stone with sleek urban furnishings, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame the snowy action on Place Blanche.
A standout feature is the "Eat-Hola" tapas counter, offering a communal tasting of signature dishes like spicy patatas bravas and Wagyu beef.

Name: La Marlénaz
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the group behind Chalet d'Adrien, this timbered outpost sits at 1,895 metres and is reached only by ski or foot.
The kitchen elevates classic Alpine fare, serving regional specialties in a warm dining room or on a sun-drenched terrace facing the Combins massif.
Hikers and skiers make the pilgrimage for the signature morel mushroom rösti, a hearty reward best enjoyed against the valley backdrop.

Name: La Marmotte
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched high on the Savoleyres slopes in Verbier, this celebrated mountain restaurant occupies a renovated 1976 chalet with sweeping views of the Val de Bagnes.
The interior defines alpine rusticism through soapstone floors, weathered wood, and a roaring fireplace that complements the kitchen’s hearty, traditional Valaisan cuisine.
A dinner of raclette and the house’s legendary secret-recipe salad often concludes with a spirited toboggan ride back down to the village.

Name: Sand Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the beach at Sandy Ground in Anguilla, this independent venue operates as a casual counterpoint to the island's hotel restaurants.
The culinary approach centers on shareable tapas and small plates paired with craft cocktails in an open-air setting.
Notable menu items include the honey-sriracha glazed Brussels sprouts and fresh lobster salad, served against a backdrop of live music and sunset views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancel at least 24–48 hours in advance to avoid fees.

Name: Eden Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Dorchester Collection’s historic Hotel Eden in Rome, this intimate wellness sanctuary offers a serene counterpoint to the city’s energetic streets.
The mood is one of hushed exclusivity, where vaulted ceilings and warm, sandy tones frame a menu of restorative rituals and advanced skincare.
Signature experiences include the Valmont ‘Great Beauty’ facial, designed to regenerate the skin using Swiss medical-grade ingredients in a private, suite-style setting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or rescheduling require 24-hours notice. Cancellations or rescheduling within 24 hours of the scheduled appointment will result in full payment being charged.

Name: Bonito
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched above Gustavia in St. Barts, this open-air venue is led by Chef Laurent Cantineaux, who combines French cooking with Peruvian influences.
The white-washed timber interior features a resident DJ and unobstructed views of the harbor, creating a distinct lounge atmosphere.
A dedicated raw bar serves signature ceviches and tiraditos, complemented by a wood-fired black truffle pizza.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a credit card guarantee. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance and no-shows are subject to a fee of €150 per person.

Name: ZZ's Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Major Food Group and designed by Ken Fulk, this private membership club maintains distinct outposts in Miami’s Design District and New York’s Hudson Yards.
The venues are defined by maximalist decor and a service philosophy that prioritizes absolute customization over standard menus.
Signature elements range from a Japanese raw bar and cigar terrace in Miami to a dedicated Carbone Privato kitchen in New York.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Aman Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the historic Crown Building on Fifth Avenue, this members' club and hotel was reimagined by architect Jean-Michel Gathy of Denniston.
The design layers the brand’s signature Asian-influenced minimalism over the structure’s original Warren & Wetmore architecture to establish a quiet atmosphere above Midtown.
A wraparound Garden Terrace defines the social space, featuring a retractable glass roof and fire pits that allow for open-air dining in any season.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Shellona
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the shell-strewn sands of Gustavia, this Mediterranean beach club is a Barrière Group destination led by Greek chef Yiannis Kioroglou.
The open-air design channels a bohemian Cycladic spirit, using driftwood tables and turquoise ceramics to frame a relaxed experience of sharing-style mezze.
Tables sit directly on Shell Beach, where millions of tiny pearly seashells replace the sand, creating a singular natural texture underfoot.

Name: L'Esprit Jean-Claude Dufour
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Just steps from Saline Beach, this open-air venue is the culinary home of Chef Jean-Claude Dufour, an alumnus of Eden Rock.
The kitchen presents a market-driven French menu that evolves daily, served within a lush tropical garden that offers a sense of secluded calm.
Diners enjoy signature plates like duck spring rolls or roasted pigeon while seated beneath white canvas sails and swaying palms.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: L'Isola
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a white-washed cottage in Gustavia, this polished Italian standby is the creation of owner Fabrizio Bianconi.
The kitchen imports ingredients directly from Italy to craft rigorous, authentic plates that offer a formal counterpoint to the island’s breezy beach clubs.
Inside the dimly lit, candle-filled dining room, servers present the signature grigliata di mare featuring grilled baby calamari, shrimp, and scallops.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Cheval Blanc Spa Paris
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by architect Peter Marino, Dior Spa Cheval Blanc Paris is a wellness destination located within the Cheval Blanc hotel along the Seine.
The facility pairs the fashion house's visual identity with advanced skincare technology, providing a menu of targeted facial and body treatments.
The space centers around the largest hotel swimming pool in Paris, distinguished by its curved design and undulating mosaic tiles.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 24 hours will incur a charge of 100% of the treatment price.

Name: Sella
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on the water’s edge at Plage de Public, this energetic destination is the creation of Michelin-starred Israeli chef Assaf Granit.
The open-air space fuses Jerusalem’s culinary traditions with a festive island atmosphere, anchored by a design utilizing ancestral rock.
Signature shareable plates include octopus glazed with amba and maple syrup, served amidst a lively soundtrack and sea views.

Name: Monroe
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the North Beach building that once housed the Jazz Workshop, this Art Deco venue is operated by Payam Arvin.
The space combines plush curving sofas and dramatic artwork with a modern d&b audiotechnik sound system designed for high-energy socializing.
A weekly Battle of the Decades event defines Fridays, with the DJ shifting genres every hour to cover music from the 60s to the present.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No cancellation fees apply if canceled at least 24 hours prior to the booking.

Name: Little Beach House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated directly on the sands of Carbon Beach, this members-only retreat is a discreet outpost of the Soho House group.
Designed by Montalba Architects, the structure prioritizes indoor-outdoor living with teak wood, floor-to-ceiling windows, and open-air corridors.
Two oceanfront terraces provide unobstructed views of the Pacific, creating a backdrop for a menu of fresh local fare and House Regulars.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel your booking up to 18:00, local time two days before your arrival date. Any cancellation request we receive after the applicable Cancellation Deadline will be subject to a fee equivalent to the total cost of the stay in the room you had booked, including any VAT/applicable taxes in relation to that room charge. This cancellation fee will also apply if you fail to arrive for your stay at Soho House, and a prepaid reservation will incur the entire stay charge.

Name: Maddox Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 2007 by nightlife operator Fred Moss, Maddox Club is a private members' destination located in London's Mayfair district.
Designed by interior architect Sammy Chams, the multi-level venue integrates an Italian restaurant with a late-night club environment.
The space features a DJ booth positioned directly within the dining room, alongside a dedicated deep house music area known as the Green Room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made 48 hours in advance for full refund of deposit. Late cancellations may be subject to charges.

Name: Lío
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Pacha Group, Lío is a combined cabaret, restaurant, and nightclub situated in Ibiza's Marina Botafoch.
The venue pairs Mediterranean dining with live theatrical performances, transitioning from a seated banquet into a late-night dance floor.
As night falls, the open-sided architecture reveals panoramic views across the water to the historic Dalt Vila.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you need to cancel your reservation, please do so with more than 48-hour notice or a fee will apply. For groups of 14+ a longer notice period will apply. All restaurant & club reservations require a minimum spend to be achieved which will be outlined when you make an enquiry. Depending on your party size a deposit may be required which will contribute towards your minimum spend and overall bill.

Name: The Roof Gardens
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Restored by Stephen Fitzpatrick as a members' club, this Grade II-listed Kensington landmark was originally designed by landscape architect Ralph Hancock.
The 1.5-acre site features three distinct themes including a Spanish garden, a Tudor garden, and an English woodland.
A flowing stream winds through the greenery, where resident flamingos wander among the mature trees.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Marian Goodman Gallery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a 1920s industrial building in Hollywood, this gallery was transformed by the architecture firm Johnston Marklee.
The 13,000-square-foot space retains the character of the former autobody garage, utilizing original skylights to illuminate the expansive exhibition rooms.
A central courtyard garden designed by Terremoto features native plants and a concrete pergola, offering a quiet outdoor extension to the art space.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Lisson Gallery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Renovated by architecture practice Ashe Leandro, this 8,000-square-foot Hollywood outpost is the first Los Angeles location for the global Lisson Gallery.
The converted industrial building in the Sycamore District features a stark white façade and polished concrete floors that anchor the exhibitions.
Original bow truss ceilings rise 25 feet above the main gallery, creating a voluminous and light-filled setting for large-scale works.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Hauser & Wirth
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the sprawling Globe Mills complex in the Arts District, this multidisciplinary art center was adapted by Creative Space and Selldorf Architects.
The complex integrates expansive exhibition spaces with an open-air courtyard and a dedicated bookstore within its industrial footprint.
A visit is best capped at the on-site restaurant Manuela, which sources herbs and eggs directly from the property’s own garden and chicken coop.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Entry is free and no advance booking is necessary.

Name: La Renommée
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a preserved 1823 storefront on Rue Saint-Honoré, this atmospheric restaurant marks the first international opening from Brendan Sodikoff’s Chicago-based Hogsalt group.
The intimate dining room blends a moody, speakeasy energy with Parisian history, featuring antique oil paintings and a focused menu of French standards.
A distinct highlight is the seamless translation of American hospitality into a historic setting, anchored by dishes like the sole meunière.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to secure your reservation. Any cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation will be charged a fee of 50€ per person. Your party size is considered final once the reservation is confirmed and decreasing your party size at any time is not permitted. Should you arrive with fewer guests, a 50€ per person change fee will be applied for all reductions in party size, for any reason, and will be added to the final check. Reservations sold or traded will be cancelled without notice.

Name: Talise Ottoman Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Positioned on Palm Jumeirah’s West Crescent, this palatial sanctuary is frequently recognized by the World Travel Awards as the region's leading spa resort.
Interiors evoke the Ottoman Golden Age, featuring dark woods, glowing lanterns, and elaborate Turkish mosaics across a sprawling 8,200-square-metre footprint.
Beyond thalassotherapy pools and snow rooms, the experience centers on the vast hammam, where foam rituals are performed on heated marble.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you need to reschedule or cancel your spa appointment, please notify the spa at least 6 hours in advance to avoid being charged for the service. Cancellation of a package, group booking or ritual requires 24 hours prior notice. Late notice or ‘no show’ is subject to a 50% cancellation fee from the total treatment price.

Name: Nobu (Malibu)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set directly on Carbon Beach, this oceanfront destination from Chef Nobu Matsuhisa features a minimalist design by Studio PCH and Montalba Architects.
The structure uses bleached wood and board-form concrete to frame the Pacific, creating a refined setting for the brand's Japanese-Peruvian cuisine.
Floor-to-ceiling windows connect the interior to a patio where guests order the signature Black Cod Miso just steps from the surf.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to secure reservations. Cancellations are accepted until the day prior to the reservation. Same-day cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of typically $25 to $50 per person.

Name: Wayan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Cedric and Ochi Vongerichten, this French-Indonesian outpost brings the flavors of its New York sibling to a chalet-inspired space in Aspen.
The teak-paneled dining room balances alpine warmth with tropical greenery, serving a menu that merges French technique with bold Jakarta roots.
A dedicated après-ski service features warming rituals like the hot Wedang whiskey cocktail, best enjoyed alongside signature lobster noodles with black pepper butter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We can only hold reservations for 10 minutes beyond the time of your booking. It is then up to the host team to attempt at accommodating the reservation.

Name: Kinugawa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Blackcode, this contemporary Japanese dining room in Paris is defined by the sleek interiors of architects Gilles & Boissier.
The space merges the conviviality of an izakaya with the hushed elegance of a salon, creating a moody and intimate dining environment.
A meal here invariably centers on the signature black cod marinated in miso, a dish that exemplifies the kitchen’s delicate approach to flavor.

Name: Sotheby's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Based in the DIFC’s Gate Village, this gallery and private sales salon operates as Sotheby’s primary outpost in the Middle East.
The destination functions beyond the auction calendar to offer year-round access to fine art, jewelry, and regional works through a curated program of exhibitions.
Housed in a building by Sir Michael Hopkins, the space is defined by its natural stone facade and intricate mashrabiya shading that filters the desert light.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Once made, no bidder may retract a bid made during the auction for any reason. There is no cooling-off period, cancellation, or rescission of bids.

Name: Cloud Nine Alpine Bistro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched at nearly 11,000 feet on Aspen Highlands, this converted ski patrol shack is a European-style bistro helmed by Executive Chef Michael Johnston.
The wood-paneled interior channels the Swiss Alps with a hearty menu of raclette, steak tartare, and bubbling pots of fondue.
Lunch service culminates in a high-energy ritual where guests dance on tables and spray champagne against a backdrop of the Maroon Bells.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard First Seating reservations require a $30 per person credit card hold, charged if cancelled within 48 hours of the reservation time. Standard Apres reservations require a $50 per person credit card hold. Prepaid packages and Snowcat Dinners are non-refundable.

Name: Sant Ambroeus
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Giampiero Tagliaferri Studio, this Milanese destination occupies a historic 1889 building in downtown Aspen as the group’s first Alpine outpost.
The interiors blend Alpine modernism with Italian heritage through details like a coffered ceiling and vintage pieces by Mario Bellini.
The all-day menu features Milanese staples such as vitello tonnato and the signature Gianduia hazelnut cake served in the coffee bar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a credit card hold. A cancellation fee of $10 per person applies for lunch reservations cancelled within 12 hours. For dinner, a fee of $25 per person applies to late cancellations and no-shows.

Name: Cape Morris
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, this private island in the Arabian Gulf is accessible only by a 64-foot yacht from Marsa Marina.
The setting prioritizes seclusion, with a pristine shoreline for water sports or quiet relaxation removed from the main city skyline.
Experiences culminate in a three-course meal or live barbecue curated by Michelin-starred chef Saverio Sbaragli, served in a private beach setting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: This offer is non-refundable and non-cancellable. Exclusively available to Jumeirah Villa and Suite guests.

Name: Bvlgari Spa (Dubai)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel, this 1,700-square-meter wellness retreat is situated on the man-made Jumeirah Bay Island.
The interiors balance Italian heritage with Middle Eastern influences, offering seven treatment rooms, a hammam, and a 25-meter indoor pool with sea views.
A standout feature is the vitality pool, inspired by Caracalla baths and adorned with fan-shaped Divas' Dream mosaic tiles in gold and green.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 100% charge will be incurred for any treatment not cancelled at least 24 hours prior to your scheduled time.

Name: Rintaro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chez Panisse alumnus Sylvan Mishima Brackett, this Michelin Bib Gourmand izakaya anchors a corner of San Francisco’s Mission District.
The kitchen applies Japanese techniques to Northern California’s seasonal bounty, creating a produce-centric interpretation of classic tavern fare.
Guests sit in booths crafted from redwood wine casks to enjoy yakitori grilled over binchotan charcoal and fresh wasabi grated on sharkskin.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are subject to a fee of $50.00 per guest.

Name: Gigi Rigolatto
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on the shores of J1 Beach, this Italian beach house is a project by Paris Society with interiors by architect Hugo Toro.
The venue unfolds as a sprawling sanctuary featuring a swimming pool, a lush garden, and a Bellini Bar framed by terracotta and white parasols.
Guests dine on sharing plates of vitello tonnato and linguine alle vongole, while the Gigi Circus offers a dedicated, supervised space for children.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the event of the Customer’s failure to show up for a restaurant reservation (“no show”), the Customer’s reservation will be cancelled in full. If the reservation is guaranteed by payment card or had been the subject of a bank pre-authorisation, the Establishment will charge the Customer fifty (50) euros that has been given as a guarantee for the reservation.

Name: L'Arpège
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris's 7th arrondissement, this three-Michelin-starred restaurant is the domain of Chef Alain Passard.
The kitchen prioritizes vegetable-forward cooking with produce sourced directly from its own dedicated gardens outside the city.
A signature amuse-bouche is the hot-cold egg, served in its shell with warm yolk, maple syrup, and sherry vinegar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card imprint is required to secure the booking. Cancellations made more than 2 days before the reservation date are free of charge. Late cancellations (less than 2 days before) or no-shows are charged €200 per person for lunch and €400 per person for dinner. If the number of guests is reduced, a fee of €200 per absent person applies.

Name: Talise Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched 150 metres above the Arabian Gulf on the 18th floor, this wellness destination is a nominee for the 2026 FACT Spa & Wellness Awards.
The light-filled space spans two levels and features separate male and female indoor infinity pools framed by floor-to-ceiling views of the horizon.
Guests can book the Golden Amber Journey, a signature ritual that incorporates red amber and frankincense to honor traditional Arab hospitality.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you need to cancel or change your appointment, please inform us twelve hours prior to your scheduled appointment time. Otherwise the full treatment fee will be applied.

Name: Nobu Beach Inn
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored at Atlantis The Royal, this is Chef Nobu Matsuhisa’s first beach club, merging his famed culinary brand with a sun-drenched destination.
The setting balances a minimalist Japanese aesthetic with the energy of a pool club, featuring warm woods, concrete, and private cabanas.
A standout menu features bite-sized adaptations of classics, such as the salmon spicy miso monaka, served alongside sweeping views of the Palm Jumeirah.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Guerlain Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Moorish-inspired One&Only The Palm, this retreat is operated by historic French beauty house Guerlain.
The sanctuary is defined by Andalusian architecture, featuring stone archways and a serene central courtyard that sets a contemplative tone.
A standout is the exclusive "Désert d'Orient" ritual, combining a silk indulgence wrap and steam session with a personalized massage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require a minimum of 24 hours notice for cancellations. Cancellations, changes, or missed appointments will incur a fee of 100% of the service.
