Name: Kenichi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
An expansion of the long-standing Aspen original, this Snowmass Village restaurant serves contemporary Japanese cuisine and sushi in a sleek atmosphere.
The dining room incorporates traditional design elements, featuring solid walnut woodwork and shoji screens that display projected moving images.
The kitchen prepares a signature Yellowtail and Otoro Serrano sashimi, a specialty dish finished with truffle oil and basil yuzu soy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We have a 48-hour cancellation policy. A $30 per person deposit is required for booking. In the instance of a no-show or cancellation with less than 48 hours in advance of the visit, the deposit paid will be non-refundable.

Name: Marea
Master_Aurora_Insights: Marea is an Italian coastal seafood restaurant at 240 Central Park South on Columbus Circle in Manhattan, which opened in May 2009. Signature dishes include handmade pastas like fusilli with octopus and bone marrow, branzino crudo with pistachio, and casarecce with crab and uni puree. Four private dining options: Praiano room seats 24, Ravello accommodates 30, Salerno Lounge fits 35, or full restaurant buyout for 125 seated guests. 2010 James Beard Award for Best New Restaurant, named one of 15 Most Exciting Dining Spots by The Infatuation, and AAA Five Star Award recipient since 2011.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Dior Spa (UAE)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 29th floor of The Lana, this wellness space marks the first Dior Spa in the UAE, with interiors by Gilles & Boissier.
The menu integrates cutting-edge technology like Icoone therapy with holistic protocols across five treatment rooms and a couple’s suite.
A signature ritual, Escale at The Lana, involves deep tissue techniques performed on a Japanese futon to release tension.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Should you need to cancel or change your appointment, please let us know at least 24 hours before the scheduled time to avoid being charged the full cost of the treatment.

Name: Matsuhisa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a 120-year-old Victorian house, this venue marks the first location established outside of Chef Nobu Matsuhisa’s original Beverly Hills flagship.
The kitchen serves the chef’s specific Japanese-Peruvian fusion, blending traditional sashimi techniques with South American ingredients like cilantro and jalapeño.
Signature plates include the Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Sashimi, two dishes that defined the brand’s global expansion.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: FZN
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within Atlantis The Palm, this three-Michelin-starred venue is the first Middle Eastern outpost from Swedish chef Björn Frantzén.
The service unfolds as a choreographed journey, transitioning from a bright, Scandinavian-style living room for appetizers to an intimate counter for the main tasting menu.
A standout course is the råraka, a crispy potato cylinder filled with vendace roe, served before guests return to the lounge for petit fours.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 72 hours of the reservation will be charged the prepayment fee of 50%.

Name: Toro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Viceroy Snowmass, this Pan-Latin dining room is the work of chef and restaurateur Richard Sandoval.
The kitchen applies modern techniques to South American staples, serving wood-fired steaks and shareable small plates in a warm, contemporary setting.
A highlight is the yellowfin tuna, which arrives thinly sliced and dressed in the chef’s signature salsa negra.

Name: Chez Margaux
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in New York’s Meatpacking District, this private member’s club is a partnership with chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
The space features vaulted ceilings and five fireplaces, housing a formal dining room and a Japanese-inspired lounge.
A caviar-and-cocktails bar anchors the venue, transforming into a nightclub known as Gaux Gaux as the evening progresses.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Loulou
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Hôtel Barrière Les Neiges, this ski-in destination brings the Parisian flair of the Loulou Group to the Bellecôte slopes.
Interior architect Corinne Sachot celebrates Savoyard culture with a warm design that complements the spirited atmosphere of the large terrace.
Executive Chef Benoît Dargère oversees a menu of Italian favorites, including a signature truffle pizza and vodka pipe rigate.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Brutto
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by the late Russell Norman, this Farringdon trattoria pays homage to the rustic, boisterous dining rooms of Florence.
The interior embraces a rough-around-the-edges aesthetic with red-checked tablecloths, low lighting, and an energetic, unpretentious atmosphere.
A standout ritual is the five-pound Negroni, a fixture that pairs perfectly with the signature roast pork tonnato.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require credit card details for reservations to protect against no-shows and cancellations with less than 24 hours notice. The charge is £25 per guest.

Name: Le 1947
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Le 1947 à Cheval Blanc is the only three-Michelin-starred restaurant in Courchevel, helmed by Chef Yannick Alléno within the alpine hotel.
Sybille de Margerie’s futuristic, all-white interior creates a hushed stage for modern French gastronomy, stripping away distraction to focus on the craft.
Named for the château’s 1947 vintage, the menu highlights Alléno’s signature extractions and sauces for a limited number of guests.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: AEON Clinic
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A pioneer in regenerative medicine, AEON Clinic is situated at Atlantis The Royal in Dubai and focuses on longevity and functional health.
The facility integrates medical diagnostics with holistic therapies, offering multidisciplinary treatments that address biological aging and physical performance.
A standout option is the Rejuvenescence IV infusion, a high-dose blend of NAD+ and nutrients engineered to boost cellular energy and mental clarity.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: AEON requests at least 24 hours' notice for cancellations or rescheduling.

Name: Longevity Hub by Clinique La Prairie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying three floors of One&Only One Za’abeel, this outpost marks the Dubai debut of the renowned Swiss medical clinic Clinique La Prairie.
The facility functions less as a spa and more as a high-tech wellness laboratory where medical science and holistic therapies converge to extend healthspan.
Visitors start with a proprietary Longevity Index assessment before exploring cryotherapy chambers, IV infusion suites, and a bar serving detoxifying tonics.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Kindly note that for external guest bookings a 50% prepayment will be required to secure all bookings. All cancellation requests made less than 24 hours prior to the booking will generate a full payment to be processed and late arrival will shorten your treatment time.

Name: Casa Cipriani
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the restored Battery Maritime Building in Lower Manhattan, this hotel and members' club is operated by the Cipriani family.
Architect Thierry Despont transformed the Beaux-Arts ferry terminal into polished interiors defined by lacquered mahogany and custom Italian furnishings.
The property features a sprawling outdoor terrace that offers rare, water-level views of the Statue of Liberty and the Brooklyn Bridge.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Guests must cancel their reservation 48 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one night's room and tax charge. Select rates require full prepayment and are non-refundable. The Club reserves the right to charge cancellation fees for members who fail to cancel and/or attend any prior reservations made.

Name: The Arts Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in ICD Brookfield Place, this four-story outpost of London’s historic institution is designed by Milan-based Dimorestudio.
The sprawling layout balances British heritage with Middle Eastern scale, offering distinct lounges defined by rich velvets and bold patterns.
Members gather at the rooftop terrace for late-night DJ sets against a backdrop of the Burj Khalifa, or retreat to the Oscuro cigar lounge.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dining reservations can be modified or cancelled up to 24 hours before the reserved time. Lanserhof at The Arts Club bookings may be cancelled up to 48 hours before the appointment for a full refund.

Name: Akasha Holistic Wellbeing
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by David Chipperfield Architects, this subterranean wellness centre at Hotel Café Royal was recently named England's Best Hotel Spa.
The space is structured around the four natural elements to unite nutrition, meditation, and fitness in a single holistic offering.
A central 18-meter lap pool anchors the space, which notably houses London's first dedicated Watsu pool for private hydrotherapy treatments.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 100% charge will be incurred for any treatment not cancelled at least 24 hours prior to your scheduled treatment time.

Name: Asaya Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by NICOLEHOLLIS, this Silicon Valley wellness retreat functions as a modern clubhouse within the Rosewood Sand Hill estate.
The interiors mirror the Santa Cruz Mountains through wood finishes, chiseled stone, and woven textures that ground the holistic treatment menu.
A standout facility is the duet Redwood Suite, which includes a secluded patio, an outdoor shower, and a Hinoki wood Japanese soaking tub.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you wish to reschedule or cancel your reservation, please be advised that 24 hours is required in order for us to accommodate your request. No-show or last minute cancellations will incur a 100% charge.

Name: Bamford Wellness Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by organic pioneer Carole Bamford, this holistic sanctuary at 1 Hotel brings the English countryside’s sustainable ethos to urban settings.
The nature-inspired space prioritizes a connection to the earth, utilizing natural materials and the brand’s own botanical product line for restorative therapies.
A standout experience is the Bamford Body Signature Treatment, which combines a cleansing foot bath with Shiatsu and Swedish massage techniques to release tension.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Treatments must be prepaid in full at the time of booking. Cancellations must be made more than 72 hours before the start of the treatment or full charge of treatment price applies. Treatments are non-refundable except for medical reasons and with proof of medical certificate.

Name: Ricari Studios
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Anna Zahn, this wellness studio at L'Ermitage Beverly Hills specializes in a tech-forward approach to physical restoration and skin health.
The signature Ricari Method combines manual therapy with mechanical stimulation to boost circulation, facilitate lymphatic drainage, and calm the nervous system.
Sessions utilize the Icoone device, which delivers micro-stimulations to connective tissue for a non-invasive massage that tones and revitalizes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Because the treatments you select are reserved especially for you with one of their trained specialists, we ask that you provide us with twenty-four hours advance notice should you need to change or cancel your appointment. No-shows and late cancellations made less than twenty-four hours before the scheduled time will be billed at the full treatment rate.

Name: Guerlain Spa at Raffles The OWO
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying four floors of the historic Old War Office, this 27,000-square-foot wellness destination was designed by Goddard Littlefair as Guerlain’s first branded spa in the UK.
The subterranean retreat centers on a 20-meter swimming pool and vitality basin, flanked by thermal facilities and a state-of-the-art movement studio.
Three VIP suites host the location-exclusive Royal Glow Tech Facial, a ritual combining microdermabrasion with photobiomodulation light therapy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you are not able to attend, please cancel your appointment with at least 24 hours’ notice. Cancellations within 24 hours will incur a 100% charge.

Name: Six Senses Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Developed by Select Group, Six Senses The Palm, Dubai is a LEED-certified hotel and residential property located on the West Crescent of Palm Jumeirah.
The beachfront retreat integrates sustainable design elements, featuring undulating architecture and cellular facades modeled after the physical structure of coral reefs.
The property houses a 60,000-square-foot wellness club equipped with a longevity clinic, an IV lounge, and a dedicated biohacking room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard cancellation windows vary by property, typically ranging from 24 to 72 hours for urban hotels and 14 to 30 days for resorts. Non-refundable rates require full prepayment at booking. Resort bookings often require a deposit or full payment 30 days prior to arrival.

Name: Aman Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Mayfair’s historic Connaught hotel, this wellness retreat marks the first standalone spa from the renowned Aman group.
Designed by Michael Blair, the subterranean sanctuary emphasizes holistic renewal through therapies inspired by the brand’s global destinations.
A granite swimming pool features a cascading waterfall, offering a serene counterpoint to the city bustle above.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask for a minimum of six hours cancellation notice. Cancellations made within six hours will be subject to the full charge of the treatment booked.

Name: Halehouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within Stanly Ranch and operated by Auberge Resorts Collection, this Napa Valley wellness compound prioritizes performance and recovery.
The offering centers on a dedicated recovery zone that blends sports science with holistic restoration.
A highlight is the Springhouse circuit, a self-paced ritual featuring a hyperbaric oxygen chamber, cold plunge, and a glass-fronted cedar sauna.

Name: The Beaumont Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Grade II listed Mayfair building, this Art Deco spa was refined by the late architect Thierry Despont.
The interiors channel 1920s New York with a palette of black and white marble, chrome accents, and geometric mosaics.
A heated marble hammam table anchors the space, offering signature scrubbing rituals alongside a cold plunge pool and relaxation area.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require 24 hours’ notice to cancel or rearrange treatments and 48 hours’ notice to cancel or rearrange Spa Experiences. Cancellations made with less than the required notice or failure to arrive for an appointment will incur the full charge.

Name: Alo Wellness Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within Alo Yoga’s Beverly Hills headquarters, this invitation-only facility serves as a private training ground for the brand’s high-profile ambassadors.
The light-filled interior merges a professional training facility with a minimalist design language, creating a photogenic backdrop that doubles as a content studio.
Visitors finish workouts on a rooftop recovery deck featuring a cold plunge and infrared sauna, often departing with a complimentary set of activewear.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 6 hours prior to class start time. A $15 fee is charged for late cancellations, and a $20 fee is charged for no-shows. Studio members are allowed three late cancellations before the fee applies.

Name: Le Pantruche
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the 9th arrondissement, this reliable bistro from chef Franck Baruzier has earned a Michelin Bib Gourmand for its intelligent take on classic French cuisine.
The intimate dining room features a retro aesthetic with classic banquettes and antique mirrors, providing a quintessential backdrop for the modernized traditional menu.
Regulars know to save room for the house signature, a technically perfect Grand Marnier soufflé served with salted caramel.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Tout-Paris
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the seventh floor of Cheval Blanc Paris, this Michelin-starred brasserie is designed by Peter Marino and helmed by Chef William Béquin.
The space functions as a vibrant all-day gathering spot where modern French classics are served against a backdrop of colorful interiors.
A vast terrace offers a panoramic sweep of the Seine, stretching from the Pont Neuf to the Eiffel Tower.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask that any cancellation to your reservation be made no less than 12 hours prior. For no shows or late cancellations, you will be subject to fee of 50€ per person that will be applied to the credit card on file.

Name: Kei
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Kei Kobayashi, the first Japanese national to win three Michelin stars in France, helms this understated dining room in the first arrondissement of Paris.
His kitchen bridges French tradition and Japanese precision, delivering tasting menus that emphasize texture and color over heavy sauces.
The signature Garden of Crunchy Vegetables anchors the experience, presenting a complex assembly of seasonal produce, smoked salmon, and arugula mousse.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the event of cancellation or changes to the number of place settings less than 48 hours in advance, the sum of €300 at Lunch and €400 at Dinner per person not present, will be charged to the card provided at the time of booking.

Name: La Scène - Le Quellec
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Two-Michelin-starred chef Stéphanie Le Quellec leads this Avenue Matignon venue, which features polished interiors by design duo Toro & Liautard.
The dining room centers on an open kitchen that acts as a stage, allowing guests to watch the brigade prepare modern French courses.
A defining dish is the caviar French toast with crème crue and sorrel, offering a savory twist on a familiar classic.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You have up to 48 hours before your reservation to cancel without charge. Beyond a delay of 15 minutes, the restaurant reserves the right not to honor the reservation.

Name: Le Coyote
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Marine Gora in the Marais, this day-to-night venue operates as a coffee shop before transforming into a spirited queer saloon.
The interior channels a minimalist Western aesthetic with fringed lampshades and a country playlist that sets a welcoming tone.
A playful menu features comfort dishes like chanterelles on cornbread alongside signature drinks such as a popcorn milkshake or spicy michelada.

Name: Jean Imbert au Plaza Athénée
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Jean Imbert oversees this Michelin-starred dining room at the Hotel Plaza Athénée, dedicating the menu to French culinary heritage.
A grand Breccia marble table anchors the space, setting a theatrical stage for the revival of centuries-old royal recipes.
Servers present historical plates such as the signature Lobster Bellevue in a hall adorned with 20,000 gold leaves.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Liquide
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Les Halles district of Paris, this modern tavern is the brainchild of Top Chef alumnus Matthias Marc.
The atmosphere strikes a balance between trendy and convivial, encouraging guests to share creative small plates in a space that feels like a lively living room.
A twelve-meter marble table d'hôte designed by Philippe Starck anchors the dining room beneath a horn chandelier.

Name: Prévelle
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the 7th arrondissement, Prévelle is the debut independent restaurant from chef Romain Meder, formerly of the Plaza Athénée.
The kitchen pursues a "free and instinctive" philosophy, prioritizing plant-based ingredients and sustainable sourcing within a modern French framework.
Hugo Toro’s intimate, pared-back interiors frame the tasting menus, while director Alexandre Montré oversees the service and wine selection.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Lolo Cave à Manger
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Loïc Minel and Christophe Juville operate this compact dining cellar and wine bar in the 9th arrondissement.
The standing-room layout centers on a communal table where patrons gather for natural wines and shared dishes.
A signature Scotch egg with 'nduja and white martini cream anchors the rotating menu of seasonal small plates.

Name: Les Enfants du Marché
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked within the historic Marché des Enfants Rouges, this spirited counter-dining spot is led by owner Michael Grosman.
The kitchen contrasts its humble market stall setting with sophisticated bistronomy, pairing pristine seafood and offal with cult natural wines.
Secure a stool at the counter to enjoy daily specials like razor clams or the signature mussels with gorgonzola sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No reservations accepted.

Name: Le Pré Catelan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Napoleon III pavilion deep within the Bois de Boulogne, this three-Michelin-starred venue is the domain of chef Frédéric Anton.
The kitchen orchestrates a refined expression of French gastronomy where precise modern techniques contrast with the building's historic grandeur.
A standout example is the signature langoustine ravioli prepared with foie gras and finished with a delicate gold leaf jelly.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Any reservation requires a credit card hold to guarantee it. No amount is charged except in case of no-show or cancellation less than 72 hours before the service. In case of a total cancellation of services or no-show by the Client on the agreed date: there is no penalty for cancellations occurring more than 72 hours before the service. For cancellations made 72 hours or less before the service, the credit card hold amount will be charged by the Service Provider. On December 31, a partial prepayment is required from the Client at the time of reservation for a minimum amount of 950 euros including VAT per person; the amount of the partial prepayment will be retained by the Service Provider if the modification occurs 72 hours or less before the service date.

Name: Le Servan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sisters Katia and Tatiana Levha run this Paris bistro that merges classic French technique with their Filipino heritage.
The kitchen reimagines the neighborhood canteen by pairing market ingredients with sharp, acidic, and spicy Asian accents.
A signature dish is the deep-fried wonton filled with blood sausage and served with a sweet chili dipping sauce.

Name: Le Gabriel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the La Réserve Paris hotel, this three-Michelin-starred dining room is helmed by chef Jérôme Banctel.
The kitchen applies technical precision to native Breton ingredients, subtly infusing them with flavors drawn from travels in Japan and Turkey.
A signature carrot course is prepared using a Turkish limewater technique that creates a firm yet melting texture before being filled with ginger mousse.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A bank imprint via a secure platform is required to guarantee the reservation. For any cancellation within 48 hours of the reservation, a cancellation fee per place will be charged. The amount of this fee will be specified by the Company at the time of booking.

Name: La Scène
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Avenue Matignon in Paris, this two-Michelin-starred restaurant is the independent venue of Chef Stéphanie Le Quellec.
The dining room is arranged around an open kitchen, allowing guests to observe the team preparing modern French dishes.
A signature starter is the caviar French toast, featuring crisp brioche topped with crème crue and sorrel.

Name: Le Mazenay
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the Marais, this intimate bistro is led by Chef Denis Groison and his wife Lan, who oversees the dining room.
The kitchen balances rigorous French technique with market produce and subtle Vietnamese influences inspired by the couple’s time abroad.
Request a table by the window for a direct view of Nicolas Flamel’s house, recognized as the oldest stone building in Paris.

Name: Origines
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set against medieval castle ruins in Le Broc, this Michelin-starred retreat is the vision of Auvergne native Adrien Descouls.
The property acts as a modern observatory, pairing sharp architecture with a menu rooted in the surrounding volcanic terroir.
Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the dormant volcanoes, a vast panorama echoed by interiors featuring raw oak and local basalt stone.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The restaurant may request a prepayment or bank imprint (credit card hold) to secure the reservation. Specific cancellation fees or deadlines are not published on the website, but the restaurant tracks no-shows and may use this information to apply stricter booking conditions.

Name: Lucas Carton
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking Place de la Madeleine, this historic Art Nouveau restaurant is currently led by chef Hugo Bourny.
The interior is distinguished by its listed early 20th-century woodwork, intricately carved by cabinetmaker Louis Majorelle.
Its menu retains the Canard Apicius, a honey-roasted duck recipe originally created here by Alain Senderens in 1970.

Name: Gaya par Pierre Gagnaire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the 7th arrondissement, this seafood-centric bistro serves as a relaxed contemporary alternative to Chef Pierre Gagnaire’s main restaurant.
The kitchen applies the chef's technical precision to marine ingredients, offering a menu that balances experimental combinations with refined comfort.
Interiors by Marcelo Joulia frame the experience, where the signature tuna and prosciutto sandwich on brioche remains a highlight.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: OOBATZ
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in Paris’s Ménilmontant, Oobatz is the permanent home for American baker Dan Pearson’s sourdough pizza, launched with the team behind Rigmarole.
Named for the Italian-American slang for "crazy," the kitchen serves naturally fermented pies with a thin, crispy texture that defies Neapolitan conventions.
A unique feature is the *carte blanche* option, a chef's choice tasting menu that delivers a progression of surprise, off-menu creations.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask for a bank imprint of 20 euros per cover, which we will keep only if a cancellation is made less than 6 hours before the reservation.

Name: Onor
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the 8th arrondissement, Onor is the socially conscious gastronomic outpost from acclaimed chef Thierry Marx and partner Ricardo Silva.
The Michelin-starred venue balances high-level modern French cuisine with a commitment to sustainability and the transmission of culinary know-how.
Signature dishes like the soy risotto anchor the menu, served within a maritime-inspired interior that honors the site's history as the former La Marée.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nakatani
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris's 7th arrondissement, this restaurant is led by chef Shinsuke Nakatani, who spent a decade working with Hélène Darroze.
The sixteen-seat dining room features a white, uncluttered interior and serves a blind tasting menu blending French tradition with Japanese finesse.
In the open kitchen, the team employs precise techniques, such as washing vegetables at 50 degrees Celsius to maximize their crispness.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le 6 Paul Bert
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located just down the street from its famous sibling in the 11th arrondissement, this modern bistro is the experimental counterpart to Bertrand Auboyneau’s classic Bistrot Paul Bert.
The intimate space functions as a dining cellar, offering a daily changing menu of market-driven small plates and natural wines instead of traditional steak-frites.
A signature feature is the open kitchen and dining room lined with floor-to-ceiling wine bottles, creating a relaxed backdrop for the seasonal cuisine.

Name: Maison Dubois
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Paris’s 8th arrondissement, this intimate gastronomic address is the solo project of chef Arthur Dubois, a former sous-chef to Pierre Gagnaire.
The hushed, domestic atmosphere features just six tables, setting the stage for precise, ingredient-led cooking that has already secured a Michelin star.
For total privacy, book the Jacques Maximin salon, a dedicated space for six that pays homage to the chef’s early mentor.

Name: Pierre Gagnaire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Hotel Balzac, this three-Michelin-starred destination serves as the flagship for chef Pierre Gagnaire.
The kitchen presents ingredients in complex constellations of satellite plates, favoring immediate inspiration over traditional culinary rules.
The experience culminates in the Grand Dessert, a signature ritual involving a simultaneous parade of miniature sweet courses.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Fees for late changes or no-shows are €300 per absent guest at lunch and €400 per person at dinner if cancelled less than 48 hours in advance.

Name: Mavrommatis
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by the Mavrommatis brothers in the 5th arrondissement, this Michelin-starred destination is the city's undisputed temple of Hellenic gastronomy.
Chef Andreas Mavrommatis elevates rustic Greek flavors through rigorous French technique, offering a sophisticated alternative to the typical taverna experience.
The menu features standout plates like grilled octopus with crispy phyllo or Lozère lamb roasted with halloumi and Swiss chard dolmades.

Name: Oobatz
Master_Aurora_Insights:
American baker Dan Pearson established this permanent outpost in the 11th arrondissement after building a following with his sold-out pop-ups.
The unpretentious dining room focuses on thin, crispy sourdough pies served in a lively atmosphere that prioritizes quality over ceremony.
Diners at the counter sample inventive toppings like polpette with caciocavallo or endive with bleu de chèvre paired with natural wine.

Name: Le Baudelaire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Hotel Le Burgundy, this Michelin-starred venue operates under the direction of Executive Chef Mylo Levin.
The kitchen prioritizes sustainable gastronomy with a vegetable-led approach that emphasizes technical precision and seasonal sourcing.
A monumental ceiling fresco by Marco del Re anchors the dining room, where guests enjoy standout dishes like lamb paired with winter squash and saffron.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: L'Archeste
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the 16th arrondissement, this Michelin-starred venue is the domain of Chef Yoshiaki Ito, a veteran of the respected Hiramatsu.
The kitchen presents precise modern French gastronomy against a backdrop of dark brushed walls and pale wooden fittings.
There is no printed menu here, as the daily changing courses are determined solely by the day's best produce.

Name: Les Cocottes
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Rue Saint-Dominique in the 7th arrondissement, this contemporary bistro was created by renowned chef Christian Constant.
The kitchen applies high-end culinary technique to seasonal French classics served exclusively in the venue's namesake cast-iron pots.
Diners perch on high stools at the long counter to enjoy hearty recipes like the signature potatoes stuffed with pig’s trotters.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ortensia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Paris’s 16th arrondissement, this Michelin-starred destination is the domain of Japanese chef Terumitsu Saito, who executes French gastronomy with exacting precision.
The intimate interior by CUT architectures features a serene, minimalist aesthetic that perfectly complements the kitchen’s refined, cross-cultural culinary approach.
Named for the hydrangea, the menu reflects the passage of time with dishes that shift in color and composition to mirror the changing seasons.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A bank imprint is required to validate the reservation. This bank transfer will only be taken in the event of late cancellation (less than 24 hours in advance) or failure to show up. If the restaurant does not hear from you within 30 minutes of the scheduled arrival time, the reservation will be considered not honoured and the bank imprint will be debited. The establishment reserves the right to charge the price of the menu selected at the time of booking for each seat left vacant.

Name: Granite
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris’s 1st arrondissement, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the debut project of chef Tom Meyer, a protégé of Anne-Sophie Pic.
The space balances relaxed elegance with a contemporary edge, serving technical French cuisine that highlights bold sauces and sustainable sourcing.
A sculptural wooden art installation curves across the walls, providing a warm and textured backdrop for the precise tasting menus.

Name: Fleur de Pavé
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the 2nd arrondissement, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the work of Chef Sylvain Sendra.
The kitchen balances precise French technique with Peruvian and Japanese influences, placing a distinct emphasis on vegetal ingredients.
A partnership with market gardener Asafumi Yamashita ensures a steady supply of pristine produce for the signature tasting menus.

Name: Masaikuta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Masaikuta is a Michelin-listed restaurant in Paris’s 11th arrondissement led by Japanese chef Masahide Ikuta.
The kitchen serves a single blind tasting menu that interprets French terroir through the lens of precise Japanese technique.
Guests experience seasonal plates like Mont-Saint-Michel cockles or matured Simmental beef paired with choices from a cellar focused on natural wines.

Name: La Scène Thélème
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former premises of Guy Savoy in the 17th arrondissement, this Michelin-starred restaurant is helmed by chef Rudy Langlais.
The venue distinguishes itself by pairing intimate theatrical performances with a refined French-Japanese culinary program in an elegant setting.
A standout finish to the tasting menu is the signature strawberry and rhubarb pavlova, accented with elderflower gel and sake lees ice cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A bank imprint is sufficient to guarantee your reservation.

Name: Le Bouillon Chartier
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1896 by brothers Camille and Frédéric Chartier, this classified historic monument in the Grands Boulevards district preserves the model of the original Parisian broth house.
The cavernous Belle Époque dining hall defines the experience, pairing rapid service and affordable classics with a backdrop of brass rails and mirrors.
Waistcoated servers perform the venue’s signature ritual, scribbling orders directly onto paper tablecloths between courses of oeuf mayonnaise and steak frites.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No reservations accepted.

Name: Le Grand Café
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the restored Grand Palais, this contemporary brasserie from the Loulou Group features interiors by acclaimed architect Joseph Dirand.
The vast, brick-toned dining room channels Belle Époque grandeur, serving polished French classics amidst oversized volumes.
A colonnaded terrace offers prime views of the Petit Palais, providing a dramatic setting for chef Benoît Dargère’s signature vol-au-vent.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Sergent Recruteur
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the Île Saint-Louis, this historic tavern is now a Michelin-starred destination led by chef Alain Pégouret, formerly of Le Laurent.
The kitchen presents rigorous modern French gastronomy set against a backdrop of exposed rafters and ancient stone walls.
Dinner might begin with duck foie gras poached in sangria with flambéed grapefruit, a dish that exemplifies the chef’s technical precision.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please note that in the event of a no-show or late cancellation on the day of booking (less than 72 hours before the booking date), 100 € per person will be charged to the credit card provided.

Name: Le Violon d'Ingres
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the culinary thoroughfare of Rue Saint-Dominique, this Michelin-starred venue is directed by owner Bertrand Bluy and chefs Alain Solivérès and Jimmy Tsaramanana.
The kitchen refines the hearty culinary codes of the French South-West, delivering technical updates to traditional brasserie fare.
Diners can expect exemplary execution of regional standards, particularly the sautéed sweetbreads, served within a discreetly modern setting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation or modification conditions are specified at the time of booking. In case of late cancellation or no-show, fees may apply.

Name: L'Escale
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on Mahé’s coast, this boutique retreat is a signature project by Winch Design, the London studio celebrated for superyacht interiors.
The aesthetic blends the polish of a vessel with island ease, featuring teak decking, soft linens, and airy, open-plan spaces.
At Mare Nostrum, diners enjoy Creole-infused seafood on a terrace overlooking the private docks and the granite peaks of Eden Island.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Gramme
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Marine Gora, this Parisian canteen and bistro blends a laid-back coffee shop vibe with serious culinary ambition.
The kitchen mixes French bistro staples with subtle Vietnamese influences in a space defined by raw materials and vintage furniture.
A standout is the signature Bánh Mì Dog, a playful reimagining of the classic sandwich featuring a hot dog bun, artisan sausage, and spicy mayonnaise.

Name: East Mamma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the 11th arrondissement near Bastille, this lively trattoria is the original outpost of the Big Mamma group.
The kitchen sources ingredients directly from Italian producers to create a menu of fresh pasta and Neapolitan pizzas in a warm, bustling atmosphere.
A standout experience is the signature truffle pasta, served in a copper pan and finished with a generous grating of cheese at the table.

Name: Les Arlots
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the 10th arrondissement near Gare du Nord, this lively bistro is led by chef Thomas Brachet.
The narrow, bustling dining room serves as a hub for natural wine enthusiasts, offering a chalkboard menu of unpretentious French market classics.
While seasonal plates rotate frequently, the standout fixture is the house-made saucisse-purée, a sausage and mash dish that has earned a cult following.

Name: NHOMe
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris’s 1st arrondissement, this one-Michelin-starred restaurant is the brainchild of chef Matan Zaken.
The concept centers on a single bespoke table where guests gather for a blind tasting menu that highlights seasonal produce.
The experience is defined by its communal nature, with a "book your chair, not your table" policy set within a vaulted, intimate dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: MoSuke
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in Paris’s 14th arrondissement, this Michelin-starred restaurant is led by Mory Sacko, a chef known for bridging three distinct culinary traditions.
The kitchen executes a precise triangular fusion of West African, French, and Japanese influences within a serene, light-filled dining room.
Signature plates include a reinterpreted beef mafé, combining the traditional West African peanut stew with tamarind and Japanese fermented tuna.

Name: Neso
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Michelin-starred chef Guillaume Sanchez, a former pastry specialist, leads this experimental venue in the 9th arrondissement of Paris.
The dining room blends raw concrete and gold tones, centering on an open kitchen where fermentation and cold extractions define the menu.
Distinctive dishes include red mullet with spicy kimchi or a trou normand finished with lovage oil, showcasing a mastery of unexpected textures.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Cornichon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In the 14th arrondissement, chef Sébastien Dagoneau leads this Bib Gourmand neo-bistro after honing his skills at Lucas Carton and Grand Véfour.
The kitchen prioritizes direct sourcing from producers to create modern market cuisine that pairs precise technique with generous flavors.
Diners can expect dishes like guineafowl with morels or pork with potato gnocchi before ending with a signature crunchy chou filled with Bourbon vanilla cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Pertinence
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near the Eiffel Tower, this pocket-sized dining room is led by the Michelin-starred duo Ryunosuke Naito and Kwen Liew.
The kitchen bridges French tradition and Japanese precision, delivering a menu that prioritizes market-fresh ingredients over theatrical presentation.
A minimalist interior of light wood and Knoll chairs sets the stage for standout plates like the signature roasted duck.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Hakkasan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Christian Liaigre, this Mayfair venue serves modern Cantonese cuisine across two floors of dark wood lattice and slate.
The interior is characterized by low lighting and intricate wooden screens that offer privacy without isolation.
A signature meal typically features the crispy duck salad with pomelo followed by roasted silver cod in champagne and honey.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require 24 hours' notice for any cancellations and amendments, otherwise, a £50 per person charge.

Name: BOA Steakhouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Guided by Executive Chef Brendan Collins, this modern steakhouse by Innovative Dining Group balances polished design with a high-energy social atmosphere.
The dining room moves away from the stuffy steakhouse archetype with a sleek, contemporary aesthetic that attracts a fashionable industry crowd.
While the 40-day dry-aged cuts are the main draw, the menu’s standout signature is the Goat Cheese Baklava featuring pistachios, black truffles, and frisée.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Dinner by Heston Blumenthal
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Mandarin Oriental Hyde Park, this two-Michelin-starred destination is the work of chef Heston Blumenthal.
The kitchen translates historic British gastronomy into modern dishes by reviving recipes from cookbooks dating back to the 14th century.
A signature Meat Fruit, chicken liver parfait disguised as a mandarin orange, anchors a menu that also features the spit-roasted pineapple Tipsy Cake.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit or debit card details are required to guarantee all reservations. If you are unable to attend on the day, please kindly inform us in writing by no later than 72 hours prior to your reserved time as a cancellation fee of £50 per person may apply after this time.

Name: Arcane 17
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Haut-Marais, this sophisticated neo-bistro is the creation of Pablo Escriva and features the wood-fired cooking of chef Sophie Léger.
The intimate, candlelit space designed by Studio Bétyle sets the stage for a menu of refined Basque and Catalan-inspired plates.
Diners can expect dishes like tuna carpaccio and grilled gambas prepared over the open charcoal fire, accompanied by a curated selection of cocktails.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Relais de l'Entrecôte
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1959 by Paul Gineste de Saurs, this Parisian institution maintains a singular focus on steak frites across its bustling locations.
The no-reservations bistro operates without a menu, serving only a walnut salad starter followed by tender sirloin and golden fries.
Servers provide a second serving of meat and pommes allumettes, all doused in the family’s secret, butter-heavy herb sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations not accepted.

Name: Le Comptoir du Relais
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring the Carrefour de l'Odéon, this bustling bistro is the flagship of Yves Camdeborde, the chef widely credited with pioneering the "bistronomy" movement.
The tight, vintage-style dining room serves market-fresh French classics that bridge the gap between haute cuisine technique and neighborhood accessibility.
Join the daily no-reservation queue at lunch for a terrace seat and a taste of the signature breaded pig’s trotters.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Sisley Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on Pointe Milou, this spa pairs the Christopher Hotel with French skincare house Sisley in a structure by architect Guillermo de Yavorsky.
The open-air design embraces the trade winds, with treatment rooms that face the ocean to merge the sound of crashing waves with botanical protocols.
Guests can book the signature double cabin, which features a private terrace and outdoor shower overlooking the breaking surf.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations in less than 24 hours will require a charge of 100% of the treatment price.

Name: W Verbier
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Concrete Architectural Associates at Place Blanche, this venue within Verbier’s only ski-in/ski-out hotel is the property's culinary anchor.
The menu focuses on modern Swiss alpine cuisine and seasonal local ingredients, served in a space defined by natural wood and an open kitchen.
Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the outdoor activity, while signature flame-grilled meats and curated tartares define the dining experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Sarkara
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Courchevel’s Le K2 Palace, Le Sarkara is a two-Michelin-starred restaurant led by Chef Sébastien Vauxion.
This distinct venue frames the entire gastronomic experience through the lens of pastry rather than traditional savory courses.
The kitchen applies savory techniques to fruits and vegetables, producing a texture-rich progression that runs from light starters to complex finishes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case the diners do not arrive or cancel the booking, a cancellation fee will be applied with the total value of the menu per person. A credit card guarantee is required at the time of booking.

Name: Clavadatsch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Hotel Schweizerhof St. Moritz, this renovated stable sits on the quiet slopes of the Suvretta area.
The rustic alpine hut offers a secluded retreat from the town's bustle, serving hearty regional classics in a traditional wood-paneled setting.
A wood-fired oven produces crisp focaccia and pizza, served on a terrace with views of the Engadin lakes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Sidonie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Hotel Le Chabichou in Courchevel 1850, Le Sidonie is a bar and restaurant overseen by chef Stéphane Buron.
The venue features a wood-accented interior that transitions from a daytime bistro into an evening lounge.
The beverage program includes signature cocktails crafted by mixologists trained by World Barista and Cocktail Champion Victor Delpierre, served beside a fireplace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Cave des Creux
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched at 2,112 meters in Courchevel 1850, this former cheese-ripening cellar is now a mountain restaurant run by Chef François Breda and a team of former ski instructors.
The menu blends Savoyard tradition with Asian flavors, served in a warm, renovated interior or on the sun-drenched terrace.
A massive outdoor dessert buffet features homemade pastries and fresh fruits set against a panoramic view of Mont Blanc.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Saulire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Courchevel 1850, this restaurant is led by chef Benoît Redondo, known for his precise handling of regional ingredients.
The kitchen is noted for its extensive use of Périgord black truffles to refine classic Savoyard dishes.
Guests order the signature truffle fondue in a dining room lined with pale wood and decorated with antique mountain objects.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Grill Alpin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Cheval Blanc Courchevel, this alpine brasserie is helmed by chef Yannick Alléno with interiors by Peter Marino.
The space is defined by the warmth of live embers and a menu that elevates traditional mountain cuisine through precise, fire-based cooking.
A signature approach involves grilling premium ingredients over coals and pairing them with a curated selection of condiments.

Name: Reif Japanese Kushiyaki
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by chef Reif Othman, this Japanese dining spot is found within Dubai’s Dar Wasl mall.
The menu centers on kushiyaki skewers grilled over binchotan charcoal alongside wagyu sandos and clay pot rice.
A distinct feature is The Experience, a four-seat counter where guests are served a daily changing omakase menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Dar Wasl: For groups of 6+, a non-refundable deposit of AED 200 per person is required. Cancellations or rescheduling require at least 24 hours notice; otherwise, payment is non-refundable. All deposits are non-refundable.
Dubai Hills: Two hours advance notice is required to cancel or change reservations. For parties of 6-9, a deposit of AED 100 per person is required. For parties of 10+, a deposit of 50% of the minimum spend (AED 388 per person) is required.

Name: Base Kamp by Aïnata
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the terrace of Le K2 Altitude in Courchevel 1850, this slopeside restaurant features a menu co-signed by chef Alan Geaam.
The kitchen brings the sun-drenched flavors of the Middle East to the Alps with a focus on generous, colorful plates designed for sharing.
A signature lunch involves enjoying traditional mezze and grilled meats while taking in panoramic views of the Saulire summit.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the event that you have been asked for a guarantee card at the time of booking, you will receive an email and a sms where you must reconfirm or cancel the reservation in the links provided for this purpose. Your reservation will only be guaranteed when it has been reconfirmed. If you wish to change the reservation date or the number of diners, your request will be honored as long as it is made with a minimum of advance notice, and if there are seats available.

Name: Le Chabichou
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Meilleur Ouvrier de France Stéphane Buron, this two-Michelin-starred destination occupies a distinctive white-wood chalet in Courchevel 1850.
The kitchen delivers a refined Alpine experience where regional ingredients are elevated through precise, technical mastery rather than unnecessary flourish.
A meal concludes with a signature trolley showcasing an exceptional selection of matured mountain cheeses.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: L'Altitude
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the 5-star Le K2 Altitude in Courchevel 1850, this restaurant celebrates traditional French gastronomy under the guidance of chefs Guillaume Duchemin and Davide Sessa.
The kitchen delivers a contemporary interpretation of classic haute cuisine, serving time-honored recipes with modern precision in an Alpine-style dining room.
For a memorable finish, pastry chef Sébastien Vauxion crafts desserts that pay tribute to the history of French culinary arts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: HIDE+SEEK
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former Vivo space on Chicago’s Randolph Restaurant Row, this venue from partners Danny Vargas and Nick Karounos merges a dining room with a lively lounge.
Siren Betty Design outfitted the two-story interior with plush booths and modern art to complement creative American plates with Mediterranean influences.
The space is anchored by feather chandeliers and an Italian marble bar, the setting for shared dishes like escargot en croute.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We have a 10-minute grace period. Your entire party must be present to be seated. If a deposit is required, it will be applied to your final bill. Should your party size decrease without notice, that portion of your deposit may be forfeited. Private Dining Room reservations incur a $10 per person non-refundable deposit at the time of reserving.

Name: La Folie Douce
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by Luc Reversade in Val d'Isère, this alpine hospitality group operates a collection of venues across the French Alps.
The format combines gastronomy with high-energy entertainment, turning slope-side terraces into open-air clubs featuring live musicians and cabaret dancers.
The La Fruitière restaurant focuses on local produce and authentic styling, providing a counterpoint to the electronic beats and table-top dancing on the terrace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Dorta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in one of the Engadin’s oldest farmhouses in Zuoz, this historic venue is now helmed by Paolo Casanova, GaultMillau’s "Green Chef of the Year 2024."
The dual-concept space pairs a casual bistro for regional classics with an intimate fine-dining room centered around an open kitchen.
Signature plates like "Minestrone di Bosco" with fermented pine cones highlight the kitchen's use of foraged alpine ingredients such as lichen and moss.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Les Caves de Courchevel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the Rue des Tovets in Courchevel 1850, this enduring nightclub stands as an institution of alpine nightlife.
The interior pairs sleek design with high-energy house music, creating a sophisticated backdrop for a discerning international crowd.
Beyond the dance floor, an intimate terrace offers a moment of calm, while the central bar anchors the room’s social energy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If the booking is cancelled less than 15 days before arrival, no refund is due.

Name: Sylvestre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Hôtel Les Grandes Alpes in Courchevel 1850, this intimate venue is the alpine stage for two-Michelin-starred chef Sylvestre Wahid.
The dining room features an open kitchen and just four tables, offering a bespoke gastronomic experience where tasting menus link the flavors of the Alpilles to the Alps.
Wahid’s signature Roscoff crab anchors the meal, served under a distinctive velvety textured ceiling designed to enhance the hushed atmosphere.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled at least 30 minutes in advance. The restaurant holds tables for a grace period of 15 minutes before marking the reservation as a no-show. No prepayment or credit card hold is required for standard bookings.

Name: La Cordée
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Verbier’s Hotel La Cordée des Alpes, this restaurant is led by Chef Romain Maillot.
The kitchen holds the rare "Fait Maison" label, ensuring every dish is crafted on-site using locally sourced, seasonal ingredients.
Diners overlook an open kitchen where the team prepares modern French-Alpine cuisine amidst a setting of dark wood paneling.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: L'Apogée Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the Jardin Alpin within the Oetker Collection’s L'Apogée Courchevel, this versatile venue operates as both a restaurant and a sophisticated lounge.
The atmosphere shifts from a relaxed lunch setting with seasonal French dishes to a subdued evening bar featuring live piano performances.
A signature daily ritual features an elaborate tea time buffet of homemade pastries and crêpes, served overlooking the former Olympic ski slope.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ecco
Master_Aurora_Insights: Housed in the Giardino Mountain hotel in Champfèr, this two-Michelin-starred destination showcases the precise "aromatic cuisine" of Executive Chef Reto Brändli. The menu focuses on intense flavor profiles and seasonal ingredients, balancing technical mastery with a clear, unpretentious presentation. The intimate dining room occupies a former chapel, creating a serene, white-walled backdrop for the signature multi-course tasting menus.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to secure the reservation. Lunch reservations incur a $10 per person cancellation fee if cancelled within 12 hours or for no-shows. Dinner reservations incur a $25 per person cancellation fee if cancelled within 12 hours or for no-shows.

Name: Beefbar St. Moritz
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the revitalised Grace La Margna, this St. Moritz outpost sees restaurateur Riccardo Giraudi bring his global dining brand to the Engadin valley.
The kitchen moves beyond standard steakhouse fare, pairing serious cuts with playful street-food inspirations in a room defined by sharp architectural lines.
Order the signature mini Kobe beef and Angus gyros for a distinct take on alpine dining that contrasts with the region's traditional fondue spots.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Paradiso Mountain Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Owned by the legendary Badrutt's Palace, this high-altitude chalet sits above St. Moritz, blending alpine tradition with cosmopolitan flair.
The venue functions as a dual-concept destination, pairing refined mountain comfort food with a vibrant outdoor deck defined by urban beats and champagne service.
A standout feature is the exclusive Gucci Paradiso lounge, where guests recline on designer furniture to enjoy signature lobster rolls and panoramic valley views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Paradiso charges a fee of CHF 50 per guest in case of no-show for confirmed bookings. This fee will be pre-authorized on your credit card and released upon your visit to Paradiso. In case of cancellation without notice or within 24 hours of the reservation, a fee of CHF 50 will be charged to your credit card.

Name: AVA MediterrAegean
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by the Riviera Dining Group, this transportive venue brings the Cyclades to Florida with interiors by acclaimed designer Lázaro Rosa-Violán.
The atmosphere balances the warmth of a traditional taverna with the pulse of a modern agora, featuring whitewashed arches and a focus on communal dining.
A standout ritual is the tableside preparation of the salt-crusted Branzino Spetziota, which anchors a menu of shared mezze and grilled seafood.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit cards are required to book reservations for 6 or more. You will have until 6 hours before your reservation to cancel. All late cancellations or no-shows will be charged a fee of $25 per person.

Name: Beefbar Courchevel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the Hotel L'Apogée in Courchevel 1850, this mountain outpost of Riccardo Giraudi’s steakhouse group features interiors by American designer Kelly Wearstler.
The dining room channels a mood of Alpine Brutalism with earthy tones and locally sourced stone to frame the menu of rare meats.
Signature plates like the Beefy Cordon Bleu with Wagyu ham are best enjoyed against the backdrop of sweeping slope views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations canceled less than 24 hours in advance will be charged a cancellation fee of $20 per guest.

Name: Le Farçon
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located at the foot of the La Tania slopes, this Michelin-starred venue is the creative domain of Chef Julien Machet. The kitchen reinterprets Savoyard heritage with precision, turning humble mountain ingredients into sophisticated plates that remain grounded in local history. A memorable highlight is the signature golden-crusted tourte, a flaky meat pie that pays homage to the region’s rustic culinary roots.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Berenjak Los Angeles
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Kian Samyani, this Dubai outpost of the London-based kababi brings the rustic culinary traditions of Tehran to the Dar Wasl district.
The space balances an earthy, tile-clad interior with the energy of an open kitchen where charcoal grills turn out authentic mazeh and meats.
A signature highlight is the blistered taftoon bread, baked to order using a twenty-four-year-old sourdough starter and best paired with black chickpea hummus.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required to secure your booking. Parties who arrive with less people than booked will incur a fee of £50pp for each absent guest. You are able to modify or cancel your booking via the 'Manage Reservation' & 'Cancel Reservation' links in your confirmation email, subject to the cancellation terms.

Name: Da Vittorio
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Carlton Hotel, this two-Michelin-starred outpost brings the Cerea family’s Lombardian hospitality to the Swiss Alps.
The kitchen focuses on Italian classics and fresh seafood, maintaining the culinary precision of its three-starred parent restaurant near Bergamo.
Service peaks with the signature paccheri alla Vittorio, a tomato-based pasta dish mixed tableside in a large copper pan.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be guaranteed with a credit card. In case of cancellation within 24 hours from the booked service or in case of no-show, the voucher will be considered as used.

Name: Man O' War
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the northeastern tip of New Zealand's Waiheke Island, Man O' War is a beachfront winery and restaurant owned by the Spencer family.
As the island's only waterfront cellar door, the venue pairs estate-grown vintages with a menu focused on local seafood and regional produce.
Guests frequently arrive by private yacht to anchor in the protected bay, enjoying alfresco wine flights just steps from the sand.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations/amendments are fully refundable if made in writing at least 48 hours prior. 50% of food cost per person is charged if cancelled less than 48 hours prior. 100% of food cost per person is charged if cancelled less than 24 hours prior or in case of a no-show.

Name: Kulm Country Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the historic Kulm Country Club, renovated by Lord Norman Foster, this St. Moritz destination is helmed by chef Mauro Colagreco.
The kitchen presents an alpine-Mediterranean concept focused on mountain terroir, with local ingredients cooked over embers and charcoal.
Guests enjoy signatures like salt-encrusted beetroot with caviar cream accompanied by live vinyl sets and views of the Olympic ice rink.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A no-show fee applies if the guest fails to show up for the booked reservation without notifying the hotel at least 24 hours prior to the reservation time. The fee amount is communicated at the time of reservation and charged to the credit card provided. The hotel will hold the reserved table for up to 15 minutes after the confirmed reservation time.

Name: La Coupole - Matsuhisa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Badrutt's Palace Hotel in St. Moritz, this dining destination is the work of chef Nobuyuki Matsuhisa.
The kitchen holds 16 GaultMillau points for its Japanese-Peruvian fusion cuisine, served in a space defined by a soaring glass dome.
This light-filled structure was originally built as an indoor tennis hall and now hosts diners for signature dishes like black cod miso.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Panoramic
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched at 3,032 metres on the Grande Motte glacier in Tignes, this dining destination is led by chef Jean-Michel Bouvier.
The interior balances alpine warmth with modern design, using timber and sheepskin textures to frame the 360-degree views of the surrounding peaks.
Guests reach the venue by funicular to enjoy wood-fired specialities and an expansive dessert buffet on the terrace facing Mont Blanc.

Name: Orfali Bros Bistro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by Syrian brothers Mohammad, Wassim, and Omar, this Dubai bistro in Wasl 51 tops regional rankings for its modern evolution of Middle Eastern cuisine.
The kitchen applies avant-garde techniques to Levantine ingredients, creating a casual bistronomy style that prioritizes bold flavor over white-tablecloth formality.
A standout signature is the Corn Bomb, a complex creation featuring layers of corn, parmesan, and jalapeño that exemplifies their inventive approach.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made no later than 72 hours prior to the reservation date and time to qualify for a refund. Cancellations made within 72 hours of the reservation will result in the full prepayment being forfeited. A 3% administrative fee is non-refundable in all cases.

Name: La Table de l'Annapurna
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Positioned within the Hotel Annapurna in Courchevel 1850, this restaurant is led by chef Jean-Rémi Caillon.
The kitchen delivers a modern take on Savoyard cuisine, utilizing seasonal ingredients to create sophisticated interpretations of regional classics.
Interiors are defined by forest-themed wallpaper and a palette of glacier blue and terracotta, though the sun-drenched terrace remains the primary draw.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: 1 OAK
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the JW Marriott Marquis, this New York export is an outpost from founder Richie Akiva and the Bulldozer Group.
The venue merges a supper club format with a late-night lounge, emphasizing "timeless design" rather than fleeting trends.
Interiors are anchored by a contemporary art collection from Roy Nachum, featuring his signature "Da Vinci Code" engraved walls.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Awaken Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by G.A Group, this Dubai wellness destination was recognized at the FACT Spa & Wellness Awards UAE 2024.
The facility integrates traditional Middle Eastern therapies with modern technology across interiors defined by earth-toned travertine and organic textures.
Guests can explore the six-room Hammam Sensorium or a hydrotherapy circuit featuring a charcoal sauna, halotherapy salt cave, and alchemy shower.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Rescheduling or cancellation must be done no less than 4 hours in advance. Appointments cancelled under 4 hours in advance are subject to a 100% cancellation fee. No-shows are charged 100% of the reservation amount.

Name: Zuma Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights: Anchored in the Dubai International Financial Centre, this contemporary Japanese izakaya is the work of chef Rainer Becker and designer Noriyoshi Muramatsu. The multi-level interior combines raw granite and steel with natural wood, focusing attention on the open sushi counter and robata grill. Patrons navigate the space via a central sculptural staircase to order the signature miso-marinated black cod wrapped in hoba leaf.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations require valid credit card details to secure the booking. Cancellations made with less than 24 hours' notice or no-shows are subject to a cancellation fee (e.g., €50 per person at some locations). For large parties (8+ guests), a deposit may be required.

Name: Casa Tua
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founders Miky and Leticia Grendene enlisted Florentine architect Michele Bönan to design this Alpine-Italian enclave in the Rockies.
The interior evokes a refined private residence rather than a restaurant, featuring rustic timber walls, plush seating, and soft lighting.
Signature plates such as nut-crusted salmon and linguine alla Nerano arrive in a dining room lined with photography from the owners' collection.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Montevino
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Based in the heart of Snowmass Base Village, this casual bistro serves Italian fare and pizzas to an après-ski crowd.
The atmosphere is relaxed and family-friendly, offering a warm respite from the slopes with a menu of classic pastas and shareable plates.
A standout feature is the convenient location near the gondola, making it an ideal spot for refueling with a signature pizza and mountain views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A fee of $50 per guest will be charged to the card on file for no-shows or same-day cancellations.

Name: L'Olivo at Al Mahara
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Andrea Migliaccio, this Italian fine-dining destination brings the pedigree of his two-Michelin-starred Capri flagship to the Burj Al Arab.
The intimate dining room wraps around a massive floor-to-ceiling aquarium, creating an immersive underwater atmosphere for the refined Mediterranean cuisine.
Signature plates include the lemon risotto with red prawns and blue lobster with raspberries, served against the silent movement of tropical fish.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Guests are required to pay an AED 250 deposit per person to confirm the reservation. Reservations can be amended or canceled up to 48 hours prior to the reservation time without incurring any charge; late cancellations or no-shows will forfeit the deposit.

Name: Catch Steak
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in downtown Aspen, this modern steakhouse from Catch Hospitality Group features interiors designed by the Rockwell Group.
The menu updates the traditional chophouse format by offering lighter, shareable plates alongside a curated collection of the world's best cuts.
A dedicated beef sommelier guides diners through the premium selection, including a signature eight-ounce truffle butter filet and rare Japanese Wagyu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel or adjust your guest count without penalty as late as 10:00 AM on the day of your reservation. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a fee. There is a 15-minute grace period for arrivals; after this time, entry is at the discretion of the door and seating is no longer guaranteed.

Name: Ellina
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Nestled in a historic stone-walled dining room in downtown Aspen, this locally owned, woman-led destination by sommelier Jill Carnevale serves modern Italian-American cuisine.
The spirited, subterranean setting complements a kitchen that balances slow-food principles with contemporary flair, delivering inventive interpretations of regional Italian classics.
The signature braised artichoke bruschetta is a beloved staple, pairing perfectly with selections from the extensive, award-winning wine list.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please let us know of your cancellation 24 hours before your reservation. *We require a credit card to reserve a table. We do not charge the card unless the cancellation policy is violated. Please note: Cancellations may result in a fee.

Name: Ushuaïa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated at Dubai Harbour, this open-air venue is a joint venture between The Night League and Studio A by Addmind Hospitality.
The seasonal winter residency brings the brand’s Ibiza format to a vast outdoor setting designed for large-scale electronic music events.
A festival-sized stage with high-tech production anchors the space, framing views of the marina skyline during signature sunset sessions.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Ticket holders can ask for a full refund of their tickets by notifying Clubtickets at help@clubtickets.com at least 24 hours prior to the event start time, if the 360 Cancellation Insurance has been added to your purchase. Once the event has started, tickets can not be refunded. If an event is cancelled, you can request a refund within 48 hours following the cancelled event. VIP bookings may be moved or refunded up to 24 hours before the event (72 hours for Opening/Closing parties).

Name: Clark's Oyster Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by MML Hospitality, this Austin-born seafood institution has exported its polished, maritime charm to outposts in Aspen and California.
The interiors channel a refined nautical nostalgia, blending warm pecan millwork and brass accents with the energy of a neighborhood diner.
A seat at the marble counter offers the best vantage for the signature pan-roasted hamburger or cold-water oysters with house-baked sourdough.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Raspoutine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in DIFC, this atmospheric supper club is the Middle Eastern outpost of the historic Parisian brand, with a menu overseen by chef Panagiotis Achamnos.
The interior channels a moody energy through heavy red velvet drapery, intricate stained glass, and baroque chandeliers that define the dining room.
Signature dishes like the potato and sheep cheese pelmeni anchor the meal before the venue shifts into a late-night deep house destination.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 24 hours notice to cancel or a charge of AED200 pp will occur. No show will be a charge of AED500 pp.

Name: The Edge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the Timberline Condominiums in Snowmass Village, this restaurant is helmed by chef Jason DeBacker, who channels his heritage into authentic alpine cookery.
The kitchen specializes in the hearty culinary traditions of Germany and Switzerland, offering a robust alternative to standard resort fare.
Signature dishes range from the red deer to a classic cheese fondue, a warming ritual best enjoyed in the dining room’s wood-paneled interior.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our cancellation policy omits all reserved tables must contact The Edge were cancellation of a booking is required. A failure to provide cancellation information will result in The Edge charging £10 per person for all of the persons attached to the booking. This charge extends to deposits. Our deposit policy omits any table reserved over and inclusive of 5 persons must provide a £10 per person deposit. Deposits are redeemable against the bill on the date reserved for, for all persons present. If a reservation is short of the booking amount and no cancellation information has been provided to The Edge their deposit payment of £10 will not be redeemable.

Name: The Snow Lodge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within The St. Regis Aspen Resort, this seasonal supper club is the alpine counterpart to Montauk’s The Surf Lodge, led by founder Jayma Cardoso.
The venue blends a lively après-ski atmosphere with fine dining, featuring the coastal Italian cuisine of New York’s Marea.
Designed by Antonio Di Oronzo, the space centers on the moody Jade Room lounge and a courtyard stage known for its major concert series.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To ensure a seamless experience for all guests, any cancellations made after 5:00 PM MST on the day prior to your reservation will incur a $75 per guest cancellation fee. A credit card is required to secure all bookings. We offer a 15-minute grace period for all reservations. If you arrive after this window, we will do our best to accommodate you; however, seating is not guaranteed and will be at the discretion of management.
