Name: SIRO Recovery Lab
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Dubai’s One Za’abeel development, this specialized wellness facility is the debut recovery concept from operator Kerzner International.
Interiors by LW Design create a minimalist backdrop for a program that prioritizes athletic restoration and biohacking over traditional leisure.
Guests access medical-grade technologies including cryotherapy chambers and infrared saunas while facing panoramic views of the downtown skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: 7 Tales
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within the City Social restaurant on the 44th floor of Dubai’s Grosvenor House, this speakeasy is a concept from Chef Jason Atherton.
The Izakaya-styled space channels the energy of Tokyo nightlife mixed with New York urban grit, featuring monochromatic seating and mirrored ceilings.
A glowing, lacquered orange bar anchors the room, surrounded by custom graffiti art by Gary Young that covers the walls and ceiling.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Anantara Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Palm Jumeirah’s eastern crescent, this Thai-inspired sanctuary by Anantara Hotels, Resorts & Spas was recently named Best Spa Dubai 2024 by the World Spa Awards.
The two-tier facility features 24 treatment rooms and extensive hydrotherapy circuits, including a traditional Turkish Hammam and ice fountains within an Asian-influenced setting.
Signature therapies incorporate local traditions, such as a purifying Alum stone exfoliation followed by aromatic Bokhour smoke to scent the skin.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation policies vary by location. Generally, a minimum of 4 to 24 hours' notice is required to avoid a cancellation fee of 50% to 100% of the treatment price.

Name: Saké Restaurant & Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Hunter St. Hospitality, this dynamic Japanese dining room combines dark, atmospheric design with a bustling and polished energy.
The kitchen executes a contemporary fusion brief, pairing pristine sustainable seafood with bold, texture-driven flavours that challenge traditional restraint.
Regulars invariably order the signature popcorn shrimp served with creamy spicy sauce, a dish that has become a defining element of the experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If a booking is cancelled late or guests do not attend, a fee of $50 per person may apply. For small groups, we request at least 4 hours’ notice to avoid this charge. For groups of 8 or more, we require a minimum of 24 hours’ notice. During peak service times, we kindly ask for a credit card to be placed on file when booking.

Name: KRASOTA
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in The Address Downtown, this immersive dining project is led by chef Vladimir Mukhin and the White Rabbit Family.
The venue functions as a gastro-theatre, merging a technical tasting menu with high-definition visual storytelling projected across the curved walls.
A signature circular table seats just 20 guests for the "Imaginary Art" performance, where dishes are synchronized with the works of eight historical painters.

Name: Nammos Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Four Seasons Resort Dubai, this Mediterranean beach club is a polished outpost of the Mykonian brand, designed by London-based Elastic Architects.
The interiors channel Cycladic design with whitewashed stone and sliding glass walls that merge the dining room with a shaded beachfront terrace.
Signature dishes like spicy tuna and soft-shell crab rolls drive the venue's status as one of the highest-grossing restaurants in the world.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Nammos Mykonos states they never request deposits for reservations. Nammos Baja Sardinia has a 24-hour cancellation policy with a €50 per person penalty for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: Ula
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Palm Jumeirah, this Mediterranean-led beachside destination is operated by Solutions Leisure Group and designed by Broadway Interiors.
The space, a winner of the Best Leisure Interior award, features an earthy, organic aesthetic that transitions from a relaxed daytime retreat to a lively evening venue.
A signature culinary highlight is the clay pot slow-roasted lamb, served amidst a seamless indoor-outdoor flow and sunset views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our Ristorante requires a credit card to reserve. Cancellations will result in a per person charge of $50. Cancellation policy will also apply to cancellations due to COVID 19 and all health or travel related circumstances.

Name: The Stew Pot
Master_Aurora_Insights:
As the oldest dining establishment in Snowmass Village, this reliable venue has operated from the mall since 1972.
The kitchen focuses on a rotating menu of homemade soups and stews, providing straightforward comfort food in an unpretentious setting.
Regulars favor the signature habanero pork stew or classic beef bowl, served with fresh bread as a post-ski ritual.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Billionaire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1998 by entrepreneur Flavio Briatore, Billionaire is a nightlife and dining destination set within a Mediterranean-style villa in Sardinia's Porto Cervo.
The venue operates as a dual-concept space, transitioning from a live dinner show featuring Italian and Asian cuisine into a late-night club.
Perched on a hillside, the three-floor property features an outdoor terrace that provides panoramic views of the Costa Smeralda coastline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations can be cancelled up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund. Late cancellations and no-shows are non-refundable. Full prepayment is required for dinner show bookings.

Name: One&Only Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Residence & Spa wing of Dubai’s One&Only Royal Mirage, this wellness retreat features the Pedi:Mani:Cure Studio by Bastien Gonzalez.
The interiors reflect a commitment to traditional Arabesque design, utilizing towering arches and geometric symmetry throughout the two-story structure.
A standout experience is the Oriental Hammam ritual, involving a steam bath and vigorous exfoliation performed on a heated marble slab.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you must reschedule or cancel your spa appointment, please notify us at least 24 hours in advance to avoid cancellation charges. A 50% charge of the service reserved will be levied for any treatments cancelled less than 24 hours prior to the appointment. A full charge will incur for all no-show appointments and those cancelled within 12 hours.

Name: The Spa at The Little Nell
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Aspen’s only ski-in/ski-out hotel, this intimate sanctuary was reimagined by Spanish designer Luis Bustamante.
The menu reflects the local "Aspen Idea" philosophy, prioritizing high-altitude remedies and active recovery over simple relaxation.
Guests retreat to one of three suites equipped with private steam showers and hybrid infrared technology for rituals using Seed to Skin Tuscany and ISUN products.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or requests to reschedule must be received no less than 24 hours before your scheduled appointment to avoid a full-price charge for all booked services. In the event you are unwell we will waive the cancellation.

Name: Petit Trois
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Ludo Lefebvre establishes a mountain outpost of his Petit Trois bistro within the MOLLIE hotel.
The menu adheres strictly to Parisian bistro codes, offering consistent execution of classics rather than regional reinterpretations.
Diners order signatures like the gruyère-topped French onion soup and steak frites in a space defined by warm woods and a heated outdoor terrace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For lunch, a $10 per person fee applies to cancellations made within 12 hours of the reservation. For dinner, a $25 per person fee applies to cancellations made within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Fuel Coffee & Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located within the Instinct wellbeing centre, this health-focused outpost pairs specialty coffee with a robust nutritional program. The kitchen delivers a purposeful menu of wholesome, energy-sustaining fare, ranging from protein-rich boxes to seasonal salads served in a bright, contemporary space. A signature post-workout smoothie or the house-roasted espresso serves as the perfect restorative ritual for visitors recharging after a session.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Iris
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Addmind Group, Iris is a large-scale nightlife venue situated at the Meydan Grandstand in Dubai.
The open-air space focuses on electronic music, featuring synchronized light and sound production alongside international DJ sets.
A retractable roof allows the club to adapt to the seasons, while the main terrace provides unobstructed views of the downtown skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Policies regarding changes to Advance Purchase/Non-Refundable reservations may vary. No refunds or credits will be made for any changes, cancellation, or non-arrival for any reason within the period of time specified by the Company at the time of booking. Your credit card will be charged immediately for the total amount indicated in the Payment Link. We may cancel your reservation if invalid credit card information is provided or if credit card is declined.

Name: Cinq Mondes Spa (The Palm)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the LVMH-owned La Samaritaine department store in Paris, Spa Cinq Mondes is a wellness retreat operated by the French skincare brand.
Designed by Suprem Architectures, the space offers therapies rooted in Japanese, Indian, and Chinese medicine.
Each of the seven treatment rooms features a softly backlit wall reminiscent of Art Deco stained glass, providing a backdrop for signature rituals like the traditional Ko Bi Do facial.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You can cancel or postpone your appointment up to 48 hours before the scheduled date by contacting the Spa where you booked. After this time, cancellations or postponements are not accepted. However, if you are ill, you will be able to cancel your appointment at any time as long as you present medical proof.

Name: Prospect
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in San Francisco’s South of Market district, this contemporary American dining room is helmed by the team behind Boulevard, including Chef Nancy Oakes.
The kitchen delivers a seasonally driven menu that balances technical precision with approachable warmth, all set within a sleek space designed by Brand + Allen Architects.
Floor-to-ceiling windows facing Folsom Street illuminate the chocolate-hued interiors, where the Heritage Berkshire pork chop remains a perennial standout.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner reservations are subject to a $25 per person fee for cancellations made within 12 hours of the reservation time or for no-shows. Lunch reservations are subject to a $10 per person fee for cancellations made within 12 hours. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation window.

Name: Secret Room Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within the F.R.N.D.S Grand Café at Address Dubai Mall, this underground speakeasy is the Dubai outpost of a Moscow-born nightlife brand.
The industrial-chic space contrasts raw concrete floors with six-meter walls wrapped in hand-painted Japanese murals, creating a dark, high-energy lair.
Its most theatrical feature is a custom lift that allows guests to drive their supercars directly onto the club’s dancefloor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All deposits are strictly non-refundable. For cancellations please email us at bookings@secret-parties.com with full details of your cancellation so that we can handle it accordingly.

Name: Ling Ling
Master_Aurora_Insights: Ling Ling by Hakkasan is a modern Cantonese restaurant located at the Mandarin Oriental in Marrakech, offering shareable plates and cocktails in a Japanese Izakaya concept. Capacity of 86 persons indoors plus 60 on the terrace, outdoor lounge, bar, resident DJ performances, and views of olive groves and resort pools. Sublime modern Cantonese dishes designed for sharing, innovative cocktails under stars, resident DJ, and international guest artists blending gourmet flavors with high energy beats. Restaurant accommodates 86 persons with a 60 person terrace, privatization available for 80 to 230 persons for birthdays, anniversaries, and work functions. Parent Hakkasan Group's namesake is taken from its Michelin star restaurant, with properties spanning North America, Europe, Middle East, Asia, and Africa.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Holding time for the table is 15 minutes. A cancellation fee of AED 200 per person applies if canceled less than 24 hours in advance. A minimum spend (e.g., AED 2,500–3,000) is required for terrace table bookings. Credit card details are required to secure the reservation.

Name: CÉ LA VI
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 54th floor of the Address Sky View, this Michelin-listed destination is helmed by Executive Chef Howard Ko.
The venue pairs contemporary Asian dishes with a vibrant rooftop atmosphere, offering one of the city’s most coveted vantage points.
A signature swing on the terrace frames the Burj Khalifa, creating a dramatic focal point against the skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made via confirmation email at least 24 hours prior to the reservation to avoid a cancellation fee of SGD $50 per guest. A credit card guarantee is required to secure the booking.

Name: Drift Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the One&Only Royal Mirage, this beachside venue is a project by the Sunset Hospitality Group.
The space is defined by a restrained aesthetic and a kitchen serving Provençal plates with a focus on organic produce.
A central infinity pool provides a clear sightline to the Dubai Marina skyline and the waters of Palm Island Bay.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Spring Café Aspen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Sabrina Rudin in 2013, this organic vegetarian outpost offers a rigorous approach to clean eating in downtown Aspen.
The kitchen strictly avoids inflammatory oils and refined sugars, prioritizing nutrient-dense ingredients meant to sustain days on the slopes.
A light-filled interior frames the experience, where the signature sweet potato gnocchi with romesco sauce remains a perennial favorite.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: Smithsonian American Art Museum
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the Amstel River in Amstelveen, this glass-walled restaurant is a collaboration between Dutch talent and South African chef Margot Janse.
The menu connects two worlds by blending local Dutch ingredients with the spices and cooking methods of the Cape.
A light-filled conservatory setting frames the meal, which features a wine list curated by Koen van der Plas to highlight rare South African vintages.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Joia Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop the Art'otel at Battersea Power Station, this Portuguese dining destination marks the London debut of two-Michelin-starred chef Henrique Sá Pessoa.
Cinematic interiors by Russell Sage Studio wash the space in pastel hues, offering a playful counterpoint to the industrial drama of the landmark chimneys outside.
Order the signature Bomba de Lisboa croquettes on the rooftop terrace for a taste of the Iberian Peninsula against sweeping views of the Thames.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: IYO Kaiseki
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Milan’s Porta Nuova district, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the vision of restaurateur Claudio Liu and chef Katsumi Soga.
It stands as Italy’s only starred kaiseki kitchen, presenting a codified multi-course menu rooted in seasonality within a minimalist, light-filled room.
A standout course features Iberian pork with leeks and sautéed mushrooms, draped in negimiso sauce and served on a hoba magnolia leaf.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Astrance
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the 16th arrondissement premises where Joël Robuchon established his reputation, this modern restaurant is directed by Chef Pascal Barbot and partner Christophe Rohat.
The kitchen presents inventive, product-focused cuisine that integrates Asian flavors and plant-based ingredients with precise French technique.
A signature button mushroom millefeuille layered with foie gras marinated in verjuice serves as a consistent anchor to the changing menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: L'Orangerie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon within the Four Seasons Hotel George V, this two-Michelin-starred venue is led by chef Alan Taudon.
The intimate glass conservatory sits in the Marble Courtyard, serving a menu dedicated entirely to seafood and plant-based cuisine.
Signature dishes like the blue lobster are served beneath the structure’s transparent roof, which offers upward views of the surrounding limestone facade.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Admission tickets are strictly non-refundable and cannot be modified, exchanged, or taken back, except in the event that the service is withdrawn or cancelled by the institution. Tickets are valid only for the specific date and time slot selected at the time of booking.

Name: Ratanà
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a restored 19th-century railway depot within the Porta Nuova district, this Milanese stalwart is helmed by chef Cesare Battisti.
The kitchen delivers a contemporary, sustainable take on Lombard classics, prioritizing ingredients from small local producers over heavy tradition.
Diners flock here specifically for the Risotto alla Vecchia Milano, a saffron-gilded signature finished with gremolata and roast veal jus.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To change or cancel a reservation, call 0287128855 or possibly leave a message on the answering machine.

Name: Vaisseau
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris’s 11th arrondissement, this minimalist destination is the first permanent restaurant from celebrated chef Adrien Cachot.
The unscripted tasting menu showcases technical precision and a penchant for offal through provocative, high-contrast flavor combinations.
A stark, all-black interior directs focus entirely to the open kitchen and playful plates like the signature mochi cacio e pepe.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: IYO
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Claudio Liu in Milan, this Michelin-starred venue blends Japanese and Italian influences under chef Michele Biassoni and sushi master Masaki Okada.
The menu pairs traditional Japanese techniques with European ingredients within a space defined by Maurizio Lai’s geometric, light-filled design.
A standout feature is the open counter serving signature dishes like wagyu gyoza with curry sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Seta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set inside the Mandarin Oriental Milan, this two-Michelin-starred destination is led by executive chef Antonio Guida.
The kitchen blends the chef’s Puglian heritage with global inspirations to create precise, contemporary Italian dishes.
Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the hotel’s second courtyard, providing a backdrop for signature plates like the risotto with raspberries and herb cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance. A credit card is required to secure the reservation, and a fee will be charged for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: À La Renaissance
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Min Wou Choi, formerly of Le Dauphin, this revitalized bistro in the 11th arrondissement was named "Meilleur café de quartier" by Le Fooding in 2026.
The kitchen delivers a modern, seasonal interpretation of French classics, paired with a robust selection of natural wines by the glass.
A sunny outdoor terrace provides a prime vantage point for observing local life, cementing its status as a genuine neighborhood fixture.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Solstice
Master_Aurora_Insights: Solstice is an intimate Michelin-starred restaurant in Paris’ 5th arrondissement, where chef Éric Trochon blends refined French gastronomy with subtle Japanese and Korean influences. With just a handful of seats, the experience feels deeply personal — combining elegant tasting menus, masterful sauces, and thoughtful wine pairings in a minimalist, design-forward setting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To secure your table we require a deposit of £50 per person for all reservations. The deposit per person paid will automatically come off your bill at the end of your meal. For a cancellation within 72 hours of the date and time of arrival, we will keep the whole payment as a cancellation charge. For cancellation outside of 72 hours, we will refund the whole payment (minus a £5 per person administration charge).

Name: Temple et Chapon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the Marais, this neo-brasserie from the Experimental Group features a menu designed by chef Mélanie Serre.
The space channels a 1950s Manhattan chop house with white tablecloths, dimmed lighting, and a focus on premium meats.
A standout dessert is the Paris-New York, a choux pastry ring filled with a rich pecan ganache.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Travellers Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1819 by Lord Castlereagh, this Pall Mall institution occupies a Renaissance-style palazzo designed by Sir Charles Barry.
Long favored by the diplomatic corps, the club enforces a charter requiring members to have travelled at least 500 miles from London.
A unique detail remains on the main staircase, where a special handrail was installed to assist the infirm French ambassador Prince Talleyrand.

Name: Taverna Trastevere
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Milan’s Brera district, this outpost of Roman cuisine is helmed by chef Ivano Paolucci alongside co-owners Nicolas Vaporidis and Alessandro Grappelli.
The space spans two floors and a garden, offering a faithful recreation of a capital-city tavern that prioritizes authenticity over trend-chasing.
A standout menu features traditional pinsa romana and classic carbonara, serving as a robust culinary embassy for Rome within the Lombard capital.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Espadon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Ritz Paris, this Michelin-starred venue is directed by Chef Eugénie Béziat, the first woman to lead the hotel’s signature restaurant.
Her menu disrupts traditional French gastronomy by weaving in the distinct flavors and memories of her childhood in Africa.
Tables face the Grand Jardin while an open kitchen reveals the brigade at work, a modern shift for the storied property.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For table reservations guaranteed via credit card imprint, a fee of €290 per person is charged for cancellations made less than 48 hours prior to the reservation time. For reservations with prepayment, the prepayment is retained if cancelled less than 72 hours prior.

Name: Sushi Yoshinaga
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near the Opéra in Paris, this intimate counter is the domain of chef Tomoyuki Yoshinaga, an alumnus of Okuda and New York’s Yoshino.
The Michelin-starred kitchen executes Edomae traditions with surgical precision, presenting superb rice and outstanding fish within a minimalist setting by Sala Hars and Agathe Marimbert.
A signature sequence features multiple varieties of fatty tuna, seasoned and served piece by piece at the ten-seat counter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card guarantee is required for all reservations. You can modify or cancel your reservation up to 72 hours before your arrival. In the event of a change within 72 hours of your reservation, a penalty of 330 euros per person will be applied, and cannot be cancelled, even in the case of COVID-19. If you're more than 15 minutes late, we won't be able to serve you your entire menu.

Name: Acanto
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Milan's Hotel Principe di Savoia, this restaurant is under the direction of chef Matteo Gabrielli.
The kitchen interprets Lombard traditions through a contemporary lens, prioritizing seasonal ingredients and technical precision.
Floor-to-ceiling windows frame a rare private garden, providing a backdrop for the venue's signature Sunday lunch ritual.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Contraste
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by chef Matias Perdomo, this Michelin-starred Milanese restaurant occupies a historic space reinvented by Debonademeo Studio.
The interior functions as a theatre where full-height velvet curtains in vibrant hues divide four distinct dining rooms inspired by the elements.
Guests enter through a champagne-colored hall featuring a wall sculpture titled 'The Secret' before experiencing a tasting menu that mirrors the venue’s visual contrasts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Derrière
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in the Marais, this apartment-style restaurant is the creation of Mourad and Hakim Mazouz, the brothers behind London’s Sketch.
The venue mimics a bohemian artist’s flat where guests enjoy classic French dishes surrounded by vintage decor and mismatched furniture.
In a playful twist on dining, patrons can enjoy their meals seated at a ping-pong table, on a bed, or even inside a dressing room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: After 15 minutes, we always cancel bookings.

Name: Rubacuori
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in Milan’s Hotel Château Monfort, Rubacuori Restaurant features Executive Chef Domenico Mozzillo’s contemporary Italian cuisine within a space rooted in the city’s Liberty style.
The interior defines the experience through a theatrical, fairy-tale narrative that splits the dining area into three thematically distinct rooms.
The Sala del Rubacuori anchors the design with silver chairs featuring heart-shaped backs and mirrored tables that reflect the chef’s modern take on tradition.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Passerini
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the 12th arrondissement, this modern Italian trattoria is the work of Roman chef Giovanni Passerini, a Le Fooding award winner.
The kitchen elevates traditional recipes into a refined bistronomy experience, focusing on fresh handmade pasta and large, shareable cuts of meat.
A standout offering is the pigeon served two ways, presenting the bird alongside pappardelle tossed in a ragout of its heart and liver.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Il Luogo Aimo e Nadia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by Aimo and Nadia Moroni in Milan’s residential outskirts, this two-Michelin-starred destination is currently led by chefs Alessandro Negrini and Fabio Pisani.
The venue pairs a collection of modern art with a menu that elevates regional Italian produce through precise, unpretentious cooking.
Its defining dish remains the spaghettoni with spring onions and chili, a testament to the kitchen’s ability to perfect humble ingredients.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You can cancel or modify the number of guests by email to reservation@aimoenadia.com without penalty, within 24 hours prior to arrival time. After that time and in case of No-show, a penalty of 160 euros per person will be charged on your credit card.

Name: Le Cinq
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Four Seasons Hotel George V in Paris, this three-Michelin-starred restaurant is led by Chef Christian Le Squer.
The kitchen modernizes French haute cuisine with a technical approach that focuses on distinct flavors and lighter sauces.
A defining dish is the spaghetti timbale, an architectural construction of pasta, ham, and truffles.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of €400 per person applies to cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance. A credit card guarantee is required at the time of booking.

Name: Divellec
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking the Esplanade des Invalides, this legendary seafood institution was revitalized by chef Mathieu Pacaud and the architects at Studio KO.
The dining room evokes a chic 1970s Riviera atmosphere, featuring lush velvet banquettes that soften the venue’s power-dining reputation.
Expect pristine maritime classics, such as gently poached oysters in watercress sauce or whole sole served with exacting precision.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Pur' - Jean-François Rouquette
Master_Aurora_Insights: Housed within the Park Hyatt Paris-Vendôme, this Michelin-starred venue serves as the primary showcase for Chef Jean-François Rouquette. The intimate interior by architect Hugo Toro is arranged around a central open kitchen, allowing a direct view of the culinary team. A long-standing signature is the suckling lamb from the Pyrenees, presented as a roasted rack alongside a stuffed saddle.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: 114 Faubourg
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Le Bristol Paris, this Michelin-starred brasserie operates under the direction of chef Vincent Schmit.
The two-tiered dining room offers a spirited alternative to the hotel’s formal restaurant, defined by its open kitchen, wrought-iron staircase, and vibrant floral wallpaper.
Regulars know to order the signature artichoke soup with black truffle and parmesan emulsion, a dish that anchors the menu of refined French classics.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Qui Plume La Lune
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris’s 11th arrondissement, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the flagship address of chef Jacky Ribault.
The intimate dining room sets a poetic tone with bare stone walls, untreated wood, and hanging branches that reflect a commitment to nature.
One wall bears a line from William Faulkner about running into the moonlight, underscoring the dreamlike atmosphere of the set-menu experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card hold (empreinte bancaire) required. Cancellation fees apply for no-shows or late cancellations. Vouchers are non-refundable if the validity period is exceeded.

Name: Quinsou
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the 6th arrondissement, this Michelin-starred bistro is led by Chef Antonin Bonnet.
The minimalist dining room features cement tiles and bare bulbs, serving as a backdrop for a blind tasting menu driven by daily market availability.
Expect precise, ingredient-led plates such as line-caught bonito with ponzu or a curated cheese course.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Meurice Alain Ducasse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking the Tuileries Garden, this two-Michelin-starred restaurant is led by Alain Ducasse and executive chef Amaury Bouhours.
The kitchen focuses on a "cuisine of the essential," using precise techniques to highlight the pure flavors of sustainable ingredients.
Dining takes place in a grand room modeled on Versailles’ Salon de la Paix and reinterpreted by Philippe Starck, often concluding with Cédric Grolet’s sculpted fruit.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 48 hours prior to the reservation or on the day of the event are non-refundable.

Name: Ristorante Berton
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a glass tower in Milan’s Porta Nuova, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the work of chef Andrea Berton.
The minimalist, light-filled dining room sets a rationalist stage for modern Italian cuisine characterized by precision and clean flavors.
A signature tasting menu focuses entirely on broth, pairing each course with a distinct liquid extraction to enhance the main ingredient.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Yoshinori
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located in the Latin Quarter, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the namesake address of Japanese chef Yoshinori Morié. The intimate dining room pairs exposed stonework with white beams, creating a calm backdrop for French cuisine prepared with Japanese technique. A ballotine of pigeon with porcini, dates, and combava exemplifies the menu's focus on seasonal ingredients and intricate presentation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card imprint required to secure booking. A fee is charged for no-shows or late cancellations (specific terms provided during booking).

Name: Sadler
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored in Milan’s Hotel Casa Baglioni, this Michelin-starred venue is the enduring stage for Chef Claudio Sadler’s precise culinary vision.
The kitchen orchestrates a modern evolution of Italian classics, applying technical rigour to regional recipes while maintaining their soulful identity.
Diners can expect inventive plates like ravioli all'ossobuco, a lighter reinterpretation of the city’s heavy staple, served amidst the building’s preserved Art Nouveau details.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Restaurant H
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Marais, this intimate dining room is led by chef Hubert Duchenne, an alumnus of Akrame and Jean-François Piège.
The kitchen replaces a traditional à la carte structure with technical, market-driven tasting menus that prioritize precision and flavor contrasts.
A signature carte blanche format invites diners to surrender control, with the chef often delivering dishes personally to explain the daily composition.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Trattoria Trippa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Milan’s Porta Romana district, this celebrated trattoria is the creation of chef Diego Rossi and partner Pietro Caroli.
The kitchen elevates humble ingredients and offal into refined plates, serving them in a dining room characterized by retro furnishings and warm yellow tones.
A meal here is incomplete without the signature fried tripe or the tagliatelle al burro e Parmigiano, a deceptively simple dish with a devoted following.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner reservations must be reconfirmed within the last 24 hours or they are subject to cancellation. Reservations are cancelled for delays of more than 15 minutes without notice. Friday lunch reservations require a credit card guarantee; a €50 per person fee applies for no-shows or cancellations after 11:00 AM on the day of the reservation.

Name: Phantom
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the brutalist framework of the Accor Arena, this nightlife venue is a project from the hospitality group Paris Society.
The 1,400-square-meter space functions as a high-capacity club, combining industrial architecture with immersive, avant-garde scenography.
A massive kinetic lighting structure hangs from the ceiling, utilizing articulated mirrors to create a shifting, geometric reflection of the dance floor below.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Prepaid reservation. Minimum 24 hours advanced notice needed.

Name: Guy Savoy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the historic Monnaie de Paris, this culinary institution is the flagship of chef Guy Savoy, with interiors by architect Jean-Michel Wilmotte.
The kitchen executes a modern vision of French fine dining that emphasizes the purity of ingredients within a setting of contemporary art.
A meal here features the signature artichoke and black truffle soup, served alongside a toasted brioche layered with truffle butter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A card imprint or deposit of €300 per person for lunch and €400 per person for dinner is required within 48 hours of booking; otherwise, the reservation is automatically cancelled. Any cancellation must be made no later than 72 hours before the scheduled reservation. Late cancellations (less than 72 hours) or no-shows will incur a penalty of €300 per person for lunch and €400 per person for dinner, charged automatically or retained from the deposit. Reducing the number of guests after the 72-hour deadline may also result in the same per-person penalty.

Name: Ze Kitchen Galerie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef William Ledeuil, this Michelin-starred fixture in Paris blends contemporary art with a distinct French-Asian culinary philosophy.
The kitchen applies rigorous French technique to Southeast Asian ingredients, producing vibrant dishes defined by aromatic broths, bright herbs, and citrus.
Diners sit amidst colorful paintings by jazz musician Daniel Humair while watching the team work through the glass-walled open kitchen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Relais Louis XIII
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the historic walls of the Convent of the Grands-Augustins, this Michelin-starred restaurant is led by Meilleur Ouvrier de France chef Manuel Martinez.
The interior features exposed beams and stone walls, creating a dignified backdrop for uncompromisingly traditional French gastronomy.
Order the signature lobster and foie gras ravioli to experience a rich classic that mirrors the venue’s deep sense of history.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Al Baretto San Marco
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Now situated in Milan’s Brera district, this historic venue maintains the clubby atmosphere that made it a fixture for Milanese society.
The dining room features dark wood paneling and soft lighting, offering a discreet setting for a menu centered on fresh seafood and Italian classics.
Order the signature Saint-Jacques raviolo, which encases a whole scallop in fresh egg pasta, or the lobster linguine finished with a grating of citron.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Datil
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Manon Fleury, this Michelin-starred restaurant in the Marais is the first permanent address for a talent previously known for her residencies.
The kitchen pursues a zero-waste philosophy, prioritizing plant-based compositions where grains and vegetables take precedence over sparingly used animal proteins.
A long, skylit dining room with waxed concrete floors sets the stage for precise dishes often featuring the ancient datil plum.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Gloria Osteria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Big Mamma Group’s first Italian outpost is a glamorous trattoria in Brera led by Neapolitan chef Manuel Prota.
The interior evokes a 1960s "Love Boat" spirit with plush velvet and a high-energy atmosphere, while the kitchen delivers elevated takes on regional classics.
Secure a spot at the Giallo Siena marble bar to sample the standout truffle risotto or a rotating dish from the daily market menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the case of no shows or late cancellations, a fee of €20 per person will be charged to the credit card on file.

Name: L'Escargot Montorgueil
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1832 and frequented by Marcel Proust, this historic institution on Rue Montorgueil is a protected Historic Monument.
The interiors evoke the Second Empire with original Gavarni frescoes, a spiral staircase, and a theatrical ambiance defined by velvet and wood.
Beneath the landmark golden snail sign, the kitchen serves its namesake gastropods in traditional garlic butter or variations like truffle, foie gras, and Espelette pepper.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bridge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated beneath the stone vaults of the Pont Alexandre III, this cavernous nightlife venue is operated by the Paris Society group.
The space contrasts the bridge’s Belle Époque engineering with a wraparound LED installation that immerses the dancefloor in shifting digital landscapes.
Its defining feature is the seamless integration of video mapping on the historic limestone, turning the subterranean archway into a dynamic visual canvas.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before. No refunds within 24 hours of the event start time.

Name: W Verbier
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at the foot of the slopes, this ski-in/ski-out venue at W Verbier is overseen by Michelin-starred chef Sergi Arola.
The kitchen presents a contemporary menu fusing Swiss alpine tradition with Mediterranean flavours, set within an interior of timber and stone.
A winter highlight is the signature rösti with foie gras, a distinct take on a mountain staple served with panoramic slope-side views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Chabichou
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within a white-painted wooden chalet in Courchevel 1850, this two-Michelin-starred venue is the domain of Chef Stéphane Buron.
His menu reflects the precision of a Meilleur Ouvrier de France, focusing on noble ingredients and complex sauces without theatrical excess.
A standout feature is the winter "Gourmet Barbecue" on the terrace, a daily ritual serving grilled specialties directly on the slopes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: AVA
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Brought to Winter Park by the Riviera Dining Group, Ava MediterrAegean is a transportive sanctuary dedicated to the flavors and culture of the Cyclades.
The interiors evoke a Mykonos escape with whitewashed plaster, natural stone, and linen accents, setting the stage for a spirited, communal dining atmosphere.
A hidden door reveals the venue’s best-kept secret, an exclusive members-only lounge designed for intimate late-night cocktails and DJ-led energy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You will have until 6 hours before your reservation to cancel. All late cancellations or no-shows will be charged a fee of $25 per person.

Name: Dorta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the historic core of Zuoz, this venue occupies one of the Engadin valley’s oldest farmhouses, with structural roots dating back to the eleventh century.
The interior features original timber walls and low ceilings, serving as a backdrop for traditional Engadin specialties and wild game.
Diners should order the signature Zuozer Heusuppe, a creamy soup steeped with local hay that captures the distinct flavor of the surrounding meadows.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Beefbar Courchevel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within Hotel L'Apogée Courchevel, this alpine outpost of Riccardo Giraudi’s global steakhouse collection features interiors by renowned designer Kelly Wearstler.
The kitchen reimagines the traditional meat-centric dining experience by blending rare cuts with street food influences in a sophisticated setting.
A menu highlight is the signature Croque Sando, served alongside comfort-focused plates like Wagyu pappardelle and truffle mashed potatoes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellation or no-shows.

Name: La Cordée
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in Verbier’s Hotel Cordée des Alpes, this chic brasserie presents a bistronomic vision led by Chef Eric Maurel.
The interior merges alpine timber with modern lines, centering on an open kitchen where the brigade transforms local Valaisan ingredients into refined, globally inspired plates.
Upholding the rigorous "Fait Maison" label, the team crafts every element from scratch, a transparent process that serves as the room’s central piece of theatre.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Beefbar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the Grace La Margna St Moritz, this dining destination by Riccardo Giraudi introduces his global steakhouse concept to the Swiss Alps.
The space pairs a sleek Alpine aesthetic with a vibrant atmosphere, featuring resident DJs and a menu that reimagines traditional meat-centric dining.
Guests enjoy premium charcoal-grilled cuts and signature street food served on custom Bernardaud porcelain, accompanied by a curated wine list.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please allow for 24-hour notice if you wish to change or cancel a booking, otherwise the following charges will apply: 100% of the booking fee for non-shows, or cancellations made within 12 hours prior. We will hold your reservation for a maximum of 20 minutes from your confirmed reservation start time.

Name: Romantik Hotel Die Krone von Lech
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Based in the Austrian village of Hittisau, this historic inn was reimagined by architect Dietmar Eberle as a study in alpine modernism.
The design balances 19th-century heritage with contemporary minimalism, showcasing interiors clad in local silver fir and craftsmanship from the Werkraum Bregenzerwald.
Guests gather in the original pine-panelled Stube for regional specialties, grounding the modern aesthetic in local culinary tradition.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation fees apply from the point of reservation. In the event of a cancellation up to 30 days prior to the arrival date, 30% of the room rate will be charged, up to 14 days prior to the arrival date, 50% will be charged, up to 7 days prior to the arrival date, 70% will be charged, and during the last week and on early departure, 100% of the entire day or package price will be charged. In the event that the room can be rented out until 30 days prior to the arrival date, no cancellation fee will be charged. It is not possible to change packages during the course of your stay or to request a refund for any hotel services not used or meals not consumed. The terms and conditions of the Austrian Hotel Industry apply (ÖHVB).

Name: Kulm Country Club by Mauro Colagreco
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a pavilion renovated by Lord Norman Foster at the Kulm Hotel in St. Moritz, this restaurant is led by chef Mauro Colagreco.
The kitchen focuses on open-fire cooking, using charcoal and embers to prepare Alpine ingredients with distinct Argentine influence.
A standout feature is the regular vinyl music sessions that accompany the flame-kissed dishes in the warm, wood-lined dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In some of our restaurants, we apply a no-show fee: The amount of the fee will be communicated at the time of reservation and will be charged if the guest fails to show up for the booked reservation without notifying the hotel at least 24 hours prior to the reservation time. The no-show fee will be charged to the credit card provided by the guest at the time of booking. The hotel will hold the reserved table for up to 15 minutes after the confirmed reservation time.

Name: Ecco
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Champfèr, this two-Michelin-starred restaurant within the Giardino Mountain hotel is led by executive chef Reto Brändli.
The kitchen focuses on aroma cuisine, a culinary style that extracts maximum flavor from seasonal ingredients to create light yet intense compositions.
Dining takes place in a refined space designed by Carlo Rampazzi, where the tasting menu serves as a precise study in seasonal textures.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of changes or cancellations (up to five people), please notify us at least 24 hours in advance. For groups of six people or more, we require 48 hours’ notice. Please note that we reserve the right to charge CHF 300 per person for no-shows.

Name: Reif Kushiyaki
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Singaporean chef Reif Othman, this Dubai destination reimagines Japanese street food in a stripped-back, contemporary setting.
The kitchen prioritizes kushiyaki grilled over robata alongside inventive plates that blend premium ingredients with a playful, high-low philosophy.
Diners gather at the open counter for the signature wagyu katsu sando, served with a house-made tonkatsu sauce and toasted milk bread.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Dar Wasl: We request that you notify us at least 24 hours prior to your reservation time of any rescheduling. Failing which, your payment will be non-refundable. All deposits are non-refundable. You are welcome to postpone your reservation for up to 30 days from the original booking date. For parties of 6 and above, a full and non-refundable deposit of AED 200 per person will be taken at the time of booking.

Dubai Hills: Two (2) hours advance notice is required should you wish to cancel or change your reservations. We can only hold your table for a maximum of 15 minutes. For parties of 6-9 people, a deposit of AED 100 per person will be required. For parties of 10 and above, a deposit of 50% of the group menu or minimum spend (AED 388 per person) will be taken.

Name: La Coupole Matsuhisa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Badrutt’s Palace Hotel in St. Moritz, this destination presents the Japanese-Peruvian cuisine of chef Nobuyuki Matsuhisa.
The dining room occupies a former indoor tennis arena, defined by a steel-and-glass dome that serves as the space's architectural centerpiece.
An open sushi bar anchors the floor plan, delivering signatures like black cod miso and yellowtail jalapeño beneath the transparent canopy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of a no-show at any restaurant operated by Badrutt’s Palace Hotel (i.e., the guest does not arrive for the booked reservation without prior notification to the hotel 24 hours before the reservation time), a fee of CHF 50.- (“no-show fee”) per person will be charged. The no-show fee will be charged to the guest’s credit card provided at the time of reservation.

Name: Da Vittorio St. Moritz
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the Carlton Hotel, this two-Michelin-starred outpost from the Cerea family brings the culinary heritage of their Lombardy estate to the Swiss Alps.
The kitchen serves elevated Italian classics and fresh seafood, maintaining the exacting standards and warm atmosphere of the original Brusaporto location.
A meal here is incomplete without the signature paccheri alla Vittorio, a rich tomato pasta dish that exemplifies the restaurant’s dedication to essential flavors.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: King's Social House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the legendary Badrutt’s Palace in St. Moritz, this dining and nightlife venue is helmed by Michelin-starred chef Jason Atherton.
The space reimagines Switzerland’s oldest nightclub as a hybrid destination where modern bistro dining transitions seamlessly into late-night DJ sets.
The interior is defined by show-stopping murals from Swiss street artists Bane + Pest, creating an edgy urban backdrop to the alpine glamour.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of a no-show or cancellation without prior notification at least 24 hours before the reservation time, a fee of CHF 50 per person will be charged to the credit card provided at the time of booking.

Name: Le Relais
Master_Aurora_Insights: Bistro Le Relais is a fine dining French restaurant at 2817 Taylorsville Road in Louisville, Kentucky, located inside the historic 1920s Bowman Field airport terminal with Art Deco interiors. Features outdoor deck overlooking Bowman Field runway, 1940s Art Deco ambiance reminiscent of Casablanca, live jazz on Sundays, and private event space called The Lobby. Chef Alexander Dulaney serves classic French cuisine including escargots de Bourgogne, boeuf bourguignon, bouillabaisse, duck confit, trout meunière, and Grand Marnier soufflé with crème anglaise. Open Wednesday through Sunday for dinner from 5:00 to 10:00 pm, closed Monday and Tuesday, plus lunch last Friday monthly from 11:00 am to 1:00 pm.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Paradiso Mountain Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Badrutt’s Palace, this St. Moritz destination functions as both a high-altitude restaurant and a spirited mountain club.
The venue combines rustic timber interiors with a lively Music Deck, where guests enjoy Alpine comfort food against a backdrop of urban beats.
Distinctive touches include staff uniformed by French skiwear brand Fusalp and a members-only Gucci Paradiso lounge designed for quiet relaxation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Paradiso charges a fee of CHF 50 per guest in case of no-show for confirmed bookings. This fee will be pre-authorized on your credit card and released upon your visit to Paradiso. In case of cancellation without notice or within 24 hours of the reservation, a fee of CHF 50 will be charged to your credit card.

Name: Avatara
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Dubai Hills Estate, this Michelin-starred vegetarian enclave is the work of Passion F&B and executive chef Rahul Rana.
The kitchen redefines Indian cuisine through a sattvic philosophy, eschewing onion and garlic to present pure, ingredient-driven dishes with a modern edge.
Interiors feature a dramatic, altar-like communal table where the sixteen-course degustation includes the signature Naivedhya, a holy offering that anchors the culinary narrative.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To confirm your reservation, you will be requested to make an advance payment. A 100% advance deposit is required for bookings of 5 or more calculated at AED 750 per person. For all bookings, you must notify us of a cancellation or any changes to the number of guests at least 24 hours before your booking. Bookings canceled up to 24 hours in advance and secured with a deposit will be granted a 50% refund on the deposit. Bookings secured by an advance deposit will be held for 30 mins after the booking time if nobody shows it will be released with no refund.

Name: HIDE+SEEK
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hide & Seek Resort is an intimate, Aussie-owned sanctuary set on an organic farm near the world-class surf breaks of Popoyo, Nicaragua.
The destination defines itself through eco-conscious minimalism, offering a handful of solar-powered villas that blend sleek design with the region’s rugged natural beauty.
Guests gather at the on-site Oasis restaurant, where daily menus showcase ingredients harvested directly from the hotel’s own organic gardens.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We have a 10-minute grace period. If a deposit is required, it will be applied to your final bill. Should your party size decrease without notice, that portion of your deposit may be forfeited. Private Dining Room reservations incur a $10 per person non-refundable deposit.

Name: Nobu Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the bridge suite at Atlantis, The Palm, this flagship location features interiors by the Rockwell Group and the culinary direction of Chef Nobu Matsuhisa.
The kitchen serves established Japanese-Peruvian cuisine, creating a distinct dining atmosphere suspended above the Palm Jumeirah.
Guests can order the signature miso-marinated black cod while taking in expansive views of the Arabian Gulf from the twenty-second floor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to secure reservations. Cancellations are accepted until the day prior to your reservation. Same-day cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of $50 per person.

Name: Sylvestre Wahid
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed inside the Hôtel Les Grandes Alpes in Courchevel 1850, this restaurant serves as the alpine stage for two-Michelin-starred chef Sylvestre Wahid.
The dining room contains only four tables and an open kitchen, offering a tasting menu that connects the Mediterranean Alpilles with the snowy Alps.
Guests experience signature dishes like the Roscoff crab in a setting designed to resemble a private residence rather than a traditional dining hall.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Table
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In Paris’s 12th arrondissement, this two-Michelin-starred restaurant is the creation of former food critic turned self-taught chef Bruno Verjus.
The dining room features a long, curved counter where guests observe the immediate preparation of ingredients sourced from small-scale producers.
A standout detail is the signature chocolate tart with caviar, a pairing that highlights the kitchen’s bold, product-first philosophy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservation guaranteed by credit card - cancellation and modification free of charge until 3:00 pm the day before the arrival date.

Name: Beefbar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Monaco by restaurateur Riccardo Giraudi, Beefbar is an international dining concept rooted in the global meat trade.
The restaurant sources cuts of American Black Angus, Australian Wagyu, and certified Kobe beef, serving them in spaces frequently designed by architectural studio Humbert & Poyet.
Its menu is divided into Leaf, Reef, and Beef sections, featuring signature items like steak frites with a house-made creamy truffle sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please allow for 24-hour notice if you wish to change or cancel a booking, otherwise the following charges will apply: 100% of the booking fee for non-shows, or cancellations made within 12 hours prior.

Name: Sisley Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Pointe Milou, this World Spa Award winner is a partnership between Hotel Christopher and French beauty house Sisley Paris.
The open-air design embraces the surroundings, with treatment rooms facing the Caribbean Sea so the sound of waves soundtracks every session.
Each of the five cabins includes a private terrace and outdoor shower, creating a secluded setting for the brand's signature Phyto-Aromatic rituals.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or rescheduling requests must be made at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a penalty. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the appointment will incur a charge of 100% of the treatment price.

Name: One&Only Spa at One&Only Royal Mirage
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by DSA Architects International with the intricate arches of traditional Arabian architecture, this spa sits within Dubai’s One&Only Royal Mirage.
The facility centers on a dedicated Oriental Hammam, featuring heated marble slabs, steam rooms, and plunge pools modeled after Moroccan bathhouses.
A distinct feature is the Pedi:Mani:Cure Studio by Bastien Gonzalez, a signature treatment room focusing on the medical well-being of the nail.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancelation of treatments less than 6 hours in advance and no show will be charged 100%.

Name: Secret Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden behind F.R.N.D.S Grand Café in Downtown Dubai, this speakeasy-style club is an import of the renowned Moscow nightlife brand.
The subterranean interior features six-meter ceilings and walls adorned with hand-painted murals referencing Japanese Yakuza culture.
In a display of engineering and status, the venue allows privileged guests to drive their supercars directly into the center of the room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For cancellations please email us at bookings@secret-parties.com with full details of your cancellation so that we can handle it accordingly. Please be aware that ALL DEPOSITS made via the Secret Parties website are strictly non-refundable.

Name: The Spa at The Little Nell
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within The Little Nell, this intimate wellness retreat features a recent redesign by interior designer Luis Bustamante.
The programming prioritizes recovery and structural health, offering advanced protocols in partnership with skincare expert Dr. Barbara Sturm.
There are only three treatment suites, each fitted with a private steam shower and changing room to allow for an entirely self-contained visit.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or requests to reschedule must be received no less than 24 hours before your scheduled appointment to avoid a full-price charge for all booked services. In the event you are unwell we will waive the cancellation.

Name: Fuel Coffee & Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originally established as the retail offshoot of the Great Barrington Coffee Roasting Company, this Main Street destination is now directed by owners Elan and Lydia Merkel.
The bustling bistro and bakery pairs small-batch roasts with a scratch-made menu that transcends typical coffee shop fare.
Regulars swear by the signature McGuido breakfast sandwich, a hearty local favorite served alongside house-baked pastries and robust espresso drinks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: AWAKEN Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the KPF-designed Atlantis The Royal, this wellness destination features interiors by GA Group and recognition from the Forbes Travel Guide.
The facility anchors its holistic approach in a hydrotherapy circuit featuring a charcoal sauna and halotherapy salt room.
A standout feature is the Hammam Sensorium, where traditional purification rituals incorporate modern sound and light therapy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or rescheduling within 4 hours of the appointment time will incur a 100% charge.

Name: Ula
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the white sands of Palm West Beach, this Mediterranean-inspired venue is the work of Solutions Leisure Group and Broadway Interiors.
The space channels a grounded, organic aesthetic with natural stone, rattan furniture, and an open kitchen that blends a beachside lounge with a relaxed dining atmosphere.
A sprawling tree anchors the central curved bar, serving as a focal point for a menu featuring clay-pot slow-roasted lamb and fresh seafood.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our Ristorante requires a credit card to reserve. Cancellations will result in a per person charge of $50. Cancellation policy will also apply to cancellations due to COVID 19 and all health or travel related circumstances.

Name: CLAP
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in DIFC Gate Village, this contemporary Japanese destination is operated by the Addmind group and led by culinary director Renald Epie.
The space combines a main dining room with a rooftop terrace and Ongaku, a separate music lounge hidden behind a discreet entrance.
Interiors are defined by eclectic touches, most notably a central chandelier crafted from over 2,000 vintage toys and anime figures.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For individual reservations a charge of €50 per person will apply in case of no-show or cancellation within 24 hours of the reservation. All reservations require card details.

Name: Ling Ling
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created by the Hakkasan team, this izakaya-style concept adapts the brand's Cantonese cuisine into a lounge format with locations in Mexico City and Marrakesh.
The venue prioritizes a social atmosphere, pairing small, shareable plates and craft cocktails with a soundtrack of curated electronic music.
A defining feature is the progression from dinner to dancing, supported by architectural elements like open-air terraces and sweeping views of the surrounding landscape.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of no-show, a charge of $250 MXN per person will apply. Multiple reservations or joining tables are not permitted. A grace period of 15 minutes is allowed.

Name: CÉ LA VI
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop the Address Sky View, this venue is helmed by Executive Chef Howard Ko, bringing the global CÉ LA VI brand to Downtown Dubai.
The space combines a restaurant, sky bar, and club lounge, serving Modern Asian cuisine against a panoramic backdrop of the city skyline.
Signature plates include wagyu beef tartare with marinated salmon roe, served alongside a terrace swing that frames the Burj Khalifa.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details are used to secure your reservation and you will not be charged at the time of making this booking. A cancellation/no-show fee of SGD $50.00 per guest applies if the reservation is not canceled at least 24 hours in advance. Cancellations must be made via the confirmation email. To cancel, click the ‘Cancel Reservation’ button in your confirmation email. We reserve the right to adjust the cancellation grace period for festive periods or special occasions.

Name: Saké Restaurant & Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the heritage-listed Argyle Stores in Sydney’s The Rocks, this award-winning venue is the flagship of Hunter St. Hospitality.
The kitchen delivers a high-octane interpretation of contemporary Japanese cuisine, blending sustainable local seafood with bold, fusion flavours.
A theatrical finale is guaranteed with the signature Dragon Egg, a chocolate sphere that melts under hot caramel to reveal a core of mousse and crumble.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: During peak service times, we kindly ask for a credit card to be placed on file when booking, helping us minimise last-minute cancellations and no-shows. If a booking is cancelled late or guests do not attend, a fee of $50 per person may apply. For small groups, we request at least 4 hours’ notice to avoid this charge. For groups of 8 or more, we require a minimum of 24 hours’ notice. Please note that separate cancellation terms apply to private room bookings, which will be shared at the time of reservation.

Name: The Edge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Jason DeBacker, this Snowmass Village restaurant brings authentic German and Alpine cuisine to the Colorado mountains.
The space provides a warm setting for après-ski gatherings, emphasizing traditional European flavors and communal dining with mountain views.
A standout detail is the classic cheese fondue, served alongside house-made wurst and crispy pork wienerschnitzel.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations within 48 hours incur a $50/person fee.

Name: 1 OAK
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the JW Marriott Marquis, this outpost of the New York-born nightlife brand is a collaboration between founder Richie Akiva and the Bulldozer Group.
The venue channels Manhattan cool through a moody aesthetic defined by a marble bar, tufted leather seating, and an intimate layout.
A signature art collection by Roy Nachum anchors the room, while floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of the Dubai Water Canal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nammos London
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Joyce Wang Studio, Nammos London is a two-storey Mayfair restaurant and the first urban outpost of the Mykonian hospitality group.
The venue translates its Aegean roots into a Mediterranean menu, offering an all-day dining format that transitions into evening gatherings.
The ground-floor dining room features a muted palette of terracotta and stone, complementing signature dishes like Greek lobster and shrimp linguine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We operate with a 24-hour cancellation policy. For late cancellations or no-shows, a penalty of €50,00 per person applies to the card provided at the time of booking.

Name: Ushuaïa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A collaboration between The Night League and Studio A by Addmind Hospitality, this open-air venue brings the Ibiza nightlife brand to Dubai Harbour.
The seasonal winter residency translates the original’s kinetic energy into a sunset-to-late offering defined by stadium-grade production and top-tier electronic music acts.
Crowds gather under the signature stage lighting for immersive audiovisual shows framed by panoramic views of the city skyline and marina.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may move the booking to another event (subject to availability) or request a refund up to 24 hours before the event, except for Opening & Closing parties or other special events which require 72 hours notice.

Name: Catch Steak
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Brought to the Rockies by Catch Hospitality Group, this energetic outpost reinterprets the classic steakhouse near the base of Aspen Mountain.
The sleek, multi-level venue balances a polished atmosphere with a lively rooftop terrace offering sweeping alpine views.
Diners can order a flight of rare Japanese Wagyu before finishing with the signature Snickers Baked Alaska.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Free cancellation before 24 hours of your reservation. After that, cancelling this reservation may trigger a fee of $50.00 per guest.

Name: Prospect
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the ground floor of the Infinity Towers, this San Francisco restaurant is led by the team behind Boulevard, including James Beard Award-winning Chef Nancy Oakes.
The lofty, glass-walled dining room by Brand + Allen Architects balances urban polish with a warm, hospitality-driven atmosphere.
Regulars return for the signature Eden Valley Berkshire pork chop, a standout dish on the seasonally evolving menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Petit Trois
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Ludo Lefebvre brings his Los Angeles–based Petit Trois concept to the boutique MOLLIE Aspen hotel.
This all-day bistro presents traditional French cuisine in a space featuring a year-round heated outdoor terrace.
Diners can expect faithful renditions of onion soup and steak frites alongside a curated selection of French wines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner reservations require 12 hours' notice of cancellation to avoid a fee of $25 per person. Lunch reservations require 12 hours' notice to avoid a fee of $10 per person. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation window. No-shows are subject to the same fees. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: 7 Tales
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Japanese-inspired speakeasy on the 44th floor of Grosvenor House is a nightlife venue from chef Jason Atherton.
The interior evokes 1960s Tokyo with graffiti-covered walls by artist Gary Yong and a soundtrack of hip-hop and funk.
A signature Negroni Game invites guests to roll a custom die to win a complimentary cocktail from the dedicated menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Billionaire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by former Formula One boss Flavio Briatore, this high-energy venue occupies the 61st floor of the Mandarin Oriental Downtown.
The "dinner show" concept pairs a dual menu of modern Italian and Japanese cuisine with live performances by acrobats, dancers, and singers.
Celebrity Chef Batuhan Piatti oversees the kitchen, where guests dine on signature dishes like salt-crusted sea bass or wagyu beef while suspended above the city skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings can be cancelled up to 24 hours before the reservation time. The price for no-shows and late cancellations is non-refundable.

Name: Drift Beach Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the One&Only Royal Mirage and managed by Sunset Hospitality Group, this beachfront destination features refined architecture by Michael Dawson.
The airy, open-plan space channels the Riviera with soft blues and whites, prioritizing Provençal cuisine over loud parties.
Guests lounge by the infinity pool facing the Palm Jumeirah skyline before dining on signature dishes like the whole poached lobster.

Name: Casa Tua
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Miky and Leticia Grendene with interiors by architect Michele Bönan, this Northern Italian outpost operates as both a restaurant and private club.
The chalet-style space features walls clad in natural bark-edged siding and structural aspen trunks that support the roof.
A twenty-one-foot, 200-year-old chef's table anchors the dining room, serving as a communal focal point for the kitchen’s classic menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We offer a 15-minute grace period for all reservations. If you arrive beyond this grace period, we will accommodate you if possible, but this is at the discretion of the restaurant. Reservations are subject to cancellations and no-shows. A credit card is required to secure reservations, and a fee may be charged for no-shows or late cancellations. Reservations are released 21 days in advance.
