Name: Rules
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Thomas Rule in 1798, London’s oldest restaurant has hosted figures from Charles Dickens to Edward VII in Covent Garden.
The menu champions traditional British cookery with a focus on game and oysters served in an Edwardian dining room lined with sketches.
The kitchen sources much of its venison, grouse, and pheasant directly from the restaurant’s own Lartington Estate.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Amaya
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by the renowned architect Bijoy Jain of Studio Mumbai, this sustainable retreat is located in the Himalayan foothills of Kasauli.
The property comprises minimalist villas built from local lime and slate that disappear into twenty acres of terraced pine forest.
Uniquely, each residence includes a private study or artist studio designed to foster creative contemplation within the quiet mountain landscape.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Your card will not be charged providing you cancel or reduce numbers at least 12 hours prior to your reservation using the “cancel” or “manage” reservation buttons in the reservation confirmation email. A cancellation fee of £30 per person will be charged if this does not occur.

Name: Sidney Street Cafe
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a century-old storefront in the Benton Park neighborhood of St. Louis, Sidney Street Cafe is a New American restaurant led by James Beard Award-winning chef Kevin Nashan.
The restaurant pairs an exposed brick and wood dining room with a menu grounded in French culinary techniques.
Signature dishes include lobster turnovers and veal dumplings.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Wahaca
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Co-founded by MasterChef winner Thomasina Miers, this UK-based group translates the bustle of Oaxacan markets into a colourful, eco-conscious dining format.
The kitchen prioritizes sustainability through a climate-conscious menu that champions regenerative produce and seasonal British ingredients over industrial imports.
Diners can navigate the offering via industry-leading carbon footprint labels, often steering choices toward the signature slow-cooked pork pibil tacos.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Duchess Theatre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Catherine Street, this Grade II listed venue was designed by architect Ewen Barr and is now operated by Nimax Theatres.
It stands as one of the West End’s smallest proscenium arch playhouses, with stalls sunk below street level to respect ancient light rights.
The intimate auditorium retains its original 1930s character, featuring a double-height ceiling and decorative bronze reliefs by Maurice Lambert.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets cannot be exchanged or refunded. In the event of a performance being cancelled, where possible and subject to availability, you will be offered alternative performances up to the seat value on the ticket. If we are unable to offer you an alternative performance, a refund will be offered. Tickets may be returned to the Theatre’s Box Office for resale up to 24 hours before the Performance; returns are only placed on sale after all other Tickets for that Performance have been sold.

Name: Ishbilia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Knightsbridge institution has remained a family-run benchmark for Lebanese cuisine in London since 1998.
The unpretentious dining room offers a quiet respite from the neighbourhood's flash, serving a rigorous selection of cold mezze and charcoal-grilled meats.
Meals begin with flatbread delivered hot from the oven and should end with the signature cheese knafeh.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ladurée
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1862 by Louis Ernest Ladurée, this Parisian house began as a bakery on Rue Royale before becoming a refined pastry shop and tea room.
Pierre Desfontaines is credited with inventing the modern macaron here by sandwiching ganache between two almond meringue shells.
The interiors are defined by a signature celadon green and elaborate frescoes inspired by the Sistine Chapel and painted by Jules Chéret.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Afternoon Tea bookings can be cancelled and refunded 48 hours before sitting time. A €10 cancellation fee will apply within this 48 hour window.

Name: Henri
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in Covent Garden’s Henrietta Experimental, this lively bistro is a collaboration between the Experimental Group and chef Jackson Boxer.
Designed by Dorothée Meilichzon, the interior features wood panelling and soft blue tones, setting the stage for a menu that playfully reinterprets French staples.
For a decadent ritual, order the "snack pack," which pairs duck-fat fries and N25 caviar with a cold martini.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Clos Maggiore
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Covent Garden, this modern European restaurant is led by Executive Chef Kim Woodward and holds a Wine Spectator Grand Award.
The interior evokes a Provençal courtyard, centering on a conservatory where a retractable glass roof and fireplace create a year-round sanctuary.
A dense canopy of white blossoms and fairy lights covers the dining room, framing seasonal plates and an extensive wine list.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We operate a strict 48 hrs cancellation policy. Cancellations made within this period will incur a charge of £40 per person to the card provided at the time of booking. No credit or refund will be provided.

Name: The Petersham Restaurant
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Head chef Sergio Martins Abreu oversees this Richmond destination, located within The Petersham Hotel and positioned directly above the River Thames.
The kitchen delivers modern British cooking in a formal space defined by floor-to-ceiling windows that maximize the light and scenery.
Afternoon tea is a standout ritual here, offering a chance to observe the river bending past the Petersham Meadows from a panoramic vantage point.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Joe's Stone Crab
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Joe's Stone Crab is an American seafood restaurant at 11 Washington Avenue in Miami Beach, Florida, established in 1913 before Miami Beach was even a city.
Joe's won the 1998 James Beard America's Classic Award, serves fried chicken and fried oysters, and offers key lime pie and brownie sundaes for dessert.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations less than 24 hours or no-shows will be charged $25 per person.

Name: Zizzi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in Chiswick by the Kaye brothers and now operated by the Azzurri Group, this network of Italian restaurants maintains a steady presence across the UK.
The interiors eschew a standardized look in favor of individually commissioned murals and design features relevant to the local neighborhood.
A central stone oven anchors the open kitchen, turning out the trademark Rustica pizzas that are stretched long for a crispier texture.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To cancel, go to zizzi.co.uk/cancel or call the restaurant directly. Tables are held for 10 minutes before potentially being released. For peak times, large groups, or seasonal occasions, a credit card pre-authorisation of £5 per guest may be required; this amount is charged only if you fail to show up or cancel within 24 hours of the booking.

Name: Matsuri
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the Mandarin Oriental, Santiago, this polished venue presents high-end Nikkei cuisine crafted by chef Juan Ozaki.
The dining room combines contemporary design with a serene backdrop, looking out over the hotel’s expansive gardens and pool.
Signature dishes include delicate usuzukuri, while the teppanyaki counter offers a front-row seat to the chef's precise technique.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If we are unable to contact you within 15 minutes of your reservation time, we may be forced to cancel your reservation, so please be sure to contact us if you are going to be late. Credit card required to reserve.

Name: PizzaExpress Jazz Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by jazz lover Peter Boizot in 1976, this Soho basement venue has hosted stars from Amy Winehouse to Norah Jones.
The intimate, low-ceilinged room prioritizes acoustics and proximity, creating a direct connection between artist and audience rarely found in larger halls.
A glossy black Steinway B grand piano anchors the stage, a permanent fixture in a space where diners enjoy live sets alongside signature pizzas.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you cancel your booking more than 48 hours prior to the advertised start time of the show, you will be refunded in full. If you cancel less than 48 hours prior to the advertised start time, you will not be entitled to receive a refund.

Name: Cora Pearl
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a historic Covent Garden townhouse, this intimate spot is the sister site to Mayfair’s Kitty Fisher’s, named after a notorious 19th-century courtesan.
The kitchen delivers elevated British comfort food with Parisian flair, serving indulgent dishes in a space defined by emerald tiles and velvet banquettes.
A standout order is the pig jowl and Montgomery cheddar toastie, a signature plate that complements the room’s clubby atmosphere.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Orso
Master_Aurora_Insights: This Theater District staple is the more culinary-minded sibling of Joe Allen, serving as a discreet haven for Broadway cast and crew. The intimate, narrow dining room offers a consistent menu of rustic Northern Italian dishes in an atmosphere defined by quiet conversation rather than scene-making. Service is presented on signature hand-painted pottery, which complements the warm glow reflecting off the room's distinctive pink marble floor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To secure your booking we require some credit card details to hold a pre-authorisation payment of $50 per person. This is a booking guarantee. No monies will be deducted from the card provided unless the booking is cancelled last minute, does not turn up, or arrives with significantly lower numbers than the confirmed booking.

Name: Boulevard Theatre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originally commissioned by Fawn James and designed by SODA Studio, this Soho venue is now operated by live entertainment company Underbelly.
The intimate space is defined by its architectural adaptability, hosting a varied programme of cabaret, comedy, and theatre within a contemporary interior.
Its standout feature is a cylindrical, revolving auditorium that can shift configurations at the touch of a button to suit any performance.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets cannot be cancelled, or money refunded but tickets may be exchanged at the discretion of the box office. Tickets may only be exchanged to a future date of the same performance; it is not possible to exchange for a different event. If there is no future performances, then in Underbelly’s sole discretion, we may offer a credit note for future Underbelly shows. An exchange cannot be issued if the original tickets are for a past date. All exchanges must be confirmed no later than 48 hours before the original date. An exchange is only confirmed once you receive an email confirmation for the new date.

Name: Vaudeville Theatre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the Strand, this historic West End venue was originally designed by prolific theatre architect C.J. Phipps, with current interiors by Robert Atkinson.
The intimate, 690-seat auditorium is defined by its Adamesque decor and excellent sightlines, fostering an unusually close connection between performer and audience.
High in the fly floor, a rare set of Victorian thunder drums and lightning sheets remains installed, preserving the acoustic mechanics of 19th-century stagecraft.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets are non-refundable unless the performance is cancelled or materially changed. Exchanges are possible up to 48 hours before the performance subject to availability. Tickets can be returned for resale up to 24 hours prior, but are only sold after all other tickets.

Name: Glenmere Mansion
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by architects Carrère and Hastings in 1911, Glenmere Mansion is a 15-room Relais & Châteaux hotel set on 150 acres in the Hudson Valley.
Built as a Tuscan-style villa, the Gilded Age estate features a private modern art collection, formal gardens, and two dining venues.
Guests can experience a Hammam ritual in the spa or gather in the central open cortile framed by marble-columned porticoes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: At the time of booking, a full non-refundable payment of the entire stay is required. If a guest needs to change the reservation dates for any reason, they will have up to 48 hours prior to check-in time to postpone the overnight accommodations and the credit will be honored up to one year from the original reservation date.

Name: Grand Hotel a Villa Feltrinelli
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on the western shore of Lake Garda in Gargnano, Grand Hotel a Villa Feltrinelli is a 19th-century residence featuring a two-Michelin-starred restaurant helmed by chef Stefano Baiocco.
The historic estate operates as a 20-room retreat defined by its castle-like facade and restored antique furnishings.
Inside the property, guests find heated marble floors, while the surrounding grounds include a dedicated greenhouse that supplies the kitchen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To secure a reservation, a deposit of 50% of the full stay is required at the time of booking. Reservations must be cancelled 45 days prior to arrival to avoid a penalty charge of 100% of the full stay.

Name: Blackberry Farm
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in the Great Smoky Mountains of East Tennessee, Blackberry Farm is a Relais & Châteaux resort owned by the Beall family.
The 4,200-acre property operates as a working farm and culinary destination that has earned three James Beard Foundation Awards.
Dining centers on the estate's signature Foothills Cuisine, an approach to Appalachian food traditions utilizing ingredients from the on-site creamery, preservation kitchen, and gardens.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Due to our size, cancellations affect us significantly; therefore, we adhere to a strict cancellation policy. Cancellations made at least 30 days prior to arrival will result in a refund of the deposit minus a $100.00 nonrefundable administration fee. If your reservation is cancelled between 29 – 15 days of arrival, we will gladly move your full deposit to new dates from one year of your original arrival date, based on availability. If your reservation is cancelled inside 15 days of arrival, half of your original deposit will be forfeited, and the remainder of your deposit will be moved to your new reservation dates that must fall within one year of your original arrival date. Please note that cancellations made at least 30 days prior to the event date will result in a full refund of the event activity fee. Cancellations made within 29 days of the event date will result in a forfeiture of the event activity fee. Proceeds from the event activity fee for concerts will be donated to a charity – either the Blackberry Farm Foundation or another charity of the artist’s choosing. As a result, concerts (as well as their taxes/fees) are nonrefundable. A two-night deposit will be charged at time of reservation. All applicable event activity fees will be charged at the time of confirmation.

Name: Andrew Edmunds
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1986 and recognized by The Good Food Guide, Andrew Edmunds is a modern European restaurant occupying an 18th-century townhouse in London's Soho.
The candlelit dining room serves a daily changing menu focused on seasonal Franco-Mediterranean plates.
The establishment is noted for its award-winning wine list, which applies minimal markups to rare vintages.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details are required for all reservations, but no money is charged at the time of booking. A cancellation fee of £25.00 per person will be charged if you fail to turn up without notice or cancel your booking less than 6 hours prior to your reservation. The restaurant will contact you on the day of the booking to re-confirm; if unconfirmed, the reservation may be released and the table resold (if successfully resold, no fee is charged). Tables may also be released if you do not arrive within 20 minutes of your booking time. For New Year's Eve and Valentine's Day bookings, a cancellation fee of 50% of the menu price per person applies for no-shows or cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation.

Name: The Delaunay
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by The Wolseley Hospitality Group, The Delaunay is an all-day restaurant located in London's Covent Garden.
The space draws inspiration from the grand cafés of Central Europe, offering a menu of continental dishes within a wood-paneled dining room.
The kitchen is known for its signature schnitzel, served in an environment modeled after 1930s Vienna.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Unfortunately, due to a high number customers not attending their bookings without notifying us, we ask for card details to secure the reservation. If you don’t arrive for your booking without letting us know, a £15 fee per person will be charged for breakfast and a £25 fee per person will be charged for lunch and dinner (if you cancel and let us know, via online or phone, you will not be charged).

Name: Luna Omakase
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked inside Los Mochis London City, Luna Omakase is a 12-seat dining counter led by Executive Chef Leonard Tanyag.
The kitchen prepares a 12-course tasting menu of Sosaku-style Edomae cuisine, utilizing seasonal ingredients in a completely gluten-free and nut-free format.
Reflecting the restaurant's celestial name, one of the signature courses is presented to diners inside a ceramic moon.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Luna Omakase operates a reservation-only policy and requires a full pre-payment at the time of booking. All bookings are subject to a 72-hour cancellation and amendment policy. There is a 100% cancellation fee for any cancellations or amendments with less than 72 hours’ notice. All cancellations, amendments or reductions prior to 72-hours will incur a £50 handling charge.

Name: Duchy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Shoreditch, Duchy is a bistro opened by Leroy alumni Alex Grant and chef Simon Shand in the restaurant's former Michelin-starred space.
The menu draws inspiration from the historic Duchy of Savoy region, blending French and Italian culinary traditions with British produce.
Dishes like pork shoulder and smoked eel croquettes are served to a regularly rotating soundtrack of 200 albums.

Name: Kudu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Kudu is a Michelin-listed South African restaurant located in London's Marylebone neighborhood, operated by the family-run Kudu Collective.
The kitchen centers its menu around an open-fire braai, blending modern European cooking techniques with South African flavors.
A signature dish is the Kudu bread, which is served with melted Malay butter, aromatic curry leaves, and pickled shallots.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Cecconi's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in London's Mayfair in 1978 and now operated by the Soho House Group, Cecconi's is a Northern Italian restaurant with locations globally.
The dining rooms focus on Venetian-inspired cuisine, serving a consistent menu of handmade pastas, fresh seafood, and wood-fired pizzas.
A signature dish across its international outposts is the handmade spaghetti prepared with Maine lobster, tomato, and chili.

Name: The Cocochine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened by chef Larry Jayasekara and gallerist Tim Jefferies, The Cocochine is a modern French restaurant in a four-story Mayfair townhouse.
The menu features dishes with subtle Sri Lankan influences, utilizing ingredients from a private Scottish island and a 1,100-acre farm in Northamptonshire.
Diners can eat in the ground-floor room or sit at a small upstairs counter overlooking the kitchen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the event that the booking is not honoured in whole or in part (including reducing party size) or is cancelled with less than 72 hours’ notice, a cancellation fee of £75 per person for lunch and £189 per person for dinner would then be charged to the card provided. Should you need to adjust or cancel your reservation, please inform us at least 72 hours in advance. This applies to all cancellations and is not discretionary.

Name: Chutney Mary
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ranjit Mathrani and Namita Panjabi of MW Eat, Chutney Mary is a Michelin-recognized Indian restaurant located in London's St James's neighborhood.
The kitchen focuses on regional Indian recipes, serving them in a dining room decorated with sepia etchings and a dedicated Pukka Bar.
Signature dishes include the Lamb Nihari Soup baked with a pastry purdah, alongside golden prawns and traditional lamb biryani.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Your card will not be charged providing you cancel or reduce numbers at least 12 hours prior to your reservation using the “cancel” or “manage” reservation buttons in the reservation confirmation email. A cancellation fee of £30 per person will be charged if this does not occur.

Name: Compton Arms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The Compton Arms is a 200-year-old Islington pub recognized as one of George Orwell's inspirations for his essay on the ideal watering hole.
Today, the whitewashed venue operates as an incubator for rotating culinary residencies.
Currently hosting the Michelin-listed Rake concept by chefs Jay Claus and Syrus Pickhaver, the kitchen serves retro-British dishes like ray wing tenders on a crumpet with hot golden syrup.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Straker's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Thomas Straker translates his online culinary following into a physical space with this neighborhood restaurant on Notting Hill's Golborne Road.
The menu focuses on straightforward, modern British dishes with Italian influences, accompanied by a selection of low-intervention wines.
Meals typically begin with one of the kitchen's signature flatbreads, most notably the mussel-topped version.

Name: Blacklock Soho
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Gordon Ker, Blacklock Soho is a subterranean chophouse set in a former strip club in central London.
The meat-focused restaurant champions whole-animal butchery, serving steaks and chops cooked over open coals.
A signature ritual involves cocktails served from a vintage trolley, complementing the shared dish of skinny chops piled on flatbread.

Name: Josephine Bouchon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Awarded a Michelin Bib Gourmand, Josephine Bouchon is a neighbourhood French bistro in Chelsea operated by chef Claude Bosi and his wife Lucy.
Named after Bosi's grandmother, the dining room operates as a traditional Lyonnaise bouchon dedicated to regional French cooking.
The kitchen focuses on Lyon specialties, preparing staple items such as pike quenelle, andouillette, and house-made pâtés.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation or no-shows will incur a £100 fee. A credit card hold is required.

Name: Bocca di Lupo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Jacob Kenedy and Victor Hugo, Bocca di Lupo is an Italian restaurant in London's Soho district.
The menu focuses on stripped-down regional cuisine, highlighting traditional dishes sourced from across the country's twenty regions.
Diners can sit at a white marble counter to watch the open kitchen, while the main dining room features original canvases by artist Haidee Becker.

Name: Mount St Restaurant
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the first floor of The Audley in Mayfair, Mount St. Restaurant is a modern British dining room operated by Artfarm with interiors by Studio Laplace.
Executive Chef Jamie Shears updates traditional London classics using seasonal ingredients sourced directly from the group's Somerset farm.
The space features a palladiana mosaic floor by Rashid Johnson and over 200 original artworks by figures like Andy Warhol and Lucian Freud.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Petite Mason (Cannes)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated at the Palm Beach complex in Cannes, La Petite Maison is a Mediterranean restaurant with a menu developed by Chef Yiannis Kioroglou.
The kitchen focuses on traditional Niçoise and Provençal dishes, served within a bright, contemporary dining room.
Outside, the open-air terrace provides a direct, panoramic view stretching across the water from Cap d'Antibes to the Lérins Islands.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our cancellation policy requires that parties of 1-5 guests this reservation must be cancelled 24 hours prior your reservation; for parties of 6 guests or more we require 48 hours notice. A later cancellation or a failure to attend will result in a charge of £75 per head, which we will charge to the credit card details provided.

Name: Story Cellar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Neal's Yard, Story Cellar is a Parisian-inspired brasserie from Michelin-starred chef Tom Sellers.
The restaurant centers around counter-style seating and a wine program that champions female winemakers, alongside classic French plates.
Its signature rotisserie chicken is brined overnight, vacuum-sealed in its own juices, and finished on the grill with butter.

Name: Alchemist
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Rasmus Munk, Alchemist is a two-Michelin-starred restaurant in Copenhagen that currently ranks eighth in The World's 50 Best Restaurants.
The avant-garde dining concept merges gastronomy, visual art, and theatrical performance into an immersive, multi-hour journey.
Guests experience the majority of their fifty-impression tasting menu seated beneath a massive planetarium-style dome that projects shifting, surreal landscapes.

Name: Caviar Kaspia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1927 in Paris's 8th arrondissement, Caviar Kaspia is a historic seafood restaurant that frequently hosts fashion designers and public figures like Karl Lagerfeld.
The dining room maintains an old-world Russian atmosphere paired with direct views of the Église de la Madeleine.
The restaurant's signature dish is a simple baked potato topped with a generous portion of sturgeon caviar.

Name: Mimi Mei Fair
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within a three-storey Georgian townhouse in London's Mayfair, MiMi Mei Fair is a Chinese restaurant founded by restaurateur Samyukta Nair with interiors by Fabled Studio.
The dining rooms are designed to resemble the private residence of a fictional empress, incorporating visual cues from 1920s Shanghai.
The culinary program centers on a signature apple wood-fired roasted Peking duck.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Sette
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sette is the first international outpost of New York City's Scarpetta restaurant group, located on the ground floor of the Bulgari Hotel in London's Knightsbridge.
The space features a modern design and serves Italian dishes imported from the brand's American counterparts.
The menu centers around the group's signature Scarpetta spaghetti, made with fresh pasta, tomato, and basil.

Name: Novikov
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Arkady Novikov, whose portfolio spans over sixty venues, this expansive dining destination is situated in London's Mayfair.
The space is divided into two distinct culinary concepts, offering a choice between a Pan-Asian room and a regional Italian restaurant.
The Asian dining area centers around an open kitchen fronted by a market-style display of fresh seafood and vegetables.

Name: Milos
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Costas Spiliadis and designed by Alain Carle Architecte, Estiatorio Milos is a Greek seafood restaurant located within The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas.
The menu focuses on Mediterranean seafood and imported Greek ingredients, served in a minimalist dining room.
A standout feature is the restaurant's signature fish market, allowing guests to personally select their daily catch from a central ice display.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation policies vary by location and party size. A credit card is typically required to secure the reservation. Late cancellations or no-shows incur a fee, which varies by restaurant (e.g., $50 per person for cancellations within 24 hours in Miami, AED 150 per guest in Dubai, or $25 for parties of 5+ if not canceled by 9am on the day of the reservation at other locations).

Name: Noma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Refshaleøen neighborhood of Copenhagen, Noma is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant and test kitchen founded by chef René Redzepi.
The team defines New Nordic cuisine through rigorous foraging and advanced fermentation techniques across its rotating seasonal menus.
A dedicated fermentation lab on the premises transforms local ingredients for the property's distinct vegetable, ocean, and game tasting menus.

Name: Sweetings
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognised by 50 Best Discovery, Sweetings is a seafood restaurant and oyster bar located within an Italian Gothic building in the City of London.
The establishment focuses on traditional British seafood, presenting classic plates in a canteen-style dining room that has remained largely unchanged since 1889.
A signature offering is the Chef's Pie, a baked dish filled with chunks of fish that vary depending on the daily catch.

Name: Ave Mario
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Big Mamma Group, Ave Mario is an Italian restaurant and pizzeria located in London's Covent Garden.
The multi-level venue draws inspiration from a Florentine palazzo, incorporating a 1980s aesthetic across its dining areas.
The interior features six-meter-high ceilings and a bar lined with 3,500 bottles, alongside a carbonara served from a four-kilogram pecorino wheel.

Name: MOI
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by chefs Andy Cook and Nick Tannett, alumni of Gordon Ramsay and Endo at the Rotunda, MOI is a Japanese restaurant in London's Soho.
The space centers around a fully open kitchen dedicated to live fire cooking, pairing grill dishes with daily crafted sushi.
Beyond the tactile interiors, the venue features a dedicated listening bar that pairs high-fidelity sound with an extensive sake selection.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All tickets are final sale and non-refundable. Unexpired tickets can be transferred to someone else or used for a future visit, and rescheduling may be accommodated. Children ages 4 and under enter free but require a ticket to reserve a time slot. All child ticket holders must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder. Tickets purchased on unauthorized websites or through scalpers will not be honored.

Name: Decimo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the tenth floor of The Standard in London's King's Cross, Decimo is the debut capital outpost from Michelin-starred chef Peter Sanchez-Iglesias.
The menu merges his Spanish heritage with Mexican influences, centering on wood-fired cooking techniques.
Floor-to-ceiling windows provide panoramic views of the city skyline alongside signature dishes like gambas rojas, tacos, and Iberico pork.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Morchella
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Awarded a Michelin Bib Gourmand, Morchella is a restaurant and wine bar set in a converted former bank in London's Clerkenwell from the team behind Perilla.
The kitchen prepares Mediterranean-inspired sharing dishes, while the adjacent bar serves a selection of natural and biodynamic wines.
The menu features signature items such as the salt cod churros.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require card details for all of our bookings. We charge late cancellation fee (within 24 hours) & no-shows fee of £30 per person.

Name: NAC
Master_Aurora_Insights:
North Audley Cantine is a French-inspired bistro in the Mayfair neighborhood of London, founded by David Bellaiche, Gabriel Cohen-Ella, and head chef Jeremy Coste.
The restaurant focuses on shared plates and features 1940s Hollywood-inspired decor with whitewashed brick walls, brown leather banquettes, and blue velvet booths.
A signature element of the menu is the Frosties soft serve dessert.

Name: Ibai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by meat suppliers Nemanja Borjanović and William Sheard with former Chiltern Firehouse chef Richard Foster, Ibai is a Basque steakhouse in the City of London.
The kitchen focuses on open-fire cooking, utilizing a charcoal grill to prepare large cuts of beef and seasonal produce.
The dining room features polished concrete and exposed ducting, providing an industrial backdrop for signature menu items like the mountain cider sorbet.
Master_Place_ID:

Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or changes to the number of guests are accepted free of charge up to 7 days before the reservation date. Any cancellations or changes made after this time, or no-shows, will be subject to a fee of €190 per person. Arriving more than 15 minutes late without prior notice is considered a no-show.

Name: Fountain Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Indianapolis's Bottleworks District, The Fountain Room is a supper club-style restaurant developed by Clancy's Hospitality and Executive Chef Ricky Martinez.
The venue departs from traditional steakhouse formats by blending retro Art Deco design with a menu of classic American fare.
The dining room is outfitted with velvet banquettes, glowing chandeliers, and a vintage reel-to-reel machine, complementing staples like pickled relish trays and prime rib.

Name: LPM
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Dubai International Financial Centre, LPM Dubai is a French Mediterranean restaurant led by chef Maurizio Pace and recognized by MENA's 50 Best Restaurants.
The space features Belle Époque interiors designed by studio Sagrada and serves unfussy Niçoise cuisine that bridges French and Italian culinary traditions.
Signature plates include escargots and burrata with tomatoes, served in a dining room decorated with a curated art collection.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations for parties of 1-5 guests must be cancelled 24 hours prior to the reservation; for parties of 6 guests or more, 48 hours notice is required. A late cancellation or a failure to attend (no-show) will result in a charge per head (e.g., £75 in London, AED 200-300 in the UAE) which will be charged to the credit card details provided.

Name: Medlar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the King's Road in Chelsea, Medlar is an independently owned, Michelin-recognized restaurant from chef Joe Mercer Nairne and manager David O'Connor.
The kitchen prepares modern French cuisine with global influences, focusing on seasonal ingredients sourced from the British Isles and Europe.
A constant on the menu since opening is the signature duck egg tart, served with red wine sauce, turnip purée, sautéed duck heart, and lardons.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We do not take a deposit or room hire charge. All we ask is for credit card details to secure the booking and that you let us know of any cancellations two days before otherwise we do charge £25 per person cancellation fee.

Name: Punk Royale
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chefs Joakim Almqvist and Kalle Nilsson, Punk Royale is a restaurant group with outposts in Stockholm, Copenhagen, and Oslo.
The concept subverts traditional fine dining by serving multi-course tasting menus in a chaotic environment fueled by smoke machines and loud music.
Upon arrival, guests surrender their cell phones before partaking in signature rituals like eating caviar directly off the back of their hands.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations are free of charge up to 48 hours before your reservation. After that, a fee of 1,000 in the local currency will be charged per guest. Your card is used to secure your reservation. No charges are made unless you cancel late or don't show up.

Name: Kai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened in 1993 by Bernard Yeoh, Kai Mayfair is a Chinese restaurant in London that held a Michelin star from 2009 to 2024.
Head chef Alex Chow focuses on liberated Chinese cooking from the Nanyang region, blending traditional techniques with modern interpretations.
The menu features dishes like Nanyang chilli lobster and a Buddha Jumps Over the Wall soup containing sea cucumber, dried scallops, and ginseng.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please be aware that card details are required to make all online bookings. 40€ per person will be charged to all cards for a no show or for a late cancellation. All cancellations should be made with more than 24 hour notice.

Name: Blacklock Shoreditch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Gordon Ker, Blacklock Shoreditch is a modern chophouse set within a former Victorian furniture factory in East London.
The kitchen focuses on cuts of meat cooked over open coals, reviving the traditional British chop house format.
The signature All In platter features a selection of beef, pork, and lamb chops served over charcoal-grilled flatbreads designed to absorb the resting juices.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you cancel within 24 hours or don't turn up, you will be charged £10 per person.

Name: Beholder
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Indianapolis, Beholder is a fine dining restaurant from James Beard-nominated chef Jonathan Brooks and sommelier Josh Mazanowski.
The kitchen focuses on modern cuisine, offering a constantly evolving menu of globally inspired, highly seasonal plates meant for sharing.
The dining room occupies a repurposed auto shop on the edge of the historic Woodruff Place neighborhood, providing an industrial backdrop for the meal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Flagstaff House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Holding a Wine Spectator Grand Award since 1983, Flagstaff House is a New American dining destination on Boulder's Flagstaff Mountain led by Chef Chris Royster.
The window-encased restaurant pairs panoramic views of the city from an elevation of 6,000 feet with a seasonal tasting menu.
Originally built as a summer cabin in 1929, the property now houses a 15,000-bottle wine cellar.

Name: The Baring
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by the Michelin Guide, The Baring is a gastropub in London’s Islington neighborhood helmed by chef Rob Tecwyn and operator Adam Symonds.
The space pairs a classic pub exterior with a minimalist dining room, serving a menu of seasonal produce and low-intervention wines.
Signature plates like the quail shish and the pig's cheek and smoked eel terrine anchor the daily menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Oak at Fourteenth
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Boulder's pedestrian Pearl Street Mall, Oak at Fourteenth is a Michelin-recommended New American restaurant helmed by chef Steven Redzikowski.
The dining room centers around an open kitchen dedicated to seasonal, locally sourced ingredients and wood-fired cooking.
A permanent fixture on the menu is the shaved apple and kale salad, a signature dish that remains a staple among regular patrons.

Name: Martino's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Martino's is an all-day Italian restaurant in London's Sloane Square, opened by restaurateur Martin Kuczmarski of The Dover.
The venue occupies the Willett Building and operates as a Milanese-style trattoria, defined by its Art Deco interiors and traditional service.
The softly lit dining room features a dedicated bar counter and a menu highlighting regional dishes like tortelli zucca.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Westerns Laundry
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Awarded a Michelin Bib Gourmand, Westerns Laundry is a North London seafood restaurant from chef David Gingell and restaurateur Jeremie Cometto-Lingenheim.
Housed in a former laundrette, the industrial space features a cobbled courtyard and serves a daily changing menu of British and Spanish small plates.
The kitchen relies on the day's catch to dictate dishes like whole turbot, paired with selections from the natural wine cellar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required to guarantee reservations. For standard bookings, a £50 per person charge applies for no-shows. For large lunch and private dining reservations, cancellations within 72 hours incur a £250 fee, and no-shows forfeit the full cost of the menu. Exclusive hire cancellations require 8 weeks' notice.

Name: Kappou Ukai Nikusho
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Ukai Group, Ginza Kappou Ukai Nikusho is a subterranean restaurant located in the Ginza district of Tokyo.
The kitchen specializes in meat-focused kappou cuisine, offering seasonal tasting menus centered around Kuroge Wagyu beef and wild game.
Guests dine at a counter crafted from a single piece of 300-year-old cypress wood, watching chefs prepare dishes over binchotan charcoal.

Name: Wild Blue
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Wild Blue Restaurant and Bar is a dining venue in Whistler, British Columbia, led by Restaurant Director Neil Henderson and Iron Chef Alex Chen.
The menu centers on Pacific Northwest cuisine, highlighting sustainable seafood and regional ingredients prepared with French and European techniques.
The dining room incorporates dark wood paneling and dim lighting, referencing the aesthetic of traditional steakhouses.

Name: Berenjak Mayfair
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Kian Samyani and backed by JKS Restaurants, Berenjak Mayfair is a Persian dining room in London.
The interior takes inspiration from the rural villas of the Caspian coast, creating a communal environment focused on Iranian home cooking.
Guests share meals around a traditional sofreh, with a menu centered on charcoal-grilled kebabs, fresh breads, and the signature Omelet Irani.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Due to card details being required to secure your booking, we cannot accept reservations over the phone or via email. Parties who arrive with less people than booked will incur a fee of £50pp for each absent guest and may be added to the waitlist until appropriate seating for the new party size becomes available. You are able to modify or cancel your booking via the “Manage Reservation” & “Cancel Reservation” links in your confirmation email, subject to the cancellation terms.

Name: Bond Street
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Mayfair district, Bond Street is a thoroughfare recently named the world's most expensive retail destination by Cushman & Wakefield.
The half-mile stretch links Piccadilly to Oxford Street, serving as a concentrated hub for international fashion houses, jewelers, and antique dealers.
Above the entrance to Sotheby's auction house sits an Ancient Egyptian sculpture dating to 1600 BC, the oldest outdoor monument in London.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: COTE NYC
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Simon Kim, Cote NYC is a Michelin-starred Korean steakhouse located in Manhattan's Flatiron District.
The restaurant merges the interactive format of Korean barbecue with the prime beef selection of an American steakhouse.
Diners cook cuts from the in-house dry-aging room on smokeless tabletop grills during the signature Butcher's Feast.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Full credit card details will be required to confirm dinner reservations only. We kindly request that all cancellations are received with at least 24 hours notice. If you no-show your reservation or cancel it within 24 hours of your booking time, you will be subject to a fee of $50 per person that will be applied to the credit card on file.

Name: Hawksworth
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Michelin-recognized chef David Hawksworth, this contemporary Canadian restaurant operates within Vancouver's Rosewood Hotel Georgia.
The kitchen focuses on Pacific Northwest ingredients to produce seasonal plates alongside an extensive wine list.
Designed by Alessandro Munge, the interior features four distinct dining rooms where guests order dishes like Korean fried cauliflower and pan-seared ling cod.

Name: Wild Tavern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated overlooking Chelsea Green in London, Wild Tavern is an Italian-inspired restaurant from George Bukhov-Weinstein and Ilya Demichev, the operators behind Goodman.
The dining room operates as a relaxed neighbourhood gathering space, focusing on straightforward regional Italian cooking and an extensive wine program.
An open fire anchors the interior, where chefs prepare large feasting plates of wild seafood and premium grilled meats.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Cloud by Käfer
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Munich's BMW Welt, The Cloud by Käfer is a fine dining restaurant led by chef Jens Madsen.
The kitchen follows a concept of culinary nomadism, shaping its seasonal tasting menus around global travel and regional landscapes.
The dining room features a fireplace, a lighting scheme inspired by the golden and blue hours, and direct views of the surrounding BMWs.

Name: The Pelican
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Relaunched by The Public House Group, The Pelican is a Notting Hill gastropub recently named London's best pub by the Good Food Guide.
The restored Victorian space replaces traditional tavern aesthetics with a pared-back interior of cream walls, exposed brick, and wooden finishes.
The kitchen serves a chop house menu, highlighted by signature bar snacks like mince on toast and bone marrow with parsley.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Tucci
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Manhattan's NoHo neighborhood, Tucci is a 60-seat Italian trattoria opened by the team behind Delmonico's, including executive chef Edward Hong.
The multi-level restaurant honors the Tucci family's culinary legacy by serving modern interpretations of traditional Northern and Southern Italian recipes.
Alongside dishes like osso buco ravioli, it is the only restaurant outside of the original Delmonico's to serve the signature Eye of Delmonico steak.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Othership
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Futurestudio, Othership is a modern bathhouse and wellness space with locations in Flatiron and Williamsburg.
The alcohol-free environment focuses on social self-care, offering guided breathwork, thermal rituals, and cold plunges to help guests regulate their nervous systems.
The facility centers around a 90-person performance sauna and a series of communal ice baths maintained at 32 degrees.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To avoid losing your credit, reserved classes, free flow and socials can be changed or cancelled up to 12 hours prior to the start of the class. If cancelled within the late cancellation window you will lose the credit from your package. If you are on the intro two week membership, a fee of $45 will be charged in the event of a late cancellation. This policy is in place to ensure that all journeyer’s get a chance to state-shift and booking privileges are not misused. We do not accept email cancellations or telepathic cancellations. Please cancel your reservation through your account on our website or mobile app. If you you do not show up for your reservation, your credit will be forfeited and journey lost. If you are on the intro 2-week membership, a fee of $45 will be charged in the event of a no show.

Name: The Knave of Clubs
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The Knave of Clubs is a restored Shoreditch pub led by a hospitality team that includes chef Patrick Powell of Chiltern Firehouse.
The venue operates as a traditional public house, pouring pints from local London breweries alongside historic beers like Double Diamond.
The concise menu centers on rotisserie chicken sourced from small farms, served alongside snacks like a prawn scotch egg with chilli jam.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We’ll hold your table for 15 minutes. If you email to let us know, we will still do our best to accommodate you, but this might mean that your time at the table is limited. A £5 deposit per person is required for lunchtime bookings.

Name: The Yellow Bittern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's King's Cross, The Yellow Bittern is an 18-seat restaurant led by chef Hugh Corcoran.
The kitchen prepares a daily changing blackboard menu of comfort food influenced by his Northern Irish heritage.
Diners can browse the downstairs bookshop before eating traditional dishes like Dublin coddle or roast guinea fowl paired with freshly baked soda bread.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Cutler & Co
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a former metalworks factory in Melbourne's Fitzroy neighborhood, Cutler & Co is the fine-dining flagship of chef Andrew McConnell.
The restaurant pairs its industrial origins with modern Australian cuisine, offering an evolving tasting menu alongside an extensive wine list.
A glass facade reveals the dining room, which is anchored by an open kitchen that allows guests to watch the culinary team at work.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details are required for tables of six people or more, with a cancellation fee of $50 per head for no-shows if seats cannot be filled.

Name: Gimlet
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Gimlet at Cavendish House is a restaurant and bar in Melbourne's central business district, helmed by executive chef Andrew McConnell.
The space features a 1920s Chicago-style interior designed by Sydney architecture firm Acme, complete with a central cocktail bar and formal dining room.
Guests sit in burgundy booths to order the signature gimlet cocktail alongside rock oysters served with thinly sliced rye and seaweed butter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to your reservation time to avoid a cancellation charge of $50 per person.

Name: Fat Badger
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Notting Hill, The Fat Badger is a multi-level pub and restaurant from the Public House Group, helmed by River Cafe alumnus George Williams.
Guests pass a velvet rope and ascend past a first-floor bar to reach the dimly lit top-floor dining room.
The kitchen serves a seasonal set menu anchored by sharing-style mains and a signature side of stacked, crispy Hasselback potatoes.

Name: Fern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within a restored barn in the Cornish village of Nanstallon, Fern is a modern British restaurant helmed by Michelin-starred chef Paul Welburn.
The dining experience centers on a seasonal menu of small plates that highlight the agricultural heritage and local produce of the South West.
Standout dishes include nostalgic creations such as Davidstow savoury custard creams served with blueberry ketchup and a 24-hour slow-cooked lamb neck kebab.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require at least 48 hours’ notice for every cancellation and this must be made via email. We may request a deposit to guarantee a table on busy days. In the event that you do not show up, we may charge £30.00 per person.

Name: MIND Restaurant
Master_Aurora_Insights:
MIND is a Michelin-starred fine-dining restaurant located in the Bavarian municipality of Markt Indersdorf, Germany, led by chef Sabrina Fenzl.
The multi-course tasting menu blends regional produce with cosmopolitan flavors, reinterpreting familiar ingredients through global culinary techniques.
Between courses, guests are invited to leave their tables and observe the chef at work in the open kitchen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A reservation can be cancelled in writing up to 24 hours before the agreed reservation period without incurring cancellation fees. In the event of failure to cancel an existing reservation or failure to appear at the reserved time on that day, we reserve the right to charge a no-show fee. The cancellation fee is €120 per registered guest. The same applies if fewer than the announced number of guests appear without prior cancellation by phone or email.

Name: Tatsuda Omakase
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tatsuda Omakase is a sushi restaurant in New York City's Hell's Kitchen, operating as the sister establishment to Korami.
The dozen-seat dining room focuses on a multi-course omakase format that pairs seasonal fish preparations with Japanese sake.
One specific offering on the tasting menu is the signature Big Mac sushi, a layered bite featuring Miyazaki wagyu and uni.

Name: Makoto
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Makoto is a modern Japanese restaurant by chef Makoto Okuwa and STARR Restaurants, located in Miami Beach's Bal Harbour Shops.
The interior features a redesign by Paris-based architect India Mahdavi, who introduced a softer, colorful aesthetic to the dining room.
The menu centers on Edomae-style sushi and robata-grilled dishes, anchored by the signature spicy tuna crispy rice.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Cote Miami
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Design District, Cote Miami is a Michelin-starred Korean steakhouse from proprietor Simon Kim and executive chef David Shim.
The restaurant merges the communal energy of traditional Korean barbecue with the hallmarks of a classic American steakhouse.
The signature Butcher's Feast features cuts of USDA prime beef prepared on interactive, smokeless tabletop grills.

Name: The Hart
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Marylebone, The Hart is a pub and dining room from Public House, the group behind The Pelican and The Hero.
The venue pairs a ground-floor bar with formal upstairs dining rooms, serving a menu sourced from the team's Cotswolds butchery.
An open kitchen anchors the first floor, allowing guests to observe the culinary process as they ascend to the upper levels.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Araxi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Whistler Village, Araxi Restaurant and Oyster Bar is a farm-to-table concept led by Culinary Director James Walt and Executive Chef Ying Gao.
The Toptable Group venue focuses on regional Pacific Northwest cuisine, sourcing ingredients directly from local farmers and purveyors.
The dining room features a dedicated oyster bar and a 1,000-label wine cellar that has held a Wine Spectator Best of Award of Excellence since 2000.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Trullo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened in 2010 by chef Tim Siadatan and Jordan Frieda, Trullo is a Michelin-recognized Italian restaurant located on Highbury Corner in London's Islington neighborhood.
The kitchen focuses on straightforward, seasonal Italian cooking with a British sensibility, offering a menu of established staples and changing daily specials.
Diners can watch the chefs prepare fresh, handmade pasta, which features in signature plates like the beef shin ragù.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: There is a non-refundable no-show fee of £20 per booking.

Name: L'Abattoir
Master_Aurora_Insights:
L'Abattoir is a Michelin-recommended restaurant in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighborhood, led by Owner and Executive Chef Lee Cooper.
Occupying a 19th-century building in the city's former meatpacking district, the dining room serves French-influenced Pacific Northwest cuisine.
A permanent fixture on the menu is the signature baked Pacific oyster, prepared with black truffle and garlic butter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations prior to ninety days before an event will receive a full refund. Cancellations that occur for any reason between ninety days and thirty-one days of the event date - deposits are non-refundable, yet transferable to a future date within twelve months of original event date (for re-bookings, deposits are non-refundable). Cancellations that occur for any reason within thirty days of the event date - deposits are non-refundable and non-transferable. Cancellations that occur for any reason within three business days of booking date, the full estimated food and beverage spend will be charged to the credit card on file. All cancellations must be communicated in writing via email.

Name: Seebamboe
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by Chef Adél Hughes, Seebamboes is a 16-seat restaurant located on the mezzanine above Galjoen in central Cape Town.
The kitchen reimagines the surf and turf concept by combining sustainably sourced seafood with regional meats and native botanical produce.
The surprise tasting menu features signature dishes like kelp spaghetti with Wagyu brisket and snoek mousse dusted with biltong powder.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings are refundable if cancelled with at least 24 hours' notice. Cancellations made within 24 hours of your reservation will result in the loss of your deposit. If your party is smaller on arrival, the missing guests will be charged as a no-show, as we prepare for each guest in advance.

Name: Avra
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by the Michelin Guide, Avra Beverly Hills is a Greek seafood restaurant operated by the Avra Group in the city's Golden Triangle.
The kitchen specializes in traditional Mediterranean fare, focusing on whole grilled fish, fresh salads, and regional delicacies.
Guests enter past a market-style ice display where they can personally select their daily catch before it is prepared to order.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Muse
Master_Aurora_Insights: Muse by Tom Aikens, located at 38 Groom Place in London's Belgravia, is a 23-cover creative contemporary restaurant occupying a converted Georgian mews house, opened in January 2020 as chef-owner Tom Aikens' return to experience-led fine dining. Muse serves tasting menus exclusively, offering six or ten courses at dinner and three or six courses at lunch, with each dish named after an anecdote, milestone, or experience from Aikens' personal life and career, with only primary ingredients listed beneath. The restaurant spans two dining levels plus a third kitchen floor, with the ground floor featuring two open kitchens, one framed by an obsidian marble counter and boucle-upholstered swivel chairs, and interiors designed by Rebecca Korner in red, gold, cream, and beige tones.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A Credit Card guarantee is required to secure all Tuesday to Friday bookings, up to and including 14 guests. Our $85 per person cancellation fee is pre-authorised upon your provided card when your details are recorded. This is not a deposit. The pre-authorised funds are only charged when our cancellation fee applies. Muse requires 24hrs notice for all cancellations and final guest number confirmations, failure to do so will incur the $85 per person cancellation fee. All Saturday reservations will be charged a deposit of $85.00 per person to secure the booking, which will be redeemed off the total bill. Reservations of 15 guests and above will be charged a deposit to secure the booking and will be subject to additional booking terms and conditions.

Name: JAN
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Munich, JAN is the eponymous three-Michelin-starred restaurant by chef Jan Hartwig, who earned the guide's top rating just six months after opening.
The seven-course tasting menu highlights regional ingredients while reinterpreting the traditional flavor profiles of German cuisine.
Guests can observe the culinary team at work through an open pass into the kitchen, known as the "Labor der Liebe" (Laboratory of Love).
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Your credit card will only be charged in case of a no-show or late cancellation. If the cancellation is made less than 48 hours in advance, we allow ourselves to charge per person a fee of 380.00 Euro. For the reservation itself and a timely cancellation (more than 48 hours before) you will not incur any costs. Cancellations are only accepted via the link in our confirmation email and must be received by us at least 48 hours before the reserved date. What happens if you cancel on the day of the reservation? In this case we allow us to charge a fee of 380.00 Euro per person.

Name: The Wilde
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Santo Versace's former home, The Wilde Milano is a private members' club founded by hospitality entrepreneur Gary Landesberg and creatively led by Alasdhair Willis.
The club centers around a cultural calendar of gallery nights and international dining, set within interiors by Italian designer Fabrizio Casiraghi.
Seating by Nalesso pairs coral velvet with striped satin to anchor the gathering spaces.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Members may cancel their Membership within 14 days from the date on which the joining and subscription fees payment is made. If the Member has started to use The Wilde's services or facilities during this period, the Company reserves the right to retain a pro-rata amount. The remainder will only be refunded by the same method as the original payment. Each Member may terminate his/her Membership by giving the Company at least one (1) month’s written notice prior to the expiry of his/her current Membership. The notice should be emailed to membership.milan@thewilde.com. If a Member ceases to use the services before the end of the year, they will not be entitled to a refund of any part of the annual subscription.

Name: Uchi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Santa Monica Boulevard, Uchi West Hollywood is the West Coast debut of James Beard Award-winning chef Tyson Cole's Austin-based Japanese restaurant.
The kitchen focuses on non-traditional sushi and seasonal omakase, presenting a distinct interpretation of Japanese cuisine.
The ORA-designed dining room provides a mid-century backdrop for signature plates like the hama chili.

Name: MAASS
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Four Seasons Hotel in Fort Lauderdale, MAASS is a contemporary American restaurant by Michelin-starred chef Ryan Ratino.
The culinary program centers around an open-fire hearth, focusing on ingredients sourced from select markets.
A fourteen-seat chef's counter provides guests with a direct view of the culinary team at work in the open kitchen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the case of no show or cancellation within 24 hours of the reservation you will be charge $15 per guest as a no show/cancellation fee.

Name: Osteria Angelina
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a former cotton factory in London's Spitalfields, Osteria Angelina is the Michelin-recognized sister restaurant to Dalston's Angelina.
The spacious, glass-ceilinged dining room focuses on Itameshi cuisine, blending Italian culinary traditions with Japanese ingredients through a sharing-plate format.
Signature dishes include fresh truffle and kelp tortellini, as well as ox tongue seasoned with wasabi and served with parmesan greens.

Name: FIG
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Co-founded by James Beard Award-winning chef Mike Lata and partner Adam Nemirow, FIG is a modern American bistro located in downtown Charleston.
The restaurant focuses on seasonally inspired cooking, utilizing regional Southern produce and sustainable seafood to prepare Lowcountry staples.
One specific menu staple is the signature ricotta gnocchi, which is served alongside lamb bolognese.

Name: Bisous
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ranked No. 39 on North America's 50 Best Bars 2025, Bisous is a Parisian-inspired cocktail bar in Chicago's Fulton Market from Footman Hospitality and barman Peter Vestinos.
As one of the few standalone bars on Restaurant Row, the space features velvet booths, patterned wallpaper, and a marble bar.
The menu highlights a dedicated martini selection, including the signature Olivette made with olive leaf-infused gin, vermouth, and saline solution.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Musaafer
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Musaafer is a Michelin-starred Indian restaurant in Houston led by Executive Chef Mayank Istwal and owners Shammi and Mithu Malik.
The two-story dining room, located in the Galleria mall, focuses on high-concept regional cuisine.
The menu stems from a 100-day research trip across India, resulting in a 12-course tasting experience and dishes like beef vindaloo prepared with filet mignon.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card required to secure reservation. Please cancel at least 24 hours in advance. Cancellations within 24 hours incur a $50 per person fee.

Name: Jin Mei Dumpling
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the heart of New York's Chinatown, Jin Mei Dumpling is a highly rated Chinese eatery focused on traditional street food.
The establishment operates entirely as a walk-up window, providing quick takeaway service without any dedicated indoor or outdoor seating.
Its menu is anchored by handmade pan-fried dumplings, offering a signature portion of fifteen pieces with crispy bottoms for five dollars.

Name: 1 Lombard Street
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Grade II-listed former banking hall in the City of London, 1 Lombard Street is a brasserie overseen by Executive Chef James Holden.
Since 1998, the restaurant has operated in the Square Mile, serving a menu of Modern European and British dishes sourced from local producers.
The dining room is anchored by a circular bar positioned directly beneath a glass domed skylight.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Corrida
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the fourth floor of downtown Boulder's Pearl West building, Corrida is a Spanish-inspired steakhouse developed by restaurateur Bryan Dayton and architecture firm Arch11.
The kitchen draws from the culinary practices of Northern Spain's Basque country, centering its menu around regenerative beef, wood-fired seafood, and dry-cured Iberian ham.
The glass-walled dining room and outdoor rooftop deck feature unobstructed views of the Flatirons.

Name: Chops City Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Grant Phelan of Phelan Family Brands, Chops City Grill is a steakhouse with locations in Naples and Bonita Springs, Florida.
The menu pairs dry-aged USDA Prime and Wagyu beef with fresh local seafood and hand-rolled sushi.
A signature offering is the 32-ounce Tomahawk steak, dry-aged in-house for over 21 days and served with white truffle béarnaise and Alaskan king crab.

Name: Arabica
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by Condé Nast Traveler, Arabica King's Cross is a Levantine restaurant situated near London's Coal Drops Yard.
The dining room features counter seating where guests can watch chefs prepare a menu of Middle Eastern meze, charcoal-grilled meats, and regional cocktails.
Outside, a dedicated terrace overlooks the grassy meadow of Lewis Cubitt Walk and the adjacent Persian-inspired Jellicoe Gardens.

Name: Jun's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Kelvin Cheung, Jun's is a Michelin-selected restaurant and cocktail bar located in Downtown Dubai.
The menu centers on third-culture cuisine, integrating North American, Asian, and Indian culinary techniques to reflect the chef's upbringing.
The signature Rainbow Heirloom Carrots are presented over a base of smoked labneh with soy honey butter and candied walnuts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: 123V Browns
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Browns fashion boutique in London's Mayfair, 123V Browns is a plant-based restaurant developed by Chef Alexis Gauthier.
The kitchen focuses on vegan small plates and serves a dedicated menu of plant-based sushi.
Guests can eat in the indoor dining room or outside in an evergreen courtyard planted with mature ferns and trees.

Name: Zuma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Rainer Becker, Zuma Cannes is a Japanese restaurant located within the 1929-built Palm Beach complex on the Côte d'Azur.
The venue adapts the brand's contemporary izakaya format for the French Riviera, featuring a large terrace equipped with retractable canopies.
Service centers around a robata grill and sushi counter, offering signature plates such as Chilean sea bass croquettes with ginger chili dressing.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations require valid card details and have a 24-hour cancellation policy. For parties of 8 people and above, a deposit of 50€ per person is required. Reservations cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice will result in a charge of 50€ per person to the card provided or the deposit will be retained.

Name: Stella's Cucina
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Stella Spanu in 2023, Stella's Cucina is a Michelin-recommended Italian restaurant located in downtown Boulder, Colorado.
The kitchen focuses on regional Italian cuisine, pairing house-made pastas and imported ingredients with a live music program.
Designed by architect Miguel Quismondo, the Art Deco-inspired room transitions into a late-night lounge complete with a dedicated dance floor and integrated sound system.

Name: Akira
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the first floor of Japan House London in Kensington, Akira is a Japanese restaurant helmed by Chef Akira Shimizu and designed by Masamichi Katayama of Wonderwall.
The menu focuses on the traditional trinity of Japanese cooking, emphasizing the relationship between food, tableware, and presentation.
Meals are served on ceramics and glassware sourced from artisans across Japan, with sushi presented in custom wooden bento boxes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card information is required to hold the reservation for the Omakase course. Cancellations within 24 hours of the reservation will be charged $50 for the $100 Omakase course or $60 for the $120 Omakase course per person. Reservations cancelled more than 24 hours in advance will not be charged. If the reservation is cancelled on the same day or without prior notice (no-show), guests will be charged automatically.

Name: 28-50 Wine Workshop & Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Richard Green, 28-50 Marylebone is a modern European restaurant and wine bar in London that earned Star Wine List's Best Short List award.
The space pairs a rustic-industrial aesthetic with an enological focus, offering more than 30 wines by the glass alongside a seasonal menu.
An internal workshop area hosts regular tastings, while a Collector's List provides access to rare bottles sourced from private cellars.

Name: Coy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at the V&A Waterfront in Cape Town, COY is the second restaurant from chef Ryan Cole of Salsify at the Roundhouse.
The kitchen highlights regional African culinary traditions by preparing indigenous ingredients with ancient cooking techniques.
Situated on the water's edge between a yacht marina and a working fishing harbor, the space offers direct views of Table Mountain alongside a seven-course tasting menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To confirm your booking, a R450 deposit per guest is required within 24 hours. If not received, the reservation will be cancelled automatically. Full refunds are offered for cancellations or changes made at least 24 hours in advance. Late cancellations, no-shows, or unannounced changes will result in the loss of the deposit.

Name: Quinta da Comporta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Envisioned by Portuguese architect Miguel Câncio Martins and operated by Experimental Group, Quinta da Comporta is a wellness resort set among the rice paddies of Carvalhal.
The property adapts the region's traditional architectural lines into a sustainable retreat focused on wellness and environmental harmony.
Guests can swim in a 40-meter infinity pool or dine at the organic restaurant, Mar D'Arrozal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bazaar Meat by José Andrés
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at the Palazzo at the Venetian Resort in Las Vegas, Bazaar Meat is a modern steakhouse by James Beard Award-winning chef José Andrés.
The restaurant departs from traditional formats by offering a wide variety of carnivorous dishes prepared with unconventional culinary techniques.
Signature offerings include starters like caviar cones alongside wagyu ribeye, all prepared across five distinct open kitchens.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If not cancelled within 24 hours of the reservation time, or if a no show, we will charge the card on file a fee of $50 per person.

Name: Alley Cats Pizza
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Alley Cats Pizza is a New York-style pizzeria in Marylebone led by Sicilian head chef Francesco Macri.
The dining room channels a Brooklyn loft aesthetic with exposed brick, concrete surfaces, and classic American films projected across the space.
The signature 14-inch pizzas are served elevated on silver racks alongside desserts like roasted hazelnut and pistachio tiramisu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Atrium at Mandarin Oriental
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The Atrium is a skylit dining space within the Mandarin Oriental Mayfair, featuring interiors by Tokyo-based design studio Curiosity.
The all-day restaurant serves a contemporary Mediterranean menu in a triple-height winter garden setting with glass ceilings and marble floors.
A large timber vortex sculpture representing the wind is suspended directly above the main dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Salt on Mass
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Owned by John Bales, Salt on Mass is a seafood and steak restaurant located in downtown Indianapolis's Mass Ave district.
The scratch kitchen focuses on coastal cuisine, preparing wild, sustainable seafood and steaks without the use of freezers.
The raw bar features options like Salt Block Sashimi and Hawaiian Poke, served in a bright space accented with nautical decor.

Name: Colmado Múrria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Barcelona's Eixample district, Colmado Múrria is an 1898 delicatessen featuring a restaurant led by Michelin-starred chef Jordi Vilà.
The establishment operates as both a specialty grocery and a dining space, serving Catalan cuisine alongside regional cheeses and preserves.
Behind its preserved Modernist facade, the shop originally opened as a coffee roaster and wafer maker called La Puríssima.

Name: Alley Cats Pizza
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Alley Cats Pizza is a New York-style pizzeria in Chelsea with a menu developed by Sicilian head chef Francesco Macri.
The restaurant focuses on 14-inch pizzas featuring a thin, foldable crust with a charred edge from a high-temperature bake.
The dining room incorporates gingham tablecloths, green glazed brickwork, and wall projections of Italian-American television shows like The Sopranos.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Brasserie Colette
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by Michelin-starred chef Tim Raue, Brasserie Colette operates locations in Berlin, Munich, and Constance.
The menu updates classic French brasserie dishes with Raue’s signature balance of sweetness, acidity, and spiciness.
Notable dishes include prawn marocain and a shared Beef Wellington, alongside a la table dressée lunch service that presents five starters and a main course simultaneously.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations are held for 15 minutes. If a delay is not communicated within this time, the reservation will be marked as a no-show and automatically canceled. No prepayment or credit card hold requirements were found.

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Notting Hill, 104 Restaurant is a modern dining establishment helmed by chef Richard Wilkins and recommended in the Michelin Guide.
The restaurant operates as the smallest fine dining venue in London, defined by its quiet atmosphere and minimal scale.
The dining room accommodates a maximum of fourteen guests across six tables for a five-course tasting menu grounded in French techniques.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets are non-refundable except in special cases such as event cancellation, postponement, pricing changes, overpayment, or booking errors. Refund requests must be justified and emailed at least 24 hours before the performance. Tickets can be exchanged up to 24 hours before the event for a ticket of equal or greater value, subject to availability. Booking conditions: Children under 5 are not admitted to performances, and latecomers are only seated if the technical setup allows, with no refunds or exchanges provided for late arrivals.

Name: Delicia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by proprietor Nicole Harlan-Oprisu, Delicia is a New Latin restaurant in the SoBro neighborhood of Indianapolis.
The kitchen blends culinary influences from Spain, the Americas, and the Caribbean to present modern interpretations of ancestral recipes.
The signature Fire and Ice cocktail features a three-chili ice ball that slowly melts to increase the heat of a hibiscus, basil, and habanero margarita.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Kloof Street House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Kloof Street House is a restaurant and bar set within a Victorian building in Cape Town's Gardens neighborhood, with a menu overseen by Executive Chef Jurgen Snyman.
The space is characterized by its vintage decor, a fireplace, and an outdoor courtyard garden.
A signature item on the menu is the baked Camembert, served warm with fig jam and toasted baguette slices.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 24-hour cancellation policy applies. In the event of a late cancellation, no-show, or failure to notify changes, the full deposit per cancelled or absent guest will be held. A deposit or prepayment may be requested to confirm the reservation. For dinner reservations, if the restaurant is unable to contact you to reconfirm by 4pm on the day of the booking, the reservation will be released.

Name: Sushi Samba
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the 51st floor of the St. Regis Palm Jumeirah, Sushi Samba Dubai is a dining destination designed by architecture firm CetraRuddy.
The restaurant merges Japanese, Brazilian, and Peruvian culinary traditions while offering 360-degree panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and city skyline.
The dining room features an 11,000-piece 3D-printed bamboo ceiling installation that sets the stage for signature dishes like the Asevichado roll.

Name: The Guild
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by EatX founder Tom Arnel, The Guild is a 20,000-square-foot dining destination located within Dubai's financial district.
The venue draws inspiration from classic New York and European brasseries, uniting four distinct culinary spaces under a single roof.
Diners transition from daytime service among the potted trees of The Nurseries to evening meals centered around a live wood-fire grill in The Salon.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND
