Name: Geranium
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Rasmus Kofoed, Geranium is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant located on the eighth floor of the Parken national football stadium in Copenhagen.
The kitchen serves a completely meat-free tasting menu that highlights foraged and seasonal Scandinavian ingredients through precise, modern techniques.
The elevated dining room provides guests with panoramic views over the adjacent Fælledparken gardens and the city skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Your reservation will be final once you have completed the deposit payment of 1,500 DKK per guest. The guest count you select is binding — reductions after booking will not result in a partial refund of the deposit. Cancellations must be made at least 72 hours prior to the reservation.

Name: 10 Greek Street
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Cameron Emirali and wine expert Luke Wilson, 10 Greek Street is a modern European restaurant in London's Soho.
The space features parquet floors and an open kitchen, centering around a daily changing, seasonal blackboard menu.
Guests can request the little black book, a hand-written ledger offering an extended selection of rare and special wine vintages.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: théa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the sixth floor of The Global Ambassador hotel in Phoenix, théa is a Mediterranean rooftop restaurant developed by restaurateur Sam Fox.
The dining room and outdoor lounge provide an elevated vantage point with direct sightlines to Camelback Mountain.
The culinary program focuses on shareable mezzo platters, lamb, and regional Mediterranean dishes served across the open-air patio.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Should your plans change, please let us know 24 hours before your reservation time. For parties of 6 or more, a fee of $25 per person will be charged for no-shows or cancellations within 24 hours of the reservation time. We do require a credit card to secure the reservations for all parties of 6 or more.

Name: The Chairman
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by owner Danny Yip, The Chairman is a restaurant in Central, Hong Kong, that secured the top position on the 2026 Asia's 50 Best Restaurants list.
The kitchen focuses on ingredient-led Cantonese cuisine, avoiding MSG and relying on locally sourced produce from its own organic farm.
Its signature dish is the steamed flowery crab, prepared with aged Shaoxing wine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We may require that you provide your credit card information to make a reservation or to pay us a deposit. Your booking confirmation will secure your table reservation for up to 15 minutes from the reserved time. If you fail to arrive at the Restaurant before the expiry of such 15 minutes for whatever reason, your reservation will be treated as a ‘no show’. You agree to give us at least 72 hours notice if you intend to cancel or change your reservation. Such notice must be given to us through our online reservation system, or by email to: reservations@thechairmangroup.com. There shall be no refund of deposit paid if cancellation or change is notified to us for less than 72 hours before the reserved time. Any deposit paid shall be forfeited by us in the event of a “no show” for whatever reason. We reserve the right to cancel any booking, and in that case, the deposit paid shall be refunded.

Name: Bloom
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Albany, Bloom Boutique Bar & Eatery is a modern dining concept from Ryan Jankow and Rob Malkus, the operators behind City Line Bar & Grill.
The restaurant focuses on New American small plates and shareable dishes served in a botanical-themed dining room.
The menu highlights globally inspired items, including ahi tuna nachos, Cuban bao, and smoked burrata panzanella.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made a minimum of 48-hours in advance. If you do not show up for your reservation or you cancel after 48 hours then you will lose your deposit. For groups over 10ppl cancellations must be made a minimum of 10 days in advance.

Name: Hotel Swexan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Harwood District of Dallas, Hôtel Swexan is a boutique property developed by Harwood International with design by Kengo Kuma.
The interiors integrate Swiss design principles with Texan cultural elements across the guest rooms and public spaces.
The property features five dining venues and a fitness level equipped with wet and dry saunas, a cold plunge, and a rooftop pool.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A charge of 1 night (including tax) will be taken at the time of booking. You can cancel for free up to 4pm (local time), the day before arrival. After this, you’ll be charged for one night’s stay plus tax.

Name: BAO
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Erchen Chang, Shing Tat Chung, and Wai Ting Chung, BAO King's Cross is a Taiwanese restaurant and bakery in London's Pancras Square.
The wood-panelled interior by Macaulay Sinclair draws inspiration from Asia's Western-style cafes and Yoshoku cuisine.
The space features private KTV rooms and a bakery counter serving the signature salted egg custard Sad Face Bao.

Name: Liberty Common
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Developed by Amaranth Hospitality and designed by Powell Architecture and Building Studio, Liberty Common is a Southern brasserie in downtown Nashville's SoBro district.
The space blends European café traditions with regional comfort food, offering a light-filled dining room just steps from Broadway.
The menu features a mix of French and Southern dishes, including steak frites, duck cassoulet, and hot chicken, alongside a weekend brunch with bottomless mimosas.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations of 6 or more require a credit card. This card will only be charged in the event of a cancellation within 24 hours of the scheduled arrival of your party.

Name: Ara
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Aldgate East, Ara is an all-day dining space from Turkish-born restaurateur Murat Kilic, the operator behind Amber and Route.
The restaurant features a borderless menu that blends Middle Eastern culinary foundations with international flavors gathered from Kilic's travels.
The kitchen focuses on cross-cultural plates, offering signature items such as blackened leeks with XO sauce and adana lamb skewers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Leche de Tigre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Nicky Ramos Chavez, Leche de Tigre is a Peruvian restaurant located in Barcelona's Sarrià-Sant Gervasi district.
The kitchen focuses on the full repertoire of traditional Andean and coastal cuisine, pairing classic plates with craft cocktails.
The namesake signature dish arrives in a crystal tumbler, featuring citrus-cured fish and mussels topped with battered calamari rings on a cocktail stick.

Name: Fismuler
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chefs Nino Redruello and Patxi Zumárraga of the Familia La Ancha group, Fismuler is a modern Spanish restaurant with outposts in Madrid, Barcelona, and Lisbon.
The dining experience centers on market-driven Mediterranean dishes served in a stripped-back, industrial-style space.
The menu features distinct signature items, including a large breaded escalope and a three-cheese cake made with a touch of blue cheese.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to guarantee the reservation, and the reservation must be reconfirmed via email or SMS link. A penalty fee of 15 euros per person is charged for no-shows or late cancellations.

Name: Shanghai Me
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by architect Michele Bönan for Fundamental Hospitality, Shanghai Me is a Pan-Asian restaurant with locations in Dubai, Doha, and London.
The dining rooms draw on 1930s Art Deco aesthetics, pairing warm velvet seating with detailed bamboo accents.
The kitchen prepares regional dishes, serving signature plates like yellowtail carpaccio and miso black cod alongside a dedicated sushi counter.

Name: East City Grill & Yakiniku
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a hemp-constructed building in Cape Town's District Six, East City Grill & Yakiniku is a dual-concept restaurant from Hemporium founder Duncan Parker.
The space merges a South African steakhouse with a Japanese barbecue experience, featuring sustainable materials and paper-globe lighting.
Diners can order flame-grilled local Wagyu or partake in the yakiniku ritual by cooking premium cuts themselves at tabletop grills.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Restaurant may keep deposit if you cancel or reduce party size within 48 hours.

Name: Clarette
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Alexandra Petit-Mentzelopoulos of the Château Margaux family, Clarette is a French restaurant and wine bar in London's Marylebone.
Set within a Tudor townhouse with an art deco interior, the venue pairs an extensive Francophile wine list with seasonal French dishes.
A dedicated Château Margaux Experience offers guests a guided tasting of four distinct wines from the family estate.

Name: CDMX Tacos
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Billy Sengupta following a corporate career in Mexico City, CDMX Tacos is a fast-paced taqueria located in a Soho alleyway.
The grab-and-go spot focuses on a concise menu of Mexican street food, offering just four taco varieties served on hand-pressed corn tortillas.
The hole-in-the-wall space features red-and-white Coca-Cola branding and a standing-room-only counter for guests.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Delamina Marylebone
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by artist and chef Limor Chen alongside her husband Amir, Delamina brings health-conscious Eastern Mediterranean cooking to London.
The menu reflects Limor’s Tel Aviv upbringing, focusing on vegetable-centric plates, aromatic spices, and charcoal-grilled meats.
Signature dishes include a kohlrabi carpaccio topped with feta and pistachios, alongside smoky aubergine paired with warm pita.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required to secure the booking. Cancellations made with less than 48 hours' notice and no-shows will incur a charge of £35 per guest.

Name: City Social
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the 24th floor of London's Tower 42, City Social is a modern British restaurant operated by chef Jason Atherton.
The dining room features art deco interiors and serves a menu that integrates European and Asian culinary techniques.
Guests experience panoramic views of the surrounding skyline while ordering cocktails from the adjacent Social 24 bar.

Name: Berber & Q Shawarma Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on London's Exmouth Market, Berber & Q Shawarma Bar is a Middle Eastern restaurant from chef Josh Katz and co-founder Mattia Bianchi.
The space channels Levantine cafe culture, offering a focused menu of rotisserie meats, vegetable mezze, and natural wines.
Guests dine in Moroccan-tiled nooks while enjoying signature dishes like slow-cooked lamb shawarma roasted over charcoal and wood.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bao
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Shing Tat Chung, Erchen Chang, and Wai Ting Chung, BAO is a Michelin-recognized Taiwanese restaurant group with multiple outposts across London.
The spaces are defined by a minimalist aesthetic and a precise menu of small plates.
The signature pork belly steamed buns remain a constant draw, while select venues also feature private karaoke rooms.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bar Douro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Max Graham, Bar Douro City is a Portuguese restaurant and wine bar situated in Broadgate's Finsbury Avenue Square.
The laid-back dining room specializes in petiscos and regional small plates, supported by an extensive list of imported Portuguese wines.
The interior is distinctly defined by traditional blue and white azulejo tiles that line the walls and the dining counter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required to secure bookings for tables of 4+ (London Bridge) or 5+ (City), with no upfront deposit. A £20 per person fee applies for no-shows. For group bookings, 72 hours' notice is required for cancellations; late cancellations, no-shows, or date changes within 72 hours incur a £20 per person charge. For private hires, deposits are non-refundable if cancelled within 7 days of the booking.

Name: Chapel Market Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by the Michelin Guide, Chapel Market Kitchen is a neighborhood restaurant in London's Islington led by chef-owner Maoz Alonim.
The flexible Mediterranean menu evolves regularly, focusing on fresh oysters, a raw bar, and grilled cuts.
Produce sourced directly from the street stalls outside frequently dictates the daily dishes, accompanied by a robust wine list.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Dover Street Counter
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by former Soho House COO Martin Kuczmarski, Dover Street Counter is a diner and bar in London's Mayfair.
Operating as the casual sibling to neighboring restaurant The Dover, the space pairs a soundtrack of 90s R&B with a menu of global comfort food.
Guests dine along a long steel counter, ordering from a dedicated menu of eight margaritas and regional Italian dishes like spaghetti all’assassina.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: £25 per person fee for no-shows or late cancellations.

Name: Carmela's Pizzeria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Carmela's is an East Coast-inspired pizzeria in London's Islington neighborhood, developed by the founders of the BiteTwice reviewing platform and led by Michelin-starred chef Tom Kemble.
The restaurant pays homage to classic Italian-American pizza culture, modeling its approach after the traditional New York slice shop.
The menu centers around 18-inch pies crafted from a specialized biga dough to create a thin, crispy crust.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Comptoir Café and Wine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Comptoir Café and Wine is an all-day dining venue in London's Mayfair, founded by Master Sommelier Xavier Rousset.
The space transitions from a daytime cafe serving coffee and pastries into an evening destination focused on small plates, cheese, and charcuterie.
A dedicated wine shop in the basement offers guests access to a selection of over 2,000 bottles.

Name: Copita
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened in 2011 in London's Soho district, Copita is a tapas bar recognized by the Michelin Guide for its Spanish menu.
The informal dining room focuses on traditional culinary practices, offering a frequently changing seasonal menu paired with over twenty varieties of sherry.
Patrons gather around counter-height wooden tables to share classic small plates such as grilled octopus and churros.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Coburg Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within The Connaught in London's Mayfair, the Coburg Bar is a quiet lounge focusing on rare whiskies and classic cocktails.
Paris-based designer India Mahdavi updated the historic space by reupholstering the room's original wingback chairs in jewel-toned velvet.
Black-and-white cameo portraits by British artist Julian Opie hang directly on the dark wood paneling beside the fireplace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Darjeeling Express
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Asma Khan in London's Soho, Darjeeling Express is a Michelin-recognized Indian restaurant that was featured on Netflix's Chef's Table.
The menu draws directly from Khan's royal Mughlai ancestry and her upbringing in Kolkata, focusing on regional dishes and street food.
The kitchen is entirely staffed by an all-female team of South Asian immigrants who prepare these recipes without formal culinary training.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require CC details for all bookings - No booking will be completed without CC details. A confirmation email will be sent to you 48 hours prior to your booking. We ask that any cancellation to your reservation be made no less than 24 hours prior. For no shows or late cancellations, you will be subject to: a fee of £30 per person that will be applied to the cc on file. For Covid related cancellations within the 24h period, we require a screenshot of the reported COVID-19 lateral flow test result confirmation provided by gov.uk to be sent to info@Darjeeling-express.com. A picture of the test itself won't be sufficient to trigger a refund of the cancellation fees. We apologise for any inconvenience this may cause.

Name: Cavita
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by El Bulli-trained chef Adriana Cavita, this Michelin-recognized restaurant brings regional Mexican cuisine to London's Marylebone neighborhood.
The menu draws from diverse culinary traditions across the country, centering its preparation methods around a traditional open-fire kitchen.
Guests can order signature dishes like corn-fed chicken with mole amarillito or visit the subterranean mezcal bar inspired by Yucatán archaeological sites.

Name: Dzo Viet Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by The Guardian, Dzo Viet Kitchen is a modern Vietnamese restaurant on Upper Street in Islington, London.
The brightly lit, cream-colored dining room balances raw brickwork with potted rubber plants and rattan lampshades shaped like wide-brimmed straw hats.
Alongside street food dishes like crispy salted egg prawns blanketed in a rich sauce, the venue features a basement karaoke room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Brigadiers
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the City of London, Brigadiers is an Indian restaurant and sports pub operated by the Michelin-recognized hospitality group JKS Restaurants.
The space is modeled after the historic army mess bars of India, focusing on tandoor-roasted meats, Indian smokers, and live sports broadcasts.
Alongside self-serve beer taps and on-tap cocktails, the venue features a dedicated whisky vending machine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or amendments must be made at least 24 hours prior to the booking. A cancellation charge of £50 per person applies for no-shows or cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation time. Card details are required to secure the booking.

Name: Baudry Greene
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened by Will Palmer and Ian Campbell of neighboring restaurants The 10 Cases and Parsons, Baudry Greene is a café and cocktail bar in London's Covent Garden.
The venue transitions from a daytime spot serving French patisserie to an evening destination focused on European small plates.
The menu features an 'nduja sausage roll with Epping Forest honey dressing alongside pre-batched classic cocktails.

Name: Delamina Townhouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Covent Garden, Delamina Townhouse is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant from husband-and-wife team Amir and Chef Patron Limor Chen.
The menu focuses on health-conscious cooking, using grilling and roasting techniques to highlight regional herbs across meat, seafood, and vegetarian dishes.
The Georgian townhouse retains its original period features, while the bar serves house cocktails infused with the same aromatic ingredients used in the kitchen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 48 hours' notice is required for cancellations. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £35 per guest.

Name: Carlotta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Marylebone, Carlotta is an Italian-American trattoria operated by the Paris-based Big Mamma Group.
The restaurant pays homage to 1980s dining with an interior featuring leather booths, framed family photos, and a heavy velvet curtain at the entrance.
The menu centers on large portions of traditional dishes, highlighted by a signature 800-gram rib-eye served on the bone.

Name: Bun House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Z He and Alex Peffly, Bun House Disco is a Cantonese restaurant and late-night eatery in London's Shoreditch.
The interior is modeled after a 1980s downtown Hong Kong drinking den, offering a menu of hot steamed buns, spicy wontons, and cocktails.
A central item is the signature squirting custard bao bun, a sweet staple that pairs with the venue's cold beer.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Chargal
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chargal is a three-storey Turkish-Mediterranean restaurant located in London's Mayfair, developed by restaurateur Serdar Demir of The Mantl.
The Berkeley Street venue unites a dedicated ground-floor mezze space, a formal dining room, and a late-night lounge under one roof.
The culinary team relies on traditional open-fire cooking techniques to prepare a menu of seasonal regional dishes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Brother Marcus
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateurs Tas Gaitanos and Alex Large, Brother Marcus is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant located in the YY London building at Canary Wharf.
The all-day dining space features an open kitchen, textured walls, and terracotta accents that create a taverna setting.
Signature menu items include a blackberry-infused Marvo Daiquiri and a baklava sandwich filled with pistachio ice cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For groups of up to 22 guests, we require card details to secure the booking. Final numbers must be confirmed at least 24 hours in advance. Any cancellations made within the 24-hour cancellation window will be subject to a £15 charge per person. For groups of 23+ guests we require a £20 per person deposit to secure the booking, which is refundable up to 72 hours before the booking. Please note that our cancellation policy may vary during the festive season.

Name: Breddos Tacos
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by former street-food traders Nud Dudhia and Chris Whitney, Breddos is a modern Mexican taqueria in London's Clerkenwell neighborhood.
The menu centers on regional tacos and tostadas made with daily salsas and fresh corn tortillas, accompanied by a dedicated mezcal list.
Diners order signature items like the masa-fried chicken taco while vinyl records spin in the dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Farm Shop Wine Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located beneath a Mayfair deli, Farm Shop Wine Bar is an underground venue created by Artfarm, the hospitality arm of gallery Hauser & Wirth.
The space pairs a European wine list with artisanal cheeses and charcuterie sourced directly from the owners' Durslade Farm in Somerset.
The snack menu features a Somerset cheese and leek toastie, offered alongside Swiss cheese varieties that nod to the founders' heritage.

Name: Clerkenwell Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Clerkenwell, this sustainable cafe is led by chefs Emma and Laura, whose backgrounds include River Cottage and La Fromagerie.
The kitchen focuses on ethically sourced European fare, building menus around organic produce, free-range meats, and line-caught fish from artisan farmers.
Beyond the dining room and secluded garden terrace, the team makes all their jams, chutneys, and fresh lemonade from scratch.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Cloth
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked into a Grade II listed building near London's Smithfield Market, Cloth is a wine-focused neighborhood restaurant helmed by chef Tom Hurst, formerly of Brawn.
The dining room pairs an extensive wine list with a pared-back menu of ingredient-led British cooking.
Housed in a structure that survived the Great Fire of London, the kitchen serves regional specialties like Dorset crab and Somerset lamb.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require credit card details for all reservations to protect against no-shows and cancellations with less than 24 hours notice. We will always do our best to rebook your table but in case this is not possible you may be charged a cancellation fee.

Name: Dream Xi'an
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Tower Hill, Dream Xi'an is a regional Chinese restaurant opened by Chef Guirong Wei, recently featured on Netflix's Chef's Table.
The kitchen focuses on the street food of China's northwestern Shaanxi province, emphasizing regional spice profiles and hand-pulled doughs.
A signature dish is the cold skin liangpi noodles, which are made from steamed starch paste and served with chicken and sesame sauce.

Name: Booking Office 1869
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the original ticket hall of London's St. Pancras Station, Booking Office 1869 is a restaurant reimagined by award-winning designer Hugo Toro.
The space functions as a Victorian Gothic winter garden, repurposing the historic ticket office into a central bar.
Every afternoon, a bartender rings a bell to commence a punch ritual, sharing local history while distributing 19th-century train tickets.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Franco's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1945, Franco's is one of London's oldest Italian restaurants, located on Jermyn Street in St James's and helmed by Head Chef Stefano Turconi.
The venue offers all-day dining and features a British racing green awning with continental-style pavement seating.
Guests can order from a curated cigar list on the heated outdoor terrace or finish their meal with the classic tiramisu.

Name: Cubé
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Cubé is a Japanese sushi and tapas restaurant in London's Mayfair, overseen by owner-chef Takamasa Mogi.
The ground-floor dining room serves traditional omakase and seasonal plates prepared with locally sourced ingredients.
Hidden beneath the main space is the Kakurega Bar, a twelve-seat basement venue serving rare sake, Japanese whisky, and a specialized oden menu.

Name: Dovetale
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within London's 1 Hotel Mayfair, Dovetale is a modern restaurant led by two-Michelin-starred chef Tom Sellers.
The bright dining room pairs natural wood finishes and abundant indoor greenery with a produce-led menu focused on reimagined European classics.
A signature tableside Knickerbocker Glory trolley allows guests to design their own custom ice cream sundaes to finish the meal.

Name: Condesa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Masterplanned by architect José Luis Cuevas in the 1920s, La Condesa is a residential neighborhood in Mexico City known for its Art Deco architecture.
The district is defined by its walkable, tree-lined boulevards, sidewalk cafés, and public parks.
At its center lies Parque México, an oval-shaped green space with winding paths that trace the footprint of a former horse racing track.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Blacklock
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Gordon Ker, Blacklock City is an award-winning chophouse located in the City of London.
Set within a subterranean former electricity substation, the restaurant focuses on sustainably sourced meats cooked over charcoal.
The menu features a signature 'All In' platter of mixed chops, followed by white chocolate cheesecake served tableside from a large bowl.

Name: Enoteca Super Tuscan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a narrow alleyway in London's Spitalfields, Enoteca Super Tuscan is an Italian wine bar and kitchen operated by Nick Grossi.
The galley-style space features parquet flooring, exposed brickwork, and booth seating, serving as a backdrop for sharing plates of bruschetta and penne with guanciale.
The cellar highlights non-traditional red blends from Tuscany, while early evening weeknight guests receive complimentary aperitivo snacks.

Name: Cantinetta Antinori
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1957 by the Antinori winemaking family, this restaurant occupies the ground floor of the 15th-century Palazzo Antinori in Florence.
The dining room focuses on traditional Tuscan gastronomy, pairing regional specialties with a broad selection of the estate's own vintages.
Housed within the palazzo's vaulted former cellars, the space serves signature dishes like the crostini della Cantinetta in a historic Renaissance setting.

Name: Fifth Floor at Harvey Nichols
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located atop the Knightsbridge department store, the Fifth Floor at Harvey Nichols is a multi-concept dining destination featuring outposts from operators like Zelman Meats and chef Aldo Zilli.
The open-plan space encompasses a café, an alfresco terrace, and a cocktail bar, serving as a culinary counterpart to the fashion collections.
Guests can bypass the shopping levels entirely by taking a dedicated express lift straight to the top.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Dim Sum Duck
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Dim Sum Duck is a family-owned Cantonese restaurant in London's King's Cross neighborhood, recognized by the Michelin Guide.
The compact dining room and pavement gazebo focus on a wide-ranging menu of handmade dim sum and traditional roast meats.
Patrons regularly form long queues outside to order signature dishes like the xiaolong bao and steamed cheung fun.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Fowl
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's St James's neighborhood, FOWL is a sustainable chicken restaurant created by chefs Will Murray and Jack Croft of the Fallow team.
Set in a former gastropub, the beak-to-feet concept focuses on utilizing the entire bird, sourcing only pasture-raised, soy-free chickens from regenerative farms.
The menu features a signature fried chicken burger coated in hot cheese sauce alongside a chicken fat crème caramel dessert.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We operate a strict cancellation policy of £50 per person should the reservation be cancelled within 48 hours of the booking. To secure large group bookings, a deposit of £20 per person is required. We have a 30-day cancellation policy for Group Bookings. Cancellations made within 30 days of your booking will result in the deposit being retained in full.

Name: Chisou
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operating in central London since 2002, Chisou is a Japanese restaurant group owned by Saga Japanese Restaurants and recognized by The Infatuation.
The wood-paneled dining rooms specialize in izakaya-style service, pairing traditional sashimi and sushi with an extensive 16-page sake menu.
The kitchen's signature Horenso salad combines baby spinach and spicy rock shrimp in a yuzu dressing.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A £20 per cover deposit is required on all bookings. The deposit is removed from your bill when you dine. In case of cancellation less than 48 hours, the deposit is non-refundable.

Name: Bancone
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized with a Michelin Bib Gourmand, Bancone is an Italian restaurant with locations across London, including its original Covent Garden site.
The dining experience centers around an open kitchen where chefs prepare a focused menu of fresh pasta each day.
Guests sit at the namesake counter to watch the preparation of signature dishes like the silk handkerchiefs, served with walnut butter and a confit egg yolk.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For reservations of 2 or more people, credit card details are required to secure the reservation. No deposit is taken when the reservation is made. If a reservation is not cancelled at least 3 hours prior to the reservation time, £25 per person will be deducted from the card added to the reservation. To cancel a private dining room reservation, 14 days notice is required via email. After the 14 days prior to the reservation, the deposit is non-refundable but the reservation can be rescheduled to a future date.

Name: Coya
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in London's financial district, COYA City is a contemporary Peruvian restaurant and pisco bar from restaurateur Arjun Waney's global hospitality group.
The glass-walled venue features a Latin American-inspired dining room and courtyard that transition from daytime service to evenings with live music.
The menu centers on South American dishes, highlighted by sea bass ceviche and an extensive library of homemade pisco infusions.

Name: Bellanger
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by The Wolseley Hospitality Group, Bellanger is a French-inspired brasserie situated on London's Islington Green.
The all-day dining room evokes the atmosphere of a Parisian grand café, offering a menu of Mediterranean-leaning seasonal dishes.
Recognized by the Michelin Guide, the space features frosted glass windows, antique mirrors, and sage green accents, with red awnings stretching over the pavement.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you need to cancel your booking, just let us know online or by phone, and there won’t be any charge. Please note, for no-shows, a £15 fee per person will apply for both lunch and dinner reservations for reservations of 6 people or more.

Name: Compagnie des Vins Surnaturels
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by hospitality collective Experimental Group, Compagnie des Vins Surnaturels is a wine bar with outposts in Paris, London, and New York.
The venues pair an extensive list of global vintages with French and Mediterranean small plates in a comfortable, lounge-like setting.
Guests can partake in the signature mystery wine challenge, where correctly identifying a blind-tasted glass rewards them with the entire bottle.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Boxhall
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Metropolitan Arcade near Liverpool Street, Boxhall City is a food and drink hall developed by the Boxpark team and designed by Macaulay Sinclair.
The 14,000-square-foot venue brings together 14 distinct kitchens, two bars, and live entertainment under one roof.
The project revitalizes a 1912 structure, allowing guests to pair international street food with live sports broadcasts and late-night cocktails.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Any cancellations within 24 hours of the booking time will not be eligible for a refund.

Name: BAO
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Shing Tat Chung, Erchen Chang, and Wai Ting Chung, BAO is a Michelin-recognized Taiwanese restaurant group in London.
The spaces feature minimalist, wood-paneled interiors that complement a focused menu rooted in Taiwanese street food traditions.
Diners order via paper checklists, selecting charcoal-grilled dishes and the signature Classic Pork Bao made with pork, peanut powder, and fermented greens.

Name: Farang
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a former electric company building in Stockholm, Farang is a Michelin-recommended Southeast Asian restaurant founded by chefs Kim Öhman, Tomi Björck, and Matti Wikberg.
The softly lit dining room features a large open kitchen and serves shared plates inspired by Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia.
Guests enter through the building's original front doors to order signature dishes like crying tiger beef and Vietnamese-style sashimi.

Name: Burger and Lobster
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 2011 in London's Mayfair by Misha Zelman and three school friends, Burger and Lobster is a dining concept that has since expanded globally.
The restaurant centers its menu entirely around two core ingredients, pairing prime Nebraskan beef with wild Atlantic lobsters.
Live lobsters are kept in large on-site tanks, and the signature meat is often served in a toasted brioche roll.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A deposit of R100 per guest is required to secure your reservation. A 100% refund will be given for any cancellation or modification made no later than 48 hours prior to your booking. In the case of a late cancellation, no notification of alteration, or a no-show, the full deposit per cancelled or absent guest will be held. Tables are held for 15 minutes before being given away. Special events require 72 hours to 7 days notice for a full refund.

Name: Myrtle
Master_Aurora_Insights: INCOMPLETE — Missing: Exact location, identity of the destination, defining character, and concrete details.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: IMPORTANT—We operate a strict 24-hour cancellation policy for tables of 1-6 guests. For tables of 7 or more guests, we require a 48-hour notice. A cancellation fee of £50 per person will apply in the event of a no-show or cancellation made less than 24/48 hours of your reservation

Name: Mriya
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on the southern coast of the Crimean Peninsula, Mriya is a coastal resort designed by British architect Sir Norman Foster.
The property is defined by its lotus-inspired architecture, which houses extensive wellness facilities, a medical center, and a traditional Japanese garden.
A central pool extends toward the Black Sea to form the shape of a petal, anchoring the structure to the surrounding natural topography.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If canceled up to 21 days before date of arrival, no fee will be charged. If canceled later or in case of no-show, 100% of the brought payment is charged.

Name: German Gymnasium
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Redesigned by Conran and Partners, German Gymnasium is a grand café and restaurant operated by D&D London within a Grade II-listed 1865 athletics facility in King's Cross.
The historic space functions as an all-day dining room focused on classic Mittel-European cuisine.
The menu highlights regional specialties such as Nürnberger sausages, thick-cut veal schnitzel, and seasonal Weisser Spargel.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If cancelling less than 24 hours, there is a charge of £25pp for 2 or more people Tuesday to Saturday.

Name: Jam Delish
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by siblings Jordan and Chyna Johnson, Jam Delish is a plant-based Caribbean restaurant and cocktail bar located in London's Angel district.
The kitchen focuses on recreating traditional family recipes entirely without the use of animal products.
A signature dish features vegan fried jerk chicken served alongside Jamaican gravy, garlic mashed potatoes, and confit hispi cabbage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Jacuzzi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Jacuzzi is a four-story Italian restaurant on West London's Kensington High Street, operated by the Paris-based hospitality company Big Mamma Group.
The maximalist space features Sicilian baroque-inspired interiors spread across the floors of a converted townhouse.
Guests dine beneath a retractable glass roof and a giant disco ball, ordering signature dishes such as lobster risotto and Neapolitan pizzas.

Name: Homeboy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by 50Best Discovery, Homeboy is a modern Irish cocktail bar in London's Islington neighborhood, founded by Dublin-born bartender Aaron Wall.
The speakeasy-style space pairs bare brick walls and leather banquettes with a relaxed atmosphere driven by an RnB and hip-hop soundtrack.
Alongside a menu of original cocktails, the bar serves a signature Grogan’s-style cheese toastie designed to accompany a proper pint of Guinness.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets cannot be exchanged or refunded after purchase. Tickets are sold subject to the venue or promoter's right to alter or vary the programme due to events or circumstances beyond its control without being obliged to refund monies or exchange tickets. For table bookings, tables are held for 15 minutes after the booking start time; if the venue does not hear from the party, the booking is given away. Full venue hire is 100% refundable 2 days before the event.

Name: Koya
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Shuko Oda and restaurateur John Devitt, Koya Soho is a Japanese noodle bar located in central London.
The space focuses on freshly made udon and dashi served to diners seated along a long blond wooden counter.
The morning menu features a selection of breakfast udon and simple porridge with pickles, alongside weekly changing blackboard specials.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Prepaid reservation required. All sales are final and non-refundable.

Name: Maresco
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Soho, Maresco is a Spanish-Scottish seafood tapas bar from Stephen Lironi, the restaurateur behind Bar Esteban and Escocesa.
The menu highlights Scottish catches, including Isle of Barra razor clams and Hebridean langoustines, prepared using traditional Spanish techniques.
Guests sit at the open kitchen counter to order the signature Bomba Maresco, a deep-fried sphere of Shetland mussels served over fennel sofrito.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require credit card details for all bookings. In the event of a no show, or a late cancellation within 3 hours of the booking, there will be a charge of £30 per person.

Name: Hoppers (Marylebone)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Marylebone, Hoppers is a Sri Lankan and South Indian restaurant operated by JKS Restaurants and co-founded by Karan Gokani.
The interior draws inspiration from the Tropical Modernist movement of Sri Lankan architect Geoffrey Bawa, utilizing natural wood and stone.
The menu centers around its namesake dish, a bowl-shaped crepe made from fermented rice flour and coconut milk batter served alongside various karis.

Name: Hoppers (Shoreditch)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in East London's Tea Building, Hoppers Shoreditch is a Sri Lankan and South Indian restaurant operated by JKS Restaurants.
The kitchen expands the brand's original focus by blending traditional Sri Lankan recipes with regional dishes from the South Indian coast.
Dishes created specifically for this location include a crab curry omelette served with nool paratha and a paneer-filled benne dosa.

Name: Lilibet's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created by former Nobu executive chef Ross Shonhan, Lilibet's is a new seafood restaurant located in London's Mayfair.
Occupying the birthplace of Queen Elizabeth II and named after her childhood nickname, the kitchen focuses entirely on British coastal produce.
The dining room features Delft-tiled walls, hand-painted murals, and woven horsehair panels inspired by vintage Louis Vuitton trunks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask that any cancellations or amendments to your reservation be made no later than 24 hours in advance. Reservations cancelled within 24 hours of your booking time or in the event of a no-show, will incur a £50 per person charge, which will be applied to the card provided at the time of booking. Please note that, as this policy is in place to protect availability for all guests, we are unfortunately unable to waive these charges or transfer reservations to future dates under any circumstances. Please note, we offer a 15-minute grace period for later arrivals.

Name: Il Portico
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1967 by the Chiavarini family, Il Portico is London's oldest family-run Italian restaurant, located in Kensington.
The neighborhood destination specializes in regional cuisine from Emilia Romagna, maintaining a traditional approach to dining.
The menu centers on recipes passed down through generations, featuring dishes like nutmeg and walnut gnocchi and wild mushroom risotto.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Goodman City
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Goodman City is an American-style steakhouse located in the City of London, recognized by the Harden's restaurant guide for its popularity among the local business crowd.
The dining room features a New York aesthetic defined by dark wood panelling, low-hanging pendant lamps, and leather-seated booths.
Steaks are prepared in an on-site dry-ageing room before being cooked over a charcoal grill.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Llerena
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designated as a Historic Artistic Site, Llerena is a whitewashed town in Spain's Extremadura region that formerly housed the Grand Masters of the Order of Saint James.
The historic quarter is defined by a dense concentration of palaces and convents that integrate Gothic, Mudejar, and Baroque architectural styles.
The local Convent of Santa Clara preserves original artwork by the Spanish Baroque sculptor Juan Martínez Montañés.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: MEATLiquor
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near Oxford Circus, MEATliquor W1 is the central London flagship of the burger and cocktail brand founded by Scott Collins and Yianni Papoutsis.
The space pairs US-style comfort food with graffiti-covered interiors, neon lighting, and a loud soundtrack.
Guests can order the signature Dead Hippie burger and summon Jägermeister directly to their table at the push of a button.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Godet
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Godet is a wine bar and listening room in Islington, London, from Sylvain Bertozzi, the operator behind Hackney's Binch.
The space updates the traditional British pub format by pairing natural wines and rotating craft beers with a music-focused atmosphere.
The venue is recognizable by its peachy-pink exterior and checkered curtains, which give way to an interior of candlelit wooden booths.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Jikoni
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Marylebone neighborhood, Jikoni is a Michelin-recognized restaurant founded by chef and author Ravinder Bhogal.
The kitchen serves a "no borders" menu blending Asian comfort food with British, East African, and Middle Eastern influences to reflect the founder's mixed heritage.
Guests dine in a domestic-style interior while ordering signature dishes like the prawn toast Scotch egg with banana ketchup.

Name: Naroon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Named after a culinary suburb in northern Tehran, Naroon is a contemporary Persian restaurant with locations in London's Fitzrovia and Marylebone.
The dimly lit dining rooms pair a jazz soundtrack with a menu of Persian small plates and traditional stews.
Signature offerings include the shishlik lamb chops, jujeh chicken with crispy rice, and a saffron gin and tonic.

Name: Fredericks
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Rhubarb Hospitality Collection, Frederick's is a dining and drinking destination housed within the former Grand Hotel Esplanade at Berlin's Sony Center.
The venue reflects the city's 1920s Belle Époque era through Parla-designed interiors, multiple lounge areas, and a modern European menu.
Guests dine and drink amidst preserved architectural details from the original 1907 hotel, most notably the historic Kaisersaal room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Maset
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Maset is a French Mediterranean bistro on London's Chiltern Street, opened by restaurateur Melody Adams of Basque restaurants Lurra and Donostia.
The menu focuses on the coastal cuisine of southern France's Occitanie region, incorporating Spanish, Italian, and North African influences.
The off-white, mirror-lined space centers around a stainless steel bar and solid wood chairs modeled after 1950s seaside brasserie seating.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
1. Bookings up to 8 guests in the main dining room (non private and non semi-private hire): In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 24 hours notice, a cancellation fee of £25 per person will apply. 
2. Bookings of more than 8 guests in the main dining room: For these bookings, a £500 deposit is required at the time of reservation. This will be deducted from the final bill. If the booking is not honoured or cancelled with less than 72 hours notice the deposit will be forfeited and non-refundable. 
3. All private and semi-private hire bookings: We require a pre-payment for all our large bookings which is the minimum spend, service charge and hire fee (if applicable). In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less that 14 days notice, a cancellation fee of £1000 will apply. In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less that 7 days notice, a cancellation fee of the full prepayment will apply. 
4. Party size: we kindly ask our guests to confirm the party size 72 hours prior to their event time, after which the pre order will be submitted to the kitchen. A reduction made after the 72 hours cut off will be charged in full. 
Cancellation fees will be automatically charged to the credit card provided during the reservation process.

Name: Hanwoo Village
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Islington neighborhood, Hanwoo Village is a contemporary Korean barbecue restaurant led by Chef Jin Kyung Jeon.
The kitchen focuses on carefully sourced halal cuts, including Japanese wagyu and Australian beef, served within a calm, Hanok-inspired setting.
A defining ritual of the dining experience is the signature beef tartare, which is prepared tableside by the chef.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Leydi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Leydi is a modern Turkish restaurant located within the Hyde London City hotel, directed by Turkish-Cypriot chef Selin Kiazim.
The menu reflects the food culture of Istanbul, focusing on meze spreads, mangal-grilled meats, and heritage grain wood-fired breads.
The weekend brunch features a shared feast highlighted by house-made sucuk and menemen served alongside unlimited Turkish tea.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations and no-shows within 24 hours of the reservation may incur a charge of £50 per person.

Name: Juno Omakase
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked behind a curtain within Los Mochis in London's Notting Hill, Juno Omakase is a six-seat dining room led by Executive Chef Leonard Tanyag.
The restaurant presents a fifteen-course menu that fuses Japanese sushi techniques with Mexican flavor profiles, while remaining entirely gluten-free and nut-free.
The daily changing courses incorporate a personal collection of spices gathered by the chef during his travels between Japan and Mexico.

Name: Mayha
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Relocated from Beirut by the Nothing But Love hospitality group, Mayha is a Japanese omakase restaurant in London's Marylebone recognized by the Michelin Guide.
Executive chef Jurek Wasio leads the culinary program, serving a highly seasonal tasting menu focused on precise technique and extensive nigiri preparations.
The dining room centers around an 11-seat curved wooden counter illuminated by tree-inspired lighting.

Name: Kebab Queen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located beneath Maison Bab in London's Covent Garden, Kebab Queen is a restaurant led by Michelin-trained chef Manu Canales alongside Ed Brunet and Stephen Tozer.
The ten-seat space focuses on a multi-course tasting menu that applies fine-dining techniques to the kebab.
During the plateless service, each course is prepared and served directly onto a heated countertop in front of guests.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Any changes or cancellations to the reservation must be made at least 15 days prior to the reservation date. Reservation deposits are non-refundable, but transferable to a future reservation under the 15-day agreement. For no-shows or late cancellations, we will be unable to transfer deposits onto a future reservation.

Name: Kutir
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Chelsea townhouse, Kutir is an Indian restaurant led by Michelin-starred chef Rohit Ghai and co-founder Abhishake Sangwan.
The menu draws inspiration from India’s royal hunting expeditions, focusing on regional tasting menus and seasonal ingredients.
Guests ring a doorbell to enter the dining room, which features a central bar and signature dishes like slow-cooked Laal Maas lamb shank.

Name: Kioku by Endo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the rooftop of The OWO in London, Kioku by Endo is a Japanese restaurant helmed by Michelin-starred chef Endo Kazutoshi.
The menu merges the chef's Yokohama heritage with Mediterranean culinary techniques, served in a dining room designed by Pirajean Lees.
Guests can dine inside one of the building's historic turrets or order the signature lunchtime Kioku Bento presented in traditional boxes from Japan.

Name: Marta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened by restaurateur Bechara Aoun, Marta is an Italian restaurant in London's Chelsea neighborhood dedicated to Roman-style pizza.
The dining room is defined by hand-crafted solid wood interiors, a travertine bar, and a central wood-fired oven.
To create the signature crisp base, chefs prepare the pizzas by hand-rolling the dough with a traditional mattarello before baking them in the hearth.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No shows and cancellations made within less than 24 hours will be subject to a $75/per person fee.

Name: Lanzhou Lamian Noodle Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by The Infatuation, Lanzhou Lamian Noodle Bar is a casual Chinese eatery near London's Leicester Square known for its made-to-order noodles.
The utilitarian space features stark lighting, shared tables, and a mini buffet counter at the front.
Diners can watch the chef pummel and twirl dough into round, slippery hand-pulled la mian or flat, chewy knife-cut dao xiao mian.

Name: Los Mochis
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Los Mochis is an agricultural city in the Mexican state of Sinaloa, recognized as the primary gateway to the Copper Canyon.
Founded around the sugar cane industry by American businessman Benjamin Francis Johnston, it serves as the western terminus for the Chihuahua al Pacífico railway.
The city's name derives from the Cahitan word for earth turtle, referencing the small flowers of the local Boerhavia coccinea plant.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We understand that plans can change; however, we kindly request guests with reservations of up to 4 people to cancel at least 24 hours in advance, and for groups of 5 or more, at least 48 hours prior. Otherwise, a £45 per person cancellation or no-show fee may apply. Events and private dining cancellation fees and charges may differ.

Name: Mr LoBo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Upper Street in Islington, Mr Lobo is a family-run Peruvian restaurant and cocktail bar operated by chef Miguel and his partner Katya.
The dining room functions as a tapas bar, focusing on sharing plates that highlight the culinary heritage of Latin America.
The kitchen prepares regional staples such as ceviche and lomo saltado, served alongside a dedicated menu of classic pisco sours.

Name: Le Café du Marché
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a converted Clerkenwell warehouse, Le Café du Marché is an independent London restaurant helmed by executive chef Simon Cottard, who trained under the Roux brothers.
The family-run establishment serves provincial French cuisine within a rustic dining room defined by bare brick walls and original wooden beams.
Guests share classic dishes like the signature côte de bœuf with béarnaise sauce accompanied by live jazz performances.

Name: Gunpowder
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Harneet Baweja, Gunpowder Spitalfields is a modern Indian restaurant in East London that holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand.
The compact 20-cover dining room features bare brick walls and focuses on regional family recipes served as sharing plates.
Standout menu items include a spicy venison and fenugreek doughnut alongside the signature Kashmiri lamb chops.

Name: Mount Koya
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Koya is a religious settlement in Japan's Wakayama Prefecture, founded in 816 by the monk Kukai.
The mountain enclave is defined by its active monastic community, where visitors stay in traditional temple lodgings and observe daily ascetic practices.
A stone path through Okunoin, Japan's largest cemetery, winds past centuries-old cedars and over 200,000 moss-covered stupas toward Kukai's mausoleum.

Name: Kapara
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Soho, Kapara is an all-day Eastern Mediterranean restaurant created by chef Eran Tibi, the founder of Bala Baya.
The venue pairs a sharing-focused menu of modern Israeli plates with a sleek interior defined by high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Signature dishes include the Aubergine Mess and beef fillet skewers glazed with maple syrup and pomegranate molasses.

Name: Lucky Cat
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Mayfair, Lucky Cat is an Asian-inspired restaurant and late-night lounge created by chef Gordon Ramsay.
Designed by studio AfroditiKrassa, the jet-black interiors reference the drinking dens of 1930s Tokyo and Shanghai.
The space centers around an open kitchen and raw bar, where chefs prepare dishes like seared Orkney scallop and Korean spiced black cod.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings of 6+ guests require card details to confirm your reservation. In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 48 hours' notice a cancellation fee of £30 per person will be charged to the card. Please note that special terms & conditions may apply for key seasonal dates.

Name: Morito
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Morito is a compact tapas and mezze bar in London's Clerkenwell, created by chefs Sam and Sam Clark as the casual counterpart to their adjacent restaurant, Moro.
The spartan space features a daily changing menu focused on the culinary traditions of Spain and North Africa.
Diners gather in the petite dining room to share signature plates like crispy aubergine with whipped feta and date molasses.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Kolamba East
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Eroshan and Aushi Meewella, Kolamba East is a Sri Lankan restaurant in London's Spitalfields featuring interiors by Fare Inc. that reference architect Geoffrey Bawa.
The space centers around a large bar, setting a relaxed stage for sharing plates that highlight traditional island recipes.
Signature dishes include a hot butter soft shell crab and whole rib jaggery beef marinated in unrefined sugar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ixchel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Named after the Mayan goddess of the moon, Ixchel is a Mexican restaurant and tequila bar on London's King's Road helmed by head chef Ximena Gayosso.
The menu introduces coastal Mexican cuisine to Chelsea, focusing on regional ingredients and traditional cooking techniques.
The interior won a LIV Hospitality Award for design and features a dedicated tequila bar alongside visual references to the Yucatán.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Marjorie's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by critics including Grace Dent, Marjorie's is a Parisian-inspired cave à manger located just off Carnaby Street in London's Soho.
The compact dining room pairs a minimalist, pale-wood aesthetic with a single-page wine list focused on lesser-known French communes.
Signature dishes include crab tartlets with ruby red bisque and brown butter poached chicken served alongside deliberately al dente rice.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Mon Plaisir
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1943 and now operated by the Lauro family, Mon Plaisir is London's oldest family-run French restaurant, located in Covent Garden.
The classic brasserie serves traditional French cuisine across four dining rooms decorated with vintage posters and memorabilia.
One distinct feature of the space is its original zinc bar, which was salvaged from a brothel in Lyon.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Junsei
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Marylebone neighborhood, Junsei is a Japanese yakitori restaurant founded by chef Aman Lakhiani.
The dining room draws inspiration from Tokyo’s listening bars, pairing a curated soundtrack with a zero-waste culinary approach.
Every part of the chicken is grilled over white-hot binchotan charcoal, and signature skewers are dipped in a master sauce that has been continuously replenished for fifty years.

Name: Mister Nice
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by entrepreneur JP Kley, Mister Nice is a French restaurant in London's Mayfair led by former Barrafina head chef Javier Duarte.
Designed by Victoria Vogel, the monochrome dining room pairs Riviera-inspired aesthetics with a menu of classic Parisian comfort food.
A secret corridor connects the space to Kley's nearby private members' club, Nikita, and the kitchen prepares signature dishes like Gruyère-loaded coquillettes pasta.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Mei Ume
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by AB Concept, Mei Ume is an Asian restaurant located within the Four Seasons Hotel London at Ten Trinity Square.
The space operates with a dual-kitchen concept, offering a menu that focuses on both Chinese and Japanese culinary techniques.
The kitchen prepares a signature Peking duck, serving it alongside a selection of sushi, dim sum, and Australian abalone.

Name: Lucky Baldwins Pub
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by David Farnworth and Peggy Simonian in 1996, Lucky Baldwins Pub is a British watering hole located in one of the oldest buildings in Old Pasadena.
The establishment is known for its extensive selection of international draft beers, with a particular focus on rare Belgian Trappist ales.
The traditional pub menu features a signature fish and chips alongside savory pot pies baked with a flaky pastry crust.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bottarga
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized with a chef's hat by The Age Good Food Guide, Bottarga is a modern restaurant in the Melbourne suburb of Brighton.
The menu combines Italian cooking techniques with Asian influences and local Australian produce.
The recently expanded two-storey venue centers around an open kitchen and features a wine list awarded two glasses by the Australian Wine List of the Year.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or reschedules within 24 hours of your reservation will incur a fee of $65 per person. No-shows will incur a fee of $100 per person. Bottarga London applies a £50.00 cancellation charge.

Name: Serra
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Serra is a Mediterranean restaurant within Mayfair's Chancery Rosewood, operating under the direction of chef de cuisine Alex Povall.
The menu focuses on Southern Mediterranean cooking, offering shareable plates that highlight seasonal ingredients from European purveyors.
The AvroKo-designed dining room features a natural palette of stone and rattan, where guests share signature dishes like crispy pancetta flatbread topped with smoked burrata.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Bistro at Bleeding Heart
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Robert and Robyn Wilson, The Bistro at Bleeding Heart is a French restaurant set within a historic courtyard in London's Clerkenwell district.
The space features exposed brick walls and an extensive wine cellar that pairs with a menu of traditional French dishes.
Guests can dine outdoors in the 19th-century yard or descend into the building's underground crypt for private magnum dinners.

Name: Thenga Cafe
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located inside the Central YMCA near King's Cross in London, Thenga Cafe is a canteen-style vegan eatery.
The daytime spot focuses on spice-inspired Indian and European fare, serving as a casual dining space for the surrounding Bloomsbury neighborhood.
The menu centers around home-cooked Bengali thalis featuring a daily rotation of plant-based curries.

Name: The July
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originating in Amsterdam, The July is an apartment-hotel brand whose London Victoria location was named Time Out's best boutique hotel for 2025.
The properties blend residential independence with hotel amenities, providing equipped kitchens alongside dedicated co-working spaces, fitness centers, and wellness areas.
At the London outpost, designed by interior architecture studio Fettle, guest rooms feature Smeg appliances and Marie-Stella-Maris toiletries.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Refundable rate: If cancelled or modified up to 1 day before date of arrival until 2PM, no fee will be charged. If cancelled or modified later or in case of no-show, the total amount of the reservation will be charged. If cancelled or modified when the client is already in-house the total price of the reservation will be charged, no money will be refunded. The card is charged for the full amount of the reservation 1 day prior to the arrival of the client. Non-refundable rate: If cancelled or modified any moment before the arrival date or when the client is in-house, the full amount of the reservation will be charged, or the charged amount will not be refunded. The full amount of the reservation will be charged to the credit card on file once the booking has been made. Security Deposit: Upon arrival we reserve the rights to charge a security deposit by means of an authorization on the credit card. The amount of the deposit (€ 200) will be temporarily withheld from your spending limit.

Name: Zuma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Rainer Becker, Zuma Miami operates as a contemporary Japanese izakaya in Downtown Miami.
Designed by Tokyo-based Noriyoshi Muramatsu, the waterfront dining room incorporates natural textures and overlooks the Miami River.
The culinary program centers around a robata grill, producing signature plates like sliced yellowtail with green chili relish, ponzu, and pickled garlic.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations require valid card details and have a 24-hour cancellation policy. For parties of 8 people and above, a deposit of 50€ per person is required, which is redeemed to your bill on the day. Reservations cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice will result in a charge of 50€ per person to the card provided, or the deposit will be retained. Experience packages and large groups have special terms and conditions and cancellation policies shared by the events team prior to booking. In the event of severe weather conditions, the restaurant reserves the right to move your party to an alternative date.

Name: William IV
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near City Road in Islington, William IV is a 200-year-old pub recently revitalized by operators Lee Godwin and Mike Harrington, formerly of Mare Street Market.
The restored venue balances a traditional ground-floor bar with a formal upstairs dining room dedicated to regional British fare.
The menu highlights ingredients from suppliers like Wright Brothers and Swaledale Butchers, featuring dishes such as a Guinness-glazed beef short rib.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Audley Public House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Artfarm and restored by architecture studio Laplace, The Audley Public House is a Victorian pub located in London's Mayfair.
The menu centers on classic bar snacks and Sunday roasts, utilizing beef and lamb sourced directly from the group's farm in Somerset.
Recognized in the 2026 Guinness Harp Guide, the pub features a site-specific, collaged ceiling installation created by British artist Phyllida Barlow.

Name: Prawn on the Lawn
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by husband and wife duo Rick and Katie Toogood, Prawn on the Lawn is a Michelin-recognized fishmonger and seafood restaurant with outposts in London and Padstow.
The kitchen focuses on sustainably caught local fish prepared as tapas-style sharing plates.
The namesake signature dish consists of avocado on toast topped with fresh prawns and chili.

Name: Plaquemine Lock
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Plaquemine Lock is a Louisiana-inspired pub situated along Regent's Canal in Islington, London, opened by chef Jacob Kenedy of Bocca di Lupo.
The waterside venue pairs a traditional British pub setting with a menu dedicated to Cajun and Creole cuisine.
Signature dishes include okra gumbo and blackened chicken, served alongside draft beer, New Orleans-style cocktails, and live jazz performances.

Name: Totti's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the Lorne Hotel, Totti's Lorne is a beachside Italian restaurant operated by Merivale and led by executive chefs Mike Eggert and Matt Germanchis.
The menu centers on produce-driven plates designed for sharing in a relaxed coastal environment.
Meals typically begin with the staple wood-fired bread, often paired with a Charlie Chaplin cocktail mixed with gin and Davidson plum.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: dLeña
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Washington D.C.’s Mount Vernon Triangle, dLeña is a modern Mexican restaurant from chef Richard Sandoval that earned recognition in the Michelin Guide.
The menu centers on "leña," or firewood, using open flames to impart smoky flavors into its grilled dishes.
This wood-fired technique extends to the beverage program, which highlights a selection of smoked mezcal and tequila cocktails.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To better serve you with securing a reservation for your desired time, a credit card is required to secure your reservation. Cancellation fees may apply for no-show reservations or cancelations within 24 hours.

Name: Pophams Bakery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ollie Gold in 2017, Pophams Bakery is an independent cafe and bakehouse in London's Islington neighborhood.
The kitchen focuses on the precise technique of lamination, producing intricate pastries and fresh sourdough that draw a steady local following.
A standout is the signature maple and bacon pastry, which folds sweet and savory elements into crisp, layered dough.

Name: Portrait Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located inside The Fifth Avenue Hotel in New York City's NoMad neighborhood, The Portrait Bar is a wood-paneled cocktail destination overseen by Bar Director Darryl Chan.
The space functions as a contemporary drawing room, offering a menu of travel-inspired cocktails and bar snacks.
Guests gather around a carved stone fireplace in a room lined with a collection of framed portraits.

Name: Yasmin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the sixth floor of 1 Warwick in London's Soho, Yasmin is a rooftop restaurant and bar helmed by executive chef Tom Cenci.
The dining room and wraparound terrace offer city views alongside a menu of sharing plates inspired by the markets of Istanbul.
Signature dishes include slow-braised lamb with bulgur keskek and whipped sheep's cheese topped with hot honey and isot biber.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Tendril
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Rishim Sachdeva, Tendril is a mostly vegan restaurant in London's Mayfair district that was featured in Condé Nast Traveller's 2026 dining guide.
The kitchen maintains a plant-first approach, avoiding heavily processed meat alternatives to highlight the natural qualities of fresh vegetables.
Guests can explore the full range of the vegetable-driven concept by ordering the signature Discovery Set Menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A £20 per person cancellation fee applies for late cancellations or no-shows. For group dining, a £20 per person upfront payment is required to secure the booking. Cancellations or changes in guest numbers are accepted no later than 7 days before the day of the reservation. After that, the deposit is non-refundable.

Name: Toum
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by architecture studio Gundry & Ducker, Toum is a modern Lebanese rotisserie and cocktail bar located in London's Mayfair district.
The menu incorporates French culinary techniques into traditional Middle Eastern recipes, centering on shared plates and roasted meats.
The signature rotisserie chicken is marinated and roasted in-house, accompanied by crisp pickles and the restaurant's namesake garlic sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Supawan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by the Michelin Guide, Supawan is a Southern Thai restaurant in London's King's Cross led by Phuket-born chef Wichet Khongphoon.
The kitchen focuses on the regional recipes of Southern Thailand, served within an understated dining room accented by floral arrangements.
A signature offering is the moo hong, a slow-cooked pork belly dish often paired with the restaurant's house-infused gins.

Name: Origin City
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by executive chef Graham Chatham, Origin City is a nose-to-tail British restaurant in London's West Smithfield, operated by the Landsberg family.
The menu relies on a farm-to-table model, sourcing heritage-breed meats from the founders' 600-acre organic farm in Argyll, Scotland.
This closed-loop sourcing extends beyond meat, incorporating seafood from their sister aquafarm, Loch Fyne Oysters, and wines from their organic vineyard in Provence.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Santa Maria Pizzeria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Neapolitan operators Pasquale Chionchio and Angelo Ambrosio, Santa Maria Pizzeria serves traditional Naples-style pizza on Islington's Upper Street.
The kitchen relies on regional Italian ingredients, baking its dough in a wood-fired oven imported directly from Italy.
Signature options include the San Mattia, which features a classic base topped with Buffalo mozzarella DOP, mushrooms, truffle oil, and parmesan shavings.

Name: Studio Amaro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Melbourne suburb of Windsor, Studio Amaro is a dual-level Italian restaurant and basement bar helmed by head chef Daniel Migliaccio.
The main floor focuses on communal dining, serving hearty Italian share plates in a contemporary setting.
Signature dishes like the casarecce Trapinese and veal cotoletta anchor the menu, while the subterranean bar plays Italian disco late into the night.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Thirty7
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Covent Garden, Thirty7 is an all-day brasserie from Matt Lovell and Rob Hampton, the founders of seafood restaurant The Oystermen.
The kitchen blends culinary influences from New York and Paris, focusing on modern European snacks, small plates, and larger sharing dishes.
Signature items include a spicy crab rarebit with Lincolnshire Poacher cheese and the '37' raclette burger.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: we will ask for your credit card details when you place a booking. You will not be charged to secure the booking but there will be a £20 charge for no-shows and last minute cancellations to cover the losses incurred. Your card details are held securely by a third party. If you do need to cancel or amend your booking, please do so through your booking confirmation email or by emailing us at reservations@oystermen.co.uk.

Name: Tamila
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Holding a Michelin Bib Gourmand, Tamila is a South Indian restaurant in London from the team behind gastropubs The Tamil Prince and The Tamil Crown.
The kitchen focuses on the regional cuisine of Tamil Nadu, providing a modern update to the traditional curry house.
Signature plates include the Thanjavur chicken curry and paneer tikka served with pineapple chutney.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: £35 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: The Sea, The Sea
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Alex Hunter with a menu by executive chef Leandro Carreira, The Sea, The Sea is a fishmonger and seafood bar in Chelsea.
The venue operates as a retail market during the day before transitioning into a seated dining space at night.
The kitchen serves a daily changing menu of small plates utilizing day-boat British catch sourced directly from its own wholesale operation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card hold of £30 per person is required to secure your indoor reservation.

Name: The Draper's Arms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Owned by Nick Gibson, The Draper's Arms is an 1830s gastropub located in the London neighborhood of Islington.
The venue functions as both a neighborhood pub and a full-service restaurant, dividing its space between a ground-floor bar and an upstairs dining room.
The upper level features high ceilings, chandeliers, and a checkerboard floor, while the kitchen serves an award-winning Scotch egg and suet crust pies.

Name: Sushi Kyu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Soho, Sushi Kyu is a ten-seat sushi bar operating as the sister restaurant to Mayfair's Cubé under head chef Mogi.
The menu centers on traditional omakase dining built around seasonal ingredients sourced directly from their places of origin.
Diners can pair their courses with a tasting flight of three sakes or sample dishes like French squid nigiri finished with yuzu zest.

Name: The Oystermen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateurs Matt Lovell and Rob Hampton, The Oystermen Seafood Bar and Kitchen is a Covent Garden destination that won the Observer Food Monthly Award for Best Restaurant.
The sea-shack-inspired space specializes in ethically sourced oysters and fresh British seafood delivered directly from the coast.
A staple of the menu is the signature sourdough bread served with seaweed butter presented in an oyster shell.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please note: we will ask for your credit card details when you make a booking. You will not be charged to secure the booking but there will be a £20 charge for no-shows and last minute cancellations to cover the losses incurred. Your card details are held securely by a third party. If you do need to cancel or amend your booking, please do so through your booking confirmation email or by emailing us at reservations@oystermen.co.uk.

Name: Yamashiro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Nono, Yamashiro Miami is an expansion of the century-old Hollywood restaurant located on the rooftop of the Gale Miami Hotel and Residences.
The kitchen focuses on Japanese cuisine, serving a menu of sushi, sashimi, hot plates, and both American and Japanese Wagyu.
Guests dine among pagodas and skyline views while ordering signature dishes like the corvina ceviche and king crab handrolls.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 2 hrs before your reservation, you will need to confirm with a deposit. Your table will be held for 15 mins.

Name: Sala de Despiece
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by chef Javier Bonet and designed by OHLAB, Sala de Despiece is a modern tapas bar in Madrid recognized by The World's 50 Best Discovery.
The space mimics a traditional market cutting room, featuring an industrial aesthetic with communal counter seating and ingredient-driven dishes.
Servers prepare much of the menu directly in front of guests, using personal blowtorches to caramelize ingredients at the counter.

Name: The Barlow Mow
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The Barley Mow Mayfair is a restored landmark gastropub at 82 Duke Street, Mayfair, London, part of the Cubitt House group, near Grosvenor Square and Bond Street.
Head Chef Director Ben Tish leads a first-floor restaurant serving rare breed meats carved tableside on a carvery trolley, plus theatrical flambéed desserts including crêpe suzette and baked Alaska.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Chimba
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Midtown Miami, Chimba is an all-day Latin American restaurant marking the first United States outpost for Argentine hospitality company Grupo Alfoz.
Executive chef Kevin Acosta surveys the culinary traditions of Argentina, Mexico, and Peru through dishes like picanha al fierro.
The space features artwork by Amadeo Seguy and Paulina Guajardo, anchored by a neon sign by the bar reading "We are all Chimbas".

Name: N17 The Lane
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by a husband-and-wife team, N17 The Lane is a gastropub and sports bar located in the Culver City neighborhood of Los Angeles.
The venue serves as a dedicated gathering space for Tottenham Hotspur fans, pairing live match broadcasts with a menu of contemporary American fare.
Signature dishes include the N17 Burger, which features a chuck, brisket, and short rib blend topped with bacon onion jam and spicy aioli.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Mayfair Chippy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near Harrods, The Mayfair Chippy Knightsbridge is the second outpost of the award-winning British seafood brand.
The restaurant refines the standard chip shop format, serving fresh oysters, crab, and fried fish in a skylit dining room with blue banquettes and marble tables.
A signature dish is the Kedgeree Scotch Egg, which coats a golden yolk in smoky spiced rice and comes with curried mayonnaise.
