Name: 5th Street Boxing with Dino
Master_Source_text: In Miami Beach, 5th Street Boxing with Dino is rooted in the 5th Street Gym revived by coach Dino Spencer with Angelo Dundee in 2010, the successor to the Dundee brothers’ original gym where Muhammad Ali trained. Spencer’s program draws active pros and national teams, with Paulie Malignaggi, James DeGale, and David Haye among those who have trained there, as well as Olympic squads from Australia and Azerbaijan. Now on Alton Road after the original site was bought by CVS, the gym is lined with black‑and‑white photos from the Ali era, and Spencer once preserved the second‑floor window from the old gym—later stolen—as a piece of its history.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The World Famous 5th Street Gym, founded in 1950 by Chris and Angelo Dundee, is a historic boxing institution at 1019 5th Street, Miami Beach, Florida.
Boxing, BJJ, Muay Thai, personal training, group sessions, and cardio classes are offered 7 days a week.
Over 10 professional undefeated fighters, 3 world champions, and the BKFC 155lb champion Luis Palomino train at the facility.

Name: 69 Leonard St
Master_Source_text: 69 Leonard Street is a Michelin-starred Edomae sushi counter in Manhattan led by Amakusa-born, Tokyo-trained chef Shion Uino. The omakase is served at a counter and centers on product sourced primarily from Japan, including seafood obtained directly from fishermen in Uino’s hometown of Amakusa. Dinner is Monday–Saturday with two seatings at 6:00 pm and 8:30 pm, and the progression often features a signature hairy crab dressed with Japanese black vinegar.

Name: African Queen
Master_Source_text: African Queen is a Saint-Tropez outpost on Place des Lices from the Beaulieu-sur-Mer restaurant founded in 1969. It brings a Mediterranean menu of fresh fish and grilled meats alongside house staples such as the 1969 truffle pizza. One enduring detail: the traditional Nicoise salad is prepared tableside with tuna ventresca, and fish courses are served with a baked potato and chive cream.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1969 on the port of Beaulieu-sur-Mer, African Queen is a French Riviera restaurant recently revitalized by restaurateur Riccardo Giraudi.
The Mediterranean dining room pairs a harborside setting with a refreshed interior by Monegasque design firm Humbert & Poyet, featuring woven rattan, burnt wood, and emerald green tiles.
The menu highlights regional flavors through signature dishes like wood-fired truffle pizza and traditional Niçoise salad.

Name: Achnagairn Castle
Master_Source_text: Achnagairn Castle in Kirkhill, seven miles from Inverness, is an exclusive-use Highland estate operated by Perfect Manors and holds a VisitScotland 5-star rating. The castle sleeps up to 55 across 24 bedrooms, while seven Mini Manors 200 metres away add a further 38 bedrooms for group stays. Its vaulted ballroom accommodates up to 200 for dinner or 260 for drinks and dancing.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Achnagairn Castle is a five-star, exclusive-use Highland estate in Kirkhill, Inverness-shire, Scotland, set on 30 acres just 12 kilometers from Inverness city centre.
Amenities include a home cinema, sauna, hot tub, free Wi-Fi, free parking, pet-friendly policy, and complimentary breakfast for all guests.
Table Manors Restaurant serves award-winning cuisine; resident chefs hold AA Two Rosettes and won the Highlands and Islands Food and Drink Restaurant of the Year 2018.
The castle offers 24 bedrooms sleeping 55, many with four-poster beds and whirlpool baths, plus a vaulted ballroom seating 200 for dinner or 260 for drinks, and 7 Mini Manors with 38 additional rooms.

Name: Acamaya
Master_Source_text: In the Bywater, New Orleans, Acamaya is a contemporary Mexican seafood restaurant from sisters Ana and Lydia Castro; it was named to Bon Appetit's 20 Best New Restaurants of 2025. Its menu leans mariscos: ceviches, aguachiles, Gulf fish, shaped by Mexico City roots and New Orleans ingredients. One concrete order: Arroz Negro with Creole tomato, clams, squid, and shrimp.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Acamaya is a Michelin-recognized Mexican seafood restaurant in New Orleans, owned by James Beard Award semifinalist chef Ana Castro and her sister Lydia.
The menu focuses on coastal Mexican mariscos, serving hot and cold dishes in a space designed by architecture firm Farouki Farouki.
Castro lives directly above the restaurant to receive daily shrimp deliveries that arrive exclusively between 5:00 and 6:30 a.m.

Name: Adam/Albin
Master_Source_text: Adam/Albin is a Michelin-starred Stockholm restaurant from chefs Adam Dahlberg and Albin Wessman. The kitchen runs a tasting format rooted in Nordic produce with global influences, with elements finished tableside. A distinctive ritual: after an initial round of snacks, guests choose the five courses they will be served.

Name: 727 Pilates Studio
Master_Source_text: Set in Miami’s Little River district, 727 Pilates Studio was conceived by interior designer Arantxa Salazar. It runs Reformer and Mat Pilates and offers members bookable access to the Sanctuary—an on-site infrared sauna and cold plunge. Its Reformer classes integrate a Pilates Chair, a rarity in most Miami studios.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by interior designer Arantxa Salazar, 727 Pilates Studio is a wellness space located in Miami's Little River district.
The concept blends physical movement with recovery, offering small-group Reformer and Mat Pilates classes in a space with tactile finishes and moody lighting.
Beyond the workout, the studio integrates a Pilates Chair into its Reformer sessions and features infrared saunas and a cold plunge pool.

Master_Source_text: 888 is a Japanese restaurant and vinyl listening lounge in downtown Nashville. It combines a sushi bar and vinyl listening setup with a menu of nigiri, maki and sashimi plus donabe fried rice and chicken karaage, and a drinks list spanning Japanese whiskies, craft beers, cocktails and a sake program. Guests get four hours of complimentary valet at JW Marriott Nashville, and the restaurant keeps late hours with a dedicated L888NITE menu.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at the base of Nashville's JW Marriott tower, 888 is a Japanese restaurant and vinyl lounge operated by Turnberry with interiors by Commune Design.
The space functions as a modern jazz kissa, pairing a high-fidelity sound system with a menu overseen by Master Sushi Chef Kiichi Okabe.
A combined sushi bar and DJ stand wrapped in tiles by illustrator Sofía Londoño anchors the dining room.

Name: A'riva
Master_Source_text: a'Riva is a seasonal Italian restaurant at Harbour Club in Sunset Harbour, Miami Beach, led by executive chef Michele Esposito. The restaurant uses tropical greenery, rich woods and subdued lighting, with abundant outdoor seating and a bar serving late-night amaros. Dishes include bluefin crudo with watermelon gazpacho, insalata verde and spaghetti alla branzino, with members and non-members welcome to dine.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the Sunset Harbour neighborhood of Miami Beach, a'Riva is an Italian restaurant helmed by executive chef Michele Esposito.
The kitchen focuses on seasonal Mediterranean plates and seafood dishes that draw direct influence from the coastal regions of Italy.
Before dinner service begins, the light-filled dining room operates as Casa Caracas, a separate daytime culinary concept.

Name: AIR
Master_Source_text: AIR is a private members club by Seaspice, set above the waterfront brasserie on the Miami River. Shaped by superyacht cues with teak-lined floors, chrome portholes and an outdoor terrace offering 180-degree river views, with membership by invitation.

Name: Albi
Master_Source_text: Albi is a Michelin-starred restaurant in Washington DC Navy Yard from chef-owner Michael Rafidi, winner of the James Beard Foundation's 2024 Outstanding Chef award. The kitchen focuses on Levantine flavors through a live-fire wood-burning hearth and Sofra five-course tasting menu.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Michael Rafidi, Albi is a Michelin-starred restaurant in Washington, D.C., focused on modern Palestinian cuisine.
The kitchen relies on a live-fire, wood-burning hearth to prepare seasonal Mid-Atlantic ingredients using traditional Middle Eastern techniques.
Diners can choose from an à la carte selection or the Sofra tasting menu, which features dishes like coal-fired mushroom hummus and brown butter knafeh.

Name: Agora
Master_Source_text: Agora is a Greek souvla bar on the edge of Borough Market in London, created by David Carter and located beneath sister restaurant OMA. A vast charcoal rotisserie drives skewers of native-breed chicken, lamb and pork, alongside wood-fired flatbreads and seasonal meze, and the restaurant holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand.

Name: Aleli Roof Top
Master_Source_text: Aleli Rooftop is an open-air, live-fire restaurant on the third-floor roof above Lorea in Roma Norte, Mexico City, led by chef Oswaldo Oliva, recognized with a Bib Gourmand by the Michelin Guide. The kitchen centers on a wood-and-charcoal parrilla using macadamia wood.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognised with a Michelin Bib Gourmand, Alelí Rooftop is an open-air restaurant by chef Oswaldo Oliva in Mexico City's Roma Norte neighbourhood.
The terrace focuses on traditional Mexican cuisine prepared over a wood-fired grill, filling the space with the scent of burning embers.
Diners can sit at the bar to watch the cooks at work before ordering the zarandeado fish loin and the signature roasted cheesecake.

Name: Ahana Yoga
Master_Source_text: Ahana Yoga is a Miami Design District studio founded by Dawn Feinberg, recognized in Miami New Times as Best Yoga Studio 2024. Its programming includes Ahana Flow and Ashtanga practice and a partnership with W South Beach's AWAY Spa.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by yoga instructor Dawn Feinberg, Ahana Yoga is a dedicated studio space located in the Miami Design District.
The curriculum blends the formal, breath-based principles of Ashtanga with creative sequencing to offer a variety of classes.
Practitioners gather for the signature Ahana Flow sessions, which are accompanied by curated music, and a weekly Sunday Service ritual.

Name: Alpha Hydration & Wellness
Master_Source_text: Alpha Hydration & Wellness is a Los Angeles IV therapy provider founded by ER physician Dr. Jon Prince. It delivers IV vitamin infusions, hydration and booster shots across categories including athletes, travel and jet lag, with treatments at home or in-clinic.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Alpha Hydration & Wellness is an IV hydration and wellness clinic founded in 2018, located at 5353 Topanga Canyon Blvd, Suite 300, Woodland Hills, Los Angeles, California.
Services include IV vitamin infusions, IV hydration, vitamin booster shots, NAD+ add-ons, BHRT pellet therapy, ozone therapy, weight loss, and beauty injections, using USA-sourced vitamins and normal saline.
The clinic operates the Hydrenergy IV Lounge in-suite and offers a retail vitamin store; no named restaurant, bar, or entertainment venue is associated with this property.
The entire 3rd-floor suite serves as the clinic space; concierge mobile service is available to homes, workplaces, and caretaker locations across greater Los Angeles.

Name: Agua Sal
Master_Source_text: Aguasal is the coastal Mediterranean restaurant at Andaz Miami Beach from Jose Andres Group. Its menu focuses on seafood and pan-Mediterranean preparations, from grilled sea bream and seared cobia with braised fennel to a chicken tagine with couscous.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Rodrigo Estrada, Agua y Sal Cebichería is a seafood restaurant located in the Polanco neighborhood of Mexico City.
The kitchen focuses on Latin American coastal cuisine, offering a menu anchored by traditional Caribbean and South American recipes.
Diners can explore regional flavor profiles through a signature ceviche tasting flight paired with a house Pisco Sour.

Name: Alara
Master_Source_text: Alara is a modern Mediterranean restaurant and bar in Georgetown, Washington DC from restaurateur Hakan Ilhan. The menu centers on Turkish and Greek dishes with Levantine influences, open until 2am on Fridays and Saturdays.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by veteran restaurateur Hakan Ilhan, Alara is a Mediterranean restaurant located in the former Paolo's space in Washington, D.C.’s Georgetown neighborhood.
The kitchen highlights the culinary traditions of four Mediterranean coastal nations, offering a menu of seasonal dishes and halal options.
A standout feature is the late-night mezze program, served within a contemporary dining room designed for shared meals.

Name: Alchemy Miami
Master_Source_text: Alchemy Miami is a private-membership wellness facility in Miami Beach focused on noninvasive therapeutic technologies including a hyperbaric oxygen chamber, cryotherapy, red and infrared light treatments, PEMF, altitude training, and diagnostics.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Alchemy Miami is a private membership wellness facility situated in the South of Fifth neighborhood of Miami Beach.
The center focuses on regenerative health and longevity by harnessing natural elements including heat, cold, light, frequency, and oxygen.
Members utilize a range of noninvasive therapeutic technologies, with access to specific recovery modalities such as hyperbaric chambers, cryotherapy, and red-light therapy.

Name: Anatomy Fitness
Master_Source_text: Anatomy Fitness is a Miami health-and-wellness club co-founded by Chris Paciello and Marc Megna, with locations in Miami Beach, Midtown, Coconut Grove, and Doral.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by former NFL player Marc Megna and nightlife entrepreneur Chris Paciello, Anatomy Fitness operates multiple health clubs across Miami.
The facilities merge sports science with strength conditioning, focusing heavily on post-workout recovery alongside personalized training programs.
Members utilize the signature Wellness Sanctuary, a dedicated space equipped with hot and cold plunges, infrared saunas, and eucalyptus steam rooms.

Name: Altro Paradiso
Master_Source_text: In SoHo, Manhattan, Altro Paradiso is an Italian restaurant at 234 Spring Street led by chef Ignacio Mattos and listed by the MICHELIN Guide.

Name: Amavi (Miami)
Master_Source_text: Amavi is a New York-born Mediterranean restaurant at the Shops at Midtown Miami, led by partners Jonathan Mansour, Igor Dze, Fallou Bathily, and Francesco Campoy.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Midtown Miami, Amavi is a Mediterranean restaurant transplanted from New York and led by Chef Tolga Mutlu.
The kitchen focuses on coastal flavors, serving dishes like lamb chops glazed in pomegranate molasses and housemade mafaldine with rib ragu alongside specialty cocktails.
The space features tall archways, Venetian plaster walls, and an illuminated walkway that transitions into a catwalk when the DJ starts playing.

Name: Amara at Paraiso
Master_Source_text: Amara at Paraiso is a Biscayne Bay waterfront restaurant in Miami's Edgewater from James Beard Award-winning chef Michael Schwartz.
Master_Aurora_Insights: United States

Name: Antiquario da Marco
Master_Source_text: Antiquario da Marco is a family-run Italian restaurant in Zurich with origins dating to 2000, serving Italian classics.
Master_Aurora_Insights: Antiquario da Marco is a second-generation family-run Italian restaurant at Freiestrasse 213, Zurich, situated 10 minutes from the city center near Kreuzplatz. The kitchen serves homemade pasta in 25 fresh daily varieties, including signature Triangoli, plus fresh fish, seafood, beef, grappa, and Italian wines. The restaurant offers indoor and terrace dining seating for couples and large groups; no private event room or room count data available.

Name: Ardbeg Distillery
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1815 on Islay and now owned by LVMH, Ardbeg Distillery produces heavily peated single malts on the island's south coast.
Master_Aurora_Insights: Perched on the wild south coast of Islay since 1815, Ardbeg is one of Scotland's most storied distilleries, producing a heavily peated single malt so distinctive it has earned the title of the world's most highly awarded smoky whisky, claiming World Whisky of the Year, Scotch Whisky of the Year, and World's Best Single Malt across consecutive years. What sets Ardbeg apart is what devotees call "the peaty paradox", a whisky of intense smoke and peat that somehow yields a surprising, deep sweetness, drawing a global cult following of over 160,000 members across 130 countries united by a single mission: ensuring the doors of Ardbeg never close again.

Name: Aman Spa in The Connaught
Master_Source_text: Set beneath the Edwardian lobby of The Connaught in Mayfair, Aman Spa is Aman's first urban outpost and the brand's first spa outside an Aman resort.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Aman group, this wellness retreat is located beneath the Edwardian lobby of The Connaught hotel in London's Mayfair.
The space serves as the brand's first spa built outside an Aman resort, offering a menu of holistic, Asian-inspired therapies.
A central feature of the facility is its grotto-like swimming pool, complete with a cascading waterfall and surrounded by private treatment suites.

Name: Anna
Master_Source_text: Anna is a Greek restaurant at 63 Boulevard de la Croisette in Cannes, led by executive chef-partner Yiannis Kioroglou.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Awarded 16 Gault Millau points, Restaurant Anna is a contemporary dining space in Zurich's District 6 helmed by chef Stefano Corrado.
The minimalist urban interior features exposed concrete and simple furnishings, providing a neutral backdrop for Mediterranean and Italian cuisine.
The kitchen is recognized for its handmade pasta and seasonal dishes crafted primarily from regional Swiss ingredients.

Name: Apotheke NoMad
Master_Source_text: Apotheke NoMad is a bi-level cocktail bar in Manhattan's NoMad at 9 West 26th Street, a subterranean speakeasy connecting to a penthouse lounge.

Name: Antoine's
Master_Source_text: Established in 1840 in the French Quarter, Antoine's is the United States' oldest continuously family-run restaurant, now led by fifth-generation CEO Rick Blount.

Name: August
Master_Source_text: Restaurant August is a Contemporary Creole restaurant in a 19th-century French-Creole building in New Orleans' Central Business District, created in 2001 by chef John Besh.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Hans Christian and restaurateur Budi Cahyadi, August is a modern restaurant located in Jakarta's Sequis Tower.
Recognized as the Best Restaurant in Indonesia by Asia's 50 Best, the venue offers globally inspired tasting menus grounded in regional ingredients.
The 12-course Chef's Journey is served at an open counter that provides a direct view of the culinary team.

Name: B'artusi
Master_Source_text: B'artusi is an Italian restaurant, wine and cocktail bar at 520 Hudson Street in Manhattan's West Village from the team behind L'Artusi.

Name: Aspire Athletic Club
Master_Source_text: Aspire Athletic Club is a private fitness and training club in Guilderland, NY, founded by Chris Wertman.

Name: Arnaud's
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1918, Arnaud's is a French Quarter Creole restaurant; its French 75 Bar won the James Beard Award for Outstanding Bar Program in 2017.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Arnaud's is a historic restaurant in the New Orleans French Quarter operated by the Casbarian family and home to the James Beard Award-winning French 75 Bar.
The expansive venue focuses on traditional Louisiana Creole cuisine served alongside live jazz performances.
A staple of the menu is the signature Shrimp Arnaud, which is often paired with the kitchen's puffed Pommes Soufflé.

Name: Avra (Rockefeller Center)
Master_Source_text: Avra Estiatorio Rockefeller Center is a three-level Greek seafood restaurant from The Avra Group inside the historic Time & Life Building, with interiors by Rockwell Group.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the former Time-Life Building at Rockefeller Center, Avra is a Greek seafood restaurant designed by the Rockwell Group.
Spread across three floors, the 400-seat dining room centers around a daily display of fresh Mediterranean catch priced by the pound.
A signature starter is the Avra Chips, a stack of paper-thin, crispy fried zucchini and eggplant served with a yogurt dip.

Name: Azala
Master_Source_text: Azala Skin Clinic is a Miami-based medical spa in Coconut Grove, founded and led by Paula Brezavscek, PA-C, a Cornell graduate and clinical medicine specialist.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by an independent local owner, AZALA Lodge is a wellness retreat situated in the mountainous Mae Suai district of Chiang Rai, Thailand.
The property focuses on environmental immersion, offering panoramic views of the surrounding river, valleys, and terraced rice plantations.
Guests stay in signature Chala villas, which feature open-air terraces designed for observing the region's morning mist.

Name: Attaboy
Master_Source_text: Attaboy is a Lower East Side cocktail bar at 134 Eldridge Street, opened in 2012 by Sam Ross and Michael McIlroy in Milk & Honey's original space, named North America's Best Bar in 2017.

Name: Astoria Bar
Master_Source_text: Astoria Bar sits within Brasserie Astoria by the Frantzen Group, housed in a restored 1870s cinema at Nybrogatan 15, recognised by the MICHELIN Guide.

Name: Avante Gardner
Master_Source_text: Avant Gardner is an indoor-outdoor events complex in East Williamsburg, Brooklyn, home to The Brooklyn Mirage, The Great Hall, and The Kings Hall, ranked in DJ Mag's Top 100 Clubs 2025.

Name: Baptist Health Iceplex
Master_Source_text: Baptist Health IcePlex in Fort Lauderdale is the Florida Panthers' practice facility, a 144,000-square-foot community hub.

Name: Bar Chef
Master_Source_text: BarChef New York is the Manhattan outpost of Frankie Solarik's Toronto-born cocktail bar, set at 21 W 35th St. Solarik is a judge on Netflix's Drink Masters.

Name: Ball & Chain
Master_Source_text: Opened in 1935 on Calle Ocho in Little Havana, Ball & Chain has hosted Billie Holiday, Count Basie and Chet Baker, and was revived in 2014.

Name: Bagatelle Miami River
Master_Source_text: Bagatelle Miami South Beach is a French Mediterranean restaurant at 1669 Collins Ave, Miami Beach.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Bagatelle Miami River is a waterfront restaurant from founders Aymeric Clemente and Remi Laba, featuring menus by Corporate Executive Chef Rocco Seminara.
Designed by Sam Baron, the space blends an indoor dining room with an outdoor beach club concept inspired by the 1960s French Riviera.
Guests arriving by boat can utilize the 192-foot dock before ordering signature dishes like the stuffed potato with seasonal truffle and wild mushrooms.

Name: Ba53ment
Master_Source_text: BA53MENT is a 32-seat speakeasy and private lounge beneath 53 at 53 W 53, from Altamarea Group, set under MoMA's extended wing. It operates Tuesday-Thursday evenings.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Bachour
Master_Source_text: Bachour is a Coral Gables bakery-restaurant by chef Antonio Bachour, designated Bib Gourmand by the Michelin Guide.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by pastry chef Antonio Bachour, this Coral Gables bakery and restaurant holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand.
The establishment functions as both a contemporary dining room serving a full savory menu and an industrial-style setting for elaborate baked goods.
A central glass counter displays brightly colored tarts, macarons, and petite-gateaux finished with a signature mirror glaze.

Name: Bally's Golf Links at Ferry Point
Master_Source_text: Designed by Jack Nicklaus and operated by Bally's Corporation, this 18-hole public course in the Throgs Neck section of the Bronx is the only public course in New York City designed by a major champion.

Name: Bamford Wellness (New York)
Master_Source_text: Bamford Wellness Spa sits inside 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge and is part of the British wellness brand created by Carole Bamford, using Bamford body and skincare products.

Name: Bar Americain
Master_Source_text: Bar Americain is the cocktail bar at Brasserie Zedel in Piccadilly, housed in the restored basement of the former Regent Palace Hotel.

Name: Barry's
Master_Source_text: Barry's, founded in 1998, operates two Miami studios. Its Red Room workout alternates treadmill running and floor strength training.

Name: Bar Oliver
Master_Source_text: Bar Oliver is a Basque-leaning wine and vermouth bar from the team behind Mimi, Mr. Fong's and Casino, with a Julian Schnabel mural on the wall.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Barceloneta
Master_Source_text: Barceloneta is a Spanish Mediterranean tapas bistro in Sunset Harbour, Miami Beach, by Chef Juliana Gonzalez.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Grupo Olivé since 1996, Restaurant Barceloneta is a seafood restaurant situated along the Port Vell marina in Barcelona.
The marine-themed dining room focuses on traditional Catalan coastal cuisine prepared with catch sourced directly from local fish markets.
The kitchen is notable for serving its signature seafood paella in single portions, accompanied by direct views of the Moll dels Pescadors fishing port.

Name: Barcelona Wine Bar
Master_Source_text: Barcelona Wine Bar's Wynwood outpost in Miami is a Spanish tapas bar with a seasonal Mediterranean menu and a wine program featuring over 400 Spanish selections.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Sasa Mahr-Batuz and Andy Pforzheimer, Barcelona Wine Bar is a Spanish tapas destination that earned the 2021 Jury Prize from The World of Fine Wine.
The menu focuses on rustic Mediterranean flavors, offering shareable small plates alongside one of the largest Spanish wine programs in the United States.
Patrons pair a selection of nearly 400 wines with signature dishes like the house patatas bravas and charcuterie boards.

Name: Bar Mauro
Master_Source_text: Bar Mauro is a Roma Norte, Mexico City aperitivo bar ranked No. 14 on North America's 50 Best Bars 2025. It channels 1970s Milan in both menu and aesthetic.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Bar Mauro is an Italian aperitif-inspired cocktail lounge opened late 2024 at Tabasco 149, Roma Norte, Cuauhtémoc, Mexico City, honoring founder Mauro Mendoza's Milanese heritage.
Shelves stocked with dozens of Italian vermouths and amari, interior designed in 70s Mid-Century Modern style.
Signature cocktails include the Negroni 1929, Basilico, and Maurito; kitchen serves charcuterie, cheeses, olives, and a signature cheeseburger.

Name: Bar Kaiju
Master_Source_text: Set on the second floor of The Citadel food hall in Miami, Bar Kaiju ranks No. 77 on North America's 50 Best Bars list, dedicated to the monsters of Asian cinema.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Bathtub Gin
Master_Source_text: Opened in 2011 in Chelsea by Brooklyn-born operator Dave Oz, Bathtub Gin is a 1920s-style speakeasy named among Time Out's best speakeasy-inspired bars in New York.

Name: Berners Tavern
Master_Source_text: Berners Tavern is the restaurant at The London EDITION on Berners Street in Fitzrovia, helmed by chef Jason Atherton, with interiors by Yabu Pushelberg.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Berners Tavern is a contemporary British restaurant located within The London EDITION hotel in Fitzrovia, operating under the direction of Michelin-starred chef Jason Atherton.
The dining space features high ceilings with intricate plasterwork and taupe walls densely covered with hundreds of framed photographs and paintings.
A custom Bloody Mary trolley circulates the room every Sunday to prepare spiced, made-to-order pours directly at guests' tables.

Name: Bar Clemente
Master_Source_text: Clemente Bar is a cocktail bar and chef's counter from Daniel Humm and artist Francesco Clemente, located upstairs from Eleven Madison Park at 11 Madison Avenue.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Clemente Bar is a cocktail lounge located above the three-Michelin-starred Eleven Madison Park in New York City, created by chef Daniel Humm.
The dual-concept space pairs a main bar area with an eight-seat tasting counter, offering a plant-based menu that mirrors the restaurant below.
The interior features custom artwork by its namesake, Italian artist Francesco Clemente, including a ceiling fresco painted directly on-site above the entrance stairwell.

Name: Biograph NYC
Master_Source_text: Biograph NYC is a preventive health and longevity clinic at 27 Park Row in Manhattan's Financial District, led by Executive Medical Director Dr. Michael Doney and profiled by Robb Report.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Co-founded by longevity expert Dr. Peter Attia and entrepreneur John Hering, Biograph is a preventive health and diagnostic clinic in New York City's Financial District.
The facility pairs a spa-like design with a proactive approach to personalized medicine and early disease detection.
Members undergo a system of advanced evaluations, including full-body MRIs, DEXA scans, and VO2 max tests, to assess five core pillars of health.

Name: Biohax
Master_Source_text: Biohax Institute is a performance and regenerative medicine lab in Miami's Design District supervised by a medical team of doctors and nurse practitioners.

Name: Blue Ribbon Sushi
Master_Source_text: Blue Ribbon Sushi in SoHo is the original collaboration between chefs Bruce and Eric Bromberg and sushi master Toshi Ueki, begun in 1995. The cedar-clad space centers on a walnut sushi bar.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York's SoHo neighborhood, Blue Ribbon Sushi is a Japanese restaurant founded by chefs Bruce and Eric Bromberg with the late master sushi chef Toshi Ueki.
The space features a cedar-clad dining room and a walnut sushi bar, serving fish sourced directly from the Sea of Japan.
The menu includes the signature Toshi Roll, a direct tribute to the restaurant's founding chef.

Name: Bobo Bistro
Master_Source_text: Bobo Bistro sits in Cannes' Carre d'Or, 20 metres from La Croisette, with chef Fabrice Bellisent in the kitchen.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near La Croisette in the center of Cannes, Bobo Bistro is a Mediterranean eatery operated by Patrice Pittavino, his wife Laurine, and Stéphane Risterucci.
The kitchen focuses on seasonal Italian and French dishes crafted from fresh, organic produce, served within a 1960s-inspired vintage setting.
Curated by Laurine, a professional antique dealer, the dining room features a large shelf unit filled with multicolored reels of thread.

Name: Bethpage Black Golf Course
Master_Source_text: Set within Bethpage State Park on Long Island, Bethpage Black is a public course designed by A.W. Tillinghast that has hosted the U.S. Opens of 2002 and 2009.

Name: Blackbird Ordinary
Master_Source_text: Blackbird Ordinary is a Brickell bar and lounge at 729 SW 1st Ave, a Miami New Times Best of Miami winner for Best Ladies' Night.

Name: Bloom Spa
Master_Source_text: Bloomy Spa at Bloom House Hotel in Paris's 10th arrondissement near Gare du Nord. The hotel holds MICHELIN Guide Hotels selection.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Bloom Spa is a wellness retreat within The Sebastian, a Four Diamond hotel in Vail Village, Colorado.
The menu focuses on recovery tailored to the alpine environment, featuring treatments inspired by local wildflowers, herbs, and trees.
Signature services include the High-Altitude Adjustment Massage and the Alpenglow ritual, which combines a foot session, an earth and sea scrub, and a massage.

Name: La Cienega Tennis Center
Master_Source_text: Beverly Hills Tennis at La Cienega Tennis Center has been the city's concessionaire since 1995, recognized by the USTA as one of the nation's Outstanding Tennis Facilities.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
La Cienega Tennis Center, home of Beverly Hills Tennis, sits at 325 S. La Cienega Blvd.
16 lighted hard courts, locker rooms with showers, a full-service pro shop, secured covered parking with free 2-hour validation, and EV charging stations on site.
Beverly Hills Tennis, concessionaire since 1995, offers 90-plus hours of adult and junior group classes, USTA sanctioned tournaments, junior camps, and private lessons.
Named one of the nation's most Outstanding Public Tennis Facilities by the United States Tennis Association (USTA)

Name: Box
Master_Source_text: The Box is a Lower East Side cabaret theater and nightclub at 189 Chrystie Street, opened by Simon Hammerstein. It runs late-night burlesque and theatrical performances.

Name: Bouchon Bistro
Master_Source_text: Chef Thomas Keller's Bouchon Bistro is in Coral Gables, set within the 1924 La Palma building, in an Adam D. Tihany-designed dining room.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened by chef Thomas Keller in 1998, Bouchon Bistro is a French restaurant in the Napa Valley town of Yountville.
The lively dining room mirrors a classic Parisian brasserie, focusing on precise executions of traditional bistro fare.
Patrons dine at marble tables in red velvet booths, ordering signature plates like escargots à la Bourguignonne baked with parsley-garlic butter and puff pastry.

Name: Boucherie

Founded by Emil Stefkov of The Group Hospitality, Boucherie is a collection of traditional French brasseries located across New York City.
Designed by Julien Legeard, the spaces evoke the Art Nouveau style of La Belle Époque, offering a classic bistro menu centered around dry-aged steaks and absinthe.
The Midtown flagship features a glass-enclosed Parisian-style square and offers a whole roast suckling pig for the table.

Name: Brasserie Astoria
Master_Source_text: Brasserie Astoria is an international brasserie by three-Michelin-starred chef Bjorn Frantzen's Frantzen Group, housed in the former Astoria cinema in Stockholm.

Name: Boucherie (West Village)
Master_Source_text: In Manhattan's West Village, Boucherie is a French brasserie and steakhouse with in-house dry-aged cuts and a charcuterie bar.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Envisioned by founder Emil Stefkov of The Group Hospitality, Boucherie operates as a traditional French restaurant in the West Village.
The space draws design inspiration from the Belle Époque era, blending the atmosphere of a Parisian brasserie with the offerings of a steakhouse.
The menu features classic French staples alongside a dry-aged meat selection, highlighted by signature dishes like the Mousse de Foie Gras and the Boucherie Burger.

Name: Bostwick's Chowder House
Master_Source_text: On Pantigo Road in East Hampton, Bostwick's Chowder House is a seasonal seafood restaurant recommended by the New York Times, running a no-reservations policy.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by restaurateurs Chris Eggert and Kevin Boles, Bostwick's Chowder House is a seafood restaurant in East Hampton.
The space channels a classic New England clam shack, providing a relaxed alternative to the region's formal dining scene.
Patrons gather on the outdoor patio under market umbrellas for signature items like the Manhattan clam chowder and lobster rolls.

Master_Source_text: Inside the Grand Hotel Stockholm, The Cadier Bar takes its name from the hotel's founder, French chef Regis Cadier. It serves breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea and cocktails.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Stockholm's Grand Hôtel, The Cadier Bar is named after the property's French founder and original chef, Régis Cadier.
The oak-paneled space pairs classic decor and harbor views with a cocktail program focused on clarification and modern techniques.
The signature Cloud cocktail blends whiskey with punch, cloudberry, and vanilla to highlight regional New Nordic ingredients.

Name: Bvlgari Spa (London)
Master_Source_text: The Bvlgari Spa at Bvlgari Hotel London in Knightsbridge was designed by ACPV Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel; the hotel holds MICHELIN's top 3-Key distinction for 2025.

Master_Source_text: Opened in 2006 in the West Village, Cafe Cluny is run by Lynn Wagenknecht with partners Judi Wong and Steven Abramowitz, the team behind The Odeon and Cafe Luxembourg.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in New York's West Village, Cafe Cluny is a French-American bistro operated by restaurateur Lynn Wagenknecht.
The two-room space is modeled after a Parisian neighborhood café, featuring tightly packed tables and a lively dining room.
The menu centers on seasonal brasserie staples, highlighted by a signature steak frites au poivre and frisée salad aux lardons.

Master_Source_text: Backed by Anthony Joshua, BXR is a London boxing-led training brand with a members' gym in Marylebone and a City outpost at 22 Bishopsgate.

Backed by heavyweight champion Anthony Joshua, BXR Marylebone is a members-only boxing gym and fitness club in London.
Designed by Marie Soliman of Bergman Interiors, the multi-level space pairs professional combat training areas with dedicated studios for climbing and cardio.
Members train in a full-size boxing ring illuminated by natural light before recovering in the infrared saunas of the BXR Lab.

Name: Calissa
Master_Source_text: Calissa is a Greek restaurant in Water Mill, Hamptons, operated by Civetta Hospitality, pairing a Greek menu with a wine program from wine director Kylie Pyle.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by James Mallios and Julia Levi, Calissa is a Mykonos-inspired Greek restaurant in the Hamptons hamlet of Water Mill.
The venue pairs a menu of seafood and Mediterranean mezze with a late-night scene featuring DJ sets and live music.
A Wine Spectator-awarded beverage program offers the largest selection of rosé in the Hamptons, complementing signature dishes like whole salt-baked fish.

Name: Cane and Table
Master_Source_text: In the French Quarter, Cane & Table is a rum-focused bar and restaurant named one of Bon Appetit's five best new cocktail bars and a James Beard semifinalist.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Named one of America's best new cocktail bars by Bon Appétit, Cane and Table is a Caribbean-inspired restaurant in the French Quarter of New Orleans led by Chef Alfredo Nogueira.
The menu marries coastal Caribbean flavors with Cuban influences, complementing a drink selection focused on rum-based cocktails.
Hidden behind a signless facade, the space evokes Old Havana with its distressed plaster walls and a secluded outdoor courtyard.

Name: Camp Rubirosa
Master_Source_text: Camp Rubirosa is a seasonal pop-up in East Hampton from Rubirosa in New York City, serving Italian-American staples including house-made pastas and 14-inch pies.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created by Rubirosa owner Maria Pappalardo and restaurateur Brian Bedol, Camp Rubirosa is a permanent dining outpost in East Hampton.
The restaurant pairs the visual cues of an Americana summer camp with a menu rooted in Italian cooking.
Guests dine among vintage water skis and painted signs while eating the signature thin-crust Tie-Dye Pizza topped with vodka sauce and a swirl of pesto.

Name: Casa Madera (West Hollywood)
Master_Source_text: Casa Madera is Noble 33's coastal Mexican restaurant in Wynwood, Miami, led by executive chef Abelardo 'Tito' Vargas and designed by ICRAVE.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by hospitality group Noble 33, Casa Madera is a coastal Mexican restaurant situated atop the Mondrian Hotel on the Sunset Strip.
The Tulum-inspired space features blonde woods, rattan finishes, and an indoor-outdoor layout that provides panoramic views of the Los Angeles basin.
The menu pairs traditional taqueria fare like duck carnitas tacos with large-format dishes such as a 44-ounce bone-in wagyu tomahawk.

Name: Cannes Garden Tennis Club
Master_Source_text: Operated by the City of Cannes, Cannes Garden Tennis Club is a municipal tennis complex in Cannes La Bocca with 16 floodlit courts including 6 clay and 10 artificial grass.
Master_Aurora_Insights: Cannes holds a singular place in tennis history, in 1879 it was home to the only tennis court in all of France, and it was here that the clay court was born, when the Renshaw brothers covered their deteriorating grass court with terracotta powder sourced from a small ceramics factory near Cannes, the surface that now defines Roland Garros. The Cannes Garden Tennis Club is the city's flagship municipal complex and offers 16 floodlit courts across clay, synthetic resin, and indoor surfaces set within beautiful landscaped garden, one of the finest tennis facilities on the French Riviera. A gym, training wall, and clubhouse restaurant round out a world-class complex that is open to players of all levels.

Name: Casadonna
Master_Source_text: Casadonna is a coastal Italian waterfront restaurant in Miami's Edgewater, developed by Groot Hospitality with Tao Group, with interiors by Ken Fulk.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the 1926 Miami Women's Club building in Edgewater, Casadonna is a coastal Italian restaurant developed by Groot Hospitality and Tao Group.
The waterfront space features an interior by designer Ken Fulk, who incorporated pastel pinks, blues, and greens inspired by Havana and Miami.
The menu focuses on traditional Mediterranean fare, highlighted by signature dishes like the crispy young artichoke and house-made pastas.

Name: Caracol de Mar
Master_Source_text: Caracol de Mar is a contemporary Mexican sea-and-field restaurant in Hipodromo, Condesa, Mexico City, recognized by the Michelin Guide with a Bib Gourmand.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Relocated to Mexico City's Condesa neighborhood, Caracol de Mar is a contemporary Mexican seafood restaurant from Contramar chef Gabriela Cámara.
The kitchen focuses on sustainable coastal ingredients and agricultural produce, serving dishes in a multi-level space with a sunlit upper dining room.
Meals often conclude with the restaurant's signature carajillos, an espresso and Licor 43 cocktail mixed directly at the table.

Name: Calcasieu
Master_Source_text: Calcasieu is Link Restaurant Group's private events venue in New Orleans' Warehouse District, from James Beard Award-winning chefs Donald Link and Stephen Stryjewski.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Warehouse District above Cochon, Calcasieu is a private dining facility operated by Chef Donald Link.
The venue provides a dedicated setting for group gatherings, offering tailored menus that highlight regional Southern cuisine and signature cocktails.
The space retains its original New Orleans warehouse character, featuring exposed interior brick walls and a wine tasting room.

Name: Casa Tua Cucina
Master_Source_text: Casa Tua Cucina is an 18,000-square-foot Italian market-restaurant inside Saks Fifth Avenue at Brickell City Centre, from the team behind South Beach's Casa Tua.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created by hospitality veterans Miky and Leticia Grendene, Casa Tua Cucina is an 18,000-square-foot Italian food hall inside Saks Fifth Avenue at Miami's Brickell City Centre.
The market and dining space features 12 culinary stations dedicated to specific preparations like handmade pasta, wood-fired meats, and crudo.
A central bar anchors the room with 55 wines available by the glass, complementing the open kitchen layout.

Name: Casino
Master_Source_text: Casino is a Lower East Side restaurant at 171 East Broadway from Aisa Shelley (Mr. Fong's, Primo's), with interiors by Camilla Deterre drawing on Italian-American traditions.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Manhattan's Lower East Side, Casino is a coastal Italian restaurant from hospitality operator Aisa Shelley and chef Ken Addington.
The dining room adopts a 1980s aesthetic, featuring white tablecloths, bright red floors, and faux-marble columns.
The menu focuses on Southern European fare, anchored by a lemony whole roasted turbot prepared in a wood-fired oven.

Name: Charles Paige Atelier
Master_Source_text: Founded by Lewis Malivanek (formerly Creative Director at Knot Standard) in 2019, Charles Paige Atelier is an appointment-only SoHo atelier for bespoke and made-to-measure clothing.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Channing Daughters Winery
Master_Source_text: In the Hamptons, Channing Daughters Winery is led by partner-winemaker James Christopher Tracy, highlighted by The New York Times and Bloomberg for its Rosso Fresco and Rosato di Cabernet Franc.

Name: Centner Wellness (Brickell)
Master_Source_text: Centner Wellness (Brickell) is a medical, longevity, and beauty center at 2333 Brickell Ave, Miami, founded by Leila Centner.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Centner Wellness Brickell is a 15,000-square-foot flagship biohacking and longevity center at 2333 Brickell Ave, Suite A1, Miami, FL 33129, founded by Leila Centner.
Amenities include the first commercially available Ammortal Chamber, multiple hyperbaric oxygen chambers (HBOTs), two Theta Chambers, high-intensity red light beds, ozone sauna, and EES systems.
Reiki healing, acupuncture, salt chambers, FlowPresso massage, and preservative-free IV drips are offered via sister company Next Wave Health and Beauty.
The facility delivers more than 30 science-backed treatments across three core pillars: medical assessment, longevity optimization, and beauty regeneration, with membership programs and custom packages available.
Named in Modern Luxury's "Best of Luxury Beauty Miami" and featured on WSVN's Deco Drive as a leading wellness destination in Miami.

Name: Chapel Bar
Master_Source_text: Created by Fotografiska and NeueHouse, Chapel Bar is a Manhattan lounge set in an 1860s Gothic Revival chapel by James Renwick Jr., architect of St. Patrick's Cathedral.

Name: Centner Wellness (Edgewater)
Master_Source_text: Centner Wellness (Edgewater) is a detox and longevity-focused wellness center on Biscayne Boulevard in Miami's Edgewater.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Centner Wellness Edgewater, located at 2336 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33137, is a biohacking-focused detox and beauty clinic founded by Leila Centner in 2023.
Services include colon hydrotherapy, infrared sauna, assisted lymphatic therapy, ionic foot detox, acupuncture, EMS body sculpting, and high-frequency facials, priced from $125 to $160.
Described by founder Leila Centner as a community-focused "mini center," the Edgewater location specializes in colonics, bodywork, massage, facials, and body contouring services.
Named in Modern Luxury's "Best of Luxury Beauty Miami" and featured in S. Florida Business and Wealth as a destination "redefining self-care" through biohacking and energy-based therapies.

Name: Champagne Bar at The Surf Club
Master_Source_text: The Champagne Bar at Four Seasons Surfside serves a curated selection of sparkling wines in an intimate lounge setting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Catch NYC
Master_Source_text: Catch NYC is a tri-level seafood, sushi, and steak restaurant in a landmark building in Manhattan's Meatpacking District, operated by Catch Hospitality Group.

Name: Cavaniola's Gourmet Cheese Shop
Master_Source_text: Founded in 2004 in Sag Harbor, Cavaniola's Gourmet Cheese Shop runs adjacent cheese shop, kitchen and wine cellar spaces on Division Street.

Name: Charter the Honey Fitz
Master_Source_text: The Honey Fitz, former U.S. presidential yacht that served five presidents including JFK, is now offered for private charter out of Jupiter in Palm Beach County.

Name: Chez Fritz
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1963 by Thea and Fritz Elsener, Chez Fritz sits on Lake Zurich in Kilchberg and reopened in June 2025 after a full renovation with interiors by Ina Rinderknecht.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking Lake Zurich in Kilchberg, Chez Fritz is a restaurant operated by the Elsener family since 1963, with interiors by architect Ina Rinderknecht.
The waterfront dining room and expansive terrace serve as the backdrop for Head Chef Igino Bruni's Mediterranean menu.
Guests can order signature dishes like the fregola sarda with seafood while taking in direct views of the water and distant mountains.

Name: City Cave Float and Wellness
Master_Source_text: Founded in Brisbane, City Cave Float & Wellness is an Australian float-therapy franchise that entered South Florida with its first U.S. site in Fort Lauderdale.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by NextGen Global Award winners Tim Butters and Jeremy Hassell, City Cave Float and Wellness is an Australian-born franchise focusing on float therapy, infrared saunas, and massage.
The center distinguishes itself from traditional sensory deprivation facilities by replacing enclosed pods with spacious, open-pool float rooms.
Each globally patented pool uses a dense concentration of magnesium sulfate to create a buoyant, gravity-free environment.

Name: Chinese Tuxedo
Master_Source_text: Chinese Tuxedo is a contemporary Chinese restaurant on Doyers Street in Manhattan's Chinatown from owners Jeff Lam and Eddy Buckingham, with executive chef Paul Donnelly.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by executive chef Paul Donnelly, Chinese Tuxedo is a contemporary Chinese restaurant located in Manhattan's Chinatown.
The menu features updated traditional banquet dishes served within a restored two-story former opera house.
The dining room retains the building's original historical pillars and stripped-down walls, contrasting these raw architectural details with mid-century modern furnishings.

Name: Chelsea Piers Golf Club
Master_Source_text: Set at Chelsea Piers on Manhattan's Hudson River, the Golf Club is a year-round public driving range with PGA pro lessons, indoor simulators, and a four-level range with 52 heated bays.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Chemin a la Mer
Master_Source_text: Chemin a la Mer, from James Beard Award-winning chef Donald Link, sits on the fifth floor of Four Seasons Hotel New Orleans overlooking the Mississippi River.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located inside the Four Seasons Hotel New Orleans, Chemin à la Mer is a restaurant helmed by chef Donald Link.
Translating to "pathway to the sea," the space pairs specialty steaks and Gulf Coast catches with panoramic views of the Mississippi River.
Patrons can observe the maritime scenery from the outdoor terrace while sampling regional dishes like the signature aerated crawfish bisque.

Name: Ciro's Cannes Beach Club
Master_Source_text: Operated by Hotel Barriere Le Majestic, Ciro's Cannes is set on the hotel's private beach off Boulevard de la Croisette, the seaside iteration of the Deauville-born Ciro's (established 1920).
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Hôtel Barrière Le Majestic, Ciro's Cannes is a seaside restaurant and beach club that brings the legacy of the 1920 Deauville establishment to the French Riviera.
The venue focuses on Mediterranean seafood, providing coastal dining with direct views of the Lérins Islands.
The menu centers on signature dishes like bouillabaisse, sole meunière, and grilled prawns prepared with fresh herbs, citrus zest, and butter.

Name: Chug's Diner
Master_Source_text: In Coconut Grove, Chef Michael Beltran's Chug's Diner is a Cuban-American spot recognized with a MICHELIN Guide Bib Gourmand. It opens at 7:30am daily.

Name: Chelsea Piers Fitness
Master_Source_text: Chelsea Piers Fitness operates a 150,000-square-foot membership club on Pier 60 in Manhattan's Hudson River Park, emphasizing multi-sport training.

Name: Chotto Matte
Master_Source_text: Chotto Matte is a Soho, London Nikkei restaurant founded by Kurt Zdesar, with Executive Chef Jordan Sclare and interiors by Andy Martin Architecture. The kitchen spans sushi, ceviche and robata.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by hospitality entrepreneur Kurt Zdesar, Chotto Matte is a restaurant group with outposts in cities including London, Miami, and Toronto.
The menu focuses on Nikkei cuisine, combining Japanese and Peruvian ingredients and cooking techniques in a highly graphic setting.
The original Soho location, designed by Andy Martin Architects, features street art behind cast glass wall panels and dining tables coated in thermochromic paint that reveals hidden manga illustrations.

Name: Claridge's Afternoon Tea
Master_Source_text: Claridge's Afternoon Tea is served in The Foyer & Reading Room at Claridge's in Mayfair, where a Chihuly sculpture hangs like a chandelier and music drifts from the grand piano.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Maybourne Hotel Group, Claridge's Afternoon Tea is a dining service hosted in the Foyer and Reading Room of the Mayfair hotel.
The menu features finger sandwiches, warm scones with Cornish clotted cream, and classic pastries paired with a loose-leaf tea selection.
Guests are served on the hotel's signature jade and white striped tableware in an Art Deco dining room.

Name: Clemente Bar
Master_Source_text: Clemente Bar is a cocktail bar and tasting counter by chef Daniel Humm and artist Francesco Clemente, upstairs from Eleven Madison Park.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Contessa
Master_Source_text: Contessa is an all-day Northern Italian trattoria by Major Food Group (Jeff Zalaznick, Mario Carbone, Rich Torrisi), opened in 2022 in the Miami Design District.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Contessa is a Northern Italian restaurant by Major Food Group located on the rooftop of The Newbury Boston.
Designed by Ken Fulk, the dining room features a glass terrace that provides views of the Public Garden.
The menu focuses on midcentury Italian classics, highlighted by signature dishes such as the spicy lobster capellini and butternut squash carpaccio.

Name: Clancy's
Master_Source_text: Clancy's is a family-run Creole restaurant in Uptown New Orleans at 6100 Annunciation Street, operated by Brad and Sue Hollingsworth with chef/proprietor Brian Larson.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Uptown New Orleans, Clancy's is a Creole bistro guided by chef Brian Larson.
The neighborhood restaurant helped establish the modern Louisiana Creole dining style that emerged in the 1980s, maintaining a focus on regional ingredients and culinary techniques.
The menu features long-standing staples like the smoked duck served with dirty rice and the veal chop in demi-glace.

Name: Club ZZ's
Master_Source_text: ZZ's Club is a private members' club by Major Food Group in the Miami Design District, designed by Ken Fulk and opened in 2021.

Name: Clean Market
Master_Source_text: Founded by Lily Kunin (Clean Food Dirty City), Clean Market is a Manhattan wellness provider at 240 E 54th St in Midtown East.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Clean Market is a modern wellness destination founded by Lily Kunin, located at 240 E 54th Street in Midtown East Manhattan, opened September 2018.
Services include NutriDrip IV Nutrient Therapy with 14 custom drip protocols, Full-Spectrum Infrared Saunas, Whole Body Cryotherapy reaching -220°F, and Lymphatic Drainage Massage.
On-site café Matchaful, a female-founded Japanese matcha purveyor, offers vegan, refined sugar-free soft serve and grab-and-go options daily
Private treatment rooms with massage chairs and PEMF mats, an IV drip lounge, infrared sauna rooms, and the largest Clean Market wellness shop in NYC.

Name: Club Room
Master_Source_text: Club Room is a two-room cocktail bar and live-music venue inside the Soho Grand Hotel in SoHo, Manhattan.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Club Space
Master_Source_text: Founded by Luis Puig in 2000, Club Space is a downtown Miami nightclub now co-owned by David Sinopoli and Davide Danese, with Insomniac acquiring an ownership stake in 2019.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Club Space is a Downtown Miami nightclub founded in 2000, holding a 24-hour liquor license, operating since 25 years at 34 NE 11th Street, owned by Link Miami Rebels.
The SPACESHELLS cocktail menu, late-night kitchen serving empanadas and grilled cheese, and Floyd, a speakeasy room with a vintage early-2000s cabinet sound system, anchor the food and beverage program.
Three rooms spanning a 25,000-square-foot complex: The Ground for live acts and bass music, The Terrace for sunrise after-hours sets, and Floyd as a ticketed intimate speakeasy.
Ranked No. 14 globally by DJ Mag Top 100 Clubs 2026, up 10 positions, recognizing its marathon closing parties for III Points Festival, Miami Music Week, and Art Basel.

Name: Crescent City Steakhouse
Master_Source_text: Opened in 1934, Crescent City Steak House on North Broad Street remains run by the Vojkovich family and is New Orleans' oldest family-owned steakhouse.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1934 by the Vojkovich family, Crescent City Steakhouse operates as Louisiana's oldest family-owned chophouse in New Orleans.
The space maintains its original mid-century layout, serving prime-aged beef to a steady base of local patrons.
Diners sit in private curtained booths to eat steaks prepared in the house-invented New Orleans style, which arrive at the table sizzling in hot butter.

Name: Court 16
Master_Source_text: At 28 Liberty Street in the Financial District, Court 16 is an indoor tennis and pickleball club founded by Anthony Evrard, named after his childhood club in Brussels.

Name: Conventillo
Master_Source_text: Conventillo is a garden-style cocktail bar in Miami's MiMo District from the team behind Argentine restaurant Muchaaachos, with a cocktail program by Unfiltered Hospitality.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Costera
Master_Source_text: Named among the best restaurants in New Orleans by Conde Nast Traveler, Costera is an Uptown Spanish restaurant from chef Brian Burns and partner Reno De Ranieri.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Co-owned by chef Brian Burns and restaurateur Reno De Ranieri, Costera is a coastal Spanish restaurant and bar in Uptown New Orleans.
The menu focuses on tapas and shareable paellas, combining Iberian recipes with regional Louisiana produce and Gulf seafood.
The dining room features industrial and rustic design elements, complementing dishes like citrus and vermouth-marinated olives and octopus a la plancha.

Name: Coquette
Master_Source_text: Coquette is a Garden District restaurant in New Orleans, opened in 2008 by chef-owner Michael Stoltzfus, a James Beard Best Chef: South finalist in 2019.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in an 1880s building on Magazine Street in New Orleans, Coquette is a contemporary Southern restaurant led by James Beard-nominated chef Michael Stoltzfus.
The kitchen relies on locally sourced ingredients to create seasonal New American dishes served in a dining room accented with chandeliers.
The restaurant offers a five-course blind tasting menu, providing a surprise sequence of dishes based on daily market availability.

Name: Costa Med Bistro
Master_Source_text: Costa Med Bistro + Wine in Key Biscayne offers an elegant yet relaxed dining experience inspired by Mediterranean flavors.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Antonio Braschi, Costa Med Bistro + Wine is a Mediterranean dining room located in Key Biscayne, Florida.
The airy space focuses on an eclectic menu of Mediterranean fare, pairing fresh seafood with house-made pastas and grilled meats.
Signature plates include the char-grilled octopus and a squid ink pasta served with lobster in a spicy tomato sauce.

Name: Contramar
Master_Source_text: Contramar is a Roma Norte seafood restaurant in Mexico City, opened in 1998 by chef-restaurateur Gabriela Camara and recognized with a Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened in 1998 by chef Gabriela Cámara, Contramar is a Michelin-recognized seafood restaurant in Mexico City's Roma Norte neighborhood.
The dining room focuses on coastal Mexican cuisine, serving a menu of raw and cooked seafood preparations.
A signature dish is the pescado a la talla, a whole grilled snapper painted with green parsley sauce on one side and red adobo on the other.

Name: Cotoletta
Master_Source_text: In Coconut Grove, Cotoletta is an Italian bistro from 84 Magic Hospitality, named Best Restaurant in Coconut Grove in 2025 by Miami New Times.

Name: Crandon Park Tennis
Master_Source_text: Crandon Park Tennis Center on Key Biscayne hosted the Miami Open from 1987 to 2018 on a 13,800-seat Stadium Court.

Name: Crandon Golf at Key Biscayne
Master_Source_text: Crandon Golf at Key Biscayne is a public 18-hole course on a barrier island 10 minutes from downtown Miami, designed by Bruce Devlin and Robert von Hagge.

Name: Dead Rabbit
Master_Source_text: At 30 Water Street in Manhattan's Financial District, The Dead Rabbit opened in 2013 and has been named World's Best Bar by The World's 50 Best Bars.

Name: DBC Fitness
Master_Source_text: Founded by David Alexander, DBC Fitness is a performance training and recovery facility in Miami's Design District.

Name: Crevette
Master_Source_text: Crevette is a West Village seafood restaurant from Patricia Howard and chef Ed Szymanski, the duo behind Dame and Lord's.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the team behind Lord’s and Dame, Crevette is a Michelin-recognized seafood restaurant in New York's West Village.
The space pairs white tablecloths and cream-colored walls with a menu drawing heavily from the coasts of Spain and France.
Signature offerings include peekytoe crab agnolotti with tomato butter and a whole Dover sole served with bearnaise.

Name: Crow's Nest
Master_Source_text: The Crow's Nest is an inn and restaurant on Lake Montauk in the Hamptons, operated by hotelier Sean MacPherson.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The Crow's Nest is a seasonal inn and restaurant in Montauk, New York, operated by hotelier Sean MacPherson.
Set along the edge of Lake Montauk, the restaurant serves a Mediterranean-inspired menu focused on organic produce, mezze platters, and local seafood.
Guests often gather around the property's outdoor fire pits for sunset drinks before sharing the kitchen's signature large-batch paella.

Name: Dante's Hi Fi
Master_Source_text: Dante's HiFi in Wynwood is Miami's first listening bar concept, led by resident music director Rich Medina and featured on 50 Best Discovery.

Name: Daniel's
Master_Source_text: Daniel's Miami is a Coral Gables steakhouse from Gioia Hospitality Group, sister to the Fort Lauderdale original recognized by the MICHELIN Guide.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Coral Gables, Daniel's is a steakhouse from Gioia Hospitality Group, ranked ninth in North America by World's Best Steak Restaurants.
Led by Culinary Director Danny Ganem, the kitchen pairs a dedicated steak program with local seafood and Italian classics.
The venue is the first steak restaurant in the United States to receive the Beef Advocate Certificate.

Name: Cucina MORINI
Master_Source_text: Cucina MORINI is a Southern Italian restaurant in Washington DC from Altamarea Group, recognized by the MICHELIN Guide and Washingtonian's 100 Very Best Restaurants 2025.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Washington D.C.’s Mount Vernon Triangle, Cucina MORINI is a Southern Italian restaurant helmed by chef Matt Adler.
The menu highlights Italy's coastal regions, focusing on regional dishes like Sicilian-style crudos and handmade pastas.
A signature offering is the aperitivo bar's martini hour, paired with freshly baked sfincione topped with wild oregano and Sicilian olive oil.

Name: Den Gamle och Havet
Master_Source_text: Run by the Campogiani family, Den Gamle och Havet is an Italian seafood restaurant in Vasastan, Stockholm.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Taking its name from Ernest Hemingway's novel, Den Gamle och Havet is an Italian restaurant located in Stockholm's Vasastan district.
The space features a candlelit interior and a menu focused on rustic seafood dishes and grilled meats.
The kitchen is known for its signature Spaghetti Vongole, which guests can enjoy al fresco on the quiet street-side patio during the summer.

Name: Desert 5
Master_Source_text: Desert 5 Spot is a country bar and live-music venue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, the New York outpost of the Los Angeles original that has hosted Orville Peck and Kane Brown.

Name: Dopo Argento
Master_Source_text: Dopo Argento is an Italian/Modern Mediterranean restaurant on Southampton's Main Street from Dopo Hospitality Group, led by managing partner Maurizio Marfoglia.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Dopo Restaurant Group and chef Maurizio Marfoglia, Dopo Argento is an Italian and Mediterranean restaurant located in Southampton.
The dining room pairs a New York-style cocktail bar with a menu focused on locally sourced salads, seafood, and pasta dishes.
The property features a private wine room for events and outdoor seating across the front and back patios.

Name: Doma
Master_Source_text: Doma is a Wynwood restaurant serving Mediterranean-inspired Southern Italian cuisine, opened in 2018 and awarded Gambero Rosso's Two Forks for three consecutive years.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by owner Luca Lomonaco and executive chef Marco Giugliano, Doma is a modern Southern Italian restaurant in Miami's Wynwood arts district.
The space features an open kitchen and an outdoor terrace, providing a backdrop for a menu focused on seasonal seafood and Mediterranean flavors.
Signature dishes include the Candele alle Genovese and a whole lobster linguine, paired with an extensive wine list.

Name: Do Not Sit on the Furniture
Master_Source_text: Set on 16th Street in Miami Beach, Do Not Sit On The Furniture is a nightclub founded and run by DJ Behrouz and Megan Nazari.

Name: Double Luck
Master_Source_text: Double Luck is a Chinese restaurant on Miami's Upper East Side from the team behind Tam Tam, rated 9.2 by The Infatuation.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near Miami's 79th Street bridge, Double Luck is a Chinese restaurant from the team behind the Michelin-recognized Tam Tam, led by Chef Adrian Ochoa.
The neon-lit dining room features red lanterns and booths, providing a backdrop for a menu that reimagines Chinese-American staples.
A signature dish is the Hennessy orange chicken, which is set aflame tableside.

Name: Django
Master_Source_text: The Django is a subterranean jazz club and restaurant at The Roxy Hotel's cellar level in Tribeca, with a cocktail program by mixologist Natasha David.

Name: Dirty French
Master_Source_text: Dirty French Steakhouse in Brickell is a Major Food Group restaurant, with a menu by Chef Rich Torrisi and interiors by Ken Fulk.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Ludlow Hotel on Manhattan's Lower East Side, Dirty French is a bistro created by the hospitality company Major Food Group.
The kitchen interprets classic French cuisine by incorporating global flavor profiles from regions like Morocco and New Orleans.
Signature dishes include a mushroom millefeuille prepared with red curry and a roasted chicken for two served alongside crêpes.

Name: DIOR Spa Plaza Athenee
Master_Source_text: Dior Spa Plaza Athenee is the spa within Hotel Plaza Athenee on Avenue Montaigne in Paris, part of Dorchester Collection.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the House of Dior within the Dorchester Collection's Hôtel Plaza Athénée, this wellness space is located in the French capital.
The interior contains five individual treatment rooms, a shared suite, a sauna, and a hammam dedicated to skin and body therapies.
The facility includes the Dior Light Suite, which utilizes specialized light therapy technology designed to synchronize circadian rhythms and enhance sleep recovery.

Name: Dopo Il Ponte
Master_Source_text: Dopo Il Ponte is a Bridgehampton Italian restaurant from Dopo Hospitality Group, led by chef-restaurateur Maurizio Marfoglia.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef and co-owner Maurizio Marfoglia, Dopo Il Ponte is a modern Italian restaurant situated along Montauk Highway in Bridgehampton.
The neighborhood-style trattoria serves a menu focused on handmade pastas, prime meats, and traditional dishes like eggplant Parmigiana.
A dedicated pizzaiolo operates a wood-burning oven to produce the restaurant's signature Neapolitan thin-crust pizzas.

Name: Dopo La Spiaggia
Master_Source_text: In Sag Harbor, Dopo La Spiaggia is an Italian restaurant helmed by executive chef Maurizio Marfoglia, at Bay Street since 2016.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located across from the waterfront in Sag Harbor, Dopo La Spiaggia is an Italian restaurant helmed by chef and co-owner Maurizio Marfoglia.
The kitchen focuses on upscale Tuscan fare, offering a menu of fresh pastas and seafood in a relaxed dining room.
Standout dishes include the trenette and ravioli, which are served on an outdoor patio that provides views of passing yachts.

Name: Diane Servant
Master_Source_text: Paris-based facialist and massage therapist Diane Servant operates a 17th-arrondissement studio near the Arc de Triomphe, with treatments covered by Vogue, Vanity Fair and ELLE.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Diane Servant is a Paris-based facialist operating a studio near the Arc de Triomphe, drawing on her background preparing models for cameras and runways.
She specializes in natural rejuvenation through her proprietary Face Sculpting method, which focuses on releasing deep muscular tension.
Her signature treatment combines external lymphatic drainage with intra-buccal massage, performed to a curated soundtrack of soul and neo-soul.

Name: Eel Bar
Master_Source_text: On the Lower East Side at 252 Broome Street, Eel Bar is from the Hart's/Cervo's/The Fly team, with Aaron Crowder as chef-partner.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the Lower East Side, Eel Bar is a Basque-inspired restaurant from the hospitality team behind Cervo's, Hart's, and The Fly.
The dimly lit, retro-styled dining room centers around a robust vermouth program and a menu of Spanish and French-leaning plates.
The signature burger is distinctly topped with Roquefort cheese, tart boquerones, raw onion, and pickled piparra peppers.

Name: Duryea's Lobster Deck
Master_Source_text: On Fort Pond Bay in Montauk, Duryea's Lobster Deck is a seasonal seafood restaurant owned by investor Marc Rowan, who bought the former Duryea fish market property in 2014.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Duryea's Lobster Deck is a waterfront seafood restaurant on Montauk's Fort Pond Bay, owned by Apollo CEO Marc Rowan.
The open-air destination operates on a sprawling wooden deck and pier, evolving from a 1920s family-run fish market into a Mediterranean-inspired dining space.
The menu centers around a widely recognized $97 lobster Cobb salad, served alongside sunset views over the water.

Name: Drai's Supperclub
Master_Source_text: Drai's Supper Club is a French-American restaurant and lounge at 244 W 14th Street in Manhattan, crafted by hospitality operators Victor and Dustin Drai.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Crafted by hospitality operators Victor and Dustin Drai, Drai's Supper Club is a bi-level French-American restaurant in New York's Meatpacking District.
The venue revives the traditional supper club format, pairing a fine dining experience with live jazz performances in a dimly lit setting.
The upstairs dining room features red velvet curtains and gold-framed figurative art, while the menu highlights dishes like pasta topped with Reserve Kaluga caviar.

Name: Eel Sushi Bar
Master_Source_text: Eel Sushi Bar is a counter-led sushi bar on Talbot Road in Notting Hill; the Evening Standard awarded it five stars in June 2025.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Notting Hill neighborhood of London, Eel Sushi Bar is a Japanese restaurant from restaurateur Chris D'Sylva, the operator behind the Michelin-starred Dorian.
The compact 12-seater space focuses on refined Edomae craft, offering a traditional omakase dining experience.
Guests sit amid Swiss pine interiors, enjoying a precision-sourced, seasonal menu of around 18 courses.

Name: The Drexel
Master_Source_text: From Mandolin Aegean Bistro founders Anastasia Koutsioukis and Ahmet Erkaya, The Drexel is a modern Mediterranean restaurant on Miami Beach's Espanola Way at the 1920s Casa Matanza.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Miami Beach’s Española Way, The Drexel is a coastal Italian restaurant from Anastasia Koutsioukis and Ahmet Erkaya, the team behind Mandolin Aegean Bistro.
The kitchen focuses on wood-fired Mediterranean dishes and handmade pastas, offering a straightforward approach to regional cooking.
The dining room occupies the ground floor of the 1920s Casa Matanza building at the Esmé Hotel, retaining its original architectural details.

Name: Drip Studios
Master_Source_text: Drip Studios is a Paris HIIT studio concept that's part of The Sanctuary Group and is B Corp certified.
Master_Aurora_Insights: INCOMPLETE — Missing: Location, specific wellness offerings, operators or founders, and a concrete signature detail or feature.

Name: E11even
Master_Source_text: E11EVEN is a downtown Miami nightclub at 29 NE 11th Street, recognized by Nightclub & Bar's Top-10 Nightclubs in America and DJ Magazine's Top-50 clubs.

Name: Elcielo Miami
Master_Source_text: Elcielo Miami, awarded One MICHELIN Star, is led by Colombian-born chef Juan Manuel Barrientos and has operated in Brickell at 31 SE 5th St since 2015.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami's Brickell neighborhood, Elcielo is a Michelin-starred Colombian restaurant led by Chef Juan Manuel Barrientos.
The tasting menu applies modern culinary techniques to regional Colombian ingredients to create an interactive dining experience.
Signature moments include a cassava bread service shaped like a bonsai tree and a chocotherapy ritual where guests wash their hands in liquid chocolate.

Name: Erika Bloom Pilates
Master_Source_text: Erika Bloom Pilates is a Tribeca studio founded by Erika Bloom and included in Vogue's list of New York's best Pilates studios.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by movement practitioner Erika Bloom, this wellness collective operates studios in Manhattan, Greenwich, and the Amanyara resort in Turks and Caicos.
The method focuses on a clinical approach to fitness, emphasizing biomechanics, postural alignment, and injury prevention.
Instructors utilize a signature body-reading technique to develop individualized routines, often integrating specialized modalities like lymphatic drainage and craniosacral therapy.

Name: Ever / Body
Master_Source_text: Ever/Body is a cosmetic dermatology provider with a Manhattan center in Flatiron, led by CEO Amy Shecter.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ever/Body is a medical aesthetics brand with 7 NYC and DC metro locations, including SoHo at 453 West Broadway, Flatiron at 16 West 17th St, Upper East Side, Upper West Side, and Williamsburg.
Services include injectables such as Botox and dermal filler, laser hair removal, laser facials, chemical peels, HydraFacial, Morpheus8, and IPL, all delivered in under 60 minutes by clinically trained providers.
Treatment rooms accommodate 30- to 60-minute sessions; providers include board-certified dermatologists and nurse practitioners such as Dr. Joel Lamm, MD, and FNP-BC Janna S. at Flatiron.

Name: Electric Lemon
Master_Source_text: Electric Lemon is a seasonal American restaurant by Stephen Starr on the 24th floor of the Equinox Hotel at 33 Hudson Yards in Manhattan.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Electric Lemon is a seasonal American restaurant operated by Stephen Starr on the 24th floor of the Equinox Hotel in New York City's Hudson Yards.
The kitchen focuses on vegetable-forward dishes and crudos that highlight ingredients sourced from Mid-Atlantic farmers and artisans.
Outside, an 8,000-square-foot terrace features an infinity-edged reflecting pool, views of the Hudson River, and a large-scale sculpture by Spanish artist Jaume Plensa.

Name: Estiatorio Nostos
Master_Source_text: Estiatorio Nostos is a Greek estiatorio in Mexico City with dining rooms in Lomas de Chapultepec and at Artz Pedregal.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the restaurant group behind Mythos, Estiatorio Nostos is a Greek restaurant with locations in Mexico City's Lomas de Chapultepec and Artz Pedregal.
The kitchen focuses on traditional Mediterranean flavors, emphasizing olive oil, lamb, eggplant, and classic regional preparations.
The seafood-focused menu features seabass and fresh oysters, while meals often conclude with traditional baklava and a cup of Turkish coffee.

Name: Emeril's
Master_Source_text: Chef Emeril Lagasse's flagship opened in 1990 in New Orleans' Warehouse District and holds AAA Five Diamond status along with Relais & Chateaux membership.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened in 1990 by chef Emeril Lagasse, this two-Michelin-starred flagship restaurant is located in the Warehouse District of New Orleans.
Now helmed by his son, chef E.J. Lagasse, the kitchen serves a seasonally evolving tasting menu of contemporary Louisiana cuisine.
Meals begin with a selection of canapés, including a bite-sized barbecue shrimp tart that references one of the restaurant's early signature dishes.

Name: Expendio de Maiz Sin Nombre
Master_Source_text: Expendio de Maiz Sin Nombre is a one-MICHELIN-star restaurant in Roma Norte, Mexico City, opened in 2018 by chef Jesus Salas Tornes.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Jesús Salas Tornés, Expendio de Maíz Sin Nombre is a Michelin-starred restaurant in Mexico City's Roma Norte neighborhood.
The open-air kitchen operates without a set menu or signage, serving a sequence of dishes dictated by daily market availability.
Guests sit at shared sidewalk tables to eat rural Mexican fare centered entirely around native heirloom corn varieties.

Name: Ella Funt
Master_Source_text: Ella Funt is a modern French restaurant in Manhattan's East Village, designed by Annabel Karim Kassar.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by architect Annabel Karim Kassar and operated by entrepreneur Lounes Mazouz, Ella Funt is a modern French neo-bistro in New York's East Village.
The restaurant serves a contemporary menu of Parisian fine dining within a maximalist interior that references the neighborhood's queer history.
The venue takes its name from a performer at Club 82, a historic drag revue that previously occupied the same building.

Name: Employees Only
Master_Source_text: Employees Only is a West Village cocktail bar at 510 Hudson Street in Manhattan, opened in 2004 and ranked among the world's best bars.
