Name: Entremar
Master_Source_text: Entremar is a seafood restaurant in Mexico City's Polanco, sister restaurant to chef Gabriela Camara's Contramar.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mexico City's Polanco neighborhood, Entremar is a seafood restaurant led by chef Gabriela Cámara as the sister establishment to Contramar.
The eatery specializes in seasonal coastal Mexican cuisine, offering a straightforward approach to fresh fish recipes in a white-tablecloth setting.
Signature items include fresh tuna tostadas with chipotle sauce and avocado, which are served in the main dining room and on the outdoor terrace.

Name: Faena Rose
Master_Source_text: Based in the Faena District Miami Beach, Faena Rose is a private members club centered on art and culture, operated by Faena, whose Faena Hotel holds a Forbes Five-Star rating.

Name: Filigrana
Master_Source_text: Filigrana is a Roma Norte, Mexico City restaurant by chef Martha Ortiz, listed in the MICHELIN Guide with a Bib Gourmand.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mexico City's Roma Norte neighborhood, Filigrana is a Michelin Bib Gourmand-awarded Mexican restaurant helmed by chef Martha Ortiz.
The dining room pairs concrete interiors and floor-to-ceiling windows with purple-cushioned chairs and fully grown trees woven throughout the space.
The menu offers contemporary interpretations of regional dishes, highlighted by a signature toasted tamal cube made with fried portobellos and warm guajillo chili sauce.

Name: Fairfax
Master_Source_text: Fairfax is an all-day neighborhood restaurant in the West Village from Gabriel Stulman's Happy Cooking Hospitality, named one of Food & Wine's Restaurants of the Year in 2018.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Gabriel Stulman’s Happy Cooking Hospitality, Fairfax is an all-day cafe and wine bar in Manhattan's West Village.
The relaxed, living-room-style space transitions from a morning coffee spot into an evening destination for seasonal plates and natural wines.
The menu features the Bar Sardine burger, a signature carryover from its former sister restaurant topped with smoked cheddar, barbecue mayo, and crispy shoestring potatoes.

Name: Faena Theatre
Master_Source_text: Set inside Faena Hotel Miami Beach, the theater's spaces were created in collaboration with Baz Luhrmann and Academy Award-winning designer Catherine Martin.

Name: Experimental Cocktail Club
Master_Source_text: Operated by Experimental Group, Experimental Cocktail Club in Chinatown reopened after a full redesign by Dorothee Meilichzon, building on its 2010 launch at 13a Gerrard Street.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Felice (Palm Beach)
Master_Source_text: Felice is a Tuscan restaurant and wine bar by SA Hospitality Group (Sant Ambroeus, Casa Lever), located at The Square in West Palm Beach.
Master_Aurora_Insights: United States

Name: Fedora
Master_Source_text: Fedora is a West Village restaurant at 239 West Fourth Street, revived in 2025.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York's West Village, Fedora is a revived neighborhood restaurant operated by the team behind St. Jardim and helmed by former Le Rock chef Monty Forrest.
The subterranean space pairs a natural wine program with a menu of unconventional European dishes.
The kitchen prepares signature items like chicken Cordon bleu made with Black Forest ham and pierogies treated as ravioli.

Name: FaceKult
Master_Source_text: FaceKult is a Paris facial-training studio brand with studios in Montorgueil and at Le Bon Marche Rive Gauche, co-founded by Gaele Euvrie.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Felice (Brickell)
Master_Source_text: Felice Brickell is the Miami flagship of the New York-born Felice restaurants, operated by SA Hospitality Group, with executive chef Luigi Bailon.

Name: Fiaschetteria Pistoia
Master_Source_text: Founded in Pistoia, Tuscany in 1890, Fiaschetteria Pistoia operates East Village and West Village dining rooms in Manhattan.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Emanuele Bugiani, this compact Tuscan trattoria brings the culinary traditions of his family's historic restaurant in Pistoia to New York City.
The menu focuses on regional staples like saltless bread crostini with chicken liver puree, wild boar maccheroni, and imported Italian wines.
A hand-cranked red meat slicer anchors the dining room, turning heads whenever waiters use it to prepare fresh prosciutto.

Name: Flute
Master_Source_text: Flute is the rooftop bar at Broadwick Soho in London, with interiors by Martin Brudnizki.

Name: Forgione
Master_Source_text: Forgione is chef Marc Forgione's Tribeca restaurant, now at 30 Hudson Street after a 2024 relocation. Forgione, an Iron Chef, earned a Michelin star at age 30.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Relocated to a corner space in Tribeca, Forgione is the flagship restaurant from Michelin-starred chef Marc Forgione.
The dining room pairs a rustic aesthetic of vintage memorabilia with a New American menu focused on seasonal ingredients.
Gilded cast-iron columns remain from the space's previous tenant, while the kitchen serves signature dishes like chile lobster and hiramasa tartare.

Name: Fondation Cartier Pour L'Art Contemporain
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1984, the Fondation Cartier pour l'art contemporain is a Paris museum that moves in October 2025 to 2 Place du Palais-Royal, with interiors by Jean Nouvel.

Name: Fish Shop
Master_Source_text: Fish Shop is a seafood bar and restaurant at The Wharf in Washington DC, operated by Artfarm (the hospitality sister to Hauser & Wirth).
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Scottish village of Ballater, Fish Shop is a seafood restaurant and adjoining fishmonger created by Artfarm, the hospitality group behind the Fife Arms.
The venue focuses on ethically sourced catch from day boats and hand-dived shellfish within a relaxed dining room.
Designed by Russell Sage Studio with nautical accents, the space offers a seasonal menu featuring Cape Wrath oysters in Champagne tempura and samphire-infused Negronis.

Name: Fortnum & Mason
Master_Source_text: Fortnum & Mason is a London department store established in 1707 at 181 Piccadilly, holder of Royal Warrants, home to the Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon opened by Queen Elizabeth II in 2012.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Flatiron Pilates
Master_Source_text: Founded by classical Pilates instructor Amy Nelms, Flatiron Pilates is a Manhattan studio featured in Vogue and Forbes.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
New York Pilates Flatiron, located at 17 W 17th Street in Manhattan's Flatiron District, offers daily group Reformer Pilates classes steps from Union Square and Madison Square Park.
High-ceilinged, loft-style studio features signature pink and purple lighting, curated playlists, private dressing rooms, and individual restrooms; instructors each hold over 400 hours of training.
Signature class ABS ARMS ASS™ is a trademarked, high-intensity, full-body Reformer Pilates format offered daily across all Manhattan locations, including Flatiron.

Name: Forma Pilates (NY)
Master_Source_text: Founded by Liana Levi in 2020, Forma Pilates operates a SoHo studio in New York and has been profiled by The New York Times and Vogue.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by Vogue for its rigorous workouts, Forma Pilates is a private New York fitness studio from founder Liana Levi.
The space specializes in semi-private reformer classes that emphasize an athletic, highly individualized approach to the practice.
Originating in a Los Angeles pool house, the bicoastal operation equips its New York space with only a handful of reformers to ensure personalized instruction.

Name: Gigi Ramatuelle
Master_Source_text: Gigi Ramatuelle is an Italian restaurant and beach club on Pampelonne Beach in Ramatuelle, operated by Paris Society.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Paris Society, Gigi Ramatuelle is an Italian restaurant and beach club set within a pine forest on Pampelonne Beach near Saint-Tropez.
Designed by Franco-Mexican architect Hugo Toro, the venue integrates natural materials and Mediterranean design elements into its open-air setting.
The grounds feature a signature Bellini Bar centered around a swimming pool, alongside dining areas serving classic dishes like Vitello Tonnato.

Name: Gjelina
Master_Source_text: Gjelina NY is the Manhattan outpost of the Venice-born restaurant from founder Fran Camaj's Gjelina Group, located at 45 Bond Street in NoHo.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Abbot Kinney Boulevard in Venice, California, Gjelina is a restaurant established by founder Fran Camaj and chef Travis Lett.
The menu centers on vegetable-forward California cuisine and slow-fermented, wood-fired pizzas prepared with locally sourced ingredients.
A signature menu item is the mushroom toast with confit garlic and crème fraîche, often enjoyed on the restaurant's fire-warmed back patio.

Name: Gaba Restaurante
Master_Source_text: Gaba is a Bib Gourmand restaurant in La Condesa, Mexico City, led by chef Victor Toriz.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mexico City's Condesa neighborhood, Gaba Restaurante is a contemporary dining space helmed by Chef Victor Toriz.
The intimate, minimalist setting focuses on modern Mexican cuisine driven by seasonal local produce and a curated wine selection.
The menu features distinct plates such as 'Nduja toast, lamb neck, and wagyu tartar paired with grapes and crème fraîche.

Name: Galanga Thai House
Master_Source_text: In Roma Norte, Galanga Thai House holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand and is led by chef Somsri Raksamran alongside her husband Eleazar.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within an open-air mansion in Mexico City's Roma Norte, Galanga Thai House is a Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurant steered by chef Somsri Raksamran.
The kitchen delivers authentic Southeast Asian flavours, using original recipes and fresh herbs to showcase regional dishes beyond familiar staples.
Standout plates include a green curry with beef and baby eggplant, followed by desserts featuring doughs naturally dyed with pandan.

Name: Gekko
Master_Source_text: Gekko is a Japanese-inspired steakhouse and lounge in Brickell from David Grutman's Groot Hospitality and co-owner Bad Bunny, with interiors by Rockwell Group.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Gekko is a Japanese-inspired steakhouse and lounge in Miami’s Brickell neighborhood, co-owned by hospitality operator David Grutman and recording artist Bad Bunny.
The restaurant merges traditional steakhouse fare with Japanese cuisine, serving specialty steaks and sushi in a dimly lit setting.
Designed by the Rockwell Group, the venue encompasses three distinct rooms and features a menu anchored by a signature Tomahawk steak.

Name: Fuze House
Master_Source_text: Founded by instructor Eli Kaylin, Fuze House runs mat Pilates and sculpt studios in Miami Beach's Sunset Harbour and South Miami, named Best Pilates Studio by Miami New Times 2025.

Name: Fouquet's Spa
Master_Source_text: Spa Diane Barriere at Fouquet's New York is operated by Hotels Barriere and partners with Paris skincare house Biologique Recherche.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized in Vogue's inaugural Global Spa Guide, Spa Diane Barrière is a subterranean wellness retreat located within Hotel Barrière Fouquet's in Manhattan's Tribeca neighborhood.
Designed by Swedish architect Martin Brudnizki, the five-room space features earth-toned interiors and distinct soundscapes to establish a quiet environment beneath the city.
The facility partners with Parisian brand Biologique Recherche for treatments like the Silhouette, a full-body detoxifying algae wrap.

Name: Gitano (Seaport)
Master_Source_text: Grupo Gitano's modern Mexican restaurant and lounge at Pier 17 in the Seaport is led by founder James Gardner with executive chef Sebastian Cacho.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by founder James Gardner, Gitano is a modern Mexican restaurant and lounge situated at Pier 17 in the Seaport District.
The 14,000-square-foot waterfront venue translates the tropical atmosphere of Tulum to Lower Manhattan, pairing Yucatán-inspired cuisine with views of the Brooklyn Bridge.
The jungle-inspired setting features a menu of mezcal cocktails and is anchored by a giant disco ball.

Name: Galerie Lafayette
Master_Source_text: Galeries Lafayette Paris Haussmann is the flagship department store on Boulevard Haussmann, unveiled in 1912 after an Art Nouveau redesign featuring a stained-glass dome by Jacques Gruber.

Name: Golden Swan
Master_Source_text: The Golden Swan is a French-Mediterranean restaurant in a Greenwich Village townhouse from restaurateur Matthew Abramcyk and chef Doug Brixton.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a historic West Village townhouse, The Golden Swan is a French tavern led by restaurateur Matthew Abramcyk and chef Doug Brixton.
The venue offers two distinct atmospheres, pairing the casual ground-floor Wallace Room with a formal upstairs dining space designed by Studio Tre.
The menu focuses on French and Mediterranean fare, highlighted by a signature Dover sole prepared with meunière sauce and capers.

Name: Great Jones Spa
Master_Source_text: Great Jones Spa is a day spa at 29 Great Jones Street in Manhattan and a New York Magazine Critics' Pick.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Jamie Ahn, Great Jones Spa is a wellness retreat located in New York City's NoHo neighborhood.
The facility provides a range of hydrotherapy, massages, and facial treatments alongside traditional bathhouse elements.
Its centerpiece is the Water Lounge, which features a three-story indoor waterfall, a cold plunge pool, and a chakra-light steam room.

Name: Gospel
Master_Source_text: Gospel is a late-night lounge and sound-focused venue at 281 Lafayette Street in SoHo.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Green Bar
Master_Source_text: Green Bar is the cocktail bar at Hotel Cafe Royal in London, set within David Chipperfield Architects' reconfiguration of the Grade II-listed complex.

Name: Handshake Speakeasy
Master_Source_text: Handshake Speakeasy in Colonia Juarez, Mexico City, was named The World's Best Bar 2024 and North America's Best Bar in 2024 and 2025 by The World's 50 Best Bars.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Ham Yard Restaurant & Bar
Master_Source_text: Ham Yard Restaurant & Bar is the ground-floor bar and dining room at Ham Yard Hotel in Soho by Firmdale Hotels, with interiors by Kit Kemp.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Firmdale Hotels in London's West End, Ham Yard Restaurant & Bar is a modern European dining room holding two AA rosettes.
The colourful space reflects co-owner Kit Kemp's signature design aesthetic, offering a menu focused on seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.
Beyond the main dining room, a secluded courtyard shaded by oak trees provides a setting for al fresco drinking and dining.

Name: Habibi
Master_Source_text: Habibi is a French-Moroccan supper club on the Miami River, with the kitchen led by chef Wladimir Arevalo, formerly of Doya (Michelin Bib Gourmand) and Motek.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by hospitality veteran Roman Jones and former Doya chef Wladimir Arévalo, Habibi Miami is a French-Moroccan supper club situated along the Miami River.
The waterfront restaurant merges Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, and Asian flavors through a tapas-style menu paired with live entertainment.
Designed by Mark Lehmkuhl, the space features a tent-like structure with Moorish architectural details inspired by traditional riads and Wes Anderson films.

Name: Haymarket
Master_Source_text: Haymarket opened June 27, 2025 at 326 Seventh Avenue in Chelsea from London-born chef India Doris and co-owner Alex Pfaffenbach.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by former Saga executive sous-chef India Doris, Haymarket is a modern European restaurant in New York's Chelsea neighborhood.
The menu filters classic culinary traditions through a distinct Caribbean lens, reflecting the chef's British-Jamaican heritage with bold flavor profiles.
Guests dine beneath a custom mural of pastoral landscapes by artist Charlotte Terrel while sharing the signature deboned peri peri chicken.

Name: Hanky Panky
Master_Source_text: Hanky Panky is a speakeasy in Mexico City's Juarez neighborhood, launched in 2016, ranked No. 35 on North America's 50 Best Bars.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Concealed in Mexico City's Colonia Juárez, Hanky Panky is a speakeasy founded by Walter Meyenberg that regularly features on The World's 50 Best Bars list.
The dimly lit room focuses on a menu of globally inspired cocktails that utilize regional Mexican ingredients.
To access the space, guests enter a traditional Oaxacan fonda and pass through a false wall hidden inside the kitchen.

Name: Havana
Master_Source_text: Havana Restaurant on South Dixie Highway in West Palm Beach is family-run and a winner of The Palm Beach Post's Best Cuban Restaurant and Best Cuban Sandwich.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Michael Boland and Deirdre Swords, Havana is a Cuban-influenced restaurant in Bar Harbor, Maine, that was named a 2025 James Beard Award semifinalist.
The menu features American dishes with Latin flair, supported by a wine program that has held a Wine Spectator Award of Excellence since 2004.
In 2010, the restaurant hosted President Barack Obama and Michelle Obama for a dinner of paella and lobster thermidor.

Name: Havre 77
Master_Source_text: Havre 77 is a French brasserie in Colonia Juarez, Mexico City, conceived by chef Eduardo Garcia (Maximo Bistrot, whose flagship holds a Michelin star in 2025).
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Havre 77 is a French brasserie and oyster bar in Mexico City's Colonia Juárez, conceived by chef Eduardo García.
Transformed by Francisco Pardo Arquitecto, the restored nineteenth-century house provides a bright, Parisian-inspired dining room for traditional bistro cooking.
The menu centers on classic staples like French onion soup, grilled oysters, and a signature hamburger.

Name: Harrods
Master_Source_text: Harrods is a Grade II* listed department store in Knightsbridge, London, one of the world's most famous luxury retailers.

Name: Hearth
Master_Source_text: Hearth is the East Village restaurant at 403 East 12th Street led by chef Marco Canora, recipient of the James Beard Award for Best Chef: New York City in 2017.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Manhattan's East Village, Hearth is a Tuscan-American restaurant founded by James Beard Award-winning chef Marco Canora.
The dining room centers around an open kitchen that produces seasonal, Italian-inflected dishes using locally sourced ingredients.
The restaurant is known for its signature bone broth, which led to the creation of a dedicated takeout window called Brodo.

Name: Healthspan
Master_Source_text: Healthspan is a wellness and recovery center in Brickell, Miami, co-founded by Matt Hopkins (certified Functional Medicine Hyperbaric Operator) and Pablo Perez.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Hanu Yoga
Master_Source_text: Hanu Yoga in Miami Beach, formerly Green Monkey, is owned by Katrina Bilanchone and operates at 736 Sixth Street.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami Beach, Hanu Yoga is a wellness sanctuary founded by Kata Bilanchone and owned by former NFL player Desmond Bryant.
Formerly known as Greenmonkey, the studio expands on traditional fitness by prioritizing somatic restoration and nervous system regulation.
Alongside heated and non-heated movement classes, the space features dedicated breathwork sessions and cold plunge water therapy.

Name: Harbor Club
Master_Source_text: Harbour Club is a private members' club in Sunset Harbour, Miami Beach, founded by Annabel's and ZZ's alum James Julius, with on-site Italian restaurant a'Riva.

Name: Hurrem Hammam
Master_Source_text: Hurrem Hammam is a 20,000-sq-ft co-ed Turkish bath and wellness spa in North Miami, home to the in-house Topkapi Restaurant.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Commissioned in 1556 by the wife of Suleiman the Magnificent, this historic Turkish bath in Istanbul was designed by chief Ottoman architect Mimar Sinan.
The restored structure provides traditional hammam treatments focused on physical purification and relaxation within a classical architectural setting.
Bathers recline on a heated central marble slab beneath a skylit dome before receiving a vigorous kese scrub and foam massage.

Name: House of Yes
Master_Source_text: House of Yes is a nightclub and creative collective in Bushwick, Brooklyn, founded by artists Kae Burke and Anya Sapozhnikova in 2015.

Name: Heated Room
Master_Source_text: Heated Room is a Los Angeles fitness studio with a 4.9 average from 30,000+ ratings on ClassPass.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
With locations in Los Angeles, Heated Room is an infrared fitness studio founded by Raamy Fares and designed by architecture firm 64North.
The space specializes in high-intensity hot Pilates and strength-based mat classes conducted in a controlled climate of up to 100 degrees Fahrenheit to enhance muscle recovery.
The interior pairs a professional-grade VOID Acoustics sound system with subtle design nods to Fares’s native Senegal, including handcrafted laundry baskets.

Name: Hiyakawa Miami
Master_Source_text: Hiyakawa Miami is a Japanese restaurant in Wynwood, operated by APM Restaurant Group and recognized by the MICHELIN Guide.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hiyakawa Miami is a Michelin-recognized Japanese restaurant in the Wynwood arts district, operated by restaurateur Alvaro Perez Miranda.
The kitchen focuses on traditional washoku and omakase menus that emphasize simplicity, precise technique, and seasonal ingredients.
Designed by interior designer Bea Pernia, the space is defined by a series of curved wooden arches that frame the sushi counter.

Name: House of Louie
Master_Source_text: House of Louie is a multi-venue address in a 19th-century Covent Garden townhouse, by Paris Society International.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within a 19th-century townhouse in London's Covent Garden, House of Louie is a multi-venue dining destination operated by Paris Society.
The four-storey concept offers distinct experiences on each floor, from Japanese fare at Wani Tzuki to classic French dishes at Louie, helmed by Chef Slade Rushing.
The venue culminates on the third floor at The Alligator Bar, a cocktail lounge featuring a terrace and live entertainment.

Name: Hugo
Master_Source_text: Hugo is a Roma Norte wine bar in Mexico City.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mexico City’s Roma Norte neighborhood, Hugo is a Michelin-listed natural wine bar and bistro founded by Isabel Castillo and Thierry Chouquet.
The establishment focuses on low-intervention bottles sourced from around the world, paired with a rotating menu of European-inspired small plates by chef Michael Crespo.
The venue features an awning-shaded outdoor terrace where patrons share signature dishes like gnocchi and roast chicken.

Name: Higher Dose
Master_Source_text: HigherDOSE, founded by Lauren Berlingeri and Katie Kaps, operates an infrared wellness spa on the third floor of 11 Howard in SoHo, Manhattan.

Name: IKIGAI
Master_Source_text: Ikigai Sushi Bar on Brickell Key is an omakase dining experience in Miami.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a Fort Greene townhouse, Ikigai is a non-profit Japanese restaurant led by Masa-trained chef Rafal Maslankiewicz.
The 12-seat counter serves a vegetable-forward, kaiseki-inspired tasting menu, with all proceeds directed toward fighting local food insecurity.
Guests begin their evening with a welcome drink in the property's outdoor tea garden before moving to the dining room.

Name: Jardin Tropezina
Master_Source_text: Operated by Airelles, Jardin Tropezina is a beach club and restaurant on Pampelonne Beach in Ramatuelle, with Mediterranean menus by Michelin-starred chef Jean-Francois Piege.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on Pampelonne beach in Ramatuelle, Jardin Tropezina is a Mediterranean restaurant and beach club featuring a menu crafted by Michelin-starred chef Jean-François Piège.
Operated by the nearby Château de La Messardière, the venue focuses on regional Provencal dishes served in a casual coastal setting.
The dining area is constructed as a timber terrace heavily planted with greenery, allowing guests to eat just steps from the water.

Name: Isla CO
Master_Source_text: Isla & Co. is a restaurant in West Palm Beach.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Developed by Parched Hospitality Group and led by Executive Chef Clint Snowling, Isla & Co. is an Australian-inspired all-day restaurant with locations across the United States.
The venues transition from serving specialty coffee and coastal brunch dishes during the day to a cocktail-focused dinner service at night.
The menu features Australian staples like kangaroo skewers alongside a dedicated espresso martini flight.

Name: JECT
Master_Source_text: JECT is a medical aesthetics practice in Miami Beach at 1916 Bay Road.

Name: Irene's Italian
Master_Source_text: Owned by Sicilian-born restaurateur Irene DiPietro, Irene's in the French Quarter is now led by her son, chef Nicholas Scalco.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Irene DiPietro and helmed by chef Nicholas Scalco, this Italian restaurant operates in New Orleans’ French Quarter.
The kitchen blends traditional Sicilian recipes with regional Creole influences, presenting dishes in a dining room anchored by a piano bar.
Signature plates like the Duck St. Philip and Oysters Irene precede a flaming Baked Alaska prepared with 151-proof rum.

Name: Itoh Dining by Nobu
Master_Source_text: Itoh Dining by NOBU is a teppanyaki restaurant in Gora, Hakone, created in collaboration with chef Nobuyuki Matsuhisa.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the mountains of Gora, Hakone, Itoh Dining by Nobu is a teppanyaki restaurant created by chef Nobuyuki Matsuhisa and owner-chef Keisuke Itoh.
The menu focuses on A4 Japanese black wagyu and Kobe beef, blending regional ingredients with international culinary techniques.
Diners sit at the counter to watch the chefs prepare seasonal seafood and steaks directly in front of them.

Name: Jeans
Master_Source_text: Jean's is a NoHo bistro at 415 Lafayette Street from Max Chodorow and Ashwin Deshmukh of Superiority Burger, opened in 2023.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York's NoHo neighborhood, Jean's is a farm-to-table bistro and subterranean lounge from restaurateurs Max Chodorow, Ashwin Deshmukh, and Bernardo Metsch.
The dual-concept venue pairs a white-tablecloth dining room with a late-night club atmosphere that draws a steady downtown crowd.
The menu focuses on familiar American staples, highlighted by a signature wood-grilled half-chicken and lobster rolls served alongside lobster bisque shots.

Name: Japón at The Setai
Master_Source_text: Japon at The Setai, Miami Beach is recognized by the Prix Versailles as one of the 16 most beautiful restaurants in the world.

Name: Jetset
Master_Source_text: Jetset Pilates operates a West Palm Beach studio at 345 Banyan Blvd and has been featured by Forbes and Harper's Bazaar.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Tamara Galinsky in Miami, JETSET Pilates is a modern fitness destination featuring a flagship headquarters designed by architect Kobi Karp.
The studio focuses on a rigorous approach to movement, blending high-intensity conditioning with low-impact principles and seamless transitions between exercises.
Each session centers around a signature 50-minute full-body workout performed on custom JETSET reformers.

Name: Joanna Vargas
Master_Source_text: Joanna Vargas is a Manhattan day spa led by celebrity facialist Joanna Vargas, whose clients include Julianne Moore and Rachel Weisz.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
One of the beauty industry's most sought-after estheticians, Joanna Vargas built her reputation on delivering a signature glow through entirely non-invasive, plant-based treatments, with an A-list clientele that includes Julianne Moore, Naomi Watts, Sofia Coppola, and Maggie Gyllenhaal. 
Her signature Triple Crown Facial, which uses microcurrent to drain puffiness, tone muscle, and reshape the face with zero downtime, is exclusively available at her salon, alongside cutting-edge treatments like the Glass Skin Facial, LED full-body therapy, and radiofrequency skin tightening.

Name: Jim McLean Golf School at The Biltmore Hotel
Master_Source_text: Established by 1994 PGA Teacher of the Year Jim McLean, the school operates at The Biltmore Hotel in Coral Gables beside Donald Ross's 1925 course.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ranked the #1 Golf School in America by U.S. News & World Report, CNN, and Travel + Leisure, the Jim McLean Golf School has been headquartered at The Biltmore Hotel since 1991, set on the historic Donald Ross Championship Course in Coral Gables. 
Founded by Hall of Fame instructor Jim McLean, the school has produced major championship winners across the PGA, LPGA, and Champions Tours, with programs spanning private lessons, clinics, and multi-day schools for all skill levels. 
Every student is trained on McLean's proprietary Safety Zone® framework, built on 40+ years of golf swing research and backed by video analysis and personalized instruction from world-class teaching professionals.

Name: Kalamata Beach
Master_Source_text: Kalamata Beach is a seasonal Greek beach restaurant on Pampelonne in Ramatuelle, Saint-Tropez.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the sands of Pampelonne in Ramatuelle, Kalamata Beach is the seasonal coastal outpost of the Parisian restaurant Kalamata, helmed by a chef from Mykonos.
The beachfront space features a natural design palette of beige tones, wood, and dune grasses set against the Mediterranean Sea.
The menu centers on charcoal-grilled dishes and shared plates like king crab spaghetti, finishing with a signature Greek yogurt pavlova.

Name: Jowong
Master_Source_text: Set on Pachuca 51 in Condesa, Mexico City, Jowong is a Korean restaurant recognized with a Bib Gourmand by the Michelin Guide.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by chefs Greg Wong and Allen Noveck, Jowong is a Michelin Bib Gourmand-recognized restaurant located in Mexico City's Condesa neighborhood.
The kitchen focuses on contemporary Korean food, preparing classic dishes with regional Mexican ingredients and techniques.
Signature menu items include prime-rib barbecue, pesto tteokbokki, warm gimbap, and a banana cake dessert.

Name: Joseph Leonard
Master_Source_text: Joseph Leonard is an all-day American bistro in the West Village from Gabriel Stulman's Happy Cooking Hospitality, at 170 Waverly Place.

Name: Jewel of the South
Master_Source_text: Set in an 1835 Creole cottage in the French Quarter, Jewel of the South is led by owner and head bartender Chris Hannah and won the North America's 50 Best Bars 2024 Art of Hospitality Award.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Joyce
Master_Source_text: The Joyce is a 45-seat steakhouse on Espanola Way in Miami Beach from chef James Taylor, alumnus of Alinea and Roister.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Joyce is a Southern seafood restaurant in Downtown Los Angeles, led by founders Prince and Athena Riley alongside chef Sammy Monsour.
The kitchen focuses on sustainable coastal fare, anchoring its menu with regional soul food staples and an extensive raw bar.
Signature items include a fried shrimp sandwich, hushpuppies, and towering seafood platters that reflect the culinary traditions of the American South.

Name: Jolene
Master_Source_text: Jolene is a Downtown Miami sound room operated by Bar Lab's Elad Zvi and Gabe Orta in partnership with Club Space, named Best Dance Club by Miami New Times 2024.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Joanna Czech
Master_Source_text: Polish-born facialist Joanna Czech operates a SoHo flagship at 34 Howard Street, 2nd floor, with a client list including Amber Valletta and Jenna Lyons.

Name: Kaori (Miami)
Master_Source_text: Kaori is a MICHELIN Guide-listed modern Asian restaurant and Hi-Fi listening bar in Brickell, Miami.

Name: Kissaki (Miami)
Master_Source_text: Kissaki is a New York-born omakase Japanese restaurant group from owner Garry Kanfer, with a Miami Beach outpost in South of Fifth.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami Beach's South of Fifth neighborhood, this New York export is helmed by Executive Chef Edgar Valerio of Michelin-starred Jewel Bako.
The restaurant focuses on traditional omakase within a lounge-like interior designed by Lauren Jayne Design Studio to resemble a Japanese drinking den.
A standout ritual is the tableside preparation of signature nigiri, featuring A5 Miyazaki wagyu and otoro tuna seared directly before guests.

Name: Krus Kitchen
Master_Source_text: Krus Kitchen is a seasonal restaurant and wine shop in Coconut Grove holding a Michelin Green Star for 2024 and 2025.

Name: Kojin
Master_Source_text: Opened in July 2024 in Coral Gables, Kojin is led by chefs Pedro and Katherine Mederos and is recommended by the MICHELIN Guide.

Name: Klaw Rooftop
Master_Source_text: Set atop the former Miami Women's Club in Edgewater, The Rooftop by Klaw crowns a venue named Eater Miami's Restaurant of the Year in 2022.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in Edgewater's historic Miami Women's Club, Klaw Rooftop is a dining space from restaurateur Misha Zelman, featuring interiors by Martin Brudnizki Design Studio.
As the neighborhood's only rooftop venue, it pairs panoramic views of Biscayne Bay with a focused menu of steak and seafood.
The culinary program is anchored by its signature Norwegian king crab, which is flown in fresh and presented with tableside service.

Name: Kiki's
Master_Source_text: Kiki's is a Greek taverna on Division Street in Manhattan's Chinatown, opened on April 5, 2015 by owner Kiki Karamintzas and profiled by the Michelin Guide.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking Agios Sostis beach on Mykonos, Kiki's is an open-air Greek taverna operated by owner Vassilis.
Operating entirely without electricity, the kitchen relies on a charcoal grill to prepare a straightforward menu of fresh seafood, pork chops, and local produce.
Lacking formal signage, the restaurant maintains a daily ritual of serving complimentary wine to guests waiting for a table under the shade of surrounding trees.

Name: Keys and Heels
Master_Source_text: Keys & Heels is a speakeasy-style cocktail lounge on Manhattan's Upper East Side from restaurateur Massimo Lusardi, concealed behind a locksmith-and-shoe-repair facade.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Keys & Heels is a speakeasy hidden behind a convincing façade of an old-fashioned key-cutting and shoe repair shop on the Upper East Side, one of NYC's most charming hidden bar concepts. 
Inside, the vibe is classy and atmospheric, with retro decor, dreamy lighting, and a disco ball, complemented by creative cocktails and bar bites.

Name: Kronenhalle
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1924, Kronenhalle is a Zurich restaurant where guests dine beneath original works by Chagall, Miro, Picasso and Bonnard.

Name: La Ferneteria Miami
Master_Source_text: La Ferneteria Rooftop Miami is an Italian restaurant and lounge on the ninth floor at 230 NW 24th Street in Wynwood.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by the Accademia Italiana della Cucina, La Ferneteria is an Italian restaurant and cocktail lounge with outposts in Buenos Aires, Miami, and Asunción.
The concept pairs regional Italian dishes with a dedicated beverage program, operating in spaces that transition from dinner service to late-night lounging.
True to its name, the bar highlights Fernet, serving the bitter herbal spirit alongside signature plates like an eight-hour slow-cooked short rib.

Name: L'Oasis du Martinez Spa
Master_Source_text: Inside Hotel Martinez on the Croisette, part of The Unbound Collection by Hyatt, L'Oasis du Martinez is a spa operated by Carita in Cannes.
Master_Menu_URL: L'Oasis du Martinez is the first destination spa in Cannes, set within the art deco grandeur of Hôtel Martinez, an icon of the French Riviera where A-list film stars have gathered since the 1920s, and spans 2,800 square metres of lush botanical gardens encompassing a Provençal garden, tropical terrace, and a striking Yves Klein blue heated swimming lane. The spa is home to Carita's first flagship space outside Paris, where signature treatments incorporate precious minerals including 24k Biotech Gold, delivered across seven treatment rooms including two couple suites with therapeutic salt walls, a hammam, a tearoom, and a dedicated barbershop.

Name: KYU (New York)
Master_Source_text: Miami-born KYU, a James Beard Best New Restaurant semifinalist in 2017, brings its wood-fired, Asian-inspired grill to NoHo at 324 Lafayette Street.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originating in Miami where it earned recognition from Time magazine, KYU brings its Asian-inspired, wood-fired barbecue concept to New York's NoHo neighborhood.
The restaurant merges traditional American barbecue techniques with global flavors, emphasizing sustainably sourced ingredients and grilled meats.
Signature dishes include a smoked wagyu beef brisket and a whole-roasted cauliflower served with goat cheese and shishito herb vinaigrette.

Name: KYMA
Master_Source_text: Kyma is a Manhattan Greek seafood restaurant with a MICHELIN Guide-listed Flatiron location at 15 W 18th Street.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Reno Christou and James Ragonese, Kyma is a Greek seafood restaurant with locations in New York and Florida.
The interiors channel an Aegean coastal aesthetic, defined by white-washed walls, natural wood accents, and warm lighting.
The menu centers on traditional Mediterranean preparations, featuring signature dishes like whole grilled lavraki and wood-fired octopus served in a lively, music-driven atmosphere.

Name: L'opera
Master_Source_text: L'Opera is a restaurant-lounge on the port of Saint-Tropez, where the walls display works by contemporary artist Philippe Shangti.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the port of Saint-Tropez, L'Opéra is a restaurant and club featuring an artistic concept by Philippe Shangti and a menu by chef Mathieu Grouas.
The venue pairs global dining with theatrical entertainment, transitioning from a dinner setting into a nightlife space.
Designed like an arena with a white and gold interior, the property includes a harbor-facing terrace and nightly cabaret shows with performers dancing on tables.

Name: La Gorce Country Club
Master_Source_text: On Miami Beach, La Gorce Country Club is a private 18-hole course, one of Miami's most prestigious golf clubs.

Name: La Esquina
Master_Source_text: La Esquina is a Mexican brasserie and cantina at 114 Kenmare Street in Manhattan, listed in New York Magazine's The Thousand Best.

Name: KYU (Miami)
Master_Source_text: Opened in 2016 in Wynwood, KYU was co-founded by chef Michael Lewis and was a 2017 James Beard Award semifinalist for Best New Restaurant.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami's Wynwood neighborhood, KYU is an Asian-inspired, wood-fired restaurant originally founded by James Beard Award-nominated chef Michael Lewis and Steven Haigh.
The menu centers on a blend of traditional Japanese yakiniku grilling methods and American barbecue techniques.
The kitchen is known for its signature whole-roasted cauliflower, prepared with goat cheese and a shishito herb vinaigrette.

Name: L'Atelier de Joel Robuchon
Master_Source_text: L'Atelier de Joel Robuchon in the Miami Design District holds two Michelin stars and is operated by The Bastion Collection.

Name: La Nonna Ristorante
Master_Source_text: La Nonna Ristorante in Vail Village is led by chef Simone Reatti in partnership with Luc and Liz Meyer.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened in 2014 by self-taught chef Cono Morena, La Nonna Ristorante & Bar is an Italian dining room in the Williamsburg neighborhood of Brooklyn.
The restaurant focuses on traditional regional cuisine, offering a broad menu of handmade pastas, fresh seafood, and Roman-style pinsa.
Standout dishes include the Sacchetti al Peperoncino, which combines spicy ground sausage and Calabrian chilies in a tequila pink cream sauce.

Name: La Grande Boucherie
Master_Source_text: La Grande Boucherie is a Midtown Manhattan brasserie at 145 West 53rd Street, designed by The Prestige Group.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by The Group Hospitality, La Grande Boucherie is a sprawling French brasserie and steakhouse located in Midtown Manhattan.
Designed by The Prestige Group, the expansive space evokes the Belle Époque with an ornamental Art Nouveau aesthetic and a traditional bistro menu.
The dining room is anchored by a 150-year-old, 40-foot decorative glass ceiling that stretches over the main gallery.

Name: La Petite Mason (Cannes)
Master_Source_text: Set at Cannes' Palm Beach on Place Franklin Roosevelt, La Petite Maison is a Mediterranean restaurant led by chef Yiannis Kioroglou.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at Palm Beach, La Petite Maison Cannes is a French Mediterranean restaurant founded by Nicole Rubi and helmed by Chef Yiannis Kioroglou.
The contemporary dining room features a terrace with panoramic views stretching from Cap d'Antibes to the Lérins Islands.
The menu focuses on regional ingredients, offering signature dishes such as yellowtail carpaccio, pissaladière, and truffle scrambled eggs.

Name: LA Tennis Center
Master_Source_text: Set on UCLA's Westwood campus, the Los Angeles Tennis Center hosted the demonstration tennis event at the 1984 Summer Olympics.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
LA Tennis Centers is the birthplace of Live Ball, a fast-paced, doubles-style competitive format that has become one of LA's most popular tennis experiences, with three well-maintained locations across the Westside in Pacific Palisades, Westwood, and Cheviot Hills. 
Classes run for all levels from beginner to advanced, regularly featuring ex-professional and top Division I players in the highest-level clinics, alongside private lessons, junior development programs, and summer camps. 
It's an accessible, community-driven tennis destination that makes the sport genuinely fun for players at every stage.

Name: La Mome Plage
Master_Source_text: La Mome Plage is a private beach restaurant on Cannes's Boulevard de la Croisette, operated by La Mome Groupe.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the La Môme Group, La Môme Plage is a Mediterranean restaurant and beach club situated along the Boulevard de la Croisette in Cannes.
Redesigned by Parisian architect Fabrizio Casiraghi, the space channels the vintage French Riviera with a classic nautical aesthetic.
The teak decking and turquoise accents are directly inspired by the Riva Aquarama speedboat, creating a distinct maritime environment on the sand.

Name: La Natural
Master_Source_text: La Natural is a Little River pizzeria in Miami from Javier Ramirez and Andreina Matos, recognized by the MICHELIN Guide with a Bib Gourmand.

Name: La Petite Maison (LPM) London
Master_Source_text: Set at 53-54 Brook's Mews behind Claridge's in Mayfair, LPM London features on 50 Best Discovery and is associated with chef Raphael Duntoye.

Name: La Terrasse
Master_Source_text: Set within Chateau La Coste in Provence, an art-and-architecture wine estate, La Terrasse serves traditional Provencal cooking.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Cheval Blanc St-Tropez, La Terrasse is a Michelin-starred Mediterranean restaurant overseen by chef Arnaud Donckele.
The alfresco dining area unfolds beneath a canopy of umbrella pines, offering a menu rooted in regional Provençal influences.
Diners look out over the Bay of Saint-Tropez while eating dishes such as grilled lobster tail in its shell with roe sabayon.

Name: La Mome
Master_Source_text: Opened in 2015 by twin founders Antoine and Ugo Lecorche, La Mome is the first restaurant of La Mome Groupe on Rue Florian, a short walk from La Croisette in Cannes.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateurs Ugo and Antoine Lecorché, La Môme is a Mediterranean dining room in central Cannes.
Designed by interior architect Samy Chams, the space features walls hung with Slim Aarons photographs and a menu blending French and Italian coastal dishes.
As a signature dining ritual, waiters carry freshly laid replacement tabletops above their heads to swap out entire tables during service.

Name: La Sirena
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1986 and still run by Marcello and Diane Fiorentino, La Sirena in West Palm Beach has held Wine Spectator's Grand Award since 2015.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by James Beard Award-nominated chef Carlos Salgado, La Sirena is a Mexican restaurant in the Door County village of Ephraim, Wisconsin.
Following the closure of his Michelin-starred Taco María in California, Salgado relocated to the Midwest to open this lakeside dining space.
The property features an outdoor patio with direct views of Eagle Harbor and the waters of Lake Michigan.

Name: Laissez Faire
Master_Source_text: Laissez Faire is a cocktail lounge beneath The Beekman hotel at 10 Theatre Alley in the Financial District.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Laissez Faire is a bespoke cocktail lounge and microclub tucked inside the historic Beekman Hotel, built in 1883, its entrance marked by a neon sign hidden down a cobblestone alley in the Financial District. 
The space transitions from intimate lounge early in the evening to a full dance floor later in the night, with live jazz on Thursdays, world-class DJs on weekends, craft cocktails, and a natural wine selection. 
A rare find in Lower Manhattan, equal parts stylish date spot and underground nightlife destination.

Name: Lafayette
Master_Source_text: Lafayette is an American steakhouse in Brickell, Miami.

Name: Café Laurel
Master_Source_text: Brasserie Laurel is a French brasserie at Miami Worldcenter from Ariete Hospitality Group, the team behind chef Michael Beltran's Michelin-starred Ariete.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within Miami Worldcenter, Café Laurel is a French-inspired eatery from Michelin-starred chef Michael Beltran and Ariete Hospitality Group.
Occupying the space of the group's former Brasserie Laurel, the cafe merges Parisian culinary traditions with regional Miami influences.
The menu reimagines familiar comforts, featuring items like a Cuban sandwich croissant and a double-patty burger dressed in house-made Chug sauce.

Name: La Voile At La Reserve
Master_Source_text: La Voile is the two-Michelin-star restaurant at La Reserve Ramatuelle near Saint-Tropez, led by chef Eric Canino and owned by Michel Reybier.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within La Réserve Ramatuelle near Saint-Tropez, La Voile is a two-Michelin-starred restaurant helmed by Chef Eric Canino.
The kitchen focuses on health-conscious Provençal gastronomy, utilizing fresh produce from the estate's own vegetable garden to craft light Mediterranean dishes.
Meals are served on an outdoor terrace that overlooks the Mediterranean Sea and the surrounding Provençal garrigue.

Name: Lapis at the Fountainbleu
Master_Source_text: Set within the Morris Lapidus-designed Fontainebleau Miami Beach (opened 1954), Lapis The Spa holds a Forbes Travel Guide Four-Star rating.

Name: Bâoli Cannes
Master_Source_text: Set on Port Pierre Canto along La Croisette, Baoli Cannes brings together a restaurant, rooftop and club under Executive Chef Remi Solaz.

Name: La Tour Restaurant
Master_Source_text: Set in Vail Village, La Tour is a French restaurant from chef-owner Paul Ferzacca and a holder of Wine Spectator's Best of Award of Excellence.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Vail Village, Colorado, La Tour Restaurant is a French dining destination led by chef-owner Paul Ferzacca.
The kitchen focuses on farm-to-table ingredients and classic culinary techniques to create a seasonal menu.
Diners can order signature dishes like wild Burgundy escargots alongside selections from a wine cellar known for its collection of Romanée-Conti.

Name: La Vague D'or
Master_Source_text: La Vague d'Or is the three-MICHELIN-star restaurant at Cheval Blanc St-Tropez, led by chef Arnaud Donckele and rated 19/20 by Gault & Millau.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Cheval Blanc St-Tropez hotel, La Vague d'Or is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant helmed by chef Arnaud Donckele.
The menu focuses on Mediterranean cuisine, utilizing seasonal ingredients sourced directly from a network of regional farmers and fishermen.
A standout dish is the signature scarlet prawns, which are lightly seared and served with Corsican grapefruit.

Name: Le Charlot
Master_Source_text: Owned by restaurateurs Thierry and Bruno Gelormini, Le Charlot is at 36 Main Street in Southampton, reviewed by the New York Times.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by Bruno and Thierry Gelormini in 1995, this Upper East Side bistro brings the regional flavors of Corsica to New York.
The dining room features a Mediterranean aesthetic, defined by abundant natural light, woven rattan chairs, and crisp white tablecloths.
A signature menu item is the artichoke special, which arrives whole and is paired with a champagne vinaigrette.

Name: Le Crocodile
Master_Source_text: Le Crocodile is the Wythe Hotel's Williamsburg brasserie from chefs Aidan O'Neal and Jake Leiber, awarded three stars by the New York Times.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Le Crocodile is an all-day French brasserie in Brooklyn's Wythe Hotel, helmed by chefs Jake Leiber and Aidan O'Neal and awarded three stars by the New York Times.
The restaurant serves classic French fare, adapting the traditional Parisian bistro format for a contemporary setting.
The dining room features elevated wainscoting, built-in booths, and velvet chairs, complementing signature dishes like honey-glazed duck confit.

Name: Le Bon Marché
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1838, Le Bon Marche is a Left Bank department store in Paris owned by LVMH, featuring 19th-century architecture by Gustave Eiffel's firm.

Name: Le Cap
Master_Source_text: Le Cap is the one-Michelin-star restaurant at the Grand-Hotel du Cap-Ferrat, A Four Seasons Hotel, in Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat, Le Cap is a Michelin-starred restaurant helmed by executive chef Yoric Tièche.
The menu centers on maritime-influenced Provençal and Mediterranean cuisine, incorporating seasonal vegetables and herbs harvested directly from the hotel's gardens.
Signature plates such as blue lobster with Basque black pudding are paired with selections from a cellar stocking 1,200 wines.

Name: Le Club 55
Master_Source_text: On Pampelonne beach in Ramatuelle, Le Club 55 is a beach restaurant founded in 1955 that began as the canteen for Brigitte Bardot's And God Created Woman film crew.

Name: Le Bilboquet Sag Harbor
Master_Source_text: Opened in 2017, Le Bilboquet Sag Harbor is the Hamptons outpost of Philippe Delgrange's group, co-owned with Ron Perelman and Steven Witkoff.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by restaurateur Philippe Delgrange, Le Bilboquet is a French bistro situated directly on the waterfront in Sag Harbor.
The white-tablecloth dining room and outdoor terrace serve as a gathering space focused on classic European fare and fresh seafood towers.
Diners can order the restaurant's signature Le Poulet Cajun while taking in unobstructed views of the adjacent marina.

Name: Le Dive
Master_Source_text: Le Dive is a French tabac-inspired natural-wine bar at 37 Canal Street on the Lower East Side, from operator Golden Age Hospitality.

Name: Le Diplomate
Master_Source_text: Le Diplomate is a French brasserie at 1601 14th St NW in Washington DC's Logan Circle, operated by STARR Restaurants.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Washington, D.C.’s Logan Circle, Le Diplomate is a French brasserie from restaurateur Stephen Starr.
Built within a historic structure, the space replicates the atmosphere of a Parisian café with traditional bistro seating and a menu of French staples.
Meals begin with a complimentary bread basket featuring a house-made cranberry-walnut loaf that has received national media coverage.

Name: Libre
Master_Source_text: Set in Wynd 27 in Wynwood, Libre is an aerial fitness and hot Pilates studio holding a 4.9/5 rating on ClassPass from 995 reviews.

Name: Le Pastis Cannes
Master_Source_text: Le Pastis is a bistro and cafe-comptoir at 28 Rue du Commandant Andre in Cannes, next to La Croisette, operated by DB Group hospitality.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by David Barokas’s DB Group, Le Pastis is a traditional French bistro and café-comptoir located just steps from the Croisette in Cannes.
The kitchen focuses on market-driven Mediterranean cuisine, serving regional dishes such as truffle-roasted free-range chicken and roasted tuna with olive oil and basil.
The dining room incorporates classic design elements, featuring a traditional brass counter, Chesterfield leather seating, and vintage advertising posters.

Name: Lido
Master_Source_text: Set on Belle Isle at The Standard Spa Miami Beach, Lido Bayside Grill is the bayside restaurant operated by The Standard Hotels.

Name: Leonor Greyl
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1968, the Leonor Greyl hair-care house operates its Institut at 15 rue Tronchet in Paris's 8th arrondissement, near Opera Garnier.

Name: Lilla Ego
Master_Source_text: Lilla Ego is a Vasastan restaurant in Stockholm led by chefs Tom Sjostedt and Daniel Rams, both winners of Sweden's Arets Kock (Chef of the Year).
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Stockholm's Vasastan neighborhood, Lilla Ego is a restaurant founded by award-winning chefs Tom Sjöstedt and Daniel Räms.
The rustic dining room features exposed brick walls and white tiles, providing an unpretentious backdrop for contemporary Swedish cooking.
Meals begin with a distinct opening ritual of warm sourdough bread accompanied by grated butter and roasted sunflower seeds.

Name: Leonetta
Master_Source_text: Helmed by Top Chef finalist Ed Cotton, Leonetta is a Mediterranean restaurant in Murray Hill, Manhattan.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Top Chef alum Ed Cotton, Leonetta is a Mediterranean restaurant located in Manhattan's Murray Hill neighborhood.
The kitchen focuses on sharable plates and seasonal dishes that blend coastal flavors with a lighter style of cooking.
RD Studio designed the interiors to evoke the Mediterranean coastline, providing a backdrop for dishes like the crab ceviche.

Name: LEGACY
Master_Source_text: LEGACY is a Miami fitness brand founded by trainer Manning Sumner, built around his patented Partner Interval Training (PIT) system, with its first gym opening in 2008.

Name: Licoreria Limantour
Master_Source_text: Set in Roma Norte, Mexico City, Licoreria Limantour ranked among the World's 50 Best Bars and is known for its inventive cocktail program.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Lilla Baren
Master_Source_text: Lilla Baren is the bar inside Riche at Birger Jarlsgatan 4 in Stockholm, tied to the brasserie's 1893 origins.

Name: Lola 41
Master_Source_text: Lola 41 is the global bistro and sushi bar at White Elephant Palm Beach, located at 290 Sunset Avenue in Palm Beach.

Name: LIV (Fontainebleau)

Name: Little Sister
Master_Source_text: Little Sister is an underground lounge at Moxy NYC East Village, designed by Rockwell Group and operated by Tao Group Hospitality. An AHEAD Americas 2020 winner.

Name: Los Fuegos by Francis Mallmann
Master_Source_text: Set inside Faena Hotel Miami Beach, Los Fuegos by Francis Mallmann is an Argentinian live-fire restaurant listed in the MICHELIN Guide.

Name: Living Room
Master_Source_text: The Living Room is a cocktail lounge and live-music bar at Faena Hotel Miami Beach, a property developed with Baz Luhrmann and Catherine Martin.

Name: Love Life Cafe
Master_Source_text: Co-founded by Veronica Menin and chef Diego Tosoni, Love Life Cafe is a plant-based restaurant in Wynwood, named Best Vegan Restaurant in Miami New Times' 2024 Best of Miami.

Name: Luca Osteria
Master_Source_text: Chef Giorgio Rapicavoli, a Chopped champion, leads Luca Osteria, an Italian osteria and bar on Coral Gables' Giralda Plaza.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Luca Osteria is an Italian restaurant located on Coral Gables' pedestrian Giralda Plaza, led by award-winning chef Giorgio Rapicavoli.
The menu presents a modern interpretation of Italian cooking, breaking culinary conventions to focus on hearty, ingredient-driven dishes.
A signature dish is the patate fritte, a truffled potato puff appetizer crowned tableside with Parmigiano fonduta and a golden egg yolk.

Name: Luna Sol
Master_Source_text: LunaSol is a Wynwood nightlife project from Keith Paciello, Derek Gonzalez of Goat Hospitality Group, and Ryan Van Milligen.

Name: Lure Fishbar
Master_Source_text: Opened in 2004, Lure Fishbar is a SoHo seafood restaurant at 142 Mercer Street from Mercer Street Hospitality.

Name: Luigi
Master_Source_text: At the foot of the Hotel Martinez in Cannes, Luigi is a 1956-founded Italian restaurant and piano-bar, redesigned in 2021 by Paris architect Fabrizio Casiraghi.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originally established in 1956, Luigi is an Italian restaurant and club in Cannes that was completely redesigned by Parisian architect Fabrizio Casiraghi in 2021.
The venue operates as a combined dining and nightlife space, serving a menu focused on traditional Italian and Mediterranean cuisine.
A central piano anchors the main room, hosting live music performances each evening to accompany the dinner service.

Name: Louie
Master_Source_text: Louie is a four-floor restaurant and bar in a 19th-century townhouse at 13-15 West Street between Covent Garden and Soho, operated by Paris Society.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within a 19th-century townhouse in London's Covent Garden, Louie is a multi-level dining destination operated by French hospitality group Paris Society.
The venue unfolds across three floors, transitioning from a Japanese-inspired izakaya serving robata dishes on the ground level to a French brasserie above.
The experience culminates at the top-floor Alligator Bar, a late-night lounge featuring live DJs and an open-air terrace.

Name: Lulu Kitchen & Bar
Master_Source_text: In Sag Harbor, Lulu Kitchen & Bar is a year-round, wood-fired restaurant opened in 2017, led by chef Philippe Corbet and holding Wine Spectator's Award of Excellence.

Name: Love Yoga
Master_Source_text: Founded by Kyle Miller and Sian Gordon, Love Yoga is a Venice, LA studio opened in 2015 on Lincoln Boulevard, profiled by Vogue.

Name: Lung Yai Thai Tapas
Master_Source_text: Lung Yai Thai Tapas in Little Havana is led by chef/owner Veenuthri Trisransri and is recognized by the MICHELIN Guide with a Bib Gourmand.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Lung Yai Thai Tapas is a Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurant in Miami's Little Havana neighborhood, led by a Bangkok-born chef.
The compact space focuses on traditional Thai street food, delivering plates that balance salty, sweet, sour, and spicy flavors.
Diners gather on the outdoor patio to share signature dishes like the palo moo and northern Thai khao soi.

Name: Mamo Miami
Master_Source_text: MAMO Miami is the Brickell outpost of the SoHo-born Italian restaurant co-founded by Mikael Mammoliti with chef Salvatore Marcello, at 931 Brickell Avenue.

Name: Luxe Wellness Club
Master_Source_text: Luxe Wellness Club is a wellness-travel concierge founded in 2018 by Pascal Languillon, with offices in Biarritz, Dubai and New York. Won Travel Agency of the Year at Destination Deluxe Awards 2025.

Name: Mamo Michelangelo
Master_Source_text: Since 1992, Mamo has run Mamo Michelangelo in Antibes, set behind the ramparts in the former Domaine Ott wine cellar, welcoming guests from the Cannes Film Festival and Jazz a Juan.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Chef Mamo in 1992, Mamo Michelangelo is an Italian and Provençal restaurant set behind the ramparts of Antibes.
The kitchen focuses on the culinary traditions of southern Italy and the South of France, emphasizing regional ingredients and wood-fired cooking.
Signature dishes such as truffle focaccia and lobster risotto are served in a dining room defined by exposed stone walls and candlelight.

Name: Maiella
Master_Source_text: Maiella is an Italian restaurant on the Long Island City waterfront in Queens, designed by Bluarch and led by executive chef Giuseppe Agostino.

Name: Lyaness
Master_Source_text: Lyaness is Ryan Chetiyawardana's cocktail bar at Sea Containers London on the South Bank, winner of World's Best Bar at the 2022 Tales of the Cocktail Spirited Awards.

Name: Marion Miami
Master_Source_text: Marion Miami is a restaurant, lounge and cocktail bar in Brickell.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Mr. Hospitality, Marion Miami is an Asian-Mediterranean supper club in Brickell featuring a menu by Executive Chef Kylian Goussot.
The venue transitions from a seated dining room into a nightlife space, recently updated with a four-million-dollar interior redesign by Carlos Rodriguez.
The restaurant is known for its Thursday soiree dinner parties, which center around a dedicated champagne bar and sets by international DJs.

Name: Mama's Fish House
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1973 on Maui's North Shore, Mama's Fish House is led by Executive Chef Perry Bateman and was a 2018 James Beard Foundation semifinalist.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Maui's North Shore, Mama's Fish House is a 2018 James Beard Foundation semi-finalist founded by Doris Christenson and led by Executive Chef Perry Bateman.
Set along the beachfront of Ku'au Cove, the kitchen focuses on fresh, locally caught seafood.
The daily menu credits the specific local fisherman who caught each fish and notes the exact location of the catch.

Name: Matsuhisa Athens
Master_Source_text: Designed by Rockwell Group, Matsuhisa Athens is Nobu Matsuhisa's restaurant within Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel Athens.

Name: Maxime's Club
Master_Source_text: From London club operator Robin Birley, Maxime's is a private members' club at 848 Madison Avenue on the Upper East Side that opened in March 2025.

Name: Mary Lous (WPB)
Master_Source_text: Mary Lou's is a restaurant and cocktail bar in West Palm Beach co-founded by Alex Melillo, Joe Cervasio, and Topher Grubb. Named one of USA TODAY's best bars for 2025.

Name: Marisi
Master_Source_text: Marisi is an Italian restaurant in La Jolla, named Best Italian Restaurant 2025 by San Diego Magazine and among its Top 5 Restaurants of 2024.

Name: Masala y Maiz
Master_Source_text: Masala y Maiz, from chefs Norma Listman and Saqib Keval, holds one MICHELIN Star in Mexico City and sits on Calle Articulo 123 in Colonia Centro.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Masala y Maíz is a Michelin-starred restaurant in Mexico City, founded and operated by chefs Norma Listman and Saqib Keval.
The menu explores the historical migration of ingredients by blending Mexican, Indian, and East African culinary techniques.
Signature plates include jumbo grilled shrimp and fried baby chicken, served within an industrial space alongside a diverse wine selection.

Name: Martinez
Master_Source_text: Chef-owner Lucho Martinez's Martinez is a MICHELIN Guide-listed restaurant in Roma Norte, Mexico City, at Puebla 90.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Martínez is a Michelin-recognized restaurant in Mexico City's Roma Norte neighborhood, helmed by chef Lucho Martínez.
Inspired by Parisian bistros with nods to Mexican and Japanese cuisines, the intimate space offers a concise menu featuring dishes like pollo a la parrilla.
Diners can order at the bar for a direct view into the open kitchen, or grab a post-meal espresso from Tormenta, the chef's street-side coffee stand outside.

Name: Mavericks
Master_Source_text: Mavericks is a waterfront restaurant on Montauk's Fort Pond co-opened by sommelier Vanessa Price and James Beard-nominated chef Jeremy Blutstein.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Mavericks Montauk is a modern steakhouse situated on Fort Pond in Montauk, led by wine director Vanessa Price and James Beard-nominated chef Jeremy Blutstein.
The restaurant updates the traditional surf-and-turf concept by focusing on locally caught seafood, seasonal produce, and wood-fired steaks.
Diners enter through an oyster shell-lined hallway into a split-level dining room with westward-facing windows that frame sunset views over the water.

Name: Matsuhisa Aspen
Master_Source_text: Matsuhisa Aspen, by Chef Nobu Matsuhisa, opened in 1998 in a 120-year-old Main Street Victorian house in downtown Aspen, the first Matsuhisa beyond his original Beverly Hills location.

Name: Mastro's
Master_Source_text: Mastro's Ocean Club in Downtown Miami is part of Tilman Fertitta's Landry's group of upscale steakhouse and seafood restaurants.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1999 and now operated by the Landry's, Inc. portfolio, Mastro's is a national collection of steakhouses and seafood restaurants.
The venues pair USDA Prime steaks and fresh seafood with live music in the dining rooms.
A signature element of the experience is the multi-tiered seafood presentation served over dry ice, followed by the warm butter cake.

Name: Miami Sound Bar
Master_Source_text: Miami Sound Bar is a Downtown Miami listening bar, named Best Bar by Miami New Times in 2024.

Name: Medium Cool
Master_Source_text: Medium Cool is a subterranean cocktail lounge at 1690 Collins Avenue in Miami Beach, created by bar veterans Dan Binkiewicz, David Martinez, Josh Harris and Naren Young. Named Best Jazz Night by Miami New Times in 2024.

Name: Meju
Master_Source_text: Meju is a one-MICHELIN-star Korean chef's counter in Long Island City, Queens, led by Hooni Kim and located behind Little Banchan Shop.

Name: Michael's Genuine
Master_Source_text: Michael's Genuine Food & Drink is chef Michael Schwartz's Design District flagship. Schwartz won the James Beard Award for Best Chef: South in 2010, and the restaurant holds a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Michael's Genuine Food & Drink is a neighborhood restaurant in Miami's Design District, founded by James Beard Award-winning chef Michael Schwartz.
The Michelin-recognized eatery focuses on unpretentious, locally sourced comfort food and seasonal wood-fired fare.
Guests can dine in the outdoor courtyard while enjoying signature dishes like the classic deviled eggs and crispy pig ears with chile and lime.

Name: Miami Beach Golf Club
Master_Source_text: Originally laid out in 1923, Miami Beach Golf Club was fully rebuilt by Arthur Hills in 2002 and is one of the few public courses within a major American city.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Mimi Yoga
Master_Source_text: Founded by Mimi Ghandour, Mimi Yoga operates studios in Miami's Wynwood and Coconut Grove, holding a 4.9 rating from 30,000+ ClassPass reviews.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Miss River
Master_Source_text: Miss River is the lobby-level signature restaurant at Four Seasons Hotel New Orleans, led by James Beard Award-winning chef Alon Shaya.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located inside the Four Seasons Hotel New Orleans, Miss River is a Southern restaurant led by James Beard Award-winning chef Alon Shaya.
The menu focuses on Creole classics and Cajun flavors, utilizing ingredients sourced from a network of local fishermen and farmers.
A signature dish is the whole buttermilk fried chicken, which is presented tableside and carved to share.

Name: Mosquito Supper Club
Master_Source_text: Mosquito Supper Club in New Orleans is a celebrated Cajun supper-club restaurant.

Name: MNT Studio - Marina
Master_Source_text: Founded by Pilates instructor Elaine Hayes, MNT Studio's Marina flagship is located at 2154 Union Street in San Francisco.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
MNTSTUDIO is San Francisco's first Wellness Social Club, a boutique Pilates and coworking destination at 2154 Union St. in the Marina neighborhood, open since 2024.
Amenities include Dyson hair tools, premium shower products, a full kitchenette, Pebble Ice Machine, coffee, tea, and 3 private phone booths at the Marina coworking space.
The Marina flagship offers Reformer and Heated Mat Pilates classes at 80 degrees, plus a coworking suite with Xebec monitor rentals; Mission Rock adds a Communal Contrast Therapy Suite with infrared sauna and red light therapy.

Name: MM
Master_Source_text: MM is a members-only club beneath MILA Restaurant in Miami Beach, part of Riviera Dining Group, with a culinary program led by Chef Michael Michaelidis.

Name: Migrante
Master_Source_text: Migrante in Roma Norte, Mexico City, is led by chef Fernando Martinez Zavala and is listed by the MICHELIN Guide.

Name: MOTIVNY
Master_Source_text: MOTIVNY is a NYC physical therapy and coaching studio founded by Doctors of Physical Therapy Luke Greenberg and David Jou, at 199 Mott Street.

Name: Mountain Standard
Master_Source_text: Mountain Standard is a restaurant on Gore Creek in Vail, opened in 2012 by the Sweet Basil team and now owned by Matt Morgan.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened by the team behind Sweet Basil, Mountain Standard is a gastropub situated along Gore Creek in Vail, Colorado.
The kitchen, led by Chef McLean Hyde, prepares the majority of its regional American menu over an open wood fire.
Diners can order the signature corned pork shank, which arrives with gruyere potato puree, green apple, and a caraway vinaigrette.

Name: MPH Club
Master_Source_text: Founded in 2010 by CEO Liram Sustiel, mph club is a Miami-based exotic and luxury car rental operator with multiple South Florida locations.

Name: The Mulberry
Master_Source_text: The Mulberry is a subterranean bar at 240 Mulberry Street in SoHo, founded by Phil Meynell, Leo Jacob, and Justin Sievers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Narbona
Master_Source_text: Narbona is a Uruguayan restaurant from a family farm and winery founded in 1909, with a location in Coconut Grove, Miami.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originating from a 1909 winery in Carmelo, Uruguay, Narbona is a farm-to-table restaurant and gourmet market whose flagship estate holds Relais & Châteaux status.
The menu centers on Uruguayan and European dishes crafted from ingredients produced directly on the brand's agricultural properties.
Diners pair wood-fired meats and fresh pastas with the estate's proprietary Tannat wines, cheeses, and signature dulce de leche.

Name: Nobu London
Master_Source_text: Nobu London Old Park Lane is chef Nobu Matsuhisa's original London restaurant, opened in 1997 on the first floor of COMO Metropolitan London.

Name: Nobu Downtown
Master_Source_text: Nobu Downtown in Manhattan's Financial District occupies two levels of the landmarked former AT&T building at 195 Broadway, designed by Rockwell Group.

Name: Navy Beach
Master_Source_text: Opened in 2010 in Montauk, Navy Beach is a waterfront restaurant run by co-owners Frank and Kristina Davis, Franklin Ferguson, and Leyla Marchetto.

Name: Musket Room
Master_Source_text: On Elizabeth Street in Manhattan, Musket Room holds one Michelin star, led by chef Mary Attea and pastry chef Camari Mick, named Food & Wine Best New Chefs in 2024.

Name: Nobu Caesars Palace
Master_Source_text: At Caesars Palace in Las Vegas, Nobu sits within the world's first Nobu Hotel, with interiors by Rockwell Group.

Name: NYC Performance Lab
Master_Source_text: NYC Performance Lab is a human performance testing and training facility in Midtown Manhattan at 11 West 36th Street.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
NYC Performance Lab is Manhattan's first boutique human performance facility, located at 11 West 36th Street, offering elite-level diagnostics and training to the general public.
Services include DEXA scans, VO2 Max testing, 3D body composition analysis, Resting Metabolic Rate assessment, gait analysis with Plantiga Smart Insoles, and personalized nutrition programs.

Name: Nobu Las Vegas at Virgin Hotel
Master_Source_text: Nobu Las Vegas at Virgin Hotel opened in 1999 and is Chef Nobu Matsuhisa's original Las Vegas location, co-owned with Robert De Niro and Meir Teper.

Name: NOW Massage
Master_Source_text: Co-founded by Jason and Gara Post, The NOW Massage runs a Wynwood boutique at 61 NW 26th Street inside Sentral Wynwood.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Noisy Oyster
Master_Source_text: Noisy Oyster is a 50-cover seafood bistro in Shoreditch, London, designed by Harry Nuriev of Crosby Studios, from the duo behind Soho's Firebird.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by the founders of Soho’s Firebird, Noisy Oyster is a seafood bistro in Shoreditch featuring interiors by Crosby Studios architect Harry Nuriev.
The dining room embraces a raw, work-in-progress aesthetic with exposed ceilings, cable-wrapped columns, and a large stainless steel bar.
Head chef Alfie Bahnan serves a Mediterranean-leaning menu highlighted by freshly shucked Irish oysters and a sweet maritozzo topped with caviar.

Name: NoFar Method
Master_Source_text: Founded by instructor Nofar Hagag, Nofar Method is a Manhattan Pilates studio with locations in Flatiron and TriBeCa, praised by model Paulina Porizkova.

Name: Oasis Day Spa
Master_Source_text: Oasis Day Spa's Manhattan location sits at One Park Avenue and was named Best of New York by New York Magazine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Odeon
Master_Source_text: The Odeon has operated in Tribeca since 1980, founded by Lynn Wagenknecht with Keith and Brian McNally; Wagenknecht continues to run the brasserie.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1980 by restaurateurs Lynn Wagenknecht, Keith McNally, and Brian McNally, The Odeon is a French-American brasserie in New York's Tribeca neighborhood.
The restaurant anchored the downtown dining scene of the era, drawing artists and writers to its retro-styled room.
Its original neon sign remains unchanged, and the bar is widely credited as the birthplace of the modern Cosmopolitan cocktail.

Name: Nobu Paris Casino
Master_Source_text: Chef Nobu Matsuhisa opened Nobu at Paris Las Vegas in early 2022, the brand's third Las Vegas restaurant.

Name: Esencia Wellness Spa at Nobu Hotel Miami Beach
Master_Source_text: At Nobu Hotel Miami Beach within the Eden Roc complex, the spa operates as Esencia Wellness.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Osaka
Master_Source_text: Founded in Lima in 2002, Osaka's Miami outpost sits inside the Brickell House condominium.

Name: Omakai Aventura
Master_Source_text: OMAKAI Aventura at 18831 Biscayne Blvd is part of the Miami-born sushi group founded in 2019.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by brothers Diego and Pedro Quijada alongside Chef Aaron Pate, Omakai Aventura is a sushi restaurant in North Miami.
The space features a minimalist interior by Pink Birch Design and Urvan X Architecture, offering a fixed-price omakase experience alongside patio seating.
Guests can order individual nigiri or opt for the signature fifteen-course tasting menu served directly at the hand roll bar.

Master_Source_text: Founded in 2019, OMAKAI's Wynwood location at 2107 NW 2nd Ave sits just steps from Wynwood Walls in Miami.

Founded in 2019 by brothers Diego and Pedro Quijada alongside Chef Aaron Pate, Omakai is a sushi restaurant in Miami's Wynwood neighborhood.

Diners can order the signature Oma tasting menu, which is served in a minimalist room defined by subtle ambient lighting.

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami's Brickell neighborhood, Omakai Hand Roll Bar is a sushi restaurant founded by brothers Diego and Pedro Quijada alongside chef Aaron Pate.
The concept centers on a set omakase menu, prioritizing fresh fish and the precise construction of handcrafted rolls.
The interior features custom wall paneling designed by Oldenburg Studio, serving as the backdrop for items like the signature blue crab hand roll.

Name: Papa San

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Papa San is a Peruvian Japanese izakaya in Manhattan's Hudson Yards, created by chef Erik Ramirez and Juan Correa of the Llama Group.
The restaurant expands on the operators' Nikkei cuisine, blending South American and Asian ingredients in a space anchored by an open kitchen.
The menu features an eel pizza topped with shiitake mushrooms, pecorino cheese, and a layer of bonito flakes.

Name: Pao by Paul Qui
Master_Source_text: Set in the Faena Hotel Miami Beach, Pao by Paul Qui is helmed by Paul Qui, a Top Chef champion and James Beard Award winner.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by James Beard Award-winning chef Paul Qui, Pao is a modern Asian restaurant located within the Faena Hotel in Miami Beach.
The menu weaves Filipino, Spanish, Japanese, and French culinary influences into technique-driven dishes.
The dining room features ocean views and is anchored by Damien Hirst's "Golden Myth," a gilded unicorn sculpture that inspired the restaurant's signature sea urchin dish.

Name: Pargot
Master_Source_text: Chef Alexis Ayala's Pargot at Cordoba 212 in Roma Norte, Mexico City, is recognized by the Michelin Guide with a Bib Gourmand.

Name: Paloma
Master_Source_text: Paloma is a late-night club in South Kensington, London, at 92b Old Brompton Road, opened in September 2025.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the team behind Festsaal Kreuzberg, Paloma Bar is a 1970s-themed nightlife destination on Kottbusser Tor in Berlin.
The venue functions as a hybrid club and bar, defined by a raw interior and a music program spanning from funk to techno.
Positioned on an upper floor, the space features direct views of the elevated U-Bahn tracks from a dance floor designed to resemble a vintage living room.

Name: Pearl

Name: Pause Studio
Master_Source_text: Pause Studio is a Los Angeles recovery studio with locations in Venice, West Hollywood, Brentwood and Studio City.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by former Equinox executive John Klein, Pause Studio is a modern recovery and wellness center with locations across Los Angeles and Coral Gables.
The facility focuses on science-backed physical recovery, providing private suites equipped for whole-body cryotherapy, contrast therapy, and sensory deprivation floats.
Guests complete their sessions with curated amenities, including Le Labo shower products, Hyperice recovery tools, and Rishi herbal teas.

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Paul's Casablanca is a SoHo cocktail lounge and nightclub opened by nightlife operators Paul Sevigny and Brian McPeck.
Housed in the former Sway Lounge space, the venue retains its predecessor's Moroccan-ornamented decor while dedicating each night to a different musical genre.
Doorman Fabrizio Brienza manages the entrance, leading to a dance floor that hosts a weekly Smiths-themed party under a central disco ball.

Name: Penmar Golf Course

Name: Prenuvo (New York)
Master_Source_text: Prenuvo operates a whole-body MRI clinic in Manhattan at 312 W 34th St, with FDA-cleared body composition and brain volume reports.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by CEO Andrew Lacy and radiologist Dr. Raj Attariwala, Prenuvo is a preventative health clinic in New York offering proactive, whole-body MRI scans.
The radiation-free imaging technology is designed to detect early-stage cancers and asymptomatic conditions like aneurysms before they progress.
The comprehensive scan takes up to 60 minutes in an open-bore machine, allowing patients to stream Netflix or listen to music during the process.

Name: Prenuvo (Los Angeles)
Master_Source_text: Prenuvo is a whole-body MRI screening clinic in Los Angeles, offering preventive health imaging.

Name: Prenuvo (Miami)

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Andrew Lacy and Dr. Raj Attariwala, Prenuvo operates a preventative health clinic in Coral Gables offering proactive, whole-body MRI scans.
The facility utilizes radiation-free imaging technology to screen for hundreds of conditions, including early-stage solid tumors and aneurysms, in under an hour.
During the procedure, patients can stream Netflix or listen to evidence-based music therapy designed to reduce anxiety.

The restaurant pairs its seasonal menu with a selection of natural wines and classic cocktails.
Guests dine on an open-air terrace where pizzas are baked to order in a traditional stone oven.
