Master_Source_text: Prince Arthur is a Belgravia corner pub on Pimlico Road housing a Basque restaurant led by Head Chef Adam Iglesias, listed in the MICHELIN Guide.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognised by the Michelin Guide, The Prince Arthur is a Basque-influenced restaurant housed within a restored Victorian pub in London's Belgravia.
The space retains its traditional wood-panelled architecture while shifting the culinary focus to an iced seafood counter and a wood-fired grill.
Signature menu items include pintxo gildas, whole turbot with pil pil sauce, and a torrija dessert paired with Guinness ice cream.

Name: Queen
Master_Source_text: Set in the restored 1945 Paris Theater on Washington Avenue, Queen is a Miami Beach Japanese-style grill and sushi restaurant.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Miami Beach's restored Paris Theater, Queen is a Japanese steakhouse and lounge operated by restaurateur Mathieu Massa.
The venue repurposes a 1945 Art Deco landmark into a sprawling dining and nightlife space, pairing Wagyu beef and sushi with live entertainment.
The interior features Lobmeyr chandeliers and an open kitchen, while a hidden counter offers a 14-course omakase menu led by Chef Max Kamakura.

Name: Public Records
Master_Source_text: Public Records is a music venue, bar and eatery in a former ASPCA building at 233 Butler Street, Gowanus. Esquire named it one of the best bars in America in 2020.

Located on the ground floor of The Ben hotel in downtown West Palm Beach, Proper Grit is a restaurant led by Executive Chef Daniel Pundik.
The kitchen focuses on classic American comfort fare prepared with locally sourced, seasonal Florida ingredients.
A signature weekend tea service pairs sweet and savory bites with Jenwey Tea Co. blends and optional tea-infused cocktails.

Recognized with a Four-Star rating from Forbes Travel Guide, Raffles Spa is a wellness center located within the Raffles Arcade at Raffles Hotel Singapore.
The spa centers its treatments around a gemstone theme, utilizing crystal-infused oils alongside skincare products from Biologique Recherche and ISUN.
Guests have access to hydrothermal amenities that include a warm Peruvian salt pool, an herbal sauna, and an ice fountain.

Name: Quintonil
Master_Source_text: Quintonil in Polanco, Mexico City, led by chef Jorge Vallejo with Alejandra Flores, holds two Michelin stars and ranks among the World's 50 Best.

Name: Red Hook Tavern
Master_Source_text: Red Hook Tavern in Red Hook, Brooklyn, is by Billy Durney and was named a New York Times Critic's Pick by Pete Wells.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Brooklyn, Red Hook Tavern is a neighborhood restaurant from James Beard-nominated pitmaster and chef Billy Durney.
The menu serves classic New York tavern fare within the waterfront neighborhood, maintaining a traditional pub atmosphere.
The restaurant's signature offering is an eight-ounce dry-aged burger topped with molten American cheese and crisp white onion.

Name: Ritz Carlton Spa
Master_Source_text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa New York, NoMad sits within The Ritz-Carlton New York, NoMad, a Manhattan tower designed by Rafael Vinoly.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The Ritz-Carlton Spa New York, NoMad is a 6,800-square-foot wellness sanctuary located at 25 West 28th Street in Manhattan's NoMad neighborhood, within the all-glass 50-story Ritz-Carlton hotel.
Amenities include 8 treatment rooms, men's and women's aromatherapy saunas, steam rooms, experience showers, private relaxation lounges, and a 24-hour fitness center.

Name: Reviv
Master_Source_text: Founded in 2013, REVIV is a global provider of IV drip therapy and vitamin shots, with clinics across 47 countries including Miami Brickell.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
REVIV is a global IV drip therapy and precision nutrition brand, founded in Miami in 2013, operating 108+ clinics across 47 countries, with locations inside iconic venues including The Cosmopolitan Las Vegas, Harrods London, and Harvey Nichols Knightsbridge.
Amenities include private treatment rooms, massage chairs, Strip-view or city-view seating, mobile in-room service, and a multidisciplinary team of doctors, pharmacists, nurses, and scientists.
Signature therapies include Ultraviv, Vitaglow, Megaboost, Royal Flush, NAD+, and HELIIX, plus B12, Glutathione, and CoQ10+ booster shots, formulated by medical professionals.
Treatment types span in-clinic IV drips, intramuscular vitamin shots, blood testing, and genetic sequencing at Flagship locations; REVIV X clinics offer express wellness between meetings.

Name: Roosevelt Golf Course
Master_Source_text: Roosevelt Municipal Golf Course in Griffith Park is a City of LA-operated nine-hole executive course restored in 2019 by architect Forrest Richardson.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Roosevelt Golf Course, a City of Los Angeles municipal 9-hole executive course, sits at 2650 N. Vermont Ave. in Griffith Park, directly across from the Greek Theatre.
Walking-only course with a practice putting green, rental clubs, and a cafe; 2,478 yards from longest tees, par 33, slope rating 110.

Name: Rescue Spa
Master_Source_text: Rescue Spa, founded by esthetician Danuta Mieloch, operates at 29 East 19th Street in Manhattan and is included in Vogue's 2025 Global Spa Guide.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Rescue Spa NYC, founded by master esthetician Danuta Mieloch, is a luxury day spa at 29 East 19th Street in Manhattan's Flatiron District, open 7 days a week.
Amenities include advanced modalities such as microcurrent, LED, ultrasound, RF, and IPL, plus a retail boutique carrying Biologique Recherche, Danucera, MBR, SkinCeuticals, Valmont, and Environ.
Signature treatments include the Bio-Lift Facial, the Fix-It-All Facial, deep tissue, Swedish, and hot stone massage, plus hair services using Oribe and Miriam Quevedo.
Services span facials, body treatments, nails, hair color, and blowouts; the duplex Flatiron location offers group reservations of 3 or more with special booking policies.

Name: Roe
Master_Source_text: Roe is a three-storey, 500-cover restaurant in Wood Wharf (Canary Wharf), opened in April 2024 by Fallow co-founders Will Murray and Jack Croft.

Name: Restaurante Rosetta
Master_Source_text: Restaurante Rosetta in Roma Norte is led by Elena Reygadas, named The World's Best Female Chef 2023, and holds one MICHELIN star.

Name: Restore Hyper Wellness
Master_Source_text: Restore Hyper Wellness operates a West Palm Beach studio at 2795 S Dixie Hwy, part of a national network with 225+ locations.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Restore Hyper Wellness operates two Palm Beach area locations: in Palm Beach Gardens and West Palm Beach.

Core therapies include Whole Body Cryotherapy (up to 3 minutes, sub-zero temps), Infrared Sauna (30–45 minutes), Red Light Therapy, Compression, and Mild Hyperbaric Chamber.

Name: Reserve Padel (New York)
Master_Source_text: Reserve Padel is a members-only padel club in Hudson Yards, Manhattan, founded by Wayne Boich.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Reserve Padel Hudson Yards, at 360 10th Ave in Manhattan, is New York City's first padel club, established in 2023 at the Hudson Yards development.
The members-only club features 3 outdoor glass-enclosed padel courts, elevated viewing areas, wellness amenities, locker rooms, a pro-shop, and a juice bar.
The club offers 3 outdoor courts with priority booking, preferred court time, lesson and clinic rates, and access to members-only events.

Name: Rosemarys
Master_Source_text: Rosemary's Miami is the South Florida outpost of the New York-born restaurant brand founded by Carlos Suarez, which also spans three New York locations and one in Tokyo.

Name: Rosa Negra Miami
Master_Source_text: RosaNegra is a Mexican restaurant with its U.S. flagship in Brickell, Miami.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Eduardo Beaven, Rosa Negra is a Latin American dining concept with outposts in destinations like Tulum, Mexico City, and Miami.
The menu surveys the culinary traditions of South America and Mexico, pairing premium cuts of meat and fresh seafood with a club-like atmosphere.
Dinners regularly transition into evening spectacles, complete with resident DJs, live saxophone performances, and signature dishes like the Super Colossal Octopus.

Name: Rothes Glen
Master_Source_text: Rothes Glen is an exclusive-use castle in Speyside with 14 bedrooms for up to 28 guests, owned by Damian Riley-Smith, founder of Whisky Magazine.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Rothes Glen is a Baronial-style Highland castle in Speyside, Scotland, built in 1893 and designed by whisky architect Charles Chree Doig, refurbished in 2021.
The 11-acre grounds include a private lochan with rowing boat, rose terrace, fountain terrace, and a helipad in the front meadow.
The tasting room houses the Whisky Hall of Fame and Old & Rare Whisky Collection; evenings feature a castle casino with roulette and blackjack.
There are 14 king-size en suite bedrooms across two floors, plus 2 formal drawing rooms, 2 dining rooms, a snooker room, tasting room, vault, and tower room.

Name: Rubirosa
Master_Source_text: On Mulberry Street in Nolita, Rubirosa is a 2009 Italian-American pizzeria from AJ and Joe Pappalardo, named among Food & Wine's best pizza places in the U.S.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by the Pappalardo family of Staten Island's Joe & Pat's, Rubirosa is an Italian-American restaurant in Manhattan's Nolita neighborhood.
The kitchen focuses on reinvented classics, fresh pastas, and a notably extensive gluten-free menu.
Its signature Tie Dye pizza features a thin crust topped with vodka sauce, fresh mozzarella, and a pesto drizzle.

Name: The Sacred Space Miami
Master_Source_text: The Sacred Space Miami is a wellness and event venue at 105 NE 24th Street, founded by Karla Dascal and designed by architect Rene Gonzalez.

Name: Sage and Sound
Master_Source_text: Sage + Sound is a Manhattan wellness destination founded by Lacey Tisch and Lauren Zucker, with a flagship at 1481 Third Avenue.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sage + Sound is a 5,500-square-foot flagship wellness destination at 1481 Third Avenue on the Upper East Side of Manhattan, founded by Lacey Tisch and Lauren Zucker.
Services include facials by Tracie Martyn, acupuncture, lymphatic massage, manicures by Sundays Nail Studio, breathwork, and a curated skincare retail shop.
On-site café Isle of Us, conceived by restaurateur Lisle Richards, serves holistic food and beverages daily; The Study hosts up to 7 mindfulness classes per day.
The Study meditation room features a custom BASWA sound panel ceiling; the space includes treatment rooms, a nail salon, retail zones, and 2 fully equipped kitchen areas.

Name: Sagaponack General Store
Master_Source_text: Housed in an 1878 building, Sagaponack General Store reopened in 2025 after a four-year restoration by owner Mindy Gray with architect Frank Greenwald.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sagaponack General Store, established in 1878 at 542 Sagg Main Street, Sagaponack, New York, is a fully restored historic community market reopened April 2025 after a four-year renovation.
Expect Le Colombe cold brew on tap, soft-serve ice cream, frozen yogurt, locally sourced honey, flowers, produce, penny candy, and beer, open daily 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
Chef Daniel Eddy, formerly of Michelin-starred Rebelle in Manhattan and Michelin Bib Gourmand-winning Winner Bakery in Brooklyn, leads the menu of biscuit sandwiches, rotisserie chicken, soups, and baked goods.

Name: Sadelle's (Coconut Grove)
Master_Source_text: Sadelle's Coconut Grove is a restaurant from Major Food Group, co-founded by Jeff Zalaznick, Chef Mario Carbone, and Chef Rich Torrisi.

Name: Sadelle's (Design District)
Master_Source_text: Sadelle's at Kith in the Miami Design District is a Major Food Group brand, at 69 NE 41st Street.

Name: RVIVL
Master_Source_text: RVIVL is a fitness recovery studio in Playa Vista, Los Angeles.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ken Silver and Dr. Adam Sands, RVIVL is a fitness recovery studio in Playa Vista, California, that serves as the official recovery partner of the Los Angeles Sparks.
The wellness center focuses on optimizing physical performance and overall health through a suite of science-backed modalities.
Signature treatments include private infrared saunas, ice baths, full-body red light therapy, and NAD+ IV drips.

Name: Saint Tuesday
Master_Source_text: Set in the sub-cellar of the Walker Hotel Tribeca, Saint Tuesday is led by owner-operator Christopher Covey.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: San Vicente West Village
Master_Source_text: Jeff Klein's San Vicente West Village, a private members' club at 115 Jane Street, is designed by AD100 interior designer Rose Uniacke.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
San Vicente West Village, a private members-only club at 119 Jane Street in Manhattan's West Village, occupies a 1908 landmark building, originally a sailors' home that housed Titanic survivors in 1912, redesigned by British designer Rose Uniacke.
Members access multiple dining spaces, bars, event spaces, a screening room, a discotheque, a billiards room, and a lushly planted roof garden overlooking the Hudson River, plus luxurious guest rooms with private terraces.
The Dining Room, housed in the building's former ballroom, features live jazz and a roaring fireplace; the club also offers a sushi bar, Drawing Room, and a Billiards Room with bar.

Name: Salama (Saint-Tropez)
Master_Source_text: Salama is a Moroccan and Mediterranean restaurant in Saint-Tropez, a few metres from Place des Lices.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Frédérique and Fabrice Dorel, Salama is a Moroccan and Mediterranean restaurant set within an exotic garden near the Place des Lices in Saint-Tropez.
Occupying the former Villa Romana, the dining room is defined by Moorish architectural details, lantern lighting, and patterned tiles.
The menu centers on shareable regional specialties, highlighted by a signature chicken pastilla layered with eggs, onions, spices, and cinnamon almonds.

Name: Salama (Cannes)
Master_Source_text: Salama is a Moroccan and Mediterranean restaurant at 10 rue Florian in Cannes.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Frédérique and Fabrice Dorel, Salama is a Moroccan and Mediterranean restaurant situated near the Croisette in Cannes.
The dining room, designed by Studio Oreka, features a Moroccan-inspired interior with contemporary furnishings.
A staple on the menu is the signature chicken pastilla, a warm, layered pastry stuffed with chicken, eggs, onions, and cinnamon almonds.

Name: Saint Germain
Master_Source_text: Chefs Blake Aguillard and Trey Smith, Food & Wine Best New Chefs 2021, run Saint-Germain in the Bywater neighborhood of New Orleans, with a reservation-only tasting menu.

Name: Samaritaine
Master_Source_text: La Samaritaine, the LVMH-owned department store by Pont-Neuf, reopened in June 2021 after a 16-year closure with a new glass facade by SANAA.

Name: San Lorenzo
Master_Source_text: San Lorenzo is a no-menu Italian restaurant in Miami's Little River from 84 Magic Hospitality, with executive chef Giulio Rossi.

Name: Sanguich Little Havana
Master_Source_text: On Calle Ocho, Sanguich de Miami is a Cuban sandwich shop run by Daniel Figueredo and Rosa Romero, recognized with a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by husband-and-wife duo Daniel Figueredo and Rosa Romero, Sanguich de Miami is a Michelin-recognized Cuban sandwich shop in Little Havana.
The restaurant distinguishes itself by preparing all core ingredients in-house, including the city ham, garlic confit pork, mustard, and pickles.
The signature Cubano is pressed using a custom-designed, patented plancha that ensures an even, crisp toast on the traditional bread.

Name: Sana Skin Studio
Master_Source_text: Named Best Facial in Miami by Miami New Times 2022, Sana Skin Studio was founded in 2020 by Valentina Hernandez-Botero, with locations in Wynwood, Coconut Grove and Fort Lauderdale.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sana Skin Studio, founded in 2020 by Valentina Hernandez-Botero, is a clean-beauty facial studio located at 49 NW 24th Street in Wynwood, Miami, the brand's original flagship location.
Services include 3 base facial types plus add-ons: peels, microcurrents, gua sha massage, and LED light therapy.
Goal-driven facials include the Signature 50 for monthly maintenance and a firming eye treatment using 96 Red LED lights targeting the full 360 eye area to boost collagen and reduce fine lines.

Name: Saint Ambroeus (Palm Beach)
Master_Source_text: Sant Ambroeus Palm Beach is set in Royal Poinciana Plaza with interiors by Robert McKinley.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Studio Robert McKinley, Sant Ambroeus brings Milanese café culture and dining to the Royal Poinciana Plaza in Palm Beach.
The restaurant operates as an all-day destination, transitioning from a morning espresso and pastry counter to a formal dining room serving traditional Milanese dishes.
The interior features green jasper columns, coral banquettes, and terrazzo floors poured in a cream, pink, and black wave pattern.

Name: Shibui Spa
Master_Source_text: Shibui is the spa at The Greenwich Hotel in Tribeca; its build-out involved Japanese craftsmen, some designated Living National Treasures.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Shibui Spa is a subterranean, Japanese-inspired spa located inside The Greenwich Hotel at 377 Greenwich Street, Tribeca, Manhattan, co-owned by Robert De Niro.
Amenities include a lantern-lit heated pool beneath a 250-year-old bamboo farmhouse, steam and rain showers, a 1,000-square-foot fitness center, and ADA-accessible facilities.
The spa features 5 individual treatment rooms, a shiatsu room with a traditional Japanese soaking tub, a relaxation lounge, and yoga and Pilates available poolside.

Name: Sant Ambroeus (West Village)
Master_Source_text: Sant Ambroeus West Village at 259 West 4th Street is part of SA Hospitality Group led by partners Gherardo Guarducci and Dimitri Pauli.

Name: Sant Ambroeus (Madison)
Master_Source_text: Sant Ambroeus on Madison Avenue was the brand's first U.S. location, a Milanese cafe on the Upper East Side.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Brought to Manhattan in 1982 by the Pauli family, Sant Ambroeus is a Milanese restaurant and café situated on Madison Avenue.
Operating as both a dining room and an Italian pasticceria, the venue offers a menu of espresso, pastries, and Northern Italian fare.
The kitchen focuses on regional staples, including a signature vitello tonnato and the bakery's Princess Cake.

Name: Seasonly
Master_Source_text: Founded in 2018 by Fany Pechidat, Seasonly is a Paris-based skincare brand running Skin Studios, including an outpost at Galeries Lafayette Haussmann.

Name: Sea Spice
Master_Source_text: Seaspice Brasserie & Lounge sits on the Miami River at 412 NW North River Drive.

Name: Sant Ambroeus (Lafayette)
Master_Source_text: Sant Ambroeus SoHo at 265 Lafayette Street is part of SA Hospitality Group, with Thomas Botto as executive chef.

Name: Selfridges
Master_Source_text: Designed by Daniel Burnham and opened in 1909, the Grade II*-listed Selfridges on Oxford Street was named the world's best department store in 2010 and 2012.

Name: Shell Bay Club
Master_Source_text: Shell Bay Club is a private members' club in Hallandale Beach by Auberge Resorts Collection, anchored by a Greg Norman-designed championship course.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Developed by The Witkoff Group and managed by Auberge Resorts Collection, Shell Bay Club is a private members club and residential enclave on Florida's Gold Coast.
The property centers on sporting and maritime amenities, including a 48-slip private marina and a 7,250-yard golf course designed by Greg Norman.
Its racquet club is the only private facility in Florida to feature all four Grand Slam tennis court surfaces.

Name: SeaSpa Miami
Master_Source_text: Sea Spa + Fitness is at Loews Miami Beach Hotel, offering spa and fitness facilities.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Loews Miami Beach Hotel, Sea Spa is an adult-only wellness facility situated inside the property's St. Moritz Tower.
The space centers on ocean-inspired therapies, utilizing marine-based skincare lines such as OSEA and Repêchage across its sixteen treatment rooms.
Guests can undergo the signature Ocean Dreams massage or select revitalizing body treatments that incorporate seaweed-infused wraps.

Name: Sketch Afternoon Tea
Master_Source_text: Sketch in Mayfair, London, founded by Mourad Mazouz with chef Pierre Gagnaire, includes the three-Michelin-starred Lecture Room & Library.

Name: Smith & Wollensky
Master_Source_text: Smith & Wollensky's Miami Beach outpost sits at 1 Washington Avenue in South Pointe Park.

Name: Sous LA
Master_Source_text: Sous La is a facial and body treatment studio in Sunset Plaza, West Hollywood, founded in 2020 by Amanda Jeppesen.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sous La is a lymphatic-first beauty and longevity studio founded in 2020, with flagship locations on the Sunset Strip in West Hollywood, Los Angeles, and in Yorkville, Toronto.
Core amenities include lymphatic drainage, facial sculpting massage, deep tissue and fascia work, and intra-oral buccal techniques addressing tension beneath the surface.
The celebrity-loved Radical Radiance Regime™ (RRR™) spans Face, Body, and Scalp/Brain treatments, rooted in science to activate lymphatic drainage, detoxify, release tension, and reset the nervous system.

Name: Sono Center
Master_Source_text: Sono Center is a breast imaging practice in Los Angeles (Westwood) and Pasadena.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sono Center is a radiology clinic at 2154 Westwood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90025, specializing in FDA-cleared SonoCine Automated Whole Breast Ultrasound (AWBUS) for early breast cancer detection.
Services include SonoCine AWBUS breast screening, plus 13 proactive imaging options, abdominal, thyroid, vascular, and renal ultrasound; exams take under 30 minutes; FSA and HSA eligible.

Name: Skincare by Amy Peterson
Master_Source_text: Skincare by Amy Peterson is an aesthetic clinic in Miami Beach led by medical aesthetician Amy Peterson, based at 1560 Lenox Ave.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Named Best Medspa by Modern Luxury, Skincare by Amy Peterson is an aesthetics practice in Miami Beach led by its namesake founder.
The clinic specializes in advanced laser technology, body contouring, and injectables, building personalized protocols tailored to individual skin needs.
During injectable services, the team utilizes Mindray Ultrasound and VeinViewer technology to visualize vascular anatomy in real time for precise placement.

Name: Sky Ting Yoga
Master_Source_text: Sky Ting Yoga is a Manhattan studio founded by Krissy Jones in 2015, with a NoHo flagship at 324 Lafayette Street.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sky Ting Yoga, founded in 2015 by Krissy Jones, is a community-driven boutique wellness studio at 324 Lafayette Street, 4th Floor, in NoHo, Manhattan.
Offering classes in vinyasa, Katonah Yoga, Pilates, breathwork, and dance, with international brand partners including Chanel, Nike, and Maison Margiela Fragrances.
Two large studio rooms (one heated, one not), plus SKY TING TV, an on-demand streaming platform offering hundreds of classes at any level.
Featured by Fashionista as "New York's Most Stylish New Wellness Destination," with notable clients including Carine Roitfeld, Phoebe Bridgers, and former Vogue editor Sally Singer.

Name: Silver Mirror Facial Bar
Master_Source_text: Silver Mirror Facial Bar operates four Manhattan locations and has been covered by Vogue and Allure.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Silver Mirror Facial Bar, founded in 2016, is New York City's original modern facial bar concept, with 5 Manhattan locations including Flatiron, Bryant Park, Upper East Side, Upper West Side, and Manhattan West.
Retail features dermatologist-approved product lines from Dr. Dennis Gross, iS Clinical, Sanitas, and Revision, available at all locations for post-treatment home care.
Each bar features semi-private treatment rooms with plush, heated tables, designed for efficient in-and-out appointments before or after work.

Name: Sophie's
Master_Source_text: Sophie's is a bar at Bank Hotel in Stockholm, a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sophie's Bar at Bank Hotel sits at Arsenalsgatan 6, Norrmalm, Stockholm, part of Stureplansgruppen.
Features velvet seating, a decorated floral ceiling, international cocktail menu, bottle service, resident DJs, and proximity to Kungsträdgården subway, approximately 100 meters away.
Sophie's Bar and sibling venue Papillon at Bank Hotel offer cocktails, champagne service, and an international food menu available morning, midday, and evening.

Name: Sol Yoga
Master_Source_text: Founded by Catherine DeFrancesco, Sol Yoga operates its Miami studio at Sunset Harbour, having launched its first studio in Wynwood in 2018.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
SOL Yoga Sunset Harbour is a 3,500-square-foot infrared-heated wellness studio located at 1811 Purdy Ave, Miami Beach, Florida, founded by Catherine DeFrancesco.
Amenities include showers, lockers, a smoothie bar, a lifestyle boutique, and state-of-the-art infrared-heated studios; cryotherapy services are also offered on-site.
Classes offered include SOL Flow, SOL Power, Hot Pilates, SOL Sculpt, Yogilates, and Sculpt Your Flow, led by Miami's sought-after instructors daily.

Name: Spa Cheval Blanc (South of France)
Master_Source_text: Spa Cheval Blanc at Cheval Blanc St-Tropez is run by Guerlain as the property's dedicated spa.

Name: Steak House No. 316
Master_Source_text: Steak House No. 316 is a downtown Aspen steakhouse.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in an 1888 Victorian building on Aspen's Restaurant Row, Steak House No. 316 is a classic American chophouse operated by Craig and Samantha Cordts-Pearce of CP Restaurant Group.
The dining room features velvet seating and dark wood accents, providing a traditional setting for prime steaks and chops.
Signature menu items include the 316 Plateau seafood assortment and the Branding Iron onion rings.

Name: Spencer's (SoHo)
Master_Source_text: Spencer's is a SoHo day spa at 550 Broadway, designed by founder Ryan McCarthy with Charlotte Taylor and EBBA Architects.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ryan McCarthy, Spencer's is a design-led day spa in New York's SoHo that earned a runner-up spot for Best Day Spa in the 2025 USA TODAY 10BEST awards.
The interior provides a quiet retreat from the city, blending the visual cues of a Japanese ryokan and an Italian resort.
The signature full-body massage integrates global techniques, aromatherapy, hot stones, and heated wraps.

Name: Spencer's (WeHo)
Master_Source_text: Spencer's is a West Hollywood day spa by founder Ryan McCarthy, an LA outpost of the New York flagship.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ryan McCarthy, Spencer's is a wellness destination and spa situated in a 1920s Spanish-style home in West Hollywood.
The space functions as an alternative to clinical environments, providing targeted bodywork and signature facials in a residential setting.
The interior features a dedicated waiting lounge decorated with ikebana-inspired botanicals and specialized rooms for couples treatments.

Name: Spring Cafe New York
Master_Source_text: On South Spring Street in Aspen, Spring Cafe is a vegetarian cafe founded by Sabrina Rudin in 2013.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the second floor of a Chinatown building, Spring Cafe is a plant-based eatery operated by owner Chu.
The counter-service restaurant focuses on vegan Chinese fusion, providing a calm dining space set apart from the busy neighborhood.
The menu reimagines Asian-inspired staples without animal products, centering on signature items like braised tofu skin bao buns and zhajiang noodle salads.

Name: Steakhouse Caesars
Master_Source_text: Set within Caesars New Orleans at 8 Canal Street, The Steakhouse is helmed by executive chef Paul Robert.

Name: Studio Marisol
Master_Source_text: Studio Marisol is a Paris hair studio spanning three addresses, with its Marais Hair Gallery referenced in the Louis Vuitton City Guide.

Name: Surf Club
Master_Source_text: Opened on New Year's Eve 1930, The Surf Club in Surfside is now a Four Seasons hotel by architect Richard Meier, housing Thomas Keller's Michelin-starred restaurant.

Name: Surfside Tennis Courts
Master_Source_text: Surfside Tennis Center is located in Veterans Park at 8750 Collins Avenue, operated by the Town of Surfside Parks and Recreation.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Surfside Tennis Center is a Town of Surfside Parks and Recreation facility on Collins Avenue

The center features 3 lighted tennis courts open Monday through Friday and the facility also hosts 2 outdoor pickleball courts

Name: Straker's London
Master_Source_text: Straker's is chef Thomas Straker's Notting Hill restaurant in London, recognised by the MICHELIN Guide.

Name: Surya Spa at Proper Hotel
Master_Source_text: Surya Spa is the Ayurvedic spa at Santa Monica Proper Hotel, founded by Martha Soffer with interiors by Kelly Wearstler.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Martha Soffer, internationally acclaimed Panchakarma expert, Ayurvedic doctor, and chef, Surya Spa is a 3,000-square-foot Ayurvedic sanctuary inside the Kelly Wearstler-designed Santa Monica Proper Hotel. 
Treatments range from four-handed massages and herbalized oil therapies to personalized Dosha Yoga and full 3–28 day Panchakarma cleanse programs, with every oil and herb handmade and customized to each guest.

Name: Sugar
Master_Source_text: Sugar is the 40th-floor rooftop bar atop EAST Miami at Brickell City Centre, designed by Studio Collective.

Name: Strive Total Wellness
Master_Source_text: Strive Total Wellness is a sports medicine practice with Manhattan locations in NoMad and Union Square, founded in 2013.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Strive Total Wellness is a sports medicine and integrative wellness facility founded in 2013, with 4 NYC locations: NoMad, Union Square, Hudson Yards, and Williamsburg.
Services include physical therapy, chiropractic care, NYS Licensed Massage Therapy, acupuncture, yoga, Pilates, personal training, and nutritional support.
Strive operates from a 6,000 sq ft flagship facility, grown from a single treatment room, with board-certified doctors, physiatrists, and licensed therapists on staff.

Name: Sud 777
Master_Source_text: Led by chef Edgar Nunez in Jardines del Pedregal, Sud 777 holds one Michelin star.

Name: Sturehof
Master_Source_text: Set on Stureplan in central Stockholm, Sturehof is a seafood-focused brasserie with roots on this site since 1887.

Name: T Bar Southampton
Master_Source_text: T Bar Southampton is the Hamptons outpost of T Bar, set at 268 Elm Street in Southampton, founded by restaurateur Tony Fortuna.

Name: Sushi Yasu Tanaka
Master_Source_text: Sushi Yasu Tanaka is a sushi counter inside MIA Market in the Miami Design District, run by chef Yasu Tanaka and listed in the MICHELIN Guide.

Name: Sushi Bar
Master_Source_text: Sushi Bar Miami Beach is a 12-seat omakase counter inside the Esme Miami Beach hotel, from chef-operators Phillip Frankland Lee and Margarita Kallas-Lee.

Name: Tak
Master_Source_text: Tak is a rooftop restaurant at Brunkebergstorg in central Stockholm, led by culinary director Frida Ronge. Wallpaper's 2018 Best New Restaurant winner.

Name: Tacos Los Alexis
Master_Source_text: Led by chef Alexis Ayala, Tacos Los Alexis is a Mexico City taqueria recognized by the Michelin Guide with a Bib Gourmand.

Name: Taktika Padel LA
Master_Source_text: Taktika Padel LA sits inside the LA Galaxy facility at Dignity Health Sports Park in Carson.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Taktika Padel is LA's premier padel destination, set within the campus of Dignity Health Sports Park, home of the five-time MLS Cup Champion LA Galaxy, with four professional courts open to all skill levels. 
Courts are available for open play, private lessons, clinics, and tournaments, with a team of experienced coaches on hand.

Name: Table 26
Master_Source_text: Table 26 opened in 2012 in West Palm Beach, owned by Eddie Schmidt and Ozzie Medeiros with Executive Chef Martha Encarnacion.

Name: Sushi Nakazawa
Master_Source_text: Sushi Nakazawa in the West Village is led by chef Daisuke Nakazawa and holds a Michelin star plus a four-star New York Times review.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Sushi Nakazawa is a Michelin-starred restaurant in New York City led by chef Daisuke Nakazawa.
The dining experience centers entirely on a twenty-course Edomae-style omakase menu featuring fish flown directly from Japan.
The meal concludes with the chef's signature tamago, a sweet egg omelet he learned to make during his apprenticeship under Jiro Ono.

Name: Sweet Basil
Master_Source_text: Opened in 1977, Sweet Basil is a Vail Village restaurant recognized by the MICHELIN Guide in Colorado.

Name: The Biohack Lab (Coral Gables)
Master_Source_text: The Biohack Lab runs a Recovery Lab inside Equinox at the Shops at Merrick Park, Coral Gables, at 370 San Lorenzo Ave.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The Biohack Lab is a medical-grade recovery and performance wellness center located inside Equinox Coral Gables, part of a 5-location South Florida network spanning Fort Lauderdale, Pembroke Pines, Morningside, and Sole Mia.
Amenities include over 25 recovery modalities: red light therapy, PEMF, cold plunge, infrared sauna, hyperbaric oxygen, lymphatic drainage compression, H-Wave, Alpha-Stim, and BrainTap neuro-clarity.

Name: The Balmoral Spa
Master_Source_text: Irene Forte Spa sits within The Balmoral, a Rocco Forte hotel on Princes Street in Edinburgh, using B Corp-certified Irene Forte Skincare.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Nestled beneath Edinburgh's most iconic five-star landmark, the Irene Forte Spa at The Balmoral transports guests to the Mediterranean through Sicilian botanicals, volcanic stone therapies, and cutting-edge treatments like LYMA Laser Pro, all within steps of Princes Street. 
Its proprietary skincare line, shaped by 35 years of clinical research, holds both B Corp status and the Butterfly Mark for sustainable excellence

Name: The Biohack Lab (Fort Lauderdale)
Master_Source_text: The Biohack Lab's Fort Lauderdale location is at 1785 SE 17th Street.

Name: The Balvenie Distillery
Master_Source_text: Founded in 1892 in Dufftown, Speyside, The Balvenie is a single malt distillery owned by William Grant & Sons, guided by Malt Master David Stewart MBE since 1962.

Name: Tamarind Tribeca
Master_Source_text: Tamarind Tribeca is a Michelin Guide-listed Indian restaurant at 99 Hudson Street in Manhattan's TriBeCa.

Name: Tam Tam
Master_Source_text: Tam Tam is a Vietnamese food and wine bar in downtown Miami run by Tam Pham and Harrison Ramhofer, awarded Michelin's Bib Gourmand in 2024 and 2025.

Name: Tanière³
Master_Source_text: Set beneath ancestral vaults in Old Quebec, Taniere3 is led by chef Francois-Emmanuel Nicol and holds two Michelin stars.

Name: The American Hotel
Master_Source_text: Dating to 1846 in Sag Harbor, The American Hotel is an eight-room inn and restaurant whose dining room has held Wine Spectator's Grand Award since 1981.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Sag Harbor, New York, The American Hotel is a longstanding restaurant led by executive chef Jonathan Parker.
The menu focuses on classical American-French cuisine, featuring traditional preparations of prime meats, Long Island duckling, and seasonal Peconic Bay scallops.
Guests can dine in the glass-enclosed Atrium among palms and ivy, pairing meals with selections from a cellar that has held a Wine Spectator Grand Award since 1981.

Name: The Den at Azabu Miami Beach
Master_Source_text: Hidden behind Sushi Azabu's dining room at the Stanton Hotel on Ocean Drive, The Den at Azabu Miami Beach is a counter-only omakase recognized by the Michelin Guide.

Name: The Coral Room
Master_Source_text: The Coral Room is the hotel bar at The Bloomsbury in London, part of The Doyle Collection, with interiors by Martin Brudnizki.

Name: The Club at the Moore
Master_Source_text: On the second floor of the landmark Moore building in the Miami Design District, The Club at The Moore is a private members' club anchored by a Zaha Hadid installation.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a reimagined 1922 landmark building in the Miami Design District, The Club at The Moore is a members-only social club anchored by a site-specific Zaha Hadid sculpture and spanning nearly 20,000 square feet of restaurant, bars, lounges, and private dining rooms. 
The experience is built around culinary excellence and cultural programming spanning art, design, music, and entertainment, with a rotating art collection curated by internationally renowned advisor Monica Kalpakian.

Name: The Duck & The Peach
Master_Source_text: The Duck & The Peach is a New American restaurant on Capitol Hill in Washington, D.C., named to the New York Times' 25 best in D.C.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by James Beard-nominated restaurateur Hollis Wells Silverman, The Duck & The Peach is a New American restaurant in Washington, D.C.'s Capitol Hill.
Executive chef Katarina Petonito blends Northern California influences with New England comfort in an airy space designed to resemble a dinner party.
The menu centers on a signature rotisserie duck with watercress panzanella and desserts by award-winning pastry chef Rochelle Cooper.

Name: The Chloe
Master_Source_text: The Chloe is a hotel and restaurant in a 19th-century Uptown New Orleans building.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a 19th-century Victorian mansion on St. Charles Avenue, The Chloe is an Uptown New Orleans restaurant developed by LeBlanc + Smith with interiors by Sara Ruffin Costello.
The dining room and front porch serve a contemporary menu of Creole cuisine focused on regional Southern ingredients.
Diners can order signature dishes like the Creole-spiced Gulf fish before taking their drinks to the outdoor pool bar.

Name: The Biostation
Master_Source_text: The Biostation is a Miami medical wellness clinic in Midtown 5.
Master_Aurora_Insights: Founded by Dr. Martin G. Bloom, a cardiologist and functional medicine expert with over 40 years of experience, the biostation is Miami's leading destination for science-backed age management, built on the conviction that medicine should prevent aging, not simply treat it. Every client receives a fully personalized protocol built from an assessment of over 100 biomarkers, spanning hormone therapy, nutrient IV therapy, medical aesthetics, and advanced diagnostics.

Name: The Biohack Lab (Pembroke)
Master_Source_text: The Biohack Lab's Pembroke Pines site is at Vita Health Regenerative Wellness Center, 12301 Taft St, Suite 200.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The Biohack Lab blends the wisdom of nature with modern science across 25+ pain-free, drug-free, and non-invasive modalities, spanning hyperbaric oxygen therapy, IV infusions, red light therapy, stem cell treatments, and pulsed electromagnetic field therapy. 
The Pembroke Pines location is a modern sanctuary designed for biohackers and wellness newcomers alike, with an experienced team that personalizes every recovery journey.

Name: The Edition Membership
Master_Source_text: The Miami Beach EDITION runs a private Beach Club membership for locals at 2901 Collins Avenue.

Name: The Macallan Estate
Master_Source_text: The Macallan Estate on the River Spey in Speyside features a distillery visitor experience by Rogers Stirk Harbour + Partners, shortlisted for the RIBA Stirling Prize.

Name: The Lab Athletic Club
Master_Source_text: The Lab Athletic Club is a training gym on Sunset Boulevard in West Hollywood, founded by strength coach Rocco DiStefano.

Name: The Maine Mayfair
Master_Source_text: The MAINE Mayfair is a 350-cover New England-inspired brasserie at 20 Hanover Square, Mayfair, by restaurateur Joey Ghazal.

Name: The Lobster Club
Master_Source_text: The Lobster Club is Major Food Group's Japanese restaurant in the Seagram Building, designed by Peter Marino and led by chef Tasuku Murakami.

Name: The Gibson Room
Master_Source_text: The Gibson Room is a Coral Way bar-restaurant in Miami from chef Michael Beltran's Ariete Hospitality Group, listed in the MICHELIN Guide.

Name: The Saxony Bar
Master_Source_text: Inside Faena Hotel Miami Beach, the Saxony Bar is the property's late-night lounge.

Name: The Spa at The Standard
Master_Source_text: Set on Belle Isle in Miami Beach, The Spa at The Standard sits within The Standard Spa, Miami Beach.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Belle Isle, The Standard Spa, Miami Beach is an adults-only retreat housed in a mid-century property originally designed by architect Norman Giller.
The destination functions as a hydrotherapy playground inspired by global bathing cultures, featuring a Turkish-style hammam and a cedar sauna.
Guests can experience the signature 150-minute Soul Temple ritual or relax in the outdoor waterfall hot tub overlooking Biscayne Bay.

Name: USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center
Master_Source_text: The USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in Flushing Meadows is the home of the US Open, one of the world's largest public tennis facilities.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center is the world's largest public tennis facility, located in Flushing Meadows-Corona Park, Queens, New York, home of the US Open Grand Slam since 1978.
The 46.5-acre complex features 22 outdoor courts, 12 indoor courts, a fitness center, ball machines, a pro shop, and an Indoor Training Center open year-round.
On-site dining includes Eataly, Carnegie Deli, Fare by Chef Alex Guarnaschelli, Aces with Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto, Pat LaFrieda Meat Co., and Moët & Chandon Clubhouse Bar.
Four stadiums seat up to 23,200 at Arthur Ashe, 14,053 at Louis Armstrong, 8,000 at the Grandstand, and 2,800 at Court 17, all rentable for events.

Master_Source_text: Zimmi's is a West Village French restaurant opened in December 2024, led by proprietor Jenni Guizio with chef Maxime Pradie, and profiled by The New Yorker.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Zimmi's is a Provençal-inspired restaurant in New York's West Village, opened by hospitality veteran Jenni Guizio and chef Maxime Pradié.
The intimate bistro focuses on traditional French fare, elevating humble ingredients with careful technique and long cooking times.
A signature dish is the pastasciutta, which features fresh tagliatelle tossed in a savory ragout of chicken liver, heart, and gizzard.

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Sarah Larson Levey and recently acquired by FitLab, Y7 Studio operates multiple Los Angeles locations, including outposts in West Hollywood and Silver Lake.
The brand focuses on hip-hop yoga, offering intense, music-driven vinyasa flows in a dark, mirrorless environment.
Each studio is heated to 80 to 90 degrees using infrared technology to induce a heavy sweat during the candlelit sessions.

Name: Le Verre Volé
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Cyril Bordarier near the Canal Saint-Martin, this pioneering dining cellar operates as both a curated wine shop and a lively bistro.
The compact room is lined with shelves of natural vintages that frame a daily chalkboard menu of market-driven French plates.
Locals and industry insiders alike return for the signature sausage and mash, a comforting classic that anchors the ever-changing selection of living wines.

Amanpulo
Amanpulo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the entirety of Pamalican Island in the Philippines, this retreat was designed by National Artist for Architecture Francisco Mañosa for Aman.
Timber casitas raised on stilts interpret the local *bahay kubo* vernacular, set amidst white sands and protected coral reefs.
A defining feature is the Kawayan Bar, a floating bamboo platform where guests picnic and lounge while drifting on the turquoise sea.

Name: DakaDaka
Master_Source_text: DakaDaka in Mayfair
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Mayfair’s Heddon Street, DakaDaka is a modern Georgian restaurant and natural wine bar from founders Giorgi Mindiashvili and Mitz Vora.
The kitchen reinterprets ancient traditions for a contemporary setting, delivering flame-licked dishes that pair British ingredients with the distinct flavours of the Caucasus.
A massive open kitchen features three elaborate ovens, turning out signatures like kidney-bean hummus with chilli crisp and soft-serve made from Saperavi grapes.

Name: Holy Basil
Master_Source_text: Holy Basil Santa Monica
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chefs Wedchayan Arpapornnopparat and Tongkamal Yuon have brought their acclaimed Bangkok-style street food to the Westside, maintaining a reputation for uncompromised heat.
The kitchen eschews sweetness for unapologetically spicy and pungent flavors that channel the visceral energy of Thai markets.
Standout dishes include the Gra Pow Wagyu, a fiery stir-fry of minced beef, and the complex Nam Tok Angus Beef Tataki.

Name: Lala's Burgers
Master_Source_text: Lala’s Burgers in Miami
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originally a pop-up by the creators of Apocalypse BBQ, this burger specialist now operates a standalone venue in Kendall.
The kitchen focuses on a streamlined selection of smash burgers, distinguishing itself with thick, crispy patties and bold execution.
A defining element is the house signature sauce, which pairs the heat of harissa with cooling mint for a unique finish.

Name: The Izaka-ya by Katsu-ya
Master_Source_text: The Izaka-ya by Katsu-ya (Beverly Grove)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Master Sushi Chef Katsuya Uechi, this Beverly Grove outpost offers a casual yet polished spin on the traditional Japanese gastropub.
The bustling space serves as a lively backdrop for sharing innovative small plates and sake, emphasizing a communal dining experience.
A visit here is incomplete without the Spicy Tuna on Crispy Rice, a signature dish featuring grilled rice cakes topped with creamy, spicy tartare.

Name: Birch Event Design
Master_Aurora_Insights:
New York–based Birch Event Design is a creative production studio led by founder and chief creative officer Josh Spiegel.
The firm is distinguished by its seamless logistics and warm, personalized environments that prioritize thoughtful composition over overproduced spectacle.
Spiegel originally honed his craft selling floral arrangements from his father’s balloon shop in Brooklyn, a background that grounds the agency’s inventive approach.

Name: Marcy Blum Associates

Helmed by a Le Cordon Bleu-trained chef and Vogue top-listed planner, this New York studio orchestrates high-production celebrations for clients like the Rockefellers and LeBron James.
The firm is renowned for a theatrical approach that prioritizes guest flow and culinary excellence, treating every wedding as a live performance.
Her signature style blends the discipline of professional kitchens with the dramatic flair of a High School of Performing Arts education.

Name: Amy Katz Events
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by Amy Katz, this PartySlate Top 50 firm orchestrates sophisticated weddings and events across New York City and the Hamptons.
The studio delivers stylish, tightly coordinated itineraries with a focus on guest flow, offering a polished experience that avoids the premiums of the ultra-luxury market.
Frequently operating at venues like The Pierre, the team is specifically noted for its agility in executing complex Manhattan nuptials on remarkably short notice.

Name: LLG Events

Led by husband-and-wife duo Lauren and Paul Grech, this New York–based firm orchestrates high-production weddings for a global clientele.
The team functions as "event architects," prioritizing hospitality flow and immersive design to execute large-scale, complex celebrations.
Notable work includes commissions at The Plaza Hotel and a "Wedding Planner POV" series that highlights their exacting operational standards.

Name: Bridges
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former Hop Shing space in Chinatown, this bistro is led by chef Sam Lawrence, previously of Estela.
The dining room is defined by a bright, social energy and a confident menu of European small plates suited for sharing.
A signature comté tart with chanterelles stands out as a prime example of the kitchen’s precise, ingredient-driven execution.

Name: Arjuna Solitaire Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring the Kampong Dewa Resorts enclave in Sihanoukville, Arjuna Solitaire by JHL Collection introduces a measured standard of hospitality to Cambodia’s evolving southern coast.
The interiors merge Khmer and Indonesian design influences, establishing a composed retreat that feels distinct from the region’s rapid development.
Ascend to the 23rd-floor Angkasa Restaurant & Bar for panoramic ocean views that stretch across the Gulf of Thailand.

Name: Christy Sports
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1958, this Denver-born specialist operates over 60 outposts across the Rockies, serving as a staple for seasonal gear rentals.
Beyond its winter legacy, the shop pivots to a summer cycling center, outfitting riders with everything from casual cruisers to performance mountain bikes.
Select locations feature premium demo fleets from Trek and Santa Cruz, allowing enthusiasts to test top-tier suspension on local singletrack.

Name: Mi Chola
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in downtown Aspen, this lively modern Mexican cantina is the creation of local restaurateurs Darren Chapple and Adam Malmgren.
The atmosphere is defined by a high-energy, hip vibe featuring Day of the Dead-inspired decor, bold murals, and a bustling bar scene.
A standout feature is the signature spicy margarita, best enjoyed alongside street-style tacos or the generous nachos in the eclectic dining room.

Name: Pool Bar & Patio at The St. Regis
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at the base of Aspen Mountain, this year-round terrace anchors the central courtyard of the red-brick St. Regis Aspen Resort.
The heated outdoor pool and hot tubs provide a sophisticated alpine retreat with unobstructed views of the ski slopes.
For a distinct local taste, order the signature Downhill Snapper, a herbaceous twist on the Bloody Mary featuring basil and dill.

Name: Aspen Meadows | Cascades Tennis and Pickleball
La Tête d'Or
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Flatiron District, this French steakhouse from Chef Daniel Boulud features interiors by the Rockwell Group.
The concept merges the format of a New York steakhouse with Parisian flair, set against a backdrop of leather paneling and mirrors.
A signature prime rib anchors the menu, while the name pays tribute to the historic park in Boulud’s native Lyon.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window.

Name: Bagatelle
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in New York by Rémi Laba and Aymeric Clemente, this French Mediterranean concept channels the spirit of the French Riviera across its global outposts.
The setting pairs a refined bistro aesthetic with a spirited atmosphere, where the dining experience frequently transitions into a lively, music-driven event.
A signature menu highlight is the whole truffled roast chicken, carved tableside and served with country-style potatoes and a rich jus.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We hold all reservations for a maximum of 15 minutes. Beyond this, your reservation will be marked as a no-show, and you will be placed on our waitlist. If the guest cannot honor the booking, we ask to be informed no later than 12 hours prior to the reservation time. Failure to notify the restaurant will result in a non-refundable deposit fee as the restaurant reserves the right to assign a no-show status to your reservation.

Name: Paloma [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1948 and named by Pablo Picasso for his daughter, this Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat institution remains a family-run staple of the French Riviera.
The secluded pebble beach and pine-shaded restaurant offer a timeless atmosphere, prioritizing privacy and tradition over modern excess.
Lunch service centers on the daily catch grilled over a wood fire, best enjoyed with views across the bay to the cliffs of Èze.

Name: Bridge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated beneath the Beaux-Arts grandeur of the Pont Alexandre III, this cavernous nightlife destination is managed by the prolific Paris Society group.
The interior preserves the raw, industrial character of the 1900s structure, contrasting original stone vaults with a sleek, contemporary spatial arrangement.
Its defining feature is a monumental, immersive video installation that spans the walls and ceiling, enveloping crowds in synchronized digital art.

Name: The Travellers Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on London’s Pall Mall, this historic institution occupies the city’s first Italianate building, designed by Sir Charles Barry, architect of the Houses of Parliament.
Originally established to connect gentlemen who had travelled at least 500 miles from the capital, it remains a discreet sanctuary for diplomats and foreign visitors.
The celebrated library serves as the clubhouse’s centrepiece, featuring an extensive collection of travel literature beneath a rare cast of the ancient Greek Bassae Frieze.

Name: Soholistic Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Firmdale group’s Ham Yard Hotel, this Kit Kemp–designed spa offers a quiet respite in the heart of Soho.
The space centers on a cool white marble steam room, providing a serene backdrop for advanced HydraFacials and Temple Spa rituals.
A standout option is the Champagne and Truffles Deluxe facial, which uses gold, silk, and black truffles to brighten the complexion.

Name: EntreNos [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chefs Evan Burgess and Osmel Gonzalez, this Michelin-starred Miami concept celebrates Florida's agricultural wealth with a hyper-seasonal, sustainable ethos.
The kitchen champions locally sourced ingredients, crafting a constantly evolving menu that blends cross-cultural techniques with a strict zero-waste philosophy.
Uniquely, the experience transforms a humble daytime coffee shop into an intimate fine-dining counter, creating a relaxed, dinner-party atmosphere.

Name: Alo Wellness Club [DUPLICATE]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Beverly Hills landmark originally designed by I.M. Pei, this invite-only facility serves as a private training ground for the brand’s community.
The monochromatic training space pairs strength conditioning with advanced biohacking, prioritizing recovery as much as exertion.
Members utilize clinical amenities ranging from cryotherapy chambers and infrared saunas to a rooftop pool with sweeping city views.

Name: Conrad Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Frank Gehry’s The Grand LA, this downtown sanctuary features understated, calming interiors designed by Tara Bernerd & Partners.
The facility prioritizes high-tech wellness over traditional wet rooms, offering recovery cabins, infrared saunas, and a quantum harmonic wave room.
A signature Enlightenment Lounge anchors the experience, providing a darkened, meditative space equipped with weighted blankets and solitary resting nooks.

Name: Fjord
Master_Aurora_Insights: Based in central Oslo, this seafood specialist is the creation of acclaimed Norwegian restaurateur Ole Jonny Eikefjord. The kitchen operates without a traditional à la carte option, offering instead a set tasting menu that changes daily to reflect the freshest available catch. Diners experience a six-course progression in a low-lit, modern space, with dishes that emphasize pure flavors and rich sauces over theatrical presentation.

Name: Orfali Bros
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Dubai’s Wasl 51, this unpretentious bistro is led by three Syrian brothers—Mohammad, Wassim, and Omar Orfali—who recently topped the MENA’s 50 Best Restaurants list.
The kitchen reimagines Levantine roots through a global, experimental lens, blending personal storytelling with advanced "bistronomy" techniques.
A definitive example of their playful precision is the signature "Corn Bomb," a texturally complex morsel featuring multiple forms of corn and aged Parmigiano Reggiano.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made no later than 72 hours prior to the reservation date and time to qualify for a refund. Cancellations made within 72 hours of the reservation will result in the full prepayment being forfeited. A 3% administrative fee is non-refundable in all cases. Same-day reductions in party size are strictly non-refundable.

Name: Guerlain Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by WA International within the Moorish-Andalusian One&Only The Palm, this sanctuary is an outpost for the historic Parisian beauty house Guerlain.
The secluded facility features a couples' suite with a private hammam and offers therapies that blend French expertise with Middle Eastern traditions.
A standout experience is the signature Dubai Harmony treatment, a vitality-boosting session that alternates hot and cold temperatures to balance the body.

Name: The Bvlgari Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel, this 1,700-square-meter sanctuary brings sophisticated Italian craftsmanship to Jumeira Bay Island.
The light-filled oasis features a traditional hammam, thermal suites, and a 25-meter indoor pool framed by floor-to-ceiling ocean views.
Its vitality pool draws inspiration from the ancient Baths of Caracalla, featuring a mosaic floor that mimics scattered gemstones.

Name: AWAKEN Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the KPF-designed Atlantis The Royal, this holistic wellness sanctuary offers a curated menu of therapies designed to restore inner balance.
Interiors clad in earth-toned travertine and organic textures create a grounding atmosphere for treatments that blend ancient Arabian traditions with modern technology.
The facility features the Hammam Sensorium, a reimagined bathhouse experience, alongside a halotherapy salt cave and an outdoor meditation pavilion.

Name: Drift Beach [duplicate]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the One&Only Royal Mirage and managed by Sunset Hospitality Group, this beachfront destination features refined architecture by Michael Dawson.
The airy, open-plan space channels the Riviera with soft blues and whites, prioritizing Provençal cuisine over loud parties.
Guests lounge by the infinity pool facing the Palm Jumeirah skyline before dining on signature dishes like the whole poached lobster.

Name: EPIK
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Meydan Grandstand, this high-energy nightlife destination is the latest concept from Sunset Hospitality Group.
The sprawling 25,000-square-foot venue merges Arabic music traditions with cutting-edge technology to create a modern Khaleeji nightclub experience.
A state-of-the-art kinetic ceiling anchors the space, transforming the dance floor with a dynamic, shifting display of movement and light.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All ticket purchases are non-refundable and final. If you are unable to attend the Event or make an error during the purchasing process, you will not be eligible for a refund, exchange, or return. Tickets may be transferred if the original Ticket holder can no longer attend the event. Names on Tickets must be changed to match the ID of the Attendee using the Ticket.
