If the Event is cancelled due to a Force Majeure situation, the Promoter may, but is not obligated to, issue refunds. In the unlikely case the Event is cancelled for reasons unrelated to Force Majeure, the Promoter will issue refunds limited to the original ticket price.

Name: 1 OAK
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the JW Marriott Marquis, this Dubai outpost of the New York nightlife brand is operated by the Butter Group.
The venue is characterized by a visually striking, art-driven environment and a music rotation centered on hip-hop and open-format sets.
A signature cavernous hallway engraved with Charles Darwin’s writings leads to a main room anchored by Roy Nachum’s art installations.

Name: Man O' War
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a 4,500-acre estate on the eastern tip of Waiheke Island, Man O' War is a vineyard and tasting room owned by New Zealand’s Spencer family.
It remains the island’s only beachfront winery, defined by a relaxed setting where the tasting lawn extends directly onto the sands of the bay.
Guests sample the signature Dreadnought Syrah under pohutukawa trees, often arriving by boat to anchor in the calm waters.

Name: Raspoutine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in DIFC, this outpost of the Parisian institution is a restaurant-club hybrid serving refined French cuisine with distinct Russian influences.
The theatrical, baroque interior features heavy red velvet and antique chandeliers, creating an intimate atmosphere that shifts seamlessly from dinner to dancing.
A standout finish is the signature berry pavlova, a light counterpoint to the decadent caviar service and the venue's late-night energy.

Name: Le Relais
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the protected estate of the Château de Chambord, this boutique hotel bears the contemporary signature of architect Jean-Michel Wilmotte.
The property balances modern warmth with monumental heritage, offering the only accommodation located directly inside the vast national park.
Book a Chambord-facing room for an unparalleled view of Francis I’s intricate slate roofline and chimneys, best admired at sunrise.

Name: White's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1693 by Francesco Bianco, London’s oldest club counts King Charles III among the few permitted to enter its strictly private doors.
This male-only enclave serves as a center for political and aristocratic networking, maintaining a rigid code of conduct unchanged for generations.
A leather-bound betting book details historic wagers, such as a £3,000 bet on which raindrop would reach the bottom of the bow window first.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Mollie Aspen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by CCY Architects with interiors by Post Company, this 68-room hotel sits across from Paepcke Park in downtown Aspen.
The timber-clad structure channels the area’s Bauhaus heritage, featuring a blend of Japanese and Scandinavian aesthetics with sand-cast brass and hand-dyed textiles.
A rooftop spa pool offers views of Aspen Mountain, while the ground floor hosts Petit Trois, a Parisian bistro by Chef Ludo Lefebvre.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Al Maha
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, this secluded sanctuary is a member of Marriott’s The Luxury Collection.
The property comprises 42 Bedouin-style tented suites, each appointed with regional antiques, an artist’s easel, and a private temperature-controlled infinity pool.
Free-roaming Arabian oryx and gazelles frequently graze near the sundecks, offering intimate wildlife encounters against a backdrop of rolling dunes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation within 30 days of arrival - guests will be charged for one night's stay. Cancellation within seven days of arrival - guests will be charged for the total number of nights reserved. Reservations are only confirmed on receipt of a deposit equal to one night's stay. Full pre-payment is required 30 days prior to arrival.

Name: Plates
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Shoreditch, this plant-based restaurant and food design studio is led by chef Kirk Haworth and his sister Keeley.
The kitchen transforms seasonal produce through innovative techniques, earning the venue the UK’s first vegan Michelin star.
A minimalist interior features a bar crafted from felled London trees, grounding the tasting menu in natural textures.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We take a per person deposit at the point of booking to secure the reservation. The deposit is refundable up to 48 hours prior to the reservation. Cancellations or requests to reschedule made within 48 hours of the reservation will render the deposit non-refundable. Additionally, reductions in party size within 48 hours, ie. booking for a table of 4 and attending as a table of 3, will render the full deposit paid at point of booking non-refundable.

Name: Crisp Pizza [duplicate]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Found on a Mayfair corner, this partnership between Crisp Pizza founder Carl McCluskey and the team behind The Devonshire revives a historic pub.
The venue splits its personality between a traditional ground-floor pub serving excellent Guinness and a dining room defined by bare brick and red leather.
The main draw is the signature thin-crust pizza known for its distinct crunch and structural integrity.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Billing information is taken for pre-orders, deposits, events, or holding credit card information for use in the case of no-shows (where applicable). Specific cancellation fees and windows are not publicly listed.

Name: Surrenne
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located beneath The Emory in Belgravia, this private wellness club from the Maybourne Hotel Group features interiors by Remi Tessier and the UK’s first Tracy Anderson studio.
The four-floor subterranean space combines high-tech medical science with holistic therapies, offering longevity programmes alongside restorative treatments.
A 22-metre swimming pool features underwater soundscapes, while the wet area houses a snow shower and a sliding glass door filled with bubbling water.

Name: Biome by Corinthia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Spanning four floors of the Corinthia Hotel, this wellness destination features interiors by GA Design and a glass amphitheatre by Heneghan Peng Architects.
The subterranean space utilizes black Tunisian marble, textured leather, and curved walls to create a darker aesthetic distinct from clinical spa environments.
A glass-walled sauna anchors the thermal floor, accompanied by an ice fountain and a stainless steel swimming pool reflecting flickering fires.

Name: Oka
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Michelin-starred chef Raphael Rego leads this venue in Paris’ 17th arrondissement, blending his Brazilian heritage with French technique.
Named after the Tupi word for house, the restaurant features interiors by architect Arnaud Behzadi and furniture by Sergio Rodrigues.
A ceiling fresco by Florence Bamberger anchors the room, depicting jaguars and toucans in a tribute to Brazilian wildlife.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery if items are in the same condition as received. Tailored by OKA (made-to-order) items can be cancelled or changed within 48 hours of ordering; thereafter, cancellations or returns within 14 days are refunded at 50% of the order value. Return fees apply for parcels (£10–£50) and heavy/fragile items (£30–£95) based on order value, deducted from the refund; returns are free for orders over £3,000. Outlet store purchases are non-refundable. Original standard delivery charges are refunded if the entire order is cancelled within 14 days of delivery.

Name: Le Bistrot des Dames
Master_Aurora_Insights: Tucked away in the Batignolles district within the Hotel Eldorado, this neighborhood favorite offers a quiet respite from the city's bustle. The interior retains a nostalgic charm with vintage decor and a lively bar, while the kitchen serves market-driven bistro classics alongside a robust wine list. The true draw is the hidden courtyard garden, a lush sanctuary filled with hydrangeas and palms where guests dine under the open sky.

Name: Le Calbar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the 12th arrondissement, this cocktail bar is the creation of industry veterans Thierry Malikian and Christophe Sichanh.
The venue balances a chic setting with a deliberately unpretentious concept that challenges the stiffness of traditional speakeasies.
While the menu features creative drinks, the memorable signature is the staff’s uniform of formal shirts, bow ties, and colorful boxer shorts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: EME Catedral Mercer
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Seville’s Santa Cruz district, this contemporary hotel by Mercer Hoteles was designed by architect Juan Pedro Donaire.
The site integrates 14 restored 16th-century Andalusian houses, contrasting original masonry with minimalist interiors around a central courtyard.
A multi-level rooftop terrace hosts a swimming pool and bar that sit almost within reach of the Giralda bell tower.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Flexible Rates: Free cancellations up to 48h before the arrival date. For cancellations made 48h or less before arrival, or in case of no-show or early departure, the hotel will charge 100% of the stay. Non Refundable Rates: The total amount will be charged at booking. No refund will be made in case of cancellation, early departure or no-show. Deposit: The hotel reserves the right to pre-authorize the credit card provided and charge the first night 7 days prior to arrival. Special conditions apply during Easter/Holy Week and April Fair.

Name: Beefbar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created by Riccardo Giraudi in Monte-Carlo, this global collection breaks the stiff codes of traditional meat-centric dining.
The experience balances high-end design with a relaxed atmosphere, presenting a menu that juxtaposes rare meats with global street food influences.
A standout detail is the presentation of signature street food on custom Bernardaud porcelain plates adorned with playful emojis.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be guaranteed with a credit card. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are subject to a fee of $20 per person.

Name: Die Krone von Lech
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Engadin village of La Punt, this 16th-century coaching inn has been transformed into a gastronomic destination by British chef James Baron and his wife Natacha.
The interiors pair original pine-panelled Stüvas with sleek modern furnishings, creating a rooted yet refreshing atmosphere.
A standout detail is the restaurant La Chavallera, where Baron’s technical precision elevates local ingredients into artful plates served beneath historic vaulted ceilings.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation fees apply from the point of reservation. In the event of a cancellation up to 30 days prior to the arrival date, 30% of the room rate will be charged, up to 14 days prior to the arrival date, 50% will be charged, up to 7 days prior to the arrival date, 70% will be charged, and during the last week and on early departure, 100% of the entire day or package price will be charged. In the event that the room can be rented out until 30 days prior to the arrival date, no cancellation fee will be charged.

Name: Le Relais
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the historic Badrutt’s Palace in St. Moritz, this establishment serves as the hotel’s primary dining venue.
The interior retains a Belle Époque character, offering a formal setting for traditional French and international cuisine.
A signature element is the tableside guéridon service, where dishes such as steak tartare are prepared overlooking Lake St. Moritz and the surrounding peaks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window.

Name: Cat Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Courchevel 1850, this intimate venue is a collaboration between the St-Tropez-based Indie Group and local hospitality figure Nils Claret-Tournier.
The space balances a cozy, soft-lit lounge with a spirited club atmosphere, defined by minimalist interiors and a sophisticated disco-tech soundtrack.
Design details by Sarita Posada frame the experience, which centers on signature cocktails and a seamless shift from relaxation to dancing.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Avatara [duplicate]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Rahul Rana in Dubai Hills Estate, this Michelin-starred venue is the first all-vegetarian Indian restaurant to earn such recognition.
The kitchen eschews mock meats in favor of sattvic principles, elevating humble vegetables through a philosophy described as the reincarnation of soulful food.
A sixteen-course degustation menu guides guests through a spiritual narrative, often beginning with a ceremonial Naivedhya offering to set a reverent tone.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To confirm your reservation, you will be requested to make an advance payment. A 100% advance deposit is required for bookings of 5 or more calculated at AED 750 per person for the Avatara Experience Menu. For all bookings, you must notify us of a cancellation or any changes to the number of guests at least 24 hours before your booking. Bookings secured by an advance deposit will be held for 30 mins after the booking time if nobody shows it will be released with no refund. Bookings canceled up to 24 hours in advance and secured with a deposit will be granted a 50% refund on the deposit.

Name: Nobu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Nobu Matsuhisa’s celebrated Japanese-Peruvian outpost commands the 22nd floor of Atlantis, The Palm.
The kitchen executes a sophisticated blend of traditional sushi mechanics and bold South American ingredients in a space defined by expansive skyline views.
Regulars order the signature black cod miso to enjoy alongside the vista from what was once the hotel’s Royal Bridge Suite.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to secure reservations. Cancellations are accepted until the day prior to your reservation. Same-day cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of $50 per person.

Name: Le Bar at Les Airelles
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Palace-rated Les Airelles in Courchevel 1850, this intimate drinking den channels the spirit of a 19th-century Austro-Hungarian castle.
The interior is a study in alpine warmth, where crackling fires and aged timber frame a collection of rare spirits and prestigious vintages.
Patrons can retire to the dedicated smoking room to pair a signature cocktail with a selection from the well-stocked cigar cellar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Experimental Chalet
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the heart of the Swiss Alps, Experimental Chalet Verbier is a boutique retreat from the Experimental Group with interiors by Milanese architect Fabrizio Casiraghi.
The design departs from classic alpine aesthetics, blending lacquered wood, deep jewel tones, and mid-century modern furniture.
The building houses the Farm Club, a nightlife institution that has been a fixture of Verbier since 1971.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard cancellation window is 30 days prior to arrival by 12:00 PM hotel time; cancellations made within this period, early departures, or no-shows are charged 100% of the stay. Non-refundable rates require full prepayment at the time of booking and are non-changeable and non-refundable. A valid credit card is required to guarantee reservations.

Name: Steakhouse No. 316
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a historic 1888 Victorian mining cabin in Aspen, this intimate steakhouse is the work of local hospitality duo Craig and Samantha Cordts-Pearce.
The dimly lit, clubby interior defines the space with dark woods and heavy drapes, creating a focused backdrop for prime cuts.
Settle into a plush red velvet banquette for the signature tableside Caesar salad, a theatrical ritual that complements the menu of butcher cuts and fine wines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance. A credit card is required to secure the reservation, and late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a cancellation fee.

Name: Perrotin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by French gallerist Emmanuel Perrotin, this venue in the Dubai International Financial Centre represents the dealer’s first expansion into the Middle East.
The gallery distinguishes itself with a specialized focus on the secondary market, presenting blue-chip works by modern and contemporary masters.
Its setting in Gate Village places it at the heart of the city’s art scene, neighboring international auction houses like Christie’s and Sotheby’s.

Name: CLAP
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on a rooftop in DIFC, this contemporary Japanese restaurant is the Dubai outpost of the Beirut-born concept by 7 Management.
The layout integrates a dining room, lounge, and the hidden Ongaku music bar, all framed by a terrace with views of the downtown skyline.
A custom chandelier assembled from 2,100 Japanese action figures anchors the reception area, offering a sharp contrast to the sleek wood-and-stone interiors.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations require card details. Restaurant reservations are subject to a 24-hour cancellation policy. For individual reservations a charge of €50 per person will apply in case of no-show or cancellation within 24 hours of the reservation. For group bookings if the reservation is not honored or canceled less than 24 hours in advance, the deposit will not be refunded.

Name: PARC
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Locals Maryanne and Harley Sefton enlisted executive chef Mark Connell to lead this modern French farmhouse in downtown Aspen.
The venue features three distinct environments, balancing a community bar with a main dining room dedicated to seasonal Colorado ingredients.
A standout dish is the "Railroad Tie," a layered fry creation topped with beef tartare, caviar, and crème fraîche.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Silencio
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden six floors beneath Rue Montmartre, this atmospheric cultural venue was conceived and designed entirely by filmmaker David Lynch.
The subterranean space operates as a members’ salon for screenings and concerts before transitioning into a public nightclub in the early hours.
Its moody, labyrinthine interior features gold-leafed walls, a private cinema, and a smoking room modeled after a forest.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Taboo Beach Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Tulum’s Hotel Zone, this beach club and restaurant is a flagship venue from the Mexican hospitality firm RosaNegra Group.
The destination pairs Mediterranean cuisine with a bohemian aesthetic that shifts from relaxed lounging to a spirited party atmosphere.
Design elements such as rustic parota wood bars and woven rugs frame the signature rituals of live saxophone performances and champagne service.

Name: The Brooklyn Mirage
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on a cliff promontory near the Caves of Hercules, this Tangier hideaway has long been a discreet refuge for the literary and diplomatic set.
The property features independent whitewashed bungalows with floor-to-ceiling windows, offering a minimalist aesthetic that prioritizes privacy and frames the vast Atlantic Ocean.
Secure a table on the cascading terrace for the daily ritual of mint tea accompanied by panoramic views of the waves crashing against the coastline below.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All ticket sales are final; no refunds or exchanges. Events take place rain or shine. Refunds are provided only if an event is cancelled. Must be 21+ with valid photo ID.

Name: La Cave des Creux
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at 2,112 meters in Courchevel, this former shepherd's hut is now a restaurant run by two former ski instructors from a local family.
The kitchen serves refined Savoyard classics alongside lighter Asian-inspired dishes in a space that balances rustic timber with contemporary polish.
A sprawling outdoor dessert buffet serves as the terrace's centerpiece, offering oversized tarts and fresh fruit against a panoramic backdrop of the Three Valleys.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Experimental Chalet
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Verbier, this alpine lodge from the Experimental Group features interiors by architect Fabrizio Casiraghi and dining by chef Gregory Marchand.
The design eschews rustic clichés, blending traditional timber framing with sleek brass accents and mid-century modern furnishings.
A standout feature is the Farm Club, a historic nightlife institution that has defined the resort’s après-ski scene for over fifty years.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled by 12pm hotel time 30 days prior to arrival to avoid a penalty of 100% of the full stay. Non-refundable rates are charged the total amount at the time of booking and are not refundable. All reservations must be guaranteed by a valid credit card.

Name: Steakhouse No. 316
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a historic miner's cabin in Aspen, this moody steakhouse is operated by Craig and Samantha Cordts-Pearce of CP Restaurant Group.
Plush red velvet banquettes and gilded mirrors create a film noir atmosphere that complements a traditional menu of prime beef and seafood.
Beyond the standard porterhouse, the kitchen distinguishes itself with a signature octopus cafreal appetizer served with two sauces.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a credit card hold. Cancellations made within 48 hours of the reservation time are subject to a fee of $150 per person. The same fee applies if the entire party is not present within 10 minutes of the reservation time.

Name: Zuma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored in the DIFC’s Gate Village, this contemporary Japanese izakaya from chef Rainer Becker consistently ranks among the World’s 50 Best Restaurants.
The multi-level venue features Noriyoshi Muramatsu’s elemental design of hewn stone and steel, creating a high-energy atmosphere for the city’s financial elite.
While the miso-marinated black cod is the culinary headliner, the weekend Baikingu brunch serves as a central ritual for Dubai’s social set.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations require valid credit card details to secure the booking. Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a penalty. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a fee of approximately $50 or €50 per person charged to the card on file. For parties of 8 or more, a deposit may be required.

Name: PARC
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former L'Hostaria space on Hyman Avenue, this modern mountain destination is led by Chef Stefano Schiaffino, whose background merges French technique with Peruvian influence.
The seasonally driven kitchen prioritizes local ingredients and global flavors, supported by a Wine Spectator award-winning list of over 1,300 labels.
Signature plates like elk carpaccio arrive in a contemporary dining room defined by wood beams and soft gray-blue tones.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Surf Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Reviving Harvey Firestone’s 1930s society playground, this Surfside icon pairs Russell Pancoast’s Mediterranean foundation with crystalline towers by Pritzker Prize–winner Richard Meier.
Interiors by Joseph Dirand balance historic glamour with modern restraint, framing Atlantic views through restored arches and cool, cream-colored stone.
While Thomas Keller leads the kitchen, the property’s soul resides in the legendary Cabana Row, where Winston Churchill once painted seaside watercolors.

Name: Raspoutine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in DIFC, this outpost of the Parisian institution is operated by Paris Society in partnership with Addmind.
The interior features a nocturnal aesthetic defined by heavy red velvet drapery, intricate chandeliers, and intimate banquettes.
A dinner service featuring the signature potato with caviar eventually gives way to a late-night atmosphere driven by deep house music.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before reservation. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a fee. A credit card is required to secure the booking.

Name: Anantara Spa [ DUPLICATE ]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Positioned on the Palm Jumeirah’s eastern crescent, this wellness sanctuary reflects the Thai heritage of the Anantara brand.
The sprawling facility blends Asian therapies with Middle Eastern traditions, featuring twenty-four treatment rooms and a Turkish Hammam.
Distinctive wet facilities include a liquid sound pool, crystal steam rooms, and an ice grotto.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Any cancellations made less than 24 hours will incur a 50% charge. For no-shows, the full treatment price will be charged.

Name: The Academy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Comprising five Georgian townhouses in London’s literary Bloomsbury, this boutique hotel was reimagined by Champalimaud Design for YTL Hotels.
Interiors blend modern bespoke furniture with period architecture, creating a scholarly retreat that channels the spirit of the Bloomsbury Group.
A secluded courtyard garden offers a rare outdoor escape, while the signature Mr Ma’s Afternoon Tea pays homage to local literary history.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Best Flexible bookings can usually be cancelled by 2pm, 2 days prior to arrival. Advance Purchase rates are non-refundable and non-amendable. A £30 preauthorisation is taken at check-in to cover incidentals.

Name: The Rex Rooms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the historic 151 King’s Road address, this surrealist lounge is the latest nightlife concept from designer Marc Jacques Burton.
The interior pays homage to the avant-garde with sinuous curves, distorted mirrors, and webbed timber formations that create a dreamlike, immersive aesthetic.
A secret door reveals The King’s 1942 Room, a private enclave designed for seclusion separate from the main venue’s energy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Cyashitsu Ryokan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by architect Keisuke Maeda of UID, this modern ryokan in Oku-Asakusa reimagines the traditional tea house for contemporary travelers.
The intimate interior is defined by low ceilings, sliding screens, and tatami floors that create a meditative, cocoon-like atmosphere.
Hand-painted fusuma doors by artist Alan West accent the guestrooms, while a reservable open-air bath on the sixth floor offers sweeping views of the Tokyo Skytree.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Cancellation charges are as follows:
No show, the day of check-in: 100% (for the first night)
1 day before check-in: 80%
2 to 7 days before check-in: 50%
If you do not stay/show up without notice, you will be charged 100% of the accommodation charges.
When the number of days contracted is shortened, cancellation charges for the first day shall be paid by the Guest regardless of the number of days shortened.

Name: Equinox (London)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the top floor of the Grade II listed Derry & Toms building, this club was designed by United Design Partnership to honor its Art Deco heritage.
The interiors reference the site's history as the Biba boutique and Rainbow Room nightclub, utilizing organic materials and soft lighting throughout the space.
An illuminated elliptical dome skylight crowns the open-plan strength floor, serving as the architectural centerpiece above the training areas.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel or reschedule your Session or Treatment up to twenty-four (24) hours before the Session or Treatment is due to start. You will be charged for the full cost of the Session or Treatment if you cancel or reschedule with less than twenty-four (24) hours’ prior notice or if you fail to show up to your Session or Treatment.

Name: Caldera House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated at the base of Jackson Hole’s aerial tram, this ski-in retreat was realized by CLB Architects and the Los Angeles studio Commune.
The property operates as a hybrid private club and boutique hotel, defining its chalet aesthetic with American craftsmanship and mid-century European furnishings instead of rustic tropes.
Sprawling suites offer wood-burning fireplaces and balconies, while the street level houses the Old Yellowstone Garage, a local Italian institution revived on-site.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 20% non-refundable deposit is required at the time of booking. The remaining balance is due 45 days prior to arrival. If cancelled outside of 45 days prior to arrival, the 20% deposit is forfeited. If cancelled within 45 days of arrival, the full amount of the booking is non-refundable. Shortening a stay within 45 days of arrival also results in the full amount being non-refundable.

Name: I Camisa & Son
Master_Aurora_Insights:
London’s original Italian deli, I Camisa & Son has been a Soho institution since 1929, counting actor Stanley Tucci among its vocal supporters.
Shelves are stacked floor-to-ceiling with imported groceries and hanging salumi, while the counter serves made-to-order sandwiches on fresh ciabatta.
A lunchtime queue is all but guaranteed, with regulars waiting for the signature ciabatta filled with freshly sliced mortadella.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel your Contract with us for the Goods you order at any time up to the end of the fourteenth working day from the date you receive the ordered Goods. You do not need to give us any reason for cancelling your Contract nor will you have to pay any penalty. To cancel your Contract you must notify us in writing. If you have received the Goods before you cancel your Contract then you must send the Goods back to our contact address at your own cost and risk. Once you have notified us that you are cancelling your Contract, any sum debited to us from your credit or debit card will be credited to your account as soon as possible and in any event within 30 days of your order provided that the Goods in question are returned by you and received by us in the condition they were in when delivered to you.

Name: Atlas
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Marlon Blackwell Architects and INC Architecture & Design, this LEED Gold-certified hotel sits at the entrance to Harvard’s Enterprise Research Campus in Allston.
The interiors function as a communal social hub, featuring a living room-style lobby with natural wood, stone, and mossy green textiles.
A standout element is the ground-floor restaurant Ama, helmed by the James Beard-nominated team behind Comfort Kitchen, which serves global comfort food.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings and tickets are non-refundable and must be paid in full in advance. No refunds will be issued if the venue is open, including for personal emergencies, sickness, travel disruptions, or no-shows. Date changes are permitted within 2 hours of the original transaction time. Cancellation due to bad weather will receive an E-voucher valid for 18 months. Failure to attend results in forfeiture of the booking.

Name: The Crown and Shuttle
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Shoreditch High Street, this award-winning independent pub is a revived Victorian boozer that combines a gritty history with a contemporary focus on craft beer.
The stripped-back interior features exposed brick and mismatched furniture, serving as a backdrop for local ales and an all-day menu of hearty fare.
A sprawling rear garden acts as the venue’s centerpiece, offering a rare open-air retreat complete with a resident food truck.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Fairmont Empress
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking Victoria’s Inner Harbour, this 1908 National Historic Site by architect Francis Rattenbury is a defining example of Canada’s grand railway hotels.
A comprehensive restoration by Hirsch Bedner Associates has sharpened its Edwardian character, blending original Chateauesque features with contemporary interiors.
While the afternoon tea service remains a staple, the Q Bar’s signature Empress 1908 Gin, infused with butterfly pea blossom to turn indigo, offers a distinct local ritual.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard cancellation window is 72 hours prior to arrival. A deposit of the first night's room and tax is required at the time of booking.

Name: Chabrot [ CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in Paris's 8th arrondissement, this intimate bistro and wine cellar is the personal project of restaurateur Hélène Poitevin.
The venue serves as a discreet gathering place for authentic French cuisine, prioritizing seasonal ingredients and expert pairings over trend-chasing.
Its name pays homage to the Occitan custom of adding red wine to the last of a soup, a ritual that perfectly captures the venue's convivial spirit.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Golden Heart
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored on a corner of Commercial Street in Spitalfields, this storied East London pub is presided over by formidable landlady Sandra Esquilant.
Once the unofficial headquarters of the Young British Artists, it retains a gritty, unpretentious charm that belies its status as a piece of art history.
Inside, the walls display personal gifts from former regulars, including signature neon works by Tracey Emin that glow above the traditional bar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Deposits are non-refundable if the booking is cancelled within 48 hours of booking time. To cancel an online booking, click the link in the booking confirmation email.

Name: Bar Boulud [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated opposite Lincoln Center, this bistro by Chef Daniel Boulud channels the spirit of a traditional Lyonnais bouchon on the Upper West Side.
The kitchen specializes in rustic French fare, pairing house-made terrines and pâtés with selections from Burgundy and the Rhône.
A curved, barrel-inspired ceiling mirrors the focus on viticulture, framing the signature tasting board of house-made charcuterie.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Kenza [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Tony Kitous of the Comptoir Group, Kenza is a Middle Eastern dining venue located in London's Devonshire Square.
The subterranean space is modeled after a Moroccan riad, incorporating beaded lanterns, carved wood, and regular belly-dancing performances.
The signature dish is a slow-roasted lamb shoulder prepared with figs, prunes, dates, and pistachios served over couscous.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Beaumont
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a Grade II-listed 1926 garage in Mayfair, this Art Deco hotel features interiors recently refreshed by the late architect Thierry Despont.
The atmosphere evokes a transatlantic 1920s aesthetic with polished walnut, checkerboard floors, and a collection of original paintings and photography.
Its most striking feature is ROOM, a cubist suite-sculpture by Antony Gormley that dominates the building’s façade and offers a cave-like sleeping experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard reservations must be cancelled not later than 24 hours prior to the time of expected arrival to avoid a charge of one night's rate. Non-cancellable rates require a full non-refundable deposit of the total accommodation cost at the time of booking. A pre-authorisation is required for the total room nights plus £150 per day for incidentals.

Name: Tandoor Chop House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Covent Garden, this hybrid concept from Ennismore founder Sharan Pasricha is led by head chef Kundan Rawat.
The kitchen applies traditional tandoor cooking and rich marinades to prime British cuts, creating a menu of smoky, robust plates.
A signature dish is the bone marrow naan, a rich fusion staple that encapsulates the restaurant’s cross-cultural approach.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Goring
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Belgravia near Buckingham Palace, this is London’s only family-owned five-star hotel, still managed by the founding Goring family.
It holds a Royal Warrant from Queen Elizabeth II and balances Edwardian history with the relaxed atmosphere of a country home.
The Michelin-starred Dining Room serves Eggs Drumkilbo, a lobster and caviar dish famously favored by the Queen Mother.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The rate of the room for one night will be charged if the reservation is cancelled less than 24 hours prior to arrival (GMT). Credit card details will be required to confirm the reservation. Promotional rates may require full non-refundable prepayment at the time of booking.

Name: The Other Naughty Piglet [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the mezzanine of Andrew Lloyd Webber’s The Other Palace theatre in Victoria, this wine bar is the second outpost from duo Joe Sharratt and Margaux Aubry.
The kitchen delivers seasonal, charcoal-grilled small plates with a modern European edge, accompanied by an extensive list of low-intervention vintages.
Signature BBQ monkfish is a standout, served in a spirited, light-filled space that overlooks the theatre’s lobby.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Owned by the Irish family-run Doyle Collection, this Marylebone Village property features public spaces designed by Amsterdam studio Concrete.
The aesthetic merges mid-century furnishings with contemporary art, creating a polished backdrop for the street-side 108 Brasserie and bar.
Select suites distinguish themselves with heated terraces that feature retractable roofs and outdoor fireplaces.

If notice of cancellation is not received by the required date, the hotel will charge one night's accommodation. A credit card is required to guarantee the reservation, and pre-authorisation or pre-payment of the full stay is required upon check-in.

Name: The Crown
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the historic market town of Old Amersham, this 16th-century coaching inn has been reimagined by celebrated designer Ilse Crawford.
The interiors define the modern rustic aesthetic, stripping back clutter to reveal original timber beams alongside warm, tactile minimalism.
Guests gather in the cobbled courtyard or by the inglenook fireplace, surrounded by signature touches like sheepskin throws and classic Windsor chairs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Mandrake
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Fitzrovia, this award-winning hotel is the surrealist vision of entrepreneur Rami Fustok, with interiors designed by his sister Tala Fustok.
The property is defined by its moody, hedonistic atmosphere, centered around a central open-air courtyard draped in hanging jasmine and passionflower.
A standout feature is the Waeska Bar, where an ethnobotanical cocktail menu is served amidst a collection of taxidermy and global artifacts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:

Save for the inclusion of further additional services, no amendments, variation, or cancellation to the booking is allowed after 24 hours prior to check-in date. A valid credit card is required to secure the booking and full payment amount will not be taken at the time of booking. Payment will be taken in full on the day of arrival. Cancellation is not permitted. Please note that for reservations made under non-refundable offers, the card used for payment must be present at the time of check-in along with the cardholder. A valid credit card will be required and pre-authorised at time of check-in to cover incidentals.

Name: The Prince
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A St Kilda landmark since the 1930s, this Art Deco icon has been revitalized by IF Architecture to blend its seaside heritage with contemporary polish.
The atmosphere is effortlessly cool and bohemian, serving as a vibrant cultural hub where live music, dining, and design converge near the bay.
A standout feature is the legendary Prince Bandroom, a live music institution that has hosted decades of iconic performances just steps from the beach.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard cancellation window is 48 hours prior to arrival. Non-refundable rates require full prepayment and are non-refundable. A valid credit card is required to guarantee the reservation.

Name: The Franklin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in a row of Victorian townhouses in Knightsbridge, this boutique hotel is part of the Starhotels Collezione and features interiors by designer Anouska Hempel.
The space is defined by a moody aesthetic where dark velvets and grey tones create an intimate environment.
A standout feature is the restaurant lined with Venetian mirrors, serving modern Piedmontese dishes overseen by Michelin-starred chef Alfredo Russo.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations are accepted without penalty up to 48 hours before 4 PM on the day of arrival. Cancellations within the 48-hour cancellation policy are subject to the first night’s room and tax. Please be aware that attempting to modify a reservation within the 48-hour cancellation period will be considered a cancellation. Advance Purchase Rates are non-refundable. A valid credit card is required at the time of booking to hold the reservation. The credit card will be authorized pre-arrival to ensure validity, however, no deposit will be taken with the exception of an Advanced Purchase Rate. In this case, the entire amount would be charged and is non-refundable.

Name: Proud East [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the banks of the Regent's Canal in Haggerston, this multi-functional venue from the Proud Group is a café, restaurant, and event space designed by Studio TILT.
The steel-structured interior features a light-filled mezzanine and distinct zones defined by black-stained wooden floors and larch ceiling fins.
A double-height library wall anchors the dining area, while the outdoor terrace offers waterside views of the passing canal boats.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: San Lorenzo [Closed]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched in the Dolomites of South Tyrol, this 16th-century hunting lodge is the passion project of former fashion executives Giorgia and Stefano Barbini.
The private retreat prioritizes alpine silence and careful restoration, blending heritage architecture with contemporary design.
Beyond the panoramic outdoor whirlpool, the estate features a private 18-hole golf course carved directly into the steep mountain slopes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Draycott Arms [closed]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Staffordshire village of Draycott-in-the-Moors, this revitalized pub is the work of landlords Zara Hutson and Brayn Urquhart.
The venue operates as a community-focused hub, combining a cosy, welcoming atmosphere with a menu of dependable British classics and well-kept ales.
A standout feature is the kitchen’s commitment to local produce, best experienced through their signature homemade pies or the popular Sunday roast ritual.

Name: The Carlton Tower Jumeirah
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Knightsbridge, this modernist tower recently underwent a £100 million transformation led by design studio 1508 London.
The light-filled interiors feature rare balconies with city views, while the flagship restaurant Al Mare is helmed by chef Marco Calenzo.
A double-height, 20-metre swimming pool is bathed in natural daylight, offering a bright alternative to the capital's typical basement spas.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard cancellation is by 2pm 1 day prior to arrival. Non-refundable rates are charged in full at booking and cannot be cancelled or amended. All reservations require a credit card guarantee; deposits are not required unless specified.

Name: Sketch [duplicate]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in an 18th-century Mayfair townhouse once home to the suffragettes, this immersive venue is the brainchild of restaurateur Mourad Mazouz and chef Pierre Gagnaire.
The Gallery serves as a living art installation, bathed in golden hues by architect India Mahdavi with works by British-Nigerian artist Yinka Shonibare.
While the menu offers playful French dishes, the space is most famous for its futuristic, egg-shaped restroom pods.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details are required to secure bookings. A cancellation fee (varying by room, typically £30–£85 per person) applies to no-shows or cancellations made within 48 hours of the reservation.

Name: The Elgin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Built in 1887 as the summer residence of the Maharaja of Cooch Behar, this heritage hotel stands in the heart of Darjeeling.
The interiors preserve a colonial atmosphere with Burma teak panelling, crackling fireplaces, and period furniture.
A highlight is the afternoon tea served in the lounge, offering views of the Kanchenjunga mountains on clear days.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Confirmed dates/days may be altered, cancelled or cut short only if intimation in writing reaches the company, 16 days prior to the check in date. No refund/postponement if the cancellation is done after that. All bookings must be guaranteed at the time of reservation by a Credit Card or Travel Agency.

Name: Blakes
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Widely credited as the world’s first boutique hotel, this South Kensington address was created by designer Anouska Hempel.
The interiors are theatrically opulent and intentionally dark, mixing traditional English details with exotic artifacts from the Far East.
A standout feature is the Corfu Suite, famous for its towering four-poster bed and floor-to-ceiling white muslin drapes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Blakes Hotel must receive all amendments or cancellations two days (48 hrs) prior to arrival in order to avoid charges. Advance Purchase Rates require full payment at the time of booking and are non-refundable. A credit card guarantee or a deposit equivalent to the first night’s accommodation is required to confirm a booking. In the event of a no-show on the day of arrival, 100% full payment will be charged.

Name: Foley's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in London’s Fitzrovia, this spirited tasting kitchen is led by alumni of The Palomar, bringing a high-energy dining philosophy to the neighbourhood.
The kitchen delivers a confident, eclectic mix of Asian-inspired small plates, served in a space that balances industrial design with warm, convivial hospitality.
Secure a seat at the downstairs chef’s counter to witness the culinary action up close, ideally accompanied by the signature sticky beef.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Brown's Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened in 1837 in Mayfair, London’s oldest hotel is a Rocco Forte property featuring interiors by Olga Polizzi.
The atmosphere blends Victorian heritage with modern British art and dining at Charlie’s, overseen by Michelin-starred chef Adam Byatt.
Its literary legacy is anchored by the Kipling Suite, where Rudyard Kipling penned The Jungle Book during his stay.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation policy varies by rate. Flexible rates typically allow free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival. Non-refundable rates require full prepayment and are non-refundable. Credit card guarantee required.

Name: Golborne Road Market
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooked by Erno Goldfinger’s Trellick Tower, this vibrant street market operates as a community-focused counterpoint to the adjacent Portobello Road.
Stalls mixing utilitarian housewares and bric-a-brac with mid-century furniture line the pavement, joined on weekends by antique dealers and North African food vendors.
A defining local ritual involves queuing at Lisboa Patisserie for a warm pastel de nata and coffee to enjoy on the kerb.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Seven Stars Resort
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by industrial designer Eiji Mitooka for JR Kyushu, this sleeper train tours the volcanic landscapes of Japan’s Kyushu island.
The limited-capacity service functions as a showcase for regional craftsmanship, blending Western technological comfort with traditional Japanese joinery.
A signature panoramic window in the rear Blue Moon lounge offers guests an unobstructed view of the receding tracks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be received 14 days prior to arrival. A 3-night deposit is required at the time of booking. Festive Season (Dec 18 - Jan 2) restrictions apply.

Name: The Stafford
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located off St James’s Place, this historic property spans 17th-century townhouses and a cobbled mews, with dining overseen by Michelin-starred chef Michael Caines.
Accommodation ranges from the classic Main House to the rustic Carriage House, a collection of suites housed within former stables.
Its 380-year-old wine cellar, originally built by Lord Francis Godolphin, served as an air-raid shelter for American and Canadian officers during the Second World War.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings made directly with the hotel can be cancelled up to 24 hours prior to arrival. Bookings made on third-party websites usually require 48 hours notice. Special offers may vary. Reservations must be guaranteed with a credit card.

Name: The Standard
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Rising above the High Line in New York’s Meatpacking District, this concrete-and-glass structure was conceived by hotelier André Balazs and designed by Ennead Architects.
Its eighteen stories stand on massive concrete pillars, defined by floor-to-ceiling windows that frame the city and the park below.
A standout feature is the rooftop venue Le Bain, which hosts a plunge pool on the dance floor and overlooks the Hudson River.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be canceled by 4 PM local time 48 hours prior to arrival to avoid a penalty of one night's room and tax. Non-refundable rates are charged in full at the time of booking.

Name: The Three Crowns
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in the medieval stannary town of Chagford, this Grade II* listed 13th-century inn is a five-star Dartmoor retreat operated by Steve Bellman and John Milan.
The building retains its original character with an imposing granite façade and oak beams while integrating a contemporary glazed courtyard.
A standout feature is the glass-roofed atrium dining space where guests enjoy locally sourced dishes including a Sunday roast that frequently garners acclaim.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a charge (typically the first night or full amount). Standard bookings are "Pay at Hotel" with card details required to secure the room; some packages may require a non-refundable deposit.

Located in London's Marylebone district, this outpost from Monocle magazine was designed by the publication's in-house team led by Yoshitsugu Takagi.
The space functions as a physical extension of the brand's editorial voice, blending Japanese minimalism with Nordic influences in a compact setting.
A signature prawn katsu sandwich is served at the custom-made red oak counter beneath bold pendant lights from Manufactum.
