Name: Bubbledogs [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by award-winning sommelier Sandia Chang, this London-based concept pairs gourmet hot dogs with a specialized library of grower Champagnes.
The offering champions small-batch wines from independent producers, serving them alongside playful comfort food in a distinct high-low gastronomic contrast.
Signature options include the Mac Daddy, topped with macaroni and cheese, accompanied by a glass of rare bubbles that reflect their specific terroir.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Montagu Square
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Marylebone, this Grade II-listed garden square was developed by the Portman Estate and designed by architect J.T. Parkinson.
The enclave is defined by its uniform Georgian terraces and a private central garden that offers a quiet retreat from the surrounding city.
Number 34 holds a unique cultural legacy, having served as a home for Ringo Starr, Jimi Hendrix, and John Lennon during the 1960s.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Jackalope
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Carr Design Group and named Australia’s Hotel of the Year, this bold property sits on the Willow Creek Vineyard in the Mornington Peninsula.
Dark, monochromatic interiors and moody lighting contrast with the rolling vines to create an atmosphere distinct from traditional country estates.
A seven-meter sculpture guards the entrance, while the restaurant features a ceiling installation of 10,000 amber bulbs representing fermentation bubbles.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please ensure full pre-payment is made within 14-days of booking. If payment is not made within 14-days of booking your reservation may be subject to cancellation. Reservations must be cancelled 14-days prior to arrival to avoid penalty. Any date changes will be subject to the current rates applicable on the new dates. Cancellations or Changes to your stay within 14-days will forfeit 50% of the deposit. Cancellations within 7-days will forfeit 100% of the deposit. Full Pre-Payment Required.

Name: The Wellesley
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Knightsbridge building that once served as a tube station entrance, this property was redesigned by interior designers Fox Linton Associates.
The interiors display a refined Art Deco aesthetic with high-gloss exotic woods, bevelled mirrors, and a dedicated lounge honoring the site’s musical past.
A heated cigar terrace features the largest hotel humidor in Europe and a floor inlaid with a laser-cut map of Cuba.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The standard cancellation window is 48 hours by 3:00 PM prior to arrival; late cancellations incur a one-night penalty. Non-refundable rates require full prepayment and are not refundable.

Name: Marylebone Village
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Managed by the Howard de Walden Estate, this central London enclave spans ninety-two acres of Georgian terraces and Victorian mansion blocks.
The neighborhood maintains a distinct village atmosphere through a strictly curated collection of independent boutiques and artisan food producers.
Residents frequent the Sunday Farmers’ Market on Aybrook Street, located just moments from the skylit Edwardian galleries of Daunt Books.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Cavendish London
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the Chatsworth Estate, this 18th-century coaching inn is owned by the Duke of Devonshire, with kitchens led by executive chef Adam Harper.
The interiors pair original stone fireplaces and oak beams with contemporary furnishings to create a comfortable base for exploring the Peak District.
Dinner is served in the Gallery Restaurant, where the walls are hung with contemporary art drawn directly from the Devonshire family’s private collection.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation and prepayment policies vary according to rate type. Flexible rates typically allow cancellation by 2:00 PM on the day of arrival without penalty. Non-refundable rates require full prepayment and are non-refundable. A credit card or deposit is required to guarantee the reservation.

Name: The Wallace
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ranked among the top U.S. hotels by Tripadvisor, this Upper West Side property provides a quiet residential setting near Lincoln Center and Central Park.
The interiors blend modern amenities with residential comfort, centered on a lobby with a fireplace and rooms that feel like private apartments.
A highlight is The Wallace Lounge, a Stonehill Taylor-designed piano bar serving the signature Wallace Martini alongside nightly live music.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To cancel an upcoming stay without penalty, please contact us at least 24 hours prior to your scheduled arrival, unless a non-refundable rate has been booked. Reservations changed or canceled less than 24 hours in advance (EST) will result in a charge of one night, plus tax. A deposit of $50 per accommodation, per night is required upon check-in.

Name: Boundary
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a converted Victorian warehouse in Shoreditch, this multi-level destination was originally established by Sir Terence Conran and is now led by James McCulloch.
The property comprises seventeen guestrooms paying homage to designers like Eames and Le Corbusier, alongside a spacious ground-floor bar and brasserie.
A glass-encased rooftop orangery and terrace provides year-round dining with sweeping views across the East London skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Beagle [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Named after the ship that carried Charles Darwin, this navigable strait separates the main island of Tierra del Fuego from the southern archipelago.
The passage features the glaciated peaks of the Darwin Cordillera and subpolar forests that line the steep shores.
A key landmark is the Les Eclaireurs Lighthouse, a red-and-white tower on a rocky islet inhabited by imperial cormorants and sea lions.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To cancel an online booking, click the cancellation link in your booking confirmation email. Alternatively, please call us on 01473 730607.

Name: Sloane Place
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Chelsea, this boutique hotel operates as the spirited, open-door sister to the historic Sloane Club, with menus by executive chef Bernhard Mayer.
The interiors channel a breezy cosmopolitanism with light-filled spaces and contemporary furnishings, offering a relaxed counterpoint to the private club’s formality.
Downstairs, The Hideaway serves as an intimate speakeasy, while the main dining room blends European classics with vibrant Asian flavours.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Fully Flexible Brand Room only rate: You are eligible to amend, vary or cancel your booking up to 24 hours prior to arrival. A valid credit card is required to secure the booking and it will be charged one day prior to arrival for the full accommodation charges. Semi-Flexible Brand Room only rate: You are eligible to cancel your booking up to 7 days prior to arrival and to amend it up to 24 hours prior to arrival. A valid credit card is required to secure the booking and it will be charged 7 days prior to your stay for the full accommodation charges. Non-Refundable Brand Room only rate: A full non-refundable payment is required at the time of booking. Reservations cancelled will incur a cancellation charge of the full pre-paid amount. On arrival, a £1 pre-authorisation via chip and pin will be required.

Name: The Hari
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Belgravia, this boutique hotel is the flagship of the Harilela Group and features interiors by Tara Bernerd.
The design evokes a New York loft atmosphere with exposed brick, velvet upholstery, and a rotating contemporary art collection.
A garden terrace serves as the focal point, equipped with a retractable roof and living walls for year-round al fresco dining.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard rates allow free cancellation up to 3pm the day prior to arrival; cancellations after this time or no-shows will incur a charge equivalent to the first night's rate. Advance purchase or non-refundable rates require full payment at the time of booking and are non-refundable and non-changeable, with a 100% cancellation fee.

Name: Le Relais de Venise
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Paul Gineste de Saurs founded this Parisian brasserie in 1959, establishing a steak-frites archetype that has expanded internationally.
Diners bypass menus for a set meal of walnut salad and steak, served with a secret sauce known for its herbal complexity.
Staff note cooking preferences on paper tablecloths before delivering the main course in two stages to ensure the fries stay crisp.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Le Relais de Venise has a NO RESERVATION policy; however we offer a limited amount of reservations, exclusively through OPEN TABLE. If your preferred reservation time is not available, please walk in as usual.

Name: L'Autre Pied
Master_Aurora_Insights: INCOMPLETE — Missing: Current operational status (Research indicates venue is permanently closed)
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Levin Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Basil Street in Knightsbridge, this 12-room Victorian townhouse operates as a discreet, intimate sister property to the adjacent Capital Hotel.
The interiors blend 1930s Art Deco touches with a warm, residential atmosphere, offering a quiet counterpoint to the bustling department stores nearby.
A standout feature is the private entrance, which allows for low-key arrivals, complemented by full access to the concierge and services of the neighbouring Capital.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation must be made 48 hours before arrival. Late cancellations incur a charge of the first night's accommodation. A deposit of the first night's stay is required.

Name: Hostellerie de Levernois
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated near Beaune, this Relais & Châteaux estate features a Michelin-starred restaurant led by Chef Philippe Augé.
The property blends a restored bourgeois house with contemporary interiors, set within fifteen acres of parkland and vineyards.
A signature meal includes the risotto with frogs’ legs and snails followed by selections from the mature cheese trolley.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Free cancellation is available up to 7 days prior to arrival. For cancellations made less than 7 days in advance or in case of a no-show, a penalty of the entire stay including tax will be charged. Prepayment and deposit requirements vary by accommodation type and booking rate.

Name: Café Moderne [closed]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Paris's Bastille district, this cocktail bar and bistro is the work of acclaimed bartender Mido Ahmed Yahi.
The venue breaks from tradition by pairing a high-concept, rotating drinks list with a menu dedicated entirely to meatballs.
Expect complex pours like the St-Germain-infused Bicyclette, best enjoyed alongside the kitchen's celebrated selection of beef or lamb boulettes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Dahu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at 2,265 meters in Verbier, this slopeside chalet at La Chaux is a family-run staple directed by Claude-Alain Besse.
The dual-concept venue features a casual self-service area downstairs and a table-service restaurant on the upper level.
Secure a spot on the terrace to enjoy the signature coquelet à la broche against a backdrop of the Combins massif.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Standard cancellation window: Free cancellation up to 42 days before arrival.
Non-refundable rate conditions: If cancelled less than 42 days before arrival, 40% of the total booking amount (the deposit) is charged and non-refundable.
(Note: Special offers may reduce this window to 28 days).

Name: Cabane du Mont Fort
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched at 2,457 meters above Verbier, this Swiss Alpine Club refuge is defined by the distinctive silhouette imagined by architect Louis Dumas.
The hut functions as both a rugged high-altitude shelter and a spirited mountain restaurant, accessible to skiers and hikers alike.
A vast sun-drenched terrace serves as the focal point, offering sweeping sightlines of the Matterhorn, Mont Blanc, and Grand Combin.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Any cancellation or change of reservation must be made by email no later than 48 hours before your arrival. If you are already on your way, call us to modify or cancel. According to the CAS hut regulations, the warden has the right to request a 'no-show' tax from persons or groups who have not cancelled their reservation at least 48 hours before their arrival. The reference time is 18:00. The maximum amount of the no-show fee can be up to the value of all reserved services (overnight stay and half-board).

Name: Gotha Club [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the Radisson Blu Dubai Waterfront, this venue is the regional outpost of Gotha Club Cannes, founded by Patrick Tartary and designed by Prospect Design International.
The sprawling space brings a Riviera atmosphere to Business Bay with a tiered layout focused on high-production live entertainment.
A collection of gold panther heads commissioned from French sculptor Richard Orlinski hangs above the dance floor as the room's central visual anchor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Baz Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located directly on the quay in Gustavia, this sushi bar known as Bête à Z'ailes is owned by Jean-Marc and serves as a hub for the yachting crowd.
The open-air space offers a relaxed setting for enjoying Japanese and Thai dishes while watching the activity of the port.
Live bands perform regularly on the waterfront deck, where guests dine on fresh sashimi just steps from the water's edge.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nikki Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Pearl Jumeira, this destination from Nikki Beach Hospitality Group recently earned a LIV Hospitality Design Award for its refreshed interiors.
The property upholds the brand’s monochromatic white palette, pairing tribal house beats with uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and downtown skyline.
Guests can visit the Maison Mer restaurant for Provençal dishes or order the club’s signature sushi boats to the poolside daybeds.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Rates, prepayments, and cancellation policies are confirmed at booking. Non-refundable rates offer no refunds or credits. No-shows, late cancellations, or early departures incur full fees. A valid credit card is required at check-in and will be authorized for the stay plus incidentals.

Name: Treehouse Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the upper floors of a 1960s tower in Marylebone, this playful hotel from Barry Sternlicht’s SH Hotels & Resorts offers a nostalgic, nature-filled alternative to traditional luxury.
The interiors define a rustic-chic aesthetic with reclaimed wood, exposed concrete, and abundant hanging greenery that evokes the carefree spirit of a childhood hideaway.
Guests ascend to the rooftop bar, The Nest, for unobstructed 360-degree views over the West End skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Pay Later rates allow free cancellation up to 24 hours before arrival; late cancellations and no-shows incur a penalty of one night's stay plus tax. Pay Now rates are non-refundable and fully pre-paid at the time of booking. A credit card is required to guarantee the reservation, and a daily hold for incidentals is placed upon check-in.

Name: The Hoxton
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Shoreditch by Sharan Pasricha’s Ennismore, this open-house brand blurs the lines between guest accommodation and local community hub.
Lobbies function as inclusive social living rooms, pairing eclectic interiors with a relaxed atmosphere that rejects traditional hotel formalities.
Guests wake to a signature breakfast bag of banana, yogurt, and juice hung on the door, a ritual reflecting the fuss-free hospitality.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard bookings can be amended or cancelled free of charge up until 2pm (local time) one day before arrival; cancellations after this time or no-shows result in a charge for the full amount of the stay. Prepaid or non-refundable bookings cannot be changed or cancelled, and the deposit is non-reimbursable. Reservations must be guaranteed with a credit or debit card at the time of booking, with payment typically taken upon check-out for standard rates; a pre-authorisation (e.g., £50 per night) is required upon arrival for incidentals.

Name: The Water Poet [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A Spitalfields stalwart, this sprawling venue is defined by a labyrinthine layout that encompasses a traditional pub, dining room, and pool hall.
The interior unfolds through a series of connected spaces, offering a rare versatility that accommodates everything from casual drinking to larger gatherings.
Its standout feature is the expansive walled garden, a secluded urban courtyard that remains one of the few substantial outdoor drinking spaces in the neighbourhood.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No-shows or cancellations with less than 48 hours' notice are subject to a cancellation fee which is the amount your card is held for. For bookings up to 11 guests, please allow 48 hours should you wish to cancel your booking.

Name: Hoxton Grill [closed]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the ground floor of The Hoxton in Shoreditch, this all-day dining spot is operated by the Soho House group.
The design features exposed brick walls, deep red leather banquettes, and a central open kitchen that anchors the room.
A garden room with a retractable roof allows for year-round alfresco dining, serving as a bright backdrop for the signature Hoxton cheeseburger.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Capiz by Rapsa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Hoxton Street in Shoreditch, this laid-back neighborhood spot is led by founder Andrew Zilouf and ex-NOPI chef Francis Puyat.
The kitchen delivers a playful menu of Filipino-fusion small plates that blends Southeast Asian punch with European technique.
A standout experience is the Boodle Fight, a traditional communal feast piled high on banana leaves and designed to be eaten entirely by hand.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Sloane Square Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a historic building on its namesake square, this independent hotel places guests at the heart of Chelsea, moments from the King’s Road.
Interiors balance traditional English comfort with understated modernity, creating a quiet retreat where personal service takes precedence over high-octane glamour.
Secure a square-facing room for classic bay-window views, then visit The Knox, the hotel’s speakeasy-style basement bar known for its retro disco energy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Flexible Rate (Direct Booking): Cancellations allowed up to 24 hours before arrival with no fee. Late cancellations incur a one-night fee.
Non-Refundable / Non-Flexible Rate: No refund provided. Cancellation or modification incurs a charge equal to the full prepaid amount.
Semi-Flexible Rates: Typically cancel up to 7 days before arrival.
Advance Purchase Policy: Full prepayment required; guests must present the same credit card used for reservation upon check-in.

Name: Pharmacy [Closed]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within the coastal town of Knokke-Heist, this speakeasy is the domain of the Van Ongevalle family, a dynasty of celebrated mixologists.
The interior channels a vintage apothecary with dark timber, taxidermy, and shelves lined with curiosities, creating a moody, time-capsule atmosphere.
Its reputation was cemented when family member Ran Van Ongevalle secured the global title at the Bacardi Legacy competition.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Capital Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Knightsbridge just steps from Harrods, The Capital is a discreet townhouse hotel anchored by the seafood restaurant of acclaimed chef Tom Brown.
Operating as a "grand hotel in miniature," the property features intimate, classically styled interiors that evoke the atmosphere of a private English residence.
The wood-panelled bar serves as a sanctuary, renowned for its exceptional collection of rare whiskies and expert cheese pairings.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation must be received 24 hours prior to arrival. Reservations must be guaranteed with a credit card.

Name: Roux at The Landau [CLOSED]
Master_Aurora_Insights: INCOMPLETE — Missing: Current operational status (Permanently Closed)
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Wildwood Snowmass
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Snowmass Village, this renovated 1967 lodge offers a retro-chic alternative to traditional mountain resorts, defined by its vintage ski-chalet architecture.
The colorful interiors prioritize utility with clever storage elements like trundle drawers and open cubbies, maximizing space in the cozy guest rooms.
Social activity anchors at the Bar at Wildwood, a lively beer hall and restaurant developed in collaboration with New Belgium Brewing.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made 15 or more days prior to arrival are fully refundable. Cancellations made within 14 days of arrival forfeit 100% of the deposit. A deposit of 50% of the total cost is required at the time of booking. An incidental deposit of $50 per night is required at check-in. Policies may vary seasonally.

Name: The Polo Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ralph Lauren’s first New York restaurant occupies a clubby Midtown space designed by long-time collaborator Alfredo Paredes on the site of the historic La Côte Basque.
The interior defines American heritage style with saddle-leather banquettes, dark wood paneling, and a collection of equestrian artwork.
A Henry Koehler-inspired mural adorns the exterior, while the menu features the designer’s signature burger made with beef from his Colorado ranch.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The Polo Bar requires reservations to be made by telephone one month in advance. A cancellation fee of $100 per person applies to cancellations made less than 24 hours prior to the reservation time.

Name: Wulf & Lamb [closed]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Afroditi Krassa, this London all-day dining destination operates stylish canteens in Chelsea and Marylebone that bring an indulgent approach to plant-based eating.
The kitchen eschews health-food tropes in favor of global comfort dishes, delivering satisfying textures and rich flavours that cater to omnivores as much as vegans.
Regulars flock here for the signature Mac’n’Cheese, a creamy classic best enjoyed in the venue’s light-filled, botanical-accented dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window. A late cancellation includes canceling within the window or arriving for your reservation and choosing to leave after being seated. Although designed for walk-ins, the restaurant happily accepts bookings for larger parties.

Name: Midnight by Navarro's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This hospitality destination in New York's Manhattan West is the brainchild of Christian Navarro, the renowned "wine therapist to the stars" and former president of Wally's.
The venue blends a market-driven restaurant with a Parisian-style wine bar, offering rare spirits and artisanal cuisine amidst an atmosphere of old-world Hollywood glamour.
A standout feature is the extensive list of over 75 wines by the glass, allowing diners to sample exceptional vintages alongside elevated American classics.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows.

Name: Mabel's BBQ
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In San Diego’s North Park, this Michelin Bib Gourmand seafood tavern is the latest project from Chelsea Coleman and Rae Gurne.
The kitchen focuses on local catch and natural wines, serving dishes like paella onigiri in a bright space accented with custom ceramics.
Order the signature Spanish-style Gin & Tonic, served in a frosty goblet with Nordés gin, lemon, grape, and sage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Walk-in only.

Name: Fortune Theatre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Ernest Schaufelberg, this Covent Garden venue was the first new theatre built in the West End after the First World War.
The interior is defined by its compact scale, creating an atmosphere where the audience feels physically close to the stage.
Its exterior features a distinctive bush-hammered concrete façade, a pioneering material choice that sharply contrasted with the era's plaster traditions.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets are non-refundable. Refunds are permitted only if Ticket Refund Protection was purchased and the reason is covered (e.g., illness, severe weather). If a performance is cancelled or rescheduled, tickets may be exchanged without a fee or a full credit voucher issued. Exchanges for the same show at the same venue (equal or higher value) are available up to 48 hours before the event for a £4.95 per ticket fee. Single-night productions are not eligible for exchange.

Name: Josephine [duplicate]
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Josephine Marylebone is a French bistro in London opened by Michelin-starred chef Claude Bosi and his wife Lucy.
The restaurant focuses on regional Lyonnais dishes within a space designed by Fabled Studio to reflect classic bistro aesthetics.
The menu features a dedicated Pommes de Terre section celebrating the potato, served in a dining room with burgundy leather seats and hand-painted ceilings.

Name: Nobu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Nobu Barcelona is a hotel and restaurant by founders Nobu Matsuhisa, Robert De Niro, and Meir Teper, featuring interiors by architect David Rockwell.
The property integrates Japanese design principles with its urban setting, offering panoramic views of the Sagrada Familia from the 23rd-floor dining room.
The restaurant ceiling draws inspiration from the Japanese art of kintsugi, complementing signature menu items like the black cod miso.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Sketch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by restaurateur Mourad Mazouz and three-Michelin-starred chef Pierre Gagnaire, Sketch is a multi-room dining complex set within an 18th-century townhouse in London's Mayfair.
The venue encompasses several distinct spaces, including a brasserie, a woodland-themed lounge, and a fine dining room, each featuring contemporary art installations.
Beyond the culinary program, the destination is known for its futuristic, egg-shaped pod toilets located beneath a multicolored glass ceiling.

Name: Al Majlis
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Dubai Airports, Al Majlis is a standalone VIP terminal and lounge facility at Dubai International Airport.
The space functions as an alternative to the main concourses, streamlining departures and arrivals with dedicated passport control, security, and customs clearance.
Passengers bypass the public gates entirely, receiving private chauffeur transfers directly between the lounge and their aircraft.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 100% cancellation charges will apply in case of cancellation or no shows.

Name: Faena
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Developed by Argentine hotelier Alan Faena and partner Len Blavatnik, Faena Hotel Miami Beach is a Forbes Five-Star property located within its namesake district.
The destination integrates art and hospitality through interiors designed by filmmaker Baz Luhrmann and costume designer Catherine Martin.
The outdoor Mammoth Garden showcases "Gone But Not Forgotten," a gilded woolly mammoth skeleton created by British artist Damien Hirst.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation policies and deposit requirements vary by Faena Hotel location, with seasonal and rate-specific exceptions applying across all properties. For Miami Beach, a deposit of one room night plus tax is required at booking, and cancellations must be made 7 days prior to arrival or the deposit is forfeited. Early departures in Miami Beach incur a fee of one room night plus tax (if one night prior) or 50% of the remaining balance plus tax (if two or more nights prior). For New York, an authorization of one night’s room and tax is required at confirmation, with a refundable deposit of one night’s room and tax applied to suite bookings and stays of 5 or more nights. New York cancellations must be made 3 days prior to arrival to avoid a 1-night penalty, and early departures incur a fee of one room night plus tax. For Buenos Aires, a valid credit card is required to guarantee the reservation, and cancellations must be made up to 72 hours prior to arrival or the deposit is forfeited. Late cancellations or no-shows in Buenos Aires incur a penalty of one night at the full rate.

Name: Voyage with Adam Simmonds
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within London's Megaro Hotel in King's Cross, Voyage was a tasting-menu restaurant led by Michelin-starred chef Adam Simmonds.
The space featured a Pullman-style private dining room and an open kitchen serving dishes like lobster in kelp broth seasoned with sea urchin.
Meals concluded with a ritual where guests selected a custom tea infusion from a wooden coffret, accompanied by a take-home menu sealed with hot wax.

Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Non-Refundable Rates:
The reservation cannot be canceled and/or changed. In case of no-show, the total value of the accommodation is charged. There is no refund of the already paid amount.
Flexible Rates:
When the payment method for your reservation is direct payment at the hotel, it must be guaranteed through the credit card. In this case, there will be a pre-charge of the first night, 6 days before check-in, on the credit card provided for guarantee, and the remaining nights will be paid directly at the hotel. For reservations with flexible rates where the payment method is with a credit card, the nightly rates will be debited at the time of booking. For reservations with a Non-Refundable policy, 100% of the advanced value is debited, and in these cases, it is non-refundable.
Furthermore, at check-in, a security deposit or debit authorization on the credit card will be required to guarantee payment for the accommodation values or any services consumed on-site. This procedure will be required of the guest even if the payment has been made by a third party.
Right of Withdrawal:
The Right of Withdrawal refers to Article 49 of Law 8.078/90 of the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code (CDC). This law allows the consumer to withdraw from a contract within 7 days and receive a full refund of any payments made. This applies to payments made for both products and services – including accommodation reservations.

Everything is provisioned and staffed. Front-of-house, porters, and chefs handle setup, cooking, and service. Hired equipment is selected to match the chosen theme and style. Beverages include alcoholic and soft options, with ice. Children’s menus are created on request.

Name: Bond and Beyond
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Bond and Beyond is an immersion inspired by Ian Fleming’s novels and the Bond films. The day moves between culinary ritual and tradecraft: a bespoke private lunch at Scott’s of Mayfair and hands-on sessions in espionage led by an ex-Detective Inspector.

At Scott’s, five courses are paired with Bond’s favored drinks, with Beluga caviar and Dom Pérignon among the selections. Each course is introduced by a Bond and culinary expert with encyclopedic knowledge, linking dishes to their appearances in the books and on screen.

The espionage segment covers spy techniques and the British services, MI5 and MI6, with practical instruction in lock-picking and fingerprint taking. You hear expert insights throughout, grounding the meal and activities in Bond’s world and its real-world references.

Name: Mastery: Move like Jack Grealish
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Step onto the pitch with Manchester City and Everton superstar Jack Grealish, fresh off winning the historic Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League treble in 2023.

Known for his low socks, dribbling swagger, and charisma, Grealish thrives on flair and unpredictability.

Work on close-control dribbling drills, discover how he manipulates defenders, and hear first-hand what it’s like to play under Pep Guardiola in Europe’s most dominant side.

Expect banter, charm, and a rare inside view of life at City’s summit.

Alternatively, invite Jack to your next close-circle meet up or company event.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Maroon Bells
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Protected within the White River National Forest southwest of Aspen, this wilderness area encompasses the Maroon Bells, a pair of peaks exceeding 14,000 feet.
Distinguished by iron-rich sedimentary mudstone rather than granite, the mountains possess a maroon hue and a brittle geology known as "rotten rock."
The area’s defining visual element is the glacial valley floor, where the twin summits cast a symmetrical reflection onto Maroon Lake.

Name: Elk Camp Gondola
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This eight-passenger gondola serves as the primary artery connecting Snowmass Base Village to the resort’s upper alpine terrain.
The enclosed cabins rise nearly 1,600 vertical feet, offering panoramic views of the Roaring Fork Valley before reaching a year-round activity hub.
A distinct mid-mountain angle station defines the route, which concludes at the CCY Architects-designed Elk Camp Restaurant with its signature curved roof.

Name: Anderson Ranch Arts Center
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1966 by ceramicist Paul Soldner, this Snowmass Village campus operates as a year-round center for visual arts education and artist residencies.
The site repurposes historic log structures into naturally lit studios, hosting immersive workshops that range from photography and woodworking to painting and new media.
A defining ritual is the daily buffet lunch at the Ranch Café, where students and visiting critics convene over communal meals amidst the aspen trees.

Name: Silver Queen Gondola
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Constructed by Poma and operated by the Aspen Skiing Company, this single-stage lift rises from the heart of downtown directly to the summit of Aspen Mountain.
The 2.5-mile journey defines the resort’s town-to-summit character, whisking passengers over 3,200 vertical feet in roughly 14 minutes.
At the 11,212-foot peak, the ride concludes at the Sundeck, a lodge operated by The Little Nell that offers sweeping views of the Elk Mountains.

Name: Higher Terrain
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by founder Jen Metcalf, this lower-level studio on East Hyman Avenue brings a focused fitness philosophy to downtown Aspen.
It distinguishes itself as the town’s only dedicated Lagree Method provider, delivering high-intensity, low-impact conditioning that prioritizes alignment.
Classes center on the Megaformer, a spring-loaded machine designed to maintain constant muscle tension for deep, controlled sculpting.

Name: Aspen Historical Society
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overseeing one of the largest public archives in the region, this organization manages key heritage sites including the Victorian-era Wheeler/Stallard Museum.
The society stewards Aspen’s evolution from silver boomtown to ski resort through a vast collection of images, ledgers, and oral histories.
Its Holden/Marolt Mining & Ranching Museum offers a tangible link to the past with a preserved salt shed and restored industrial machinery.

Name: Sushi Nakazawa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Daisuke Nakazawa, a protégé of Jiro Ono featured in *Jiro Dreams of Sushi*, this Michelin-starred restaurant is dedicated to omakase.
The kitchen adheres to Edo-mae traditions, prioritizing the balance of vinegared rice and aged fish over modern flourishes.
Service culminates with the signature tamago, a sweet, custard-like egg block that famously took years of apprenticeship to perfect.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or modifications made within 48 hours of the reservation time are subject to a fee of $150 per person. This fee also applies to no-shows. Reservations are typically prepaid or require a credit card hold to secure.

Name: The Surf Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Surfside, this restored 1930s landmark pairs a Mediterranean Revival clubhouse with glass towers by Pritzker Prize-winning architect Richard Meier.
Joseph Dirand’s interiors balance the original structure’s Mediterranean soul with a disciplined, modern aesthetic.
A standout feature is the emerald-hued Champagne Bar, occupying the former ballroom where Winston Churchill and Frank Sinatra once held court.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The Surf Club does not allow cancellations for booked stays. All bookings are final.

Name: Tonteria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the basement of London’s Sloane Square Hotel, this Mexican-themed venue is operated by nightlife figures Guy Pelly and Marc Burton.
The interior references the Mayan ruins of Tulum, creating a dimly lit, cavernous setting for a menu focused on tapas and agave spirits.
A miniature train tracks along the ceiling to deliver tequila shots to booths, a ritual often accompanied by masked Lucha Libre performers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Windmill Soho
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This historic Soho venue—formerly the Windmill Theatre—is now an immersive dining and cabaret club with a menu by Michelin-starred chef Andrew McLeish.
The intimate space pairs a seasonal menu with a dinner-and-show format, where acrobats and burlesque performers move directly through the audience.
A neon "We Never Closed" sign preserves the motto from its days as the only London theatre to remain open throughout the Blitz.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We regret that tickets cannot be exchanged or refunded after purchase. Tickets are sold subject to the venue or promoter's right to alter or vary the programme due to events or circumstances beyond its control without being obliged to refund monies or exchange tickets. If the event is cancelled, please contact us for information on receiving a refund from the responsible party. If the event was moved or rescheduled, the venue or promoter may set refund limitations.

Name: Rebase
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by Atelier Wren founders Jake Raslan and Lorenzo Buscaroli, Rebase is a social wellness destination tucked away in London’s Marylebone.
The outpost shifts the focus from solitary recuperation to communal recovery, offering a design-led space where elemental therapies restore balance.
Standout facilities include a four-person hyperbaric oxygen chamber and a Powercab cryotherapy unit capable of reaching a bracing -110°C.

Name: Taku
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mayfair, this Michelin-starred omakase restaurant is the London debut of Chef Takuya Watanabe, formerly of Jin in Paris.
The kitchen specializes in Edomae sushi, applying traditional curing and aging techniques to ingredients sourced from European waters.
Dining takes place at a minimalist blonde-wood counter and features the chef’s signature tuna and caviar temaki.

Name: Hotel Duo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Dubai Hills outpost from St. Petersburg’s Duo Band is helmed by chefs Dmitry Blinov and Renat Malikov.
Bishop Design’s interiors feature fluid lines and layered arches, creating a calm setting for modern European cuisine accented with Asian notes.
The signature oxtail pie with Taleggio exemplifies the kitchen’s ability to deliver gusty, comfort-driven flavors with sharp technical precision.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Funky Buddha Brewery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Berkeley Street in London’s Mayfair, this nightclub and cocktail lounge maintains a reputation for attracting a high-profile clientele.
The interior juxtaposes modern, electro-cool design with Eastern motifs, utilizing mirrored surfaces and neon accents to create a surreal, immersive environment.
Distinctive features include giant Buddha statues and illuminated waterfalls that frame the dance floor, offering a dramatic setting for late-night rituals.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tours are by reservation only and must be requested at least five days prior to the desired event date with a non-refundable deposit to be paid in full at time of reservation.

Name: Luxx Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Mayfair’s Berkeley Street, this subterranean venue from the team behind Funky Buddha operates as both a high-energy nightclub and an intimate lounge.
The interior is defined by a maximalist, tech-forward aesthetic, where dark, polished surfaces reflect a grid of dynamic lighting and plush VIP banquettes.
A standout feature is the reactive LED wall displaying retro arcade imagery, complemented by private rooms equipped with KTV systems for a more secluded experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made 48 hours or more in advance of the reservation date will receive a 100% deposit refund. No show reservations are required to settle the full amount of the minimum spend.

Name: Phantom Creek Estates
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed inside the Palais Garnier, this dining venue by architect Odile Decq inserts a contemporary biomorphic form into the historic Beaux-Arts structure.
The interior is defined by its bold contrast, featuring undulating red and white surfaces that float without touching the original stone walls.
A suspended mezzanine provides a dramatic vantage point, enclosed by a curved glass facade that acts as an invisible veil to the city.

Name: Daniel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Vienna’s Landstraße district, this design-forward hotel and social hub is the brainchild of Austrian hotelier Florian Weitzer.
The "Smart Luxury" concept strips away stiff etiquette in favor of industrial-chic interiors, urban gardening, and a vibrant lobby culture.
A surreal, life-sized sailboat by artist Erwin Wurm hangs precariously over the roof’s edge, signaling the venue’s playful approach to hospitality.

Name: Little Beach House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former Nikita restaurant site on Carbon Beach, this Soho House outpost was designed by Montalba Architects as a quiet, residential-style retreat.
The light-filled structure prioritizes connection to the coast with a minimalist palette of teak wood, indoor-outdoor fireplaces, and floor-to-ceiling windows.
An extensive art collection curated by Francesca Gavin anchors the interiors, featuring over 100 works that complement the sweeping ocean views.

Name: Wakuriya
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in a San Mateo shopping center, this Michelin-starred kaiseki restaurant is the work of chef Katsuhiro Yamasaki.
The kitchen presents a monthly changing multicourse menu that highlights seasonal ingredients through precise Japanese techniques.
Meals frequently feature a signature appetizer of poached lobster with dashi gelée, a soft-boiled Jidori egg, and fried kombu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: No Homme
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Nestled within Dubai’s Waldorf Astoria DIFC, No Homme is a private members’ club led by hospitality veterans Piero Giglio, Massimo Shayegan, and Carmelo Cannata.
The sanctuary reimagines the traditional club model, seamlessly integrating bespoke business lounges with avant-garde dining and comprehensive wellness facilities.
Distinguished by its holistic approach, the venue hosts curated rituals including cigar and wine nights, jazz evenings, and private spa treatments tailored to the modern elite.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Gate Two
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Meydan Grandstand, this after-hours venue is a discrete concept from Addmind Hospitality, the operators of the adjacent Iris lounge.
The interior features a raw, underground aesthetic that contrasts with the city's polished norms, designed specifically for immersive, late-night sessions.
A strict no-phone policy enforces privacy, creating a rare environment where the crowd connects solely through the deep electronic music.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No refunds or credits will be made for any changes, cancellation, or non-arrival for any reason within the period of time specified by the Company at the time of booking. Charges cannot be applied to other stays, services or merchandise. Your credit card will be charged immediately for the total amount indicated in the Payment Link, which includes applicable sales, occupancy or other taxes. No prices or places availability are guaranteed until full payment is received.

Name: Ecco
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Giardino Mountain hotel in Champfèr, this two-Michelin-starred destination is led by Executive Chef Reto Brändli.
The kitchen executes the group’s "aroma cuisine" philosophy, prioritizing intense natural flavor profiles and textural precision over theatrical presentation.
Open exclusively during the winter season, the dining room serves as a seasonal stage for the chef's celebrated tasting menus.

Name: Bar Antoine at the Four Seasons
Yarrow, an Auberge Spa at Hotel Jerome
La Table
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris’s 12th arrondissement, this acclaimed destination is the culinary stage of former food critic turned chef Bruno Verjus.
A long, sculpted counter defines the space, allowing diners to watch the open kitchen and the precise assembly of ingredients sourced directly from small producers.
The menu’s signature finish is a warm chocolate tart topped with caviar, pairing rich ganache with the briny pop of sturgeon roe.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Cabane
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at the Los Monteros resort in Marbella, this established beach club is operated by Chef Dani García with design by Dolce & Gabbana.
The venue is defined by the fashion house’s signature Blu Mediterraneo majolica print, which covers the pool deck, parasols, and open-air dining terrace.
A standout feature is the Dolci Room, a dedicated dessert space entirely enveloped in the brand’s distinctive blue-and-white ceramic pattern.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tables in the restaurant are reserved for a 2-hour experience and will be held 15 minutes from the time of booking before being released. In the event of a no-show, a cancellation policy of €50 per person will be charged to the credit card details provided to secure the booking. In the event of cancellation, written notice must be given at least 24 hours prior to booking, a credit voucher will be provided for use at the same location for the same value for the duration of the season.

Name: RAKxa Wellness Spa at The St. Regis
Il Poggio
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Run by the same family since 1987, this organic estate in the UNESCO-protected Val d'Orcia offers a deeply authentic Tuscan retreat.
The property combines rustic Sienese architecture with a working farm, featuring a dedicated equestrian center and a restaurant serving produce directly from the land.
Guests can explore the rolling hills on horseback before enjoying a meal of estate-raised Cinta Senese overlooking the historic Rocca di Radicofani.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A non-refundable deposit of 25% of the total rent is required at booking. The balance is due 65 days before arrival. Cancellations made up to 66 days before arrival forfeit the 25% deposit. Cancellations made from 65 days to the arrival date or in case of no show are charged 100% of the total rental price.

Name: EPIK
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated at the Meydan Grandstand, this large-scale nightlife venue is operated by Sunset Hospitality Group.
The 25,000-square-foot club distinguishes itself with a focus on Khaleeji music and atmosphere alongside international house beats.
A state-of-the-art kinetic ceiling dominates the interior, shifting shapes to alter the light and mood above the dance floor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Orders can be cancelled within 2 days of purchase. Just email us at hello@wearehsu.com to request cancellation. Once approved, we'll issue store credit within 2-4 weeks. Tickets are generally non-refundable outside of this window.

Name: Lynn Britt Cabin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized as an Aspen Sojourner Editor's Pick, this circa-1900 cabin sits mid-mountain on Snowmass near the Village Express lift.
The intimate 60-seat venue channels a Western spirit with a menu focused on regional ingredients like wild game, trout, and local produce.
Dinner service often involves a snowcat arrival, transforming the meal into a secluded alpine ritual with views of the surrounding peaks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard reservations are subject to a 24-hour cancellation policy. Advance reservations, Foot Pass Lunches, and Snow Cat Dinners are prepaid and non-refundable.

Name: The Surf Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Surfside, this restored 1930s institution was redeveloped by Nadim Ashi and Four Seasons, pairing the original clubhouse with glass towers by architect Richard Meier.
The atmosphere blends Old Florida heritage with contemporary minimalism, anchored by Joseph Dirand interiors that frame the Atlantic views.
Its culinary highlight is The Surf Club Restaurant by Thomas Keller, serving classic Lobster Thermidor in a dining room evoking the property’s golden-age past.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Yam'Tcha
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Adeline Grattard in the Les Halles district, this venue presents a distinct fusion of French gastronomy and Cantonese culinary traditions.
The kitchen pairs premium local ingredients with wok techniques and bamboo steamers to create unexpected flavor profiles.
A defining detail is the signature bao bun filled with melted Stilton cheese and Amarena cherries, served alongside rare teas sourced by Chi Wah Chan.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Sidonie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the white chalet of Hotel Le Chabichou in Courchevel 1850, this venue provides a refined setting for après-ski relaxation.
The space, known as Le Sidonie, blends contemporary touches with traditional wood paneling to create a cosy ambiance anchored by a fireplace.
Guests can enjoy a cocktail menu curated by World Champion Victor Delpierre, accompanied by gourmet tapas from two-star chef Stéphane Buron.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: SIRO Recovery Lab
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Kerzner International, this recovery-focused destination occupies a dedicated floor within Dubai's One Za'abeel development.
The programming centers on biohacking and physical restoration, bridging the gap between medical wellness and traditional spa therapies.
Guests access high-tech tools like cryotherapy chambers and percussion therapy alongside a quiet relaxation zone framed by Himalayan salt walls.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Iris
Master_Aurora_Insights: Positioned at the Meydan Racecourse, this vibrant lounge and restaurant by the Addmind Group offers a sophisticated escape with panoramic views of the Dubai skyline. The venue is defined by its chic industrial aesthetic and free-spirited energy, featuring a state-of-the-art retractable roof that enables year-round open-air dining. A signature highlight is the celebrated sunset ritual, where live electronic music builds the atmosphere alongside artful sushi and ceviche plates.

Name: Soho House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the penthouse of the Luckman Plaza on Sunset Boulevard, this West Coast outpost features interiors originally designed by Waldo Fernandez.
The space balances privacy with a social atmosphere, anchored by a wraparound terrace and a recently refreshed English-inspired garden.
Members gather here for Nancy Silverton’s seasonal menu while taking in panoramic 360-degree views that stretch from the Hollywood Hills to Downtown.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel your booking up to 18:00 local time two days before your arrival date, with the exception of Babington House and Soho Beach House Miami (7 days before arrival) and Soho Farmhouse (14 days before arrival). Cancellations received after the deadline or no-shows are subject to a fee equivalent to the total cost of the stay. Prepaid reservations require a deposit of the full stay rate and incur the entire stay charge if cancelled late.

Name: Ben Fiddich
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hiroyasu Kayama runs this intimate Shinjuku bar, consistently ranked on the World’s 50 Best Bars list for its apothecary-style approach.
He uses wild herbs and spices from his family farm to infuse vintage spirits without a set menu.
A standout ritual involves Kayama grinding fresh botanicals in a mortar to craft his signature homemade absinthe or the Forest Cocktail.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations will be canceled if 15 minutes have passed since the reservation time.

Name: Layalina
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Knightsbridge’s Beauchamp Place, this modern Lebanese venue presents a refined interpretation of Middle Eastern cuisine within a discreet, contemporary setting.
The space functions as a dual-concept destination, pairing a ground-floor dining room with Privée, a subterranean lounge hosting late-night cabaret.
Beyond signature mezze plates, the experience is anchored by live entertainment, including belly dancing that reflects the name’s Arabic translation, "Our Nights."
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Laughing Heart
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in the Blue Ridge Mountains, Laughing Heart Lodge occupies a 19th-century estate that served for decades as a Jesuit retreat.
The atmosphere is one of communal respite, blending private rooms and hostel bunks for Appalachian Trail hikers and solitude-seekers.
While the property offers direct trail access, the former chapel—now a quiet meditation space—remains its most spiritual anchor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Patara
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Turkey’s Turquoise Coast, this former capital of the Lycian League is the historical birthplace of St. Nicholas.
The protected archaeological zone features a restored parliament building and Roman ruins leading to eighteen kilometers of dune-backed sands.
Walk the colonnaded main street to the ancient harbor before observing the seasonal nesting of loggerhead turtles on the country’s longest beach.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We would like to point out, in the case of a “no show” 15 minutes after your reservation; we reserve the right to assign your table otherwise.

Name: Le Colombier
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in the heart of Colmar’s Little Venice, this design-led retreat occupies a 16th-century Renaissance building transformed by owners Dominique and Alban Gérardin.
The interiors juxtapose original Alsatian timber beams and historic stonework with sleek Italian furniture and bold contemporary art.
A signature giant red stiletto by neo-pop artist Richard Orlinski stands in the courtyard, offering a striking contrast to the ancient architecture.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Roebuck
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In the Cheshire village of Mobberley, restaurateurs Tim Bird and Mary McLaughlin have reimagined this 1708 inn as a "petit hotel" and bistro.
The atmosphere channels a continental sensibility, trading traditional pub tropes for tiered terraces, natural wines, and a menu of refined small plates.
Look for the Potting Shed, a secluded garden hideaway, to enjoy post-dinner cocktails or the kitchen’s signature French onion soup.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Flexible rates allow free cancellation until 12:00 PM on the day of arrival; cancellations after this time are charged the full cost of the stay. Non-refundable rates require full prepayment at booking and cannot be cancelled or amended. A credit or debit card is required to guarantee the booking.

Name: The Edwards Suites
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In Newcastle West, this former family-run laundry has been transformed by Silverchair bassist Chris Joannou into a spirited cultural anchor.
The industrial aesthetic defines its character, pairing stripped-back concrete interiors with a wood-fired menu and an unpretentious atmosphere.
Honoring its origins, the bar features beer taps fashioned from an old laundry press and pendant lights crafted from salvaged tumble-dryer drums.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations 90 days in advance from event start time will receive a 50% refund. Cancellations for events starting within 90 days are non-refundable.

Name: The Portland Hospital
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London’s Fitzrovia, this Michelin-starred Modern European dining room is the brainchild of restaurateurs Will Lander and Daniel Morgenthau.
The pared-back, tablecloth-free interiors set a relaxed stage for a menu that champions robust, seasonal flavours without the usual fine-dining pomp.
Menus are printed daily to reflect the freshest ingredients, often accompanied by a wine list that features rare finds by the glass.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 48 hour minimum notice period for cancellations or rescheduling. Notice less than 48 hours will incur 50% charge of the appointment fee; less than 24 hours will incur 100% charge of the fee. DNAs (did not attend) incur a full fee charged.

Name: The Providores
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by the co-founders of Jones the Grocer, this Singaporean culinary destination combines a café, deli, and bakery within a polished industrial setting.
The concept focuses on accessible luxury and artisanal quality, offering a vast selection of globally sourced ingredients alongside an all-day dining menu.
A standout feature is the temperature-controlled walk-in cheese room, where visitors can discover and taste rare European varieties before making a purchase.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Five Fields
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in London’s Chelsea district, this Michelin-starred modern British restaurant was led by chef patron Taylor Bonnyman and head chef Marguerite Keogh.
The culinary philosophy centered on seasonal ingredients harvested daily from the venue’s dedicated kitchen garden in the Sussex countryside.
Diners experienced this farm-to-table approach through intricate vegetable-led dishes that showcased rare herbs, flowers, and heritage produce.

Name: The Ebury
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Ebury Edge community space in Pimlico, this socially conscious restaurant is the first permanent residence for catering enterprise Fat Macy’s.
The pared-back dining room serves a Middle Eastern-inspired menu while functioning as a training ground that helps young Londoners move from temporary accommodation into their own homes.
Guests enjoy seasonal sharing plates knowing that profits directly fund rental deposits for the staff.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nando's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Johannesburg by Fernando Duarte and Robert Brozin, this global fast-casual group specializes in Portuguese-style flame-grilled chicken.
The menu centers on cuts marinated in African Bird's Eye chilli, served in spaces that reflect the brand's Southern African roots.
Each location features original works from the company's private collection of contemporary Southern African art, the largest body of such work on public display globally.

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Nestled in the dramatic limestone landscape of Ninh Binh, Vietnam, this boutique retreat offers a serene escape amidst lush gardens and rice paddies.
The property comprises a series of intimate bungalows designed with traditional materials, prioritizing privacy and a seamless connection to the natural surroundings.
A defining highlight is the outdoor swimming pool, which provides uninterrupted views of the towering karst formations and the local mountain goats that graze on the cliffs.

Name: Sushi des Artistes
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Marbella, this Japanese restaurant by Jay Joden merges traditional sushi craftsmanship with French culinary touches.
The kitchen prioritizes visual composition and premium sourcing, treating each plate with an artistic sensibility that reflects the venue's name.
A defining element is the specialized Wagyu Hideyoshi menu, featuring certified Kobe beef and rare cuts imported directly from Japan.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Portobello Market
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by the Michelin Guide as a London landmark, this Notting Hill institution is the world’s largest antiques market.
The street shifts character along its route, transitioning from fine collectibles at the southern end to fresh produce and vintage fashion further north.
Pastel-painted Victorian terraces frame the weekly Saturday trading ritual, providing the market’s signature visual backdrop.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored by the Technopolis cultural complex in Athens, this former industrial district has evolved into the city’s most dynamic creative quarter.
The aesthetic is defined by a compelling tension between grit and polish, where industrial skeletons house modern lofts and street art covers factory walls.
Its skyline is distinguished by the illuminated red gasworks chimneys, a nocturnal beacon for the area’s thriving bar and gallery scene.

Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored on the Eastern Esplanade in Southend-on-Sea, this steak and lobster specialist is the brainchild of entrepreneur James Welling and chef Mark Baumann.
The venue pairs a polished, contemporary interior with a straightforward culinary focus, offering an approachable take on surf and turf classics.
Guests order signature grilled lobster and fillet steak pairings to enjoy alongside sweeping estuary views from the glass-walled dining room.

Name: Otto Enoteca e Pizzeria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Noma alumnus Vadim Otto Ursus, this intimate Berlin dining spot has established itself as a beacon of the city’s new culinary wave.
The brutalist, concrete-clad space sets the stage for a hyper-seasonal menu driven by the chef’s own permaculture plot and fermentation lab in the Schorfheide.
Order the signature sourdough with house-made koji butter to experience the depth of flavour that defines this uncompromisingly local project.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Chick 'n' Sours
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Carl Clarke and David Wolanski, this fried chicken concept now operates as a residency at Big Chill in King's Cross.
The kitchen elevates free-range poultry with Asian-inspired flavours, pairing fried cuts with punchy sour cocktails.
Standout options include the K-Pop sandwich or Kung Pao Disco Wings, best enjoyed alongside a house sour in the lively space.

Master_Aurora_Insights: Golborne Cafe & Restaurant is a family-run, Turkish-British café at 78 Golborne Road, London W10 5PS, operating daily in the Notting Hill/Kensal Town neighborhood. The café opens 7 days a week with indoor-only seating, no outdoor tables, vegetarian and vegan menu options, and affordable pricing throughout. The menu features a Turkish-British fusion, including standout dishes such as Turkish kofte, spaghetti Bolognese, English breakfast, and vegetarian plates.

Perched on the edge of Tuscany’s Orbetello Lagoon, this tasting centre is operated by a historic cooperative of local fishermen.
The kitchen serves a strictly seasonal menu of lagoon-caught fish, emphasizing sustainability and traditional preservation methods over culinary trends.
A standout is the signature smoked eel and cured mullet roe, best enjoyed at the outdoor tables as the sun sets over the water.

Name: The Golden Hind
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Permanently moored in London’s Bankside, this full-scale reconstruction of Sir Francis Drake’s flagship was meticulously built by J. Hinks & Son in Devon.
The oak-hulled vessel serves as a living museum, capturing the atmosphere of Elizabethan seafaring across five decks of authentic rigging and cramped quarters.
Unlike many static displays, this replica is fully seaworthy and has famously circumnavigated the globe, covering more than 140,000 miles under its own sail.

The property is defined by rolling drumlins and tree-lined carriage paths that balance pastoral beauty with rocky shorelines.
Its signature element is the rhythmic network of walking trails offering framed views of the Boston skyline across the harbor.

Name: Crosby Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within SoHo's Crosby Street Hotel, this all-day brasserie and lounge features colorful, pattern-rich interiors by Firmdale Hotels founder and designer Kit Kemp.
The open-plan space serves a relaxed menu from morning until late night, extending outward onto a shaded, ivy-laden terrace.
A long pewter bar anchors the main dining room, illuminated overhead by a curated selection of original 1950s pendant lights.

Name: Nardo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Nardò is a historic municipality in the Salento region of Puglia, Italy, noted for its Baroque architecture and proximity to the Ionian Sea.
The town serves as a quieter alternative to neighboring Lecce, offering a laid-back atmosphere centered around its ornate palazzos.
Its focal point is Piazza Salandra, a central square anchored by the 16th-century San Domenico church and the intricate Fontana del Toro.

Name: La Sirene
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Avani+ Palm View Dubai Hotel & Suites, La Sirene is a Lebanese restaurant recognized with a Michelin Bib Gourmand.
The eatery pairs Levantine cuisine with direct views of the Dubai skyline and Palm Jumeirah from its outdoor terrace.
Diners can experience traditional coastal cooking through signature menu items like Lebanese seabass sayadiyah, fried bizri, and double-cooked octopus leg.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We have a 20-minute grace period before offering your table to our wait list. You will be charged a cancellation fee if you do not show up for your reservation.

Name: Killer
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Killer is a rural village situated within the municipality of Burladingen in the Zollernalbkreis district of Baden-Württemberg, Germany.
Positioned in the Starzel river valley, locally known as the Killertal, the settlement is defined by the surrounding forested landscapes of the Swabian Jura.
The community is home to the Deutsches Peitschenmuseum, a facility housed in a former railway station that preserves the regional history of whip-making.

Name: Aldourie Castle
Master_Source_text: Aldourie Castle on the shores of Loch Ness has been restored by Ptolemy Dean Architects for WildLand and received RIAS and RIBA National Awards in 2025. Set within 500 acres, available for private-use stays as part of WildLand's 200-year conservation vision.

Name: Beybey
Master_Source_text: Bey Bey is a Miami Beach restaurant and lounge in Sunset Harbour, relaunching under executive chef Roberto Solis of Merida's Hunik, which ranks on Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants.

Name: Byblos
Master_Source_text: Byblos in Saint-Tropez holds France's palace hotel designation (awarded 2012) and is owned by Antoine Chevanne, who also oversees Les Caves du Roy.

Name: Buya Beach
Master_Source_text: Buya Beach is a restaurant and bar set on Praia da Cornelia in Costa da Caparica, about 20 minutes from Lisbon, featured in Forbes' guide to the area.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the dunes of Costa da Caparica near Lisbon, Buya Beach is a beachfront restaurant spun off from the Buya izakaya outposts in Florida and Berlin.
The coastal space blends Portuguese ingredients with Japanese street food flavors, operating as a cultural hub for surfers and artists.
Signature dishes include locally sourced oysters topped with citrus ponzu and ikura, alongside a miso tomahawk steak grilled over a wood fire.

Name: Concours Club
Master_Source_text: Set within Miami-Opa Locka Executive Airport, The Concours Club is a members-only motorsport club with dining led by Culinary Director Brad Kilgore, a James Beard Award nominee.

Name: Dr Cory Abbate

Name: Forma Pilates (LA)
Master_Source_text: Forma Pilates is a referral-only Los Angeles studio founded by Liana Levi in 2020 that has attracted clients including Kendall Jenner, Hailey Bieber, and Bella Hadid.

Name: Flora Plant Kitchen
Master_Source_text: Open since 2023 in Morningside, Miami, Flora Plant Kitchen is a Latin-influenced vegetarian restaurant with Cuban-American chef Fabio Delgado heading the kitchen.

Name: Gospel Tribe
Master_Source_text: Gospel Tribe is the Hamptons expression of Gospel, the SoHo late-night sound-centric club, which extends its program via seasonal pop-ups in Montauk.

Name: Intimo
Master_Source_text: INTI.MO is chef Juan Chipoco's Peruvian-Japanese Nikkei concept, linked to his CVI.CHE 105 and Pollos & Jarras group.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Panama City's San Francisco neighborhood, Intimo is a Panamanian restaurant led by chef Carlos “Chombolín” Alba and recognized by 50 Best Discovery.
The 28-seat dining room focuses on sourcing 90 percent of its ingredients locally, including produce grown directly on-site.
The restaurant's cocktail program, directed by barman Robert Martin, highlights regional flavors through ingredients like hibiscus and local rums.

Master_Source_text: Prospect is the main restaurant at Hotel Jerome, Auberge Resorts Collection, in Aspen, recommended by the Michelin Guide.

A central cocktail bar anchors the interior, while the kitchen draws a regular crowd for its signature Fried Chicken Fridays.
